Released 2026-10-30 · [GitHub release](https://github.com/amajorai/ryu/releases/tag/v0.5.0)

## Highlights

### Accounts, safety, and model routing

Signed-in users can choose a verified primary bot, star it from its main thread, and have desktop chat and the browser extension follow the effective bot with fallback; they can save an interface language followed by website, desktop, and emails across sessions. Ryu ships eleven-language UI coverage, per-surface locale catalogs, recipient-locale email rendering, and cached whole-sentence host translation. Users can start account deletion after a 24-hour step-up link, see a cookie banner that blocks analytics until accepted, and manage secure pairing and brokered secrets.

Users can receive Warn, Throttle, Restrict, or SuspendManaged steps from decayed abuse scores; reviewers void non-S4 strikes, and scheduled detectors cap automatic actions at Restrict. Operators create, preview, assign, and archive guardrail policies, with unassigned policies enforcing nothing; gateways screen admission and streamed output and block qualified hard-code verdicts with 403 platform_floor_blocked. Routing shows one Ryu Router provider with real model names; own-provider models show Free, and campaign free credit pays own-slot requests before plan pool/top-ups. Managed tiers use ryu-&lt;tier>/{lite,standard,max} ids displayed as “Ryu Code Max,” and aliases rewrite responses, SSE, headers, and upstream errors.

Affected packages:

- `ryu-core`
- `Desktop app`
- `Browser extension`
- `@ryu/i18n`
- `@ryu/auth`
- `@ryu/email`
- `@ryu/safety-taxonomy`
- `ryu-gateway`

### Agent approvals, SDKs, knowledge, and durable workflows

Agents with requireApproval pause in requires_action until a user.tool_approval answer; sessions.respondToApproval can mix custom tool results with approvals on Anthropic, and active-run starts accept reject, enqueue, interrupt, or rollback. @ryuhq/sdk/server serves SDK agents with generate and SSE streaming including approvals, workflows with start, stream, resume, cancel, and history, plus tools and local traces; Python ryu_sdk supports generate, agenerate, streaming, tool decorators, middleware, and a workflow DSL.

Teams can read, write, and delete thread or resource working memory through the core API and @ryuhq/core-client, with SDK workingMemory and ctx.memory.working; Spaces import Notion, Google Drive, Confluence, GitHub, and web content then run hybrid filtered retrieval. Workflow script nodes run JavaScript in a Deno sandbox to orchestrate sub-agents with agent(), parallel(), pipeline(), and phase(); each agent() batch is checkpointed by call, so re-runs replay finished agents. Running workflows auto-resume after a crash under a durable two-attempt budget, limits park runs until reset, and users can rewind chats to restore code, conversation, or both.

### Web, mobile, desktop, workbench, and marketplace

Website visitors get a new landing hero and section system, a server-rendered Latest updates strip, and product pages with What it is, How it works, Built for, and Works with sections. On phones, Download opens a bottom drawer with share-sheet, WhatsApp, Telegram, Messages, Email, copy-link, and full-page options; email sign-in and reset codes auto-submit, and pricing seats hand 51+ to Enterprise. Users can switch full-window interfaces from the top bar or Mod+Shift+U, with Settings → Interfaces storing per-interface choices; agent spaces show live act state across 3D passport, World 3D, Rides, and desktop town and kitchen surfaces.

CLI and desktop users get non-wrapping tabs with Alt+1..9, auto-hiding sidebar, F6/Alt+0 focus, shortcut overlay, and empty-chat recent conversations resumable by Alt+1..3; mid-turn Esc keeps partial replies and pauses queued prompts. Workbench tabs share Right/Bottom regions, drag across Center/Right/Bottom, and Board adds a List view beside Kanban with filters, Mod+K, C, and J/K navigation. Marketplace adds a Creators tab with search, sorting, profiles, and handle links; organizations edit bio/links and users join waitlists or redeem points for plan, desktop, and node time. Desktop shares one wallpaper preference across Ryu OS, startup chooser, and Customize, restores saved workbench layouts, and adds Ryu Forms for building and reviewing submissions.

### Creative studios and visual authoring

Video Studio ships timeline editing with cut, trim, ripple, razor, marquee selection, snapping, keyframes, nested sequences, templates, preview transform/color/effects, metering and export presets; editors can make J/L split edits, detach audio, run cleanup plans, use roll/slip/slide trims, freeze frame, reverse, speed ramps, beat cuts and highlights. AutoCut and shorts reframe around tracked subjects, NCC motion tracking drives graphics or tracked blur, AI fills gaps and assembles scripts, and avatar exports preserve lip-sync as overlay layers. Collaboration merges another session’s save into unsaved local edits, reports conflicts in the Changed elsewhere banner, and Download project archive creates a ZIP with the editable package and referenced media.

Voice Studio ships Studio, Library, History and Stories with generation controls, queueing, voice design, preset voices, import/export, recording, transcription, consent and multi-voice script rendering; users set seed, speed, language, delivery instructions, effects, normalization, format, tags, pronunciation and long-script chunking with crossfade. Library handles samples and History adds replay, regenerate, restore, download and stats. Sites users edit pages in a Design panel with canvas drag and drop, layers, inspector, and chat driving one validated, atomic, undoable operation list, while Forms authors add questions through a dedicated insert dialog and edit in place. Desktop users get generative AI resize presets in the image editor, with AI Resize defaulting to the local image model and local image generation defaulting to Qwen Image 2.1.

### `@ryu/api`@0.5.0

#### Minor changes

- Updated the landing-announcement API router and its tests to support background presets and the off state. The router now exposes the settings used by the admin and landing pages. (`2c6d1b5`)
- Added a landing-announcement router with an anonymous read that returns only a currently live bar and an admin read and save behind the isAdmin gate plus a platform.admin step-up, with router tests. (`dc9972d`)
- Added a request-scoped AsyncLocalStorage carrying the request headers and, for ordinary login sessions, the requester's email, plus a request-locale helper and router wiring so resolveRecipientLocale can fall back to it outside Better Auth requests. (`8102af4`)
- Adopted Effect v4 across API modules and added helpers for an unref'd clock, runBackground, scheduledWorker, a background stop registry, linearBackoff and runRoute. Migrated about 20 boot workers including hosted drafts, applied retries, timeouts and concurrency across webhooks, DNS TXT, email broadcast, the managed-agents sweeper, startup seeds, gateway enforcement push, billing status, core proxy, federation and pitch-stats, and split oversized modules such as routers/mail.ts behind stable facades.
- The Watch worker, GitHub partner intake and onboarding connection rewards now read platform feature flags through watch-switches.ts instead of environment variables. The worker is always armed but sweeps only while watch.worker is on, the partner callback returns 503 partner_intake_disabled while watch.github_partner is off, and reward grants stay paused unless onboarding.connection_rewards is on. (`45d1786`)
- Organization event notification emails now go through the localized send path so they render in the recipient's language. (`6458952`)
- Added traffic-summary routes for organization and platform-admin reads with bucketed edges, verdict tallies and window totals, and tightened the usage window ingest so out-of-taxonomy keys and non-additive breakdowns are dropped while the window is kept. (`84dec02`)
- Emitted sessionless appeal links (refKind case or org_status) on ladder Throttle and Restrict notices and automatic org suspensions, storing only sha256(jti) on a new abuseAppealGrant row and never placing the link in the inbox row. Public appeal routes view and file these appeals, and an upheld appeal voids the case's strikes (never S4) and lifts a ladder level or org suspension under the org-lift approval rule. (`37b94dd`)
- Detector jobs gained a pending-event sweep under its own lease that applies stored-but-unapplied strike events older than 5 minutes one at a time. A regression test pins expiresAt as the only TTL on violationEvent. (`d76fe9c`)
- Added abuse engine view data for subject ladder level, caps, score buckets, strike details, detector signals, and propagation lag, plus admin abuse strike routes. The void route audits, rescores affected subjects, refuses S4 strikes, and the engine helpers were covered by persistence-proof tests. (`1355262`)
- The abuse API added the strike ladder, fleet-wide gateway enforcement push with inline and sweep retries, subject review marking, and manual upstream signal intake that wrote synthetic ledger events and filed cases. Admin abuse routes and tests were extended for the new levels, case kinds, propagation, and upstream signals. (`33adc79`)
- Added POST /admin/abuse/signals/:signalId/end behind the platform-admin gate and a fresh step-up, which ends a signal's level and hold plus other active buckets of the same finding on the subject and stores a 1 to 90 day suppression, 30 by default. Dismissing a detector case applies the same to every signal on it, and recordDetectorSignals now stores a suppressed signal with no level, no hold, no audit row and no case. (`66ee21e`)
- Added detectors D1 to D7 with job wrappers and a detectors block in the versioned abuse config; signals dedupe into one open detector case per subject, automatic actions cap at Restrict and write system control audit rows, jobs run under per-detector leases that double as the schedule, and /credits/topup honors checkout holds with a 429. (`d4230ac`)
- Added the strike ledger, abuse config and usage-window modules plus abuse ingest and admin abuse routers, with actions for voiding strikes and recomputing subjects. (`980bed2`)
- Added an optional screener field to PlatformFloorDoc with validation mirroring the gateway screening policy, loosening-diff rules, server-stamped remote-processor approvals, capability-gated /gateway/resolve delivery, overlay rejection, and per-version screener summaries. (`11e97d8`)
- Added the abuse ingest router and its mounting, backed by fleet reporter credential resolution, sealed violation evidence and the violationEvent and violationEvidence persistence. The control plane resolve path now returns credential createdBy, servesEndUsers and identity.saltEpoch, and buildManagedCloudInit refuses user-data that names or carries a Ryu provider key in either inference mode. (`3de04de`)
- Added the guardrail policy store, compiler, preview and routers, compiling org, team, member, key and agent assignments into the bundle read by /gateway/resolve and the per-caller tool policy. Combination follows permit intersection, privacy OR, filter union with the stricter action winning, every budget checked and tighten-only layering, with writes gated on gateway.configure and loosening changes on an org.features step-up. (`68e2c6c`)
- Updated the SSE bus for the boot-validated Mail realtime store and added cluster tests covering the lease handling. (`ae575df`)
- Routed sponsored public agents through the hosted Ryu Gateway's OpenAI-compatible endpoint using rgw_ keys, with fixed refusal replies, the ryu-sponsored model alias and a pa1. visitor digest in x-ryu-end-user. Tightened visitor address handling to reject missing or invalid headers instead of sharing an unattributed bucket. (`752b20e`)
- The platformFloor model, floor document validation, and the hardened root-admin /api/admin/platform-floor API were added, with step-up auth for writes and preview and loosening routed through the shared admin approvals. /gateway/resolve now includes platformFloor in every resolved credential and fails closed with a 503 or platformFloorUnavailable when the floor cannot be read. (`c56b5fc`)
- Added a mail OAuth client policy that checks client ids against orgSecuritySettings.oauthMailClientIds and refuses with 403 oauth_client_not_allowed, failing closed with 503 on store errors. Mail dispatch now aborts after 30 seconds, and the OAuth principal and node delegation paths were updated with corresponding tests. (`b1558ab`)
- Added the admin-abuse router, including a read-only GET /admin/abuse/subjects/:kind/:id profile returning bans, owned and created keys, memberships and cases behind the shared admin read gate, with router tests. (`9092ab4`)
- Added public /api/appeals routes for viewing, submitting and reissuing token-scoped appeals, with per-token-hash and per-IP-hash daily limits, appeal cases carrying a five-business-day SLA, and decision emails. Admin abuse routes gained appeal handling that records cases, notifies pinned admins and applies the lift-ban approval rule. (`5e7fd66`)
- GET /api/control-plane/gateway/resolve now answers with a standing object computed from the org status, the key's own suspension or passed custodian rotation deadline, and the Better Auth ban state of the key's owner, failing closed to standing_unavailable. Only this route passes allowAbuseHold to the live credential lookup, and the managed tier entitlement is read strictly. (`6efb315`)
- The custodian-ban notice now names each affected key with its name and bounded prefix, and the org gateway-keys list returns suspendedAt and rotationRequiredAt. (`1b7b0be`)
- Added the admin-abuse router for bans, lifts, org standing, credential suspension, approvals, cases, assignment, and subject search, with platform-admin and step-up guards. The gateway credential filter now refuses suspended keys and keys past their custodian rotation deadline. (`122e64f`)
- Added accompanying authority tests. (`0ce8b2a`)
- Added opt-in interactive tool approvals on the Anthropic backend: adapters declare capabilities.toolApprovals, session create rejects requireApproval agents on other backends, approval requests join the derived pending set, and unanswered requests are denied at expiresAt with a tool_approval_timeout error. (`3dd0fa9`)
- Added a control-plane router for listing, committing, labelling, resolving, diffing, and node mirroring organization prompts, gated by agent permissions, along with an in-memory registry store. (`1a68bcd`)
- Regenerated the academy questions data to use the new mode and Console naming. (`315c4a0`)
- Added the account deletion engine with its journalled, resumable steps, a policy table covering user-linked collections with a guard test, external-service cleanup helpers, and a user route that starts a deletion request. Persistence and HTTP proof tests cover both id storage shapes, resume after failure, blockers and refused sign-in afterwards. (`3c2de4a`)
- The TypeScript vault policy evaluator now mirrors templated paths, parameter constraints and control-group validation, running the new shared fixture cases alongside the Rust implementation. (`9ff5075`)
- Added a helper that reads the signed ryu_flags claim from a Core identity token, with tests. (`648392d`)
- Feature flags gained server-derived audience targeting through a per-flag catalog declaration that the evaluator applies as a trailing rule, with reserved traits stripped from client-supplied attributes and audience presets in the admin UI. The cloud box backend is now gated behind cloud_tasks.box_backend, default off. (`14a41e2`)

(`870d2e1`)

- Redacted or omitted child-safety facts from admins who may not see S4: key suspension reasons, org standing reasons and S4 case ids, plus S4 bans and the approvals that lift them, while enforcement stays visible. Approve, reject and S4 ban lift now answer 404 for those admins, and a case id in a request body must name a case the admin may see. (`5a6c800`)
- Stopped keying the appeal per-IP daily allowance on the literal "unknown" when no trustworthy client address resolves, so banned users no longer share a single 20-call bucket. (`8550da7`)
- Made a ban keep every unexpired appeal token hash so POST /appeals/reissue adds a token instead of replacing the stored one, preventing anyone who knows the banned address from invalidating an open appeal link. (`e148695`)
- Made racing ban requests re-read the user's effective bans after inserting, so the earliest row keeps the ban and a losing request removes its own row and is refused instead of leaving two bans that neither can lift. (`ba647da`)
- Made voidStrike commit the void and every subject rescore in one transaction, so a failed rescore leaves the strike active and the call can be retried. (`b49e6af`)
- Lifting a gateway key suspension imposed for S4 or an upstream account warning now files a lift_credential_suspension approval when two or more platform admins are pinned, and the executor refuses an unsigned lift. New suspensions cannot relabel an approval-gated reason, writes compare-and-set on the stored reason, and an S4 key is a 404 for admins who may not see S4 cases. (`967af22`)

- Traffic summaries no longer draw a provider node left with zero requests after output-block overlap is removed from provider edges. An edge is kept only when it still carries the window cost. (`6f8fdd8`)

- Fleet host status reporting was added to the admin managed nodes API, with a host-status helper and a fleet router endpoint backed by tests. Cloud provisioning and the servers router were merged, keeping the stricter side where both branches changed the same code. (`3970ebe`)

- A decided appeal now blocks only links minted before it was filed, so a Restrict after a denied Throttle appeal or a new step after an upheld one gets an appealable link, while an open appeal still blocks every link to the action. An upheld appeal on a provider-forced ladder level voids its strikes but leaves the level for a second pinned admin, with persistence proofs for both paths. (`e0fd73f`)
- Ran each resumed and newly applied S4 strike through runChildSafetyPathsSettled, recording attempt count, last error and a capped exponential backoff per strike instead of stopping the sweep at the first throw. Strikes that never failed are picked up first, and after three failures a strike is noted once on the org's open S4 case and reported through childSafetyFailed and childSafetyEscalated. (`6ea472d`)
- The pending-event sweep now also picks up S4 strikes with no childSafetyHandledAt older than the grace window and reruns their idempotent child safety path. The sweep's ladder pass is time-boxed to 5 minutes so a backlog cannot outlast the 15-minute job lease. (`f34a2f5`)
- POST /abuse/strikes/:strikeId/void now finds every case listing the strike through AbuseCase.strikeIds, adds a validated body caseId first, audits the first as caseId with all of them in details.caseIds, and writes one timeline entry per case. Strike views resolve caseId the same way, opening an open case before the newest. (`4071399`)
- Gateway keys no longer read inbox createdWith while the value is still stored. createdWith is now returned on mail.manage inbox replies, including the agent-inbox 200 replay and 409 body, PATCH /inboxes/:id and POST /inboxes/:id/address, and the audit target is mail-inbox instead of mail. (`56c278a`)
- Changed automatic suspension to judge an org's effective standing rather than raw status, with compare-and-set writes on statusEpoch, and kept S4-held subjects and S4 strike weight out of ladder reviews. - The abuse ladder began holding a key at Restrict instead of suspending it when a score or upstream identifier block requested SuspendManaged, and it recorded a suspend_key recommendation on open cases while keeping org suspension automatic. (`818efa7`)
- Hosted Mail listLimit began returning 400 for a limit that was not a whole number on the inbox and message lists, matching self-hosted Mail's u32 query. createUniqueInbox re-read by clientKey before answering an explicit-localPart create with taken or held, and the invisible-owner clientId 409 carried the stable code client_id_taken. (`6e9611a`)
