- The end-signal route and a dismissed detector case now write the platform audit row before any level or hold ends. The D4 transfer refund filter runs server-side in Mongo without a regex flag, matching refund-reconcile.ts. (`89b96ee`)
- Top-up credits now stamp the org and, when the checkout names one, the paying user on the ledger row, and D4 resolves a top-up's org through its wallet so legacy rows without attribution still count, while D3 decides hotness per IP and stops reading User.lastLoginIp. The free-credit-only test for D1 and D2 is now read per org wallet as no top-up or gift card ever plus no plan pool grant in 40 days, and D5 and D6 count only strike-bearing violation events. (`acc861a`)
- Authorization across context and request handling, node delegation, managed-agent principals, org access policy and admin ops, vault storage, fleet secrets and node lists, marketplace transfers, servers transfer receiver policy and watch was tightened, with access-denial auditing added and admin API keys and API key auth updated. (`abe439c`)
- The concurrent-duplicate existing branch of Mail POST /inboxes now builds its response from the inbox view, so an OAuth grant never sees webhookUrl there. Added coverage in the mail send authorization and OAuth principal tests. (`c30e69e`)
- Cloud provisioning and admin host-status handling were updated for the patching review fixes, including nodes without a pinned signing key that only report available releases. (`cdbdbed`)
- Limited the resolve ladder to Throttle and Restrict so Warn stays a notice and a case, named the signal rather than the shared cluster id in tenant audit rows for cluster signals, and added a route test for the 429 topup_temporarily_unavailable refusal with its Retry-After plus a concurrent case-filing proof. (`af9ef10`)
- Merged the incoming security-advisory branch into the brotli request guard at src/lib/brotli-request-guard.ts. (`fbb3063`)
- Hosted Mail inbox creation now stores a scope-qualified clientKey under the one_inbox_per_client_id partial index and maps an overlapping create to the inbox the other create made; message search accepts before/after paging. Added coverage in the mail-hosted-quotas tests. (`b577e2c`)
- Added API handling for managed-node host patch status: provisioning, admin managed-node listing, fleet host-status ingestion, and server responses now carry the patch fields. (`087b149`)
- The S4 child-safety path now suspends the credential through the admin executor's writes and pushes invalidation to the fleet gateway, and S4 takes its full weight outside the per-request cap in ingest, recompute, and void. (`a71f4eb`)
- Refreshed the legal hold for every S4 event behind a strike on each ingest and listed each event id on the case, and ordered recomputeSubject strikes by batch, occurrence and event id to match the incremental path, with a persistence proof across ten days of decay. (`e3d550d`)
- Added a Brotli request guard in the API package so inbound br-encoded requests are rejected before the body is parsed. (`f07101a`)
- Touched request context and a wide set of routers and libs covering authorization paths such as billing scope, org access policy, feature flag evaluation, SSE re-authorization, step-up, support access, template rewards and vault policy, most with accompanying tests. Committed as a work-in-progress checkpoint before the fix workflow resumed. (`94a7b68`)
- Changed the hosted mail unconfigured 503 response so it no longer names an internal docs path, and updated the accompanying security test. (`3b5e347`)
- Updated the request body limit test for the Hono 413 behaviour and the scheduled server run test. (`4446e10`)
- Extended the account deletion policy so every user-referencing field has a rule: connectKey.memberUserId, deviceUsageDaily.userId, userActivityDay.userId and sentEmail.userId are deleted, while actor ids for audit, message and org-prompt authors and staff-run records are retained as org content. (`b458f58`)
- Updated the marketplace-membership settlement test to forward the overloaded updateOne without a bad cast. (`a95cb71`)
- Changed platform-floor screener role removal to always count as floor loosening, including remote processors, so it requires second-admin approval as specified. Added a regression test for dropping the only qualified remote textHazard backend and updated the remote round-trip expectation. (`b93d292`)
- Documented that the platform floor's version and contentHash are unchanged when the screener field is withheld, so a consumer that newly advertises screener capability must refetch instead of reusing a stored floor. (`0740c74`)
- A reporter holding gateway.violations.report is treated as the hosted fleet: its keyDaily and teamDaily buckets are grouped by the org owning each key or team and ingested under that tenant, audit rows are credited to the orgId they name after the same credential and membership checks as violation ingest, unknown or foreign keys are rejected, and spend alerts run per tenant. Appeal labels and the abuse console read the shared taxonomy, and case and ban codes must be taxonomy codes. (`83cd6a8`)
- Abuse ingest now purges and blocks excerpts fleet-wide only for S4 verdicts from fleet or managed_node sources, while a self_reported S4 affects only its own reporter. Remote processor records are parsed by processorId and counted only when an approvedBy from a second admin differs from recordedBy, with regression tests for both paths. (`038f7c9`)
- The organization lister in mail-oauth-organizations was rebuilt over injectable models via mailOAuthOrganizationsDepsFor so the query chain is unit-tested. It starts no further query once the abort signal has fired. (`779a0c1`)
- A regression test imports the module with only PATH and HOME set. (`434e29c`)
- The marketplace publisher earnings report now classifies each stored distribution status explicitly, so cancelled and manual_reconciliation rows no longer count as pending earnings. Tests cover the refund-held states. (`b331b15`)
- Changed the marketplace membership settlement and organization integrations store and router, and updated the channels, telemetry, marketplace performance and removed-server credential persistence-proof tests. (`25b3cbe`)
- Applied checkpointed authorization changes across API key auth, fleet enrollment, gateway credentials, GitHub marketplace install binding, managed agent principals, managed node access, node delegation, org admin ops, and the control-plane, marketplace and registry routers, with accompanying authorization tests. (`cb1312d`)
- resolvePolicy now applies the tighten-only rules beneath a lock, so lower layers keep narrowing a locked allowlist and keep adding to a locked deny list, with the lock reported only in lockedFields. Regression tests cover the review probe, a lock with no value, and the create, update and replace assignment routes. (`f3204ba`)
- A member policy budget now starts from memberDefault when the member has no explicit limit, and an archived policy that is still assigned keeps being enforced instead of failing every resolve. Added a resolve wiring test covering firewall, teamFirewall with the evaluator binding, and limits.keys for the resolved credential, with policyVersion moving on a budget change. (`60ac2b5`)
- Updated public-agent execution tests to map credential-level Gateway blocks to unavailable rather than the visitor-paused reply. (`f9b3bf5`)
- Reworked hosted Mail realtime so it fails closed when shared state is lost: socket lease renewal now checks matchedCount and closes stale sockets with 1012, ticket and lease acquisition pre-check limits and delete rows on failed recounts, and the event relay resumes from the same token for transient errors while restarting only on change-stream errors 286, 280 and 136. Shared-store failures on ticket issue, redemption or lease acquire now return 503 realtime_store_unavailable with retry-after, and degraded realtime is logged through reportMailRealtimeFailure. Added releaseAll() and releaseMailRealtimeSocketLeases() for graceful shutdown. (`d0c1699`)
- Checkpointed in-progress edits to the channels router test file as part of the security audit remediation snapshot. (`06fd049`)
- Reworked stale node actions and the servers router, including capacity handling, and added persistence-proof and capacity tests. (`20148de`)
- parsePlatformFloorDoc now rejects a disabled floor evaluator binding with a 422 and the diff counts a newly added binding as loosening unless it is enabled. The /gateway/resolve contract text now describes tighten-only floor overlays, with the gateway side of that rule left unimplemented and unverified here. (`e0cb4b1`)
- Added a ratchet guard test that freezes the remaining coarse org-role gates: new authorization gates must check a named Permission, each surviving role-literal comparison is listed with its reason, and the count may only shrink. (`fd7b8da`)
- A broad set of API library modules and routers were changed, including cloud provisioning, control audit, creator program, fleet enrollment, org integrations, Stripe and Polar webhooks, shared-budget contributions, channel user quota, aggregation, control-plane, conversations sync, fleet, org verification, Telegram login and watch, with persistence-proof tests added for several of them. (`85b0971`)
- The floor console now expires lapsed loosen_platform_floor requests with the same guarded update the abuse sweep uses before it reads or writes, so a stale pending request no longer blocks the next loosening with a 409 until someone opens the approvals page. A persistence proof test was added. (`d3bf190`)
- Checkpointed unreviewed migration edits made before a container restart, touching the control-plane router and the watch router with its tests. (`f24d192`)
- Checkpointed the in-progress unnamed-review role-gate migration across the credits library and the aggregation, control-plane, conversation-shares, org-domains, org-verification, servers, user and watch routers, with accompanying tests. (`c71bd4b`)
- Implicit service-account keys now drop OPT_IN_ONLY_SCOPES, so owner and admin keys get prompts:read but not prompts:manage or mail:manage unless requested, and apiRouter reads the server requestId through a Context helper; org-admin tests updated. (`a856ecb`)
- Target-side marketplace transfer approval now checks marketplace.transfer alone, so a custom role holding it can accept transfers, while source-side approval keeps its owner-only gate. Reward node placement now checks nodes.manage, matching fleet. (`e228e62`)
- Org-admin Mail client saves that only remove clients now stay applied when the audit write fails, while additions are reverted from a pre-image of every written field and return a 503 stating the save was undone. The Mail realtime authority records the address that opened the socket and re-runs the org IP allowlist during 60-second revalidation, closing with 4001 when it no longer matches. (`052e596`)
- Updated managed-agent ID handling and the managed-agents router, adding ID tests and a gate test and registering the router in the routers index. (`e0b0307`)
- Anchored the prompt-registry audit exemption to the /api/control-plane/orgs/:orgId/prompts path so other routers' paths containing /orgs/&lt;id>/prompts are still audited. Also touched prompt API-key auth, node delegation and the prompt registry module, with matching router and unit tests. (`f3eeb2f`)
- Added lib/mail-realtime-authority.ts, which re-checks the org IP allowlist at upgrade and re-verifies each open socket's credential every 60 seconds, closing it with 4001 on failure. Ticket and socket budgets are now counted per owner as well as per principal, socket slots are reserved at server.upgrade(), and socket lifetime dropped from 1 hour to 15 minutes. (`5445a72`)
- PUT /orgs/:orgId/security-settings now writes Mail app list changes with findOneAndUpdate and a pre-image, so each concurrent save audits its own added and removed ids without storing the full list. The audit is fail-closed: if it cannot be recorded the list is restored and the request fails with 503, and client ids over 512 characters or containing whitespace, control or format characters are rejected with a 400. (`cae99e4`)
- Snapshotted broad in-progress edits across cloud provisioning, the Polar webhook, rewards entitlements, server transfer authority and transfer flows, and the servers router, with accompanying persistence-proof, authorization, and capacity tests. The commit notes the work was still mid-edit and unverified. (`113293c`)
- Refreshed package dependencies to align with the next@16.4.1 patch refresh. (`0be4e6b`)
- Applied review fixes across billing, credits and debits, connect keys and policy, marketplace rollout, messaging, box credentials and fleet, prompt registry, and spend and grant logic, with matching tests updated. User email, password, and verification router tests were also adjusted. (`1cc077c`)
- Gave appeal submissions their own token_submit bucket of 3 per day so page reloads no longer spend the submit allowance shared with views. (`65a15bb`)
- Billing, credits, gifting, refund reconciliation, account merge, org admin and usage ingest, SCIM credential rotation, aggregation, channels, Composio relay, control-plane, enterprise identity, conversations sync, and watch routers were edited. New persistence and proof tests were added for several of these paths as part of an in-progress, unverified audit snapshot. (`f5cb5be`)
- Mail drafts scheduled with a service-account key record the account and key ids and are re-checked at send time, refusing if the account was deleted, lost mail.manage, or the key was revoked or expired, otherwise sending as the organization. The Box bridge copies X-Request-ID, Idempotent-Replayed and Retry-After onto forwarded responses, and Watch error bodies use the server request id with a matching X-Request-ID header. (`ffd6890`)
- Updated the org-admin and watch routers along with the wide-event analytics helper, adding tests for the wide-event helper and both routers. (`0a9e1de`)
- The admin-abuse router now returns a targetLabel for the approvals list and case page, resolving to the user's email or the org's name. Router tests were updated to cover the new field. (`2166826`)
- The Box 402 insufficient_credits response body now uses the request's id and also sends it as the X-Request-ID header, so the header and body agree. Router tests were added for the behavior. (`6a36c9a`)
- An in-progress, unverified audit remediation snapshot touched cloud provisioning, the Polar webhook, the policy write guard, scheduled actions, server transfer and the control-plane and servers routers. (`b1fd623`)
- Updated a broad set of API libraries and routers, including billing, channels, Composio relay, conversations and shares, credits, marketplace, org verification, SCIM credential rotation, servers, SSE routes, scheduled actions and payment webhooks, each with accompanying tests. (`3a960fa`)
- Made appeal outcome emails reach the person on every lift path, including upheld decisions, the ban lift route and approved lift_ban requests, and reopened an upheld appeal with a fresh review window when a lift_ban is rejected or expires. Added a 32 KiB request body limit registered ahead of the public /appeals routes so oversized bodies end in 413 before any rate limit is counted, and made decide_case write the appeal decision and audit row before anything takes effect with a rollback if either write fails. (`a24a722`)
- Kept open appeal cases out of the open-case lookup so new manual cases and bans for the same user no longer attach to an appeal case or get refused as duplicates. Stored the ban-time email address in lowercase so a reissue request matches it exactly. (`8ae77b3`)
- Tightened API-key authentication and limit handling, managed-agent principal checks and router error responses, adding a route proof harness for tests. (`2715d44`)
- A refusing standing is returned only to callers that send x-ryu-resolve-capabilities: standing; otherwise a held key, a banned owner or a full org suspension gets the generic 401 and standing_unavailable gets a retryable 503, both before any bootstrap exchange or usage stamp. The minimal refusing body carries managedTierUnavailable so a cache keyed on it stays at the negative TTL, and a shared org status parser makes other gateway-key routes refuse a fully suspended org. (`ace4dea`)
- The refused-key resolve test now asserts no lastUsedAt stamp for a held key and one for an active key, and the held-key source guard scans every lib and router file, allowing allowAbuseHold only in gateway-credential.ts and the single control-plane.ts definition. (`8fdc9bb`)
- Changed resumeBan to require the stored ban to match the request's permanence and reason class, refusing mismatches with ActionNotAppliedError so an approval stays pending. The abuse case view now shows completed and failed steps for each ban. (`3cd443d`)
- Banning a user now deletes their personal Better Auth API keys and blocks personal keys whose owner is banned, while executeBan records each step and repeat ban requests finish missing steps instead of returning 409. Lifting refuses expired or non-sole bans, temporary bans are capped at 90 days, and the custodian rule skips Fleet node credentials. (`8696486`)
- Merged API library and router changes for credits, organization spend, tag budgets, tool catalog browse and search, tool reconciliation, Connect policy, and audit export. (`0588629`)
- Documented in the feature-flag audience code that organizations created by Better Auth's raw adapter carry no standing fields on disk, so absent must be treated as active. (`f3d646d`)
- Added Managed Agents tool approvals across the driver, event, store and type modules, plus an Anthropic backend adapter with tool normalization. Added a prompt registry with an in-memory store and a prompts router, with tests for the adapter, driver, store, registry and router. (`b1b04f3`)
- The managed-agents router test was changed to read the request body once instead of twice, fixing pre-existing test breakage. (`25e016b`)
- `RateLimit-Policy` for `userEventBytesPerOrgPerDay` now carries `qu="content-bytes"`, and the gate test derives `Access-Control-Expose-Headers` from the router's exported `EXPOSED_HEADERS` so the two cannot drift. Rate-limit header, quota and error modules were updated with their tests. (`685bc68`)
- Mail route classes now resolve at any mount depth through a middleware that records where the router is mounted, so keyed requests no longer fail under the flattened production mount. Service-account keys were clamped to their account role's permissions and attributed to the org, and an inbox webhookUrl is only returned to a principal holding mail:manage. (`f67ea40`)
- The API gained managed-agent approvals, an Anthropic backend adapter with event normalization and tool mapping, and a driver and store for managed-agent runs. A prompt registry backed by a memory store was added and exposed through a new prompts router. (`dac9704`)
- Reconciled the merge so the API server keeps its Brotli guard, Connect token router and credential sweep alongside the incoming OIDC discovery, idempotency, problem-details, deprecation and rate-limit headers. API-key auth and limits, managed-agent principals and router error handling were updated with matching tests. (`fac7b6d`)
- Added libraries and routers for connect keys, connect tokens, connect policies, tool catalog browse and search, tool reconciliation, tag budgets, own supply, service billing and settlement, credits, and spend tags, with accompanying tests. Updated the control-plane and credits routers and the shared router index. (`53d1e5f`)
- Added the messaging router with idempotency, media, webhooks, rate limiting, budgets, billing and auth modules, and extended credits, credit holds, credit debit reasons, org spend, node delegation, feature flags and org admin routes to support it. (`8918d18`)
- Added a Brotli request guard module and bumped package dependencies to the versions required by the October 2026 advisories. (`69f6758`)
- The API package's dependency manifest now pins sharp >= 0.35.5 and moves Next.js to 16.4.1. (`d9763a2`)
- API routers and managed-agent adapters now seal user content and PII, and mail send approvals and login approvals open sealed rows instead of serving ciphertext. Added a seal-content-backfill script plus tests covering the sealed persistence paths. (`07be026`)
- Added a Brotli request guard module to the API package and refreshed its dependencies. (`dbca3d8`)
- Reworked the managed agents driver, store, events, approvals and types, and updated the Anthropic backend adapter, normalization and tool handling. (`d65aa91`)
- Added a prompts router and a prompt registry memory store, registered in the API router index. Router and registry behavior are covered by new tests. (`450ad11`)
- The managed-agents driver now appends the approval denial first and records the timeout only for denials that were actually written, so a client answer racing the expiry no longer leaves a misleading tool_approval_timeout error. (`fc61a4f`)
- The managed-agents router test mock now exports the new api-key-limits helpers. (`837cdc8`)
- Version diffs in the prompt registry now trim the common prefix and suffix and cap the LCS table, so diffing two large templates cannot allocate gigabytes. The node sync feed loads a page's versions in a single query, and nested template lookups read own fields only. (`b4bb75d`)
- Scoped the no-store header to the prompt routes in the prompts router and updated the router tests. (`ce6fa05`)
- Allowed per-key API responses now carry RateLimit-Policy and RateLimit headers, applied in the API key auth and managed-agent principal paths. (`2a0361e`)
- Per-key 429 responses now include Retry-After and RateLimit/RateLimit-Policy headers, and unhandled API router errors return application/problem+json. (`f000e94`)
- Regenerated the academy questions data file. (`decdea6`)
- Brought in the pricing money-path fixes and plan versioning across billing, credits, gifts, plan grants, pool refresh and margin checks. Added Box tenancy, fleet monitoring, reconcile, storage retention and credential routers, plus feature-flag rollout storage and audience handling. (`1a4ce6b`)
- Added Connect key, token, tool-policy and access-token handling with corresponding routers, plus own-supply catalog and store logic. Extended credits, ledger tags, service billing and credit, tag budgets, tool catalog browsing and search, and tool reconciliation, reliability and reviews, with tests across each area. (`cd32c28`)
- Added messaging routers and library code covering sending, media, idempotency, inbound handling, webhooks, auth, billing, budgets and rate limiting. Extended credits, credit holds and debit reasons, org spend, service credit, standalone credit funding, org access routes, control-plane bootstrap, feature flags, node delegation and the request body limit; messaging and mail errors are read from `code` first with a fallback to `error`. (`a00d2f8`)
- Hardened org access auth routes, the channels router with channel.manage for org channels, platform identity, scheduled server runs and the enterprise audit export, with tests alongside each. (`784fd89`)
- Reworked the checkout, billing, credits, gifts, marketplace, affiliate and seller routers along with first-party checkout, Polar payment methods, marketplace license renewal, seller account sessions and the Stripe webhook, each with updated tests. (`46c7a7c`)
- Reworked composed tool earnings, credit debiting, and service usage settlement so fees come only from top-up credit, added composed_fee_unpinned enforcement for out-of-org runs, and changed reconciliation to re-check unmatched refs before flagging lag. Also updated the tool catalog policy checks and connect policy router. (`22b79ea`)
- Merged the marketplace router and its tests against the updated marketplace contracts. (`9caf05c`)
- Regenerated the academy questions data file to match the renamed terminology. (`8dd69c1`)
- Reworked Connect access tokens, Connect key operations and tool policy, service billing and usage settlement, credits and spend tracking, own-supply catalog and store logic, and tool catalog browse and reliability, updating the related routers and tests. (`dfa5f1a`)
- Applied a broad update across API routers, libraries, and tests, spanning managed-agent backends for Anthropic, Gemini, OpenAI, ryu-node, and ryu-serverless along with billing, family-sharing, and organization modules. Persistence-proof test coverage and TypeScript configs were updated alongside the source. (`ddf18f0`)
- The API package merged Box tenant billing bindings and Connect key-feed support, with billing status, usage settlement, connect keys, tool catalog, own-supply, and credits modules updated. Both admin routers are now mounted. (`6c55e19`)
- Added composed tool definitions and settlement, including composed_tool_earnings crediting, a connect_composed receipt reason, and the COMPOSED_TOOL_FEES platform take held equal to published pricing. Review handling, the call journal, arena plan/leaderboard logic, and tool catalog browse rows were extended alongside these additions. (`b35f715`)
- Took main's content across the API package, including billing, credits, feature flags, family sharing, marketplace, organization administration, and the managed-agent backends and routers with their tests. The relabeling from the merge was applied where these files reference the Agent, Bot, OS, and Console names, and the package and TypeScript config files were carried over. (`a01db11`)
- The tool catalog library now parses and validates the freeRoute field on curated entries, with tests for free-route handling and search. (`f812e66`)
- Merged main's review fixes for the interface surface and data model across the API package, touching account merge, billing and credit, family sharing, feature flags, marketplace, org admin, vault policy and the route tests. Also pulled in the managed-agents backends for Anthropic, Gemini, OpenAI, Ryu node and Ryu serverless along with their fixtures and persistence-proof tests. (`cdb7957`)
- Regenerated the academy questions data file. (`5def049`)
- Added read-only tool reconciliation and vendor statement routers served under /api/admin, with tests covering the reconciliation and router logic. (`92b9137`)
- Added per-tag budgets and tag rollups to the Connect policy feed, settlement debits, ledger rows, credits and org spend paths, with control-plane routers for authoring tag budgets and exporting per-tag spend as CSV. Backed by new tests for tag budgets, debit organization, usage settlement and the connect tool policy. (`0be3017`)
- Added hybrid tool-catalog search to the browse router and a new /catalog/search route. BM25 results are fused with embedding similarity by weighted reciprocal rank fusion, and an optional judge model reorders the top results; Gateway failures fall back to the exact BM25 result with a disclosed reason. (`6275cd5`)
- Changed seed merging so a curated catalog row added later under an endpoint id already seeded by the generated tier replaces the generated record, matching the existing curated-wins behaviour on operation collisions. (`fc2eaf2`)
- The control plane now seeds generated catalog rows as unverified beside curated ones, retires rows that leave their spec or become covered by a curated row, and refuses admin-created generated rows. Published and browse rows carry operation and spec, and /tools marks generated rows. (`9b28010`)
- Admin edits that change a catalog entry's docsUrl, docsCheckedOn or probes now reset its verdict to unverified, and the reliability feed shares one in-flight computation and remembers failures. The exa.search.fast price row is marked unverified. (`d706825`)
- Hardened the enterprise audit export, org access auth routes, channels, platform identity and scheduled server run handlers, with tests added alongside each change. (`8aa68aa`)
- Added the public tool-catalog-browse router serving platforms, single platform and endpoint lookups plus reliability, backed by libraries that project the published catalog into the /catalog/* shape with server-side comparison rows. (`c6f0190`)
- Added the connect-tokens router for hosted OAuth exchange, console-session minting and the JWKS endpoint, plus the connect-policy router serving the policy feed, with supporting token and policy libraries and tests. (`0a3f54d`)
- Added the connect_vendor credit debit reason and extended org spend, receipt charge claims, service usage adapters and settlement, and the tool catalog to handle vendor calls and operator pricing. (`33ed570`)
- Added a tool catalog store and router with a public published-catalog route and admin curation routes, plus router tests. (`4e0ce3f`)
- Updated connect-keys so a member key leaves the key feed on demotion to viewer and a viewer cannot rotate an old member key, with tests. Adjusted service-billing-status and its tests for the billing feed. (`88eb472`)
- Added Connect key operations for minting, rotating and revoking keys, storing only SHA-256 digests, plus a connect-keys router with a feed endpoint. Service billing status and usage settlement now include self-serve tenants through their sealed settlement keys. (`89e1cd4`)
- Updated the marketplace router so agent identity mode is carried through store listings and installs, with matching tests. (`a976834`)
- Extended the service billing status feed to send each tenant's headroom and settlement cursor plus Composio add-ons, with related changes in service-credit and service-billing-status. (`720e482`)
- Settled native Connect calls under the connect_native reason at 400 micro-USD per call, added the reason to debit enums, ledger reason and funding lists, and made the receipt claim cover both composio and connect_native on one key. (`3c1530c`)
- Enforced messaging:read and messaging:manage API-key scopes clamped to the creator's org permissions, with per-key, member and org stop budgets checked before a credit hold. Hardened number lifecycle handling with resumable purchases, reconciliation of unconfirmed purchases and releases, release irreversibility, per-org caps, and number.suspended / number.released webhooks, and limited captures so they cannot debit past spendable minus other open holds. (`4123af0`)
- Changed /api/credits/debit to answer Polar's reused-with-a-different-amount response as a duplicate rather than a 5xx, with tests. (`e19f85d`)
- Added plan price versioning and migration runtime paths, changed the margin check and provider cost calculations to include mail and storage, and extended the admin pricing, servers and Polar webhook routers with matching tests. (`add69f1`)
- Reworked the plan-migration runtime and billing notifications: re-planned items get their own notice sequence, canary items gate release and can be freed through an audited admin route, replan limits withdraw with an email instead of throwing, and failed items back off 15 min / 1 h / 4 h. Renewal order checks now page and re-check a missing order, cancelPendingActions uses conditional updates and returns 409 on a lost race, and margin alerts only stamp lastNotifiedAt after a delivered notification. (`11ba455`)
- Added the daily plan-margin check with deduped alerts and admin emails, the plan migration runtime and executor, and the /api/admin/pricing admin router with preview, arm, pause, resume, cancel and skip operations. Also added the PlanPriceChangeEmail stages, a Polar product guard, provider cost table and feature flag support. (`2e02025`)
- Added a mail hosted quotas test covering the case where stored mail exceeds the new cap: existing mail is kept while new inbound mail, sends and drafts are refused. (`cf308da`)
- Added wallet credit holds with atomic admission and capped capture, the messaging ledger reason across debit and spend accounting, and the /api/messaging router for numbers, SMS, MMS, voice, WhatsApp, messages, opt-outs, settings, customer webhooks, admin sender assignment and signed SNS event routes, gated by the messaging.hosted flag, the products.messaging org feature and the new permissions. Includes quote, hold, settle and lease sweep billing logic, rate limiting, webhooks and idempotency helpers. (`5884e54`)
- Fixed provisioning and Polar webhook handling for grandfathered included slots: unkeyed legacy rows are adopted when their server exists, never-created slots past the plan's grant stay inert, and adopt-by-name runs before the fresh stock gate. Newly created included rows use the plan's base server type regardless of what was recorded, and regression tests cover each case. (`dd63639`)
- The feature-flags router test now exercises the stale-org rule against a default-off service, since services.box defaults on. (`00993b8`)
- Cloud provisioning, stock lookup and Hetzner catalog code moved to one cx23 base server per plan with a cpx22 fallback for organization plans, and plan downgrades now shrink the node in place instead of swapping the stock-upgrade path. Plan stock, node capacity, included grants, scheduled actions, the Polar webhook, marketplace rollout and Box flag gating were updated alongside, with Box remaining default-on. (`12a74a7`)
- The Core flag claim test was updated for cloud_tasks.subscription_backends defaulting on and for the new off-by-default hosted OpenAI flag carried to Core. (`ab3f8b9`)
- Override edits on a row with a stale Paid share are now checked only against the price, and the refusal directs operators to lower Paid share to Off instead of pointing at the pool. Pool ceiling updates invalidate the cached own-supply allowances. (`d7c977c`)
- Credits, campaigns, the campaigns router and the control plane returned to base, with the reserved-micro-USD handshake fields, grant headroom projection and 90-day expiry plumbing removed. The control plane now derives paid pool refusal from the allowance figures, so raising a dial on a capped pool is refused and the reason is always reported. (`bd42373`)
- Excluded anonymous sessions from the platform_admin audience even when they carry a verified ADMIN_EMAILS address. Also updated the core flag claim test to expect the subscription-backends key beside cloud_tasks.box_backend. (`ab4d473`)
- Restored pre-dial issuance rules in `reservePoolBudget` and `GET /api/campaigns/active` so campaign, referral and challenge grants are not refused while all paid dials are at 0, gating served-supply headroom on a dial being set and recording `paidRolloutBps` at row creation. Updated credits, own-supply and campaigns tests accordingly. (`c5f7e38`)
- Reserve pool budget now takes the new grant's expiry and uses the later of it and the outstanding grants' horizon, with the horizon rule looking at most 90 days ahead so open-ended grants no longer zero far-off pools. The public active-campaigns route reads headroom from minute-old cached own-supply inputs, and only reservations read fresh. (`ea63598`)
- Credit and campaign logic now derives own-supply grant headroom from the ledger via readOwnSupplyGrantHeadroom, withholds an own-supply tier from the active campaigns response when the supply bound would refuse it, and stops subtracting paid spend from per-pool remaining. (`ff1c766`)
- Added mail routers and libraries covering aliases, domains, send policy and approvals, inbound routing, webhooks, audit, hosted quotas and agent address views. (`a9b90d7`)
- Box core reconciliation and service usage adapters were updated, and the Box fleet alerts router changed with accompanying tests. (`418a3a7`)
- Merged a broad set of API libraries and routers, including Box tenants, credentials, fleet monitor and alerts, core reconcile, storage retention, plan stock and plan node upgrades, scheduled actions, feature flags, gifts, vault policy, credits, and service billing and usage modules, along with their tests. The merge kept this branch's depositFeeCap and the per-size Box rates and 5-minute minimum from the Box branch, and took the union of both sides' polar webhook, gifts, and feature flag tests. (`b4f7dfd`)
- Updated the credits and own-supply libraries plus the campaigns and control-plane routers for the reworked reserve, grant issuance and paid-consumption accounting, with tests covering the new behaviour. (`5ed7ca2`)
- Added the fail-closed plans.plus_public flag and gated Plus on it: /checkout refuses plus-* slugs unless the flag is on or the request carries the private offer, /subscription/change and its quote refuse switching into Plus while private, and the gifts router refuses new Plus subscription gifts. (`4ee5551`)
- Updated the seal-content backfill to check the key against message address digests and phase-1 credentials before storing the canary, and guarded sibling writes with compare-and-set. Also touched managed-agent ID helpers. (`b669383`)
- Own-supply prices now carry cache read and write rates, and paid traffic only draws on a pool's allowance above the free credit still outstanding against it via reservedMicroUsd on the resolve handshake. The control plane refuses to publish a paid dial on a row with an admin price override or a zero catalog price, and credits handling was updated accordingly. (`237ebfe`)
- Added a service-usage adapter test that pins the control plane's pricing of native Connect receipts so the charge stays unchanged. (`f179f7e`)
- Added paidRolloutBps to the own-supply store and admin router input with bounded validation and audit, covered by router tests. (`8669361`)
- The Box core reconcile helper was updated as part of moving minimum waivers to a signed token. (`7a945e0`)
- The marketplace router now reflects the organization switch performed before the license and payouts pages read the active organization. (`2f85a81`)
- The seal-content backfill run test was adjusted to type-check under unchecked index access. (`0c02697`)
- The control-plane reconcile now accepts a resume the Box service waived and flags ticks that skipped a minimum the Box service did not waive; usage adapters carry the waiver fields. (`bd81831`)
- The seal-content backfill now treats its key canary as authoritative, counting only seal-shaped failures toward the first-run wrong-key check with --accept-key as an override. Agent Mail arrival notifications no longer copy the subject or sender, and vendor cursor input digests in the Anthropic and OpenAI managed-agent backends are keyed per organization. (`adec0e9`)
- Added marketplace license renewal logic and expanded the marketplace, seller, and affiliate routers. Stripe webhook handling, purchase, and seller account session code were updated, each with accompanying tests. (`baa75c9`)
- The box fleet alerts router now accepts the new overflow_host_orderable alert type, with tests covering the accepted payloads. (`597dded`)
- Core reconciliation now bills core:&lt;org> session-Box storage and snapshots hourly from what the org tenant left of its allowance, and a new hourly retention job plus POST /v1/admin/retention removes trial stopped Boxes after 14 days and any org's stored Boxes and snapshots 30 days after credit ran out. Trial orgs are charged no storage at settlement, and the tenant token signs maxStorageGib 10 into rbx1 claims. (`1e64376`)
- Core-tenant reconciliation and settlement now price Box usage from the shared box-rates fixture, and the service usage adapters report billable seconds with a 300 s minimum plus saved-state bytes and byte-seconds. (`d387d82`)
- Stored agent config hashes are now HMACs under the organization's blind key rather than unkeyed digests, so a stored hash no longer allows offline guessing of the sealed instructions. Updates still match the legacy form, and the seal-content backfill rewrites versions, session snapshots and vendor agent records. (`8ae3554`)
- Extended the seal-content backfill to check the key against a stored canary, stop when seals fail while none open, and seal unauthenticated encm values only under --seal-lookalikes. The mail router now serializes messages and drafts already plaintext in memory without a second open and refuses to reseal a stored seal that does not open. (`3acedcd`)
- The referral IP check now reads a field that does not open as null instead of failing the lookup. (`b9221af`)
- Mail send receipts and managed-agent idempotency rows now store a keyed per-owner digest of the request, with legacy SHA-256 digests still replaying. The agent list opens latest versions, mail lists and threads contain a row that does not open, a login approval with an unopenable user agent reads as unknown, and mail search uses the shared filter that keeps matching plaintext from/to. (`77fa1c8`)
- The seal-content backfill script now seals legacy lookalike values verbatim along with the rest of the document. (`9376329`)
- Typed the SIEM sealing test's insert spy the same way as the lease test. (`c2a64bf`)
- Changed box-credentials to mint node core:&lt;org> tokens with a one-hour TTL, with the credential router test updated to match. (`642ff32`)
- The send quota now prefers plaintext recipient-count siblings over $size, and the mail router serializers open the sealed fields. (`172db1e`)
- Sealing tests were added. (`86f882d`)
- Seller payouts now keep Stripe's automatic schedule with instant and manual payouts and schedule edits disabled, license renewal cancel and resume require the purchasing member or billing.manage behind billing step-up with other members getting 403, and cancel-at-period-end is persisted and mirrored from subscription webhooks scoped to the connected account. Tests were added for the renewal and webhook paths. (`bee2a59`)
- The cloud_tasks.box_backend billing security tests were updated to seed the catalog default instead of the rollout base, expect the flag open for every caller and closed under the kill switch, and keep asserting that only a verified ADMIN_EMAILS caller carries the platform_admin trait. (`4f50c73`)
- Tests were extended. (`5fe50a6`)
- Added a per-IP limiter to the unauthenticated /api/checkout lookups, capping them at 60 requests a minute so invented secrets cannot spend the provider rate limits shared by the billing routes. Test coverage for the limiter was added. (`911f9e4`)
- Billing routes now refuse a session that is on a different billing account than the one named in the portal link, and first-party checkout passes the named account through. Security tests were added. (`0def1bd`)
- First-party checkout and Polar payment-method libraries were added, and the billing, checkout, credits, gifts and marketplace routers were updated with matching tests. (`41e4d92`)
- Marketplace license renewal and seller account-session libraries and routers were added, and the marketplace and affiliate routers were extended so subscription licenses can be cancelled or resumed and seller account sessions opened. (`a117732`)
- The mail alias sanitizer drops backslashes from display names, with tests covering the header-escaping case. (`a75f373`)
- Sends to new recipients now reserve their daily first-contact slots with a conditional increment before delivery, holding the send for approval when slots are unavailable and returning them when the send never reaches the provider or is refused. A persistence proof test covers the reservation path. (`5a5977c`)
- Extended mail APIs with alias, send-policy, list-policy, inbound-routing, audit, webhook and agent-view logic, including alias hardening and hosted quota and security tests. (`53c73f4`)
- Added first-party checkout and Polar payment-method helpers plus procedure-level tests, and wired them into the billing, checkout, credits, gifts and marketplace routers, including verification endpoints for Polar and Stripe sessions and server-side customer sessions for saved cards. (`1d591f5`)
- Agent mail views now return the id of the thread's earliest message in the alias view instead of base64url-encoded Message-ID/References text, and the agent thread route resolves the thread server-side within that view without accepting raw or encoded header ids. Admin and session thread routes are unchanged. (`fb080c7`)
- Custom-domain alias reservations are no longer deleted when a domain is retired, since routing already checks aliasDomainLive so mail still reaches the domain's next owner. A hardening test covers the permanence guard. (`d1a89eb`)
- Aliases on custom domains now route and send only while the domain is a verified registration of the alias owner, and deleting or expiring a domain revokes its aliases. Approval hashes cover every sent field, agents cannot edit held drafts, and approve pins the reviewed version; events outside an alias plus revoked legacy inbox events reach session webhooks only, and handle claims, alias limits, reply-direction lists, and account merge with personal mail were tightened. (`d96366b`)
- Tests drove the Box HttpAlertSink through raise, clear, and re-raise, checked that a wrong secret stayed pending, and fixed a boolean|undefined type error in feature flags. (`5c8d643`)
- Added DB-backed Box tenant tokens (core:&lt;org> for core_tick and org:&lt;org> for settlement), a POST /api/box/node-credential route for managed nodes with plan caps in the token, an HMAC-authenticated POST /api/box/fleet-alerts route, the GET /api/gateway/orgs/:orgId/budget route, and an admin fleet report. Settlement and exhaustion now iterate only org api tenants, a status feed lists suspended signed tenants, and an hourly core-tenant reconciliation debits shortfalls idempotently under box-recon:&lt;org>:&lt;hour> and alerts admins. (`a5d98aa`)
- Gift activation now records the charged quote on the gift and the unclaimed-gift sweep refunds that full charge including the fee, while older gifts without a recorded quote still refund face value. The Polar subscription webhook and plan-change projection run legacyCalendarGrantCoversSlot before granting, and the guard moved to a ledger-only module still re-exported from plan-pool-refresh. (`5a96fea`)
- Closed several money-path gaps: gifts charge face value plus the buyer's deposit fee and require the full quote to activate, subscription refunds and chargebacks reverse the current period's plan grant idempotently and mirror to the Polar meter, and refund debt blocks new standalone and gift checkouts. Plan pools are now keyed to the paid billing period so each payment buys one pool, rewards redemptions are capped per user with referral points waiting for first payment, and a Major Pass publisher payout is funded from the paid invoice net amount. (`bd25802`)
- Billing refusals for non-members now repeat what the caller typed instead of resolving a username into an email address, and recipients named by username must also be members. Added proof tests for the routes. (`570748d`)
- The conversations sync router and the organization features and invitations routers were updated, each with accompanying test files. (`7494894`)
- Updated account merge, usage and activity persistence, managed agent usage, daily session ids, usage streaks, and lifecycle email code, along with the aggregation, profile, and upsell routers. Added persistence-proof and unit tests for the affected paths. (`3db1f79`)
- Updated plan entitlement handling and the public-agents router, with accompanying coverage in the public-agents test file. (`ac46c42`)
- Box create and resume now evaluate services.box with the session email, organization plan and member audience traits used by /subscription-status. (`e9f2069`)
- Checkout in the billing router now stamps currentPlanVersionFor(), with proof tests covering discounted offers and billing routes. (`952e2dd`)
- Every plan now gets one cx23 EU base server; placement tries each EU region before falling back to cpx22 for Teams, Teams Lite and Business, while Plus, Pro and Max sell out. Provisioning re-places nodes on stock-out and records diskGb, renewals never resize existing nodes, and downgrades shrink in place behind includedNodeResizeOnPlanChange through a quiet-window scheduled action with one email notice. (`287b81e`)
- Changed account merge, credit, vault policy, conversation sync, gift, organization feature, organization invitation and server router code, with matching test updates. (`e3a5e18`)
- Made skeletonCollides owner-aware so an adopted primary address no longer blocks the alias host its handle folds to, moved held agent reply threading onto EmailDraft.inReplyTo and references instead of internal headers, and accepted the serializeMessage alias fields on send-key replays. (`9954d21`)
- Reverted the stock-dependent plan pricing across billing, removing the plan-stock module and its scheduled stock upgrade, and adjusted node entitlement, plan grants, the Hetzner catalog, and the billing and servers routers to a single base server per plan. (`92c19d7`)
- Added work-in-progress hosted mail router code, alias and mailbox helpers, and router tests covering aliases, hosted quotas and send authorization; the snapshot had not been type-checked or tested. (`904dd5c`)
- Changed invite-user to accept the typed referral tag and pass it through normalizeReferralTag, which trims, strips a leading # and cuts to 80 characters, instead of dropping tags longer than 128 characters. Added a regression test that a 150-character #-prefixed tag reaches createInvitation as its first 80 characters. (`09a3759`)
- Updated the conversations sync relay to validate, store, return and back-fill version_root per row, and stopped sync_links from inferring Root from whether another row in a server-merged payload carried a parent, so a flat peer's turns continue the selected thread. Added tests for loop payloads, merged relay payloads with flat-peer rows, wire round-trip and relay storage. (`cafa3e4`)
- Added the default-off services.&lt;slug> flags with standaloneServiceEnabledFor evaluating per org and user, and featureFlagsForOrg setting a reserved organization_id trait so an admin rule can open one service for chosen organizations. Box create and resume return 404 "not available yet" while services.box is off, list/stop/delete stay open, and settlement never reads the flags. (`5bc5418`)
- Added the hosted mail alias support libraries: send-approval evaluation and storage, untrusted agent message views, an inbound recipient route resolver over injectable lookups, per-alias and keyed mail burst budgets, alias-aware webhook audience rules and mail audit records. Account merge now re-points emailAlias claimedBy and approvedBy. (`7dbe710`)
- planOffer now picks the CX or CPX line from live stock, and the CPX node map, plan grant, node-included grant, Polar webhook, billing checkout and stock-upgrade validation all carry the chosen substrate through so a CPX node is not resized back to CX. The servers router and Hetzner catalog were updated to handle performance-capacity nodes, and /plan-availability returns per-plan offers alongside the existing boolean map. (`bf06fb1`)
- Added device usage storage, per-day session id dedupe, sub-turn attribution and a user-stats recompute guard, extending the account merge, activity, usage row and lifecycle email helpers and the aggregation and profile routers. (`2afdc3d`)
- Plan-node provisioning now places included nodes by live Hetzner stock across EU regions with a cx23 starter fallback, defers stock-out upgrades to a quiet-window node.resize ScheduledAction that the runner re-checks, throws a typed InstanceTypeUnavailableError mapped to 409 on PATCH, and adds EU cpx42 and cpx62 fallback specs. (`d7b0d85`)
- The invitation resolve endpoint now returns an address only when the caller typed it or the matched user is already an organization member, a new /orgs/:orgId/invite-user route invites by userId with the caller's own headers, and resolve is capped at 100 recipient values per 10 minutes with a JSON 429 before the permission check. (`4f2f582`)
- Marketing broadcasts now require an explicit subscription rather than only skipping contacts marked unsubscribed, so accounts that never opted in are no longer included. (`c775e1d`)
- The vault login 403 kept the branch's login_token_response, which already fixed the identity-name leak, with vault-policy tests updated to match. The account-merge and credits helpers plus the gifts and servers routers were reconciled with #756's fixes. (`064e1f6`)
- Added a sent-emails router with tests and an email-broadcast helper, and registered the router in the API router index. (`2bc5429`)
- The conversations-sync router now validates, stores, and returns the optional parent_message_id and back-fills a missing parent on rows first pushed while flat, with tests. (`4dd69e1`)
- Streak computation counted only metered days for the points bonus and rejected bucket days past tomorrow (UTC). The daily usage endpoint and profile/aggregation routers returned per-day `active` and `activeDays`, and `joinedAt` used the earlier of stats and account creation. (`d6b095d`)
- GET /orgs/:orgId/features now emits viewerEnabled per feature, resolved through resolveOrganizationFeatureValues for the calling member across member override, the viewer's teams with strictest-wins, the organization toggle and the product default, ANDed with allowedFeatures across org, user and team policy scopes. Router tests mock the resolver per case and assert the caller's team ids reach it. (`ecdfc31`)
- Added the UserActivityDay model usage and the POST /api/profile/me/activity endpoint, made the streak the union of usage, owner agent and activity days, decayed the current streak to zero after a missed day, and dropped impossible bucket days instead of failing the recompute. (`8508953`)
- Request logs and the http_request wide event now redact the emailed password-reset callback path, and persistence proofs match session rows through tokenLookupCandidates now that session.token is stored as a digest. (`0a2cd8a`)
- Waitlist pass codes and milestone passes now store a keyed HMAC digest for lookup plus a sealed copy for display, and account-merge link tokens are matched via token lookup candidates. Added log-path redaction consumed by the wide event and routers, with the platform-identity, user, composio-relay and waitlist routers updated to the new lookups. (`67b80d7`)
- The public-agents router now reports whether the Powered by Ryu badge can be removed, backed by a plan-entitlement helper and router tests. (`00009df`)
- Added the /api/sent-emails router for listing your own sends, admin listing and broadcast composition and preview. The broadcast helpers require platform.admin step-up for all-user sends, run one at a time, honour the announcement preference or marketing unsubscribes, and use the notification quota with a per-recipient idempotency key. (`1fc6368`)
- Node transfers now require the node.destroy step-up after membership and existence checks before a node can be offered to another org; gift success URL fallbacks keep the literal {CHECKOUT_ID} placeholder, with a regression test. (`9732480`)
- Vault-policy glob matching is memoized over glob and part indices to prevent stacked ** patterns from blocking the event loop; account merge disables only the source account's API keys before re-keying, and grant transfer repair is scoped to the named source wallet. (`ba432be`)
- The generated academy questions file was regenerated as part of the merge resolution. (`db838a4`)
- Added a GitHub fake test helper for the marketplace and a persistence proof test for the marketplace remix router. (`59f8c56`)
- Added a real-Mongo persistence proof with the Marketplace router mounted, driving nine cases over remix refusals on publish and re-sync, catalog card and detail reads, and remix counting. Extended the GitHub and Gateway fake with an optional manifest override so fixtures can carry a remixedFrom credit. (`add3475`)
- Updated the GitHub marketplace integration and marketplace router alongside the fake GitHub test helper and the marketplace MFA and release cooldown persistence proofs. (`700e810`)
- Added a case to the marketplace publisher MFA persistence proof that reads the public documentation paragraph and asserts it names each gated write, so the page cannot drift from the enforced routes. (`d42ceec`)
- Updated the GitHub marketplace library and its tests along with the marketplace fake GitHub helper and the publisher MFA and release cooldown persistence proofs. (`4ee96d6`)
- Release inspection now resolves a version through GitHub's immutable releases list and inspects the tree at the tag GitHub reports, so repositories that tag v&lt;version> serve cooldown fallbacks, ?version= views and archive downloads instead of returning 500. An approved version GitHub no longer lists is refused as github_release_missing (422, or 409 on the cooldown fallback), and the test fake now resolves refs by exact name with proofs for bare-tag repositories and delisted releases. (`6c4af23`)
- Added persistence-level proof tests that drive the real marketplace router as an organization owner, asserting that publisher writes such as creating a listing, re-syncing from GitHub, media upload, collection and creator-profile edits, deprecation, yanking and share-code creation are refused without a second factor and persist with an authenticator or passkey. (`9feb714`)
- Fixed root-package release inspection so a requested tag is kept in the GitHub repository URL instead of collapsing to the default branch, which restores the previous-approved-version fallback during the install cooldown and allows downloading an approved older release. Added a router-level proof covering the cooldown, fallback, channel exemption and download paths. (`b48ed30`)
- Account deletion now finishes for every account: tombstones set normalizedEmail, runs refresh executionHeartbeatAt after each step with stale-run takeover, workspace member rows are deleted after the tombstone, and error-state cloud nodes and unlisted Marketplace listings block deletion. The confirm GET reports resumable deletions as open and returns a JSON error on a store failure. (`74e4ed1`)
- Added the account-deletion policy, external-call handling, and persistence proof, and wired deletion into the user account routes with policy and proof tests. (`52756ec`)
- Regenerated the generated academy questions file with the corrected exam content. (`a27206f`)
- Marketplace routers for share codes, creator profiles, membership opt-in, performance, and family collections were updated, along with org access policy, second factor, vault policy, GitHub marketplace, release age, and managed-agent principal logic. Tests were added across these areas. (`dcf574d`)
- Updated billing, credits, marketplace, organization admin, invitation, profile, step-up, support-access and user routers, including share codes and sent-invitation handling, plus supporting libs for marketplace release age, org access policy, second factor and vault policy. Added or extended persistence-proof and proof tests across those routers and adjusted the package tsconfig files. (`893de4f`)
- Updated marketplace publishing, share codes, reviews paging, and release-age checks, along with organization invitations, access policy, and admin operations. Second-factor, step-up, vault policy, billing, credits, profile, and support-access routers and their proof tests were revised. (`ac1f0b5`)
- Changed the marketplace router and added a paging proof test for marketplace reviews. (`9e7b13c`)
- Changed the public and moderation review lists to sort by (createdAt, _id) and issue an iso|id cursor through a shared helper, so reviews sharing a millisecond are no longer skipped at page boundaries. A cursor with only a timestamp still pages by createdAt < cursor, and a cursor that is not a date starts from the top. (`5ff0139`)
- Proof tests for the profile agents ledger and the support-access unbound sweep routers were merged in. (`f047ea9`)
- Managed Agents' personal-key org check now resolves the key owner through the shared userHasSecondFactor rule instead of the renamed twoFactorEnabled field, the marketplace cooldown fallback narrows the historical-version decision with an "serve" in check before reading serve and packageDigest, and the publish-preflight fixture carries releasePublishedAt. (`02f313e`)
- Added a support-access sweep proof case that writes a past-grace impersonated session with an ended audit entry and asserts the owner's next status read deletes the session while leaving ended audit rows and unrelated sessions intact. (`69f4cb4`)
- Merged API router updates for step-up methods and flows, credits and billing proof tests, and user account, email change, password, and verification routes. (`04d1f3e`)
- Added a proof case for the legacy timestamp-only ledger cursor, requesting the next page with the last createdAt ISO string and asserting the 15 strictly older entries in newest-first order with no repeats and no nextCursor. (`e2e86da`)
- The transferable credits listing now maps organization members through orgAccessAllowsSession from lib/org-access-policy.ts instead of an inline Promise.allSettled with an HTTPException check, leaving behaviour unchanged: a refusal drops the organization and any other error still fails the request. (`dfafa94`)
- Added two credits proof cases: the default source falls back from a refusing personal organization to the first admitted one without exposing the refused organization's balances or grants, and POST /transfer enforces an organization's access policy only for members, so non-members still receive not_a_member and source_forbidden. (`1a149d4`)
- The unbound support-session sweep proof now runs its two interleaving cases under CI and fails with the reason when Mongo test commands are missing, rather than skipping silently. (`9eac569`)
- Updated the billing route proof to the current "owner or billing manager" refusal text and added a case seeding an organization administrator whose checkout is refused with a 403 and the same message. (`bbdb661`)
- POST /api/user/set-password now leaves length checking to passwordSchema, so short and over-long passwords return the same messages as sign-up, the reset flows and change-password, and the route reads the Better Auth context only after the one-use identity proof is spent. (`853cc76`)
- /api/user/initiate-email-change now resolves the caller, validates the address and account state with a new requireStepUpHeld check, and spends the proof with requireStepUp as its last step, so 400, 409 and 429 answers no longer cost an identity check. Step-up factors are decided in lib/step-up-methods.ts so the 403 refusal body and the four step-up routes list the same methods. (`7902da4`)
- Added user account route proof tests and organization invitation route tests, plus a tsconfig for desktop contracts. (`177615d`)
- Updated the marketplace router to handle remix for listings, with marketplace and performance test coverage. (`812cf4e`)
- Added a proof test covering the password policy across the reset, OTP reset, and change-password endpoints. (`87636d7`)
- The billing webhook reads Polar state once per publish rather than once per member, and a failed first invite email no longer withdraws a concurrent resend. (`4cd7275`)
- Cleared the four type errors the merged API type-check reported without changing product code or assertions: the Sent-tab route test now casts its stand-in collection to the collection signature and reads rows through a helper that accepts either list form, and the credits route proof moved from tsconfig.json's exclude list into tsconfig.desktop-contracts.json's include list. (`5ebc878`)
- Marketplace catalog cards and detail responses now expose allowRemix, remixedFrom and a live remixCount, and the GitHub publish, resync and legacy publish paths reject a remix of an opted-out listing from another publisher with remix_not_allowed. (`ad22a63`)
- Added an extension module for Vault policy helpers and test coverage alongside updates to the existing policy module. (`ff147e0`)
- Added persistence proof tests across billing, credits, org access, profile, support access, notifications, and v1 routers, and changed the credits, organization invitations, sent invitations, profile, support access, and user routers. (`8d4de32`)
- Added marketplace release age and second factor modules and an organization access policy module with tests. Updated marketplace routing, share codes, creator profiles, family collections, and org admin operations. (`e48d817`)
- Merged a broad set of API changes spanning managed-agent backends, billing and credit modules, family sharing, marketplace, organization administration, and their proof tests. Router and library updates landed across these areas alongside test and fixture changes. (`c85b573`)
- Swept across billing, credits, family sharing, feature flags, managed-agent backends, and the router layer, updating implementations and their accompanying test suites. Managed-agent adapters for Anthropic, Gemini, OpenAI, and the Ryu node and serverless backends were revised together with their fixtures and normalization code. (`992f5f4`)
- Converted 15 router persistence proofs, including admin-usage, billing stream, org-access and organization-features-gateway tests, to the owned replica set helper. (`69d6ebc`)
- Merged a large branch adding managed-agent backend adapters for Anthropic, Gemini, OpenAI, ryu-node, and ryu-serverless, together with their normalization, wire, tool, and persistence-proof test files. It also carried broad updates across billing, organization, marketplace, fleet, and router modules plus the associated coverage proof tsconfigs. (`f1cbdf6`)
- Reworked billing, credits, family-sharing, feature-flag, fleet, marketplace, and organization modules together with their test files, and touched the managed-agents backend adapters for Anthropic, Gemini, OpenAI, ryu-node, and ryu-serverless. Router files across academy, admin, billing, control-plane, mail, and managed-agents were updated alongside the context and request-context plumbing. (`0700593`)
- Passed forged-checkout metadata to the credits route proof without a union that strict tsc rejects, leaving the cases unchanged. (`0331764`)
- Adjusted the credits route proof to receive forged-checkout metadata in a form strict tsc accepts, with the case unchanged and the file still passing. (`ac92159`)
- Merged branch work into @ryu/api, touching billing, managed-agent backend adapters, feature flags, org and marketplace modules, and their routers and tests. The tsconfig coverage-proof configurations were updated alongside the source changes. (`8dc5253`)
- The support-access status read now deletes the user's impersonated sessions older than two minutes that have no open audit binding, with each delete conditional on the updatedAt it read, and the sweep never fails the owner's read.
