- Merged branch changes spanning the managed-agents drivers and backends (Anthropic, Gemini, OpenAI, Ryu node and serverless), billing and credit flows, family sharing, marketplace, org administration, and the associated router and persistence-proof tests. The package manifests, TypeScript configs, coverage-proof configs, and worker scripts were updated alongside the source changes. (`e83fa92`)
- Merged a broad set of changes across API routers and libraries covering billing, credits, family sharing, feature flags, marketplace, organizations, and the managed-agent backends for Anthropic, Gemini, OpenAI, and the Ryu node and serverless runtimes. Tests, coverage-proof tsconfig files, and the billing, quota, and email worker scripts under scripts/ were updated alongside them. (`7879ba9`)
- Added managed-agent backend adapters and normalization for Anthropic, Gemini, OpenAI, ryu-node, and ryu-serverless, with matching fixtures and tests. Billing, family sharing, organization, marketplace, fleet, and managed-agent routers and libraries were reworked and extended with persistence-proof coverage, and the TypeScript coverage configs were adjusted. (`2d39da4`)
- Touched a broad set of API modules and their tests, including billing and credits, family sharing, managed-agent backends and runtime, marketplace, organization and feature-flag code, plus routers, scripts, and TypeScript coverage-proof configs. (`999bd1e`)
- The credits router now checks each organization through the existing enforceOrgAccessForSession helper via Promise.allSettled, leaving the organization policy import as main has it. The credits proof gained forged-checkout cases whose metadata or Polar customer names the other organization, and which must credit nothing. (`c4e98d1`)
- The license validate route now answers 503 for a network failure, a timeout or a provider 5xx while still answering inactive for 4xx responses, and the billing proof pins those cases plus the waitlist, checkout-slot and lifetime-purchase behaviour. (`56f5fd9`)
- Added a route-level proof for GET /api/step-up/verify-link through the shipping Hono router, covering session binding, single use, expiry and replacement, and the offered-method check, with no product change. (`b4b0c85`)
- The profile points ledger now sorts by createdAt and _id descending and carries both in the cursor, so entries sharing a millisecond are no longer skipped between pages; timestamp-only cursors still page as before. A real-Mongo proof was added for the profile agents and ledger routes. (`ce4746a`)
- GET /api/credits/transferable and POST /api/credits/transfer now check every organization the caller belongs to against its access policy, so an organization that refuses the session is left out of the listing, rejected as a source, and blocks any transfer touching it; the default source now skips a policy-refused organization. Added route-level proof tests over the shipping Hono router with real Better Auth sessions and a real Mongo replica set. (`b453eba`)
- POST /api/billing/license/validate now answers 503 for Polar failures other than 404 and 422, which still answer inactive, so an outage or rate limit is no longer read as an invalid key. Added route-level billing proof tests and a shared route-proof harness. (`ea03d55`)
- The second-factor check now imports the Passkey model on first use instead of through a static import, and the require-2FA preview names Better Auth's passkey collection directly, so suites that partially mock the auth model no longer fail when they reach the org access policy. (`1798516`)
- Landing of a large branch touching managed-agent backends for Anthropic, Gemini, OpenAI, ryu-node and ryu-serverless, alongside billing, credit, family-sharing, feature-flag, marketplace and organization routers and their tests. (`0427301`)
- Reworked API modules and routers across billing, managed agents, family sharing, marketplace, organizations, feature flags, and account merge, with corresponding tests and fixtures updated. (`680e9b0`)
- Added managed-agent backend adapters for Anthropic, Gemini, OpenAI, Ryu node, and Ryu serverless, each with wire, normalize, tools, and fixture-backed tests, plus a shared driver, quota, lease, usage, and idempotency layer. Also updated billing, family-sharing, feature-flag, org, marketplace, and mail modules in lib and routers, with matching test suites and coverage-proof TypeScript configs. (`859b517`)
- Merged a large branch covering managed-agent backends for Anthropic, Gemini, OpenAI, ryu-node, and ryu-serverless, plus billing, credits, marketplace, family sharing, org limits, feature flags, and their routers and persistence-proof tests. Also updated context handling, Notion utilities, and several tsconfig coverage-proof configs. (`3be8abd`)
- Merged a broad set of changes across the API package, spanning lib modules and routers for billing, credits, family sharing, feature flags, marketplace, organization admin, platform identity, and the managed-agents backends for Anthropic, Gemini, OpenAI, ryu-node, and ryu-serverless, along with their test files and TypeScript coverage configs. (`6d31064`)
- Reworked a wide sweep of server modules, including billing and credit flows, family sharing and organization administration, managed-agent backends for Anthropic, Gemini, OpenAI, and Ryu runtimes, plus the matching routers and their tests. (`f9b1a3a`)
- The merge brought the Marketplace release history into the API package: parked pending releases, per-version review decisions, and the reviewed-bytes `?version=` gate. The install cooldown was rebuilt to drop the separate `previousStableVersion` field, so during a cooldown installs fall back to the newest older version review approved through the same `historicalVersionGate` reviewed-digest check. Publish-route tests were updated to give their session user an authenticator app, and additional proof suites and tsconfig proof configurations were added. (`0bfeb76`)
- Brought in wide-ranging changes across the API's lib and router modules, including managed-agents backends, billing, family sharing, marketplace, and feature-flag code, together with their test files and updated package and tsconfig metadata. (`77c01e4`)
- The API package was updated across its billing, credits, family sharing, marketplace, mail, org administration and feature flag modules, with matching test coverage. Managed-agent backends gained a fuller Anthropic adapter with recorded request, session and event fixtures, and the Gemini, OpenAI, Ryu node and serverless adapters and their drivers were reworked alongside the runtime, lease, quota and sweeper logic. (`7b203e4`)
- Merged changes spanning billing, credits and ledger helpers, managed-agent backends for Anthropic, Gemini, OpenAI, Ryu node and serverless, feature flags, marketplace, family sharing, org admin and the router layer, along with their test suites and coverage tsconfigs. Also updated worker scripts and isolated-test tooling. (`28e5be5`)
- Managed-agent support expanded across the Anthropic, Gemini, OpenAI, ryu-node, and ryu-serverless backends, adding adapters, wire and normalize modules, and recorded request/response fixtures with corresponding tests. Routers and library modules covering family sharing, billing and credits, marketplace, fleet enrollment, mail quotas, platform identity, feature flags, and managed-agent lifecycle were updated, with new persistence-proof and authorization tests alongside them. (`0932854`)
- Reworked a large set of API modules and routers, including account merge, credits, creator program, cloud provisioning, Stripe and Polar webhooks, SCIM credential rotation, server transfer, shared budgets, SSE routes, conversation shares, mail authorization, org verification, and marketplace membership, adding or extending tests across each area. Added aggregation ingest fencing and updated context to support the new checks. (`f2f28cc`)
- Merged origin/main into the release branch, resolving conflicts across the API routers, billing and entitlement libraries, managed-agent backends, marketplace and org-admin code, and the associated tests. The merge also updated the coverage and desktop-contract TypeScript configs. (`5cbf4b6`)
- Required an authenticator app or passkey to create Marketplace share codes, returning 403 marketplace_mfa_required while leaving revocation ungated, and added router tests. (`9a43cd9`)
- Integrated a large set of API changes covering the managed-agents backends for Anthropic, Gemini, OpenAI, ryu-node and ryu-serverless, plus billing, credits, family sharing, organization limits, feature flags, marketplace and mail routers. Numerous routers, lib modules, test suites and coverage-proof TypeScript configs were reconciled so the combined changes build and type-check together.
- Added a proof test case where the mail provider stand-in refuses the new address while the old-address mail is delivered, asserting a 500, a cancelled stored change, a 400 from the already-sent old-address link, an unchanged account email, and a successful retry once the address is reachable. (`72e7dbb`)
- Email-change initiation now asks the email-harmony user hook for the normalized key of the proposed address and answers 409 when another account holds it, while still allowing the account's own other spelling. Applying a confirmed address maps a duplicate-key error to "taken", cancels the pending change, and returns 409 from both confirm routes. (`5f303aa`)
- POST /api/user/set-password now resolves the caller, validates the body and password schema, and only then calls requireStepUp, so a rejected password no longer spends the one-use account.security proof. New proof and unit tests cover the refused-weak-password cases. (`c2c9df1`)
- Changed the organization-invitations router and added an organization-sent-invitations router, each accompanied by proof, ties, and unit test files. (`edc6d05`)
- Changed the organization sent-invitations router to page past Better Auth's row cap, with tie-break ordering by date and id, and added tests for ties, proof cases and the 2,000-row boundary alongside updated organization-invitations router tests. (`0d5ce97`)
- Request context modules (context.ts, request-context.ts) were updated alongside an MFA enrollment context test, a user account routes proof test, and a new tsconfig.account-routes-proof.json used to type-check those routes. (`3dfc6af`)
- Added a proof test for the user account routes along with its dedicated TypeScript config. (`c3c45c0`)
- Added a shared second-factor check and a marketplace release-age module, and wired them into the marketplace router and GitHub marketplace bindings. Publisher writes under marketplace.publish now return 403 marketplace_mfa_required without an authenticator app or passkey, and install/update plus archive download requests fall back to the previous stable version or return 409 release_cooldown while a release is cooling down. (`56790cd`)
- Organization two-factor enforcement now accepts passkeys alongside authenticator apps through a shared second-factor check, and the admin lockout guard and members-without-2FA preview count passkeys too. (`79a1108`)
- Request context construction now carries multi-factor enrollment state, with a dedicated enrollment test covering the context and request-context paths. (`32270d2`)
- Merged the user-account-routes proof test and the TypeScript config used for account-route proofs. (`fb229c8`)
- Added a user account routes proof test and a dedicated tsconfig used for that account-routes proof run. (`194e9a0`)
- Merge added a proof test for the user-account routes and a dedicated tsconfig for that proof build. (`ca85663`)
- Added a proof test for user account routes along with a dedicated TypeScript config for that proof build. (`60251a5`)
- Added a user-account-routes proof test and a dedicated TypeScript config used to typecheck that proof. (`7bd7b4a`)
- Feature flag evaluation, audience, and core flag claim logic were updated together with the feature flags and feature waitlists routers. Marketplace release, search kinds, and performance code plus the billing and control-plane routers were also changed, with tests added across these areas. (`de8399f`)
- The billing quota worker, own-supply-catalog module, and the feature-waitlists, marketplace, step-up, and user routers were updated alongside their tests. TypeScript configs for the package and for desktop contracts were adjusted as well. (`e8a0a9a`)
- Cloud provisioning, credits, team seat reminders and seat billing, platform identity and waitlist access codes were adjusted, each with accompanying tests. (`00ebe8a`)
- Applied Biome formatting to the Vault policy evaluator and its extension module, with the policy test file reformatted to match. (`ecf9cc6`)
- Merged branch work adding a proof test for the user-account routes along with a dedicated tsconfig for that test. (`a833166`)
- Added a proof test that drives the account routes through the shipping Better Auth handler and a Mongo replica set, covering password status, set password, email change, and account merge. Added a scoped proof tsconfig with strict checks. (`10d2648`)
- `/api/marketplace/catalog` accepts an `id` parameter that returns a single exact listing through the same public pipeline, capped at 256 characters, which lets `marketplace.describe` describe ids longer than the 120-character query cap while keeping the id in `query` for an older Marketplace. Relevance now ranks a listing whose name contains the whole query above one that matches only word by word, with route and performance tests added. (`58cb6a9`)
- The merge brought updates across several API routers, including feature-waitlists, marketplace, step-up and user, plus changes to own-supply-catalog, the billing-quota worker, the isolated test script and the package tsconfigs. A batch of accompanying test files was updated alongside them. (`ddf81f4`)
- Added a vault policy extension client module and extended the existing vault policy module with tests. (`1bb047d`)
- Merged a broad set of API changes spanning billing, credits, programs, marketplace, mail, organization administration, managed agents and OAuth routers, together with their tests and TypeScript config updates. (`e650a39`)
- Merged API package updates for own-supply catalog handling, organization invitation email proof coverage, step-up routing, and user password tests and routing. The changes adjusted shared API package behavior and its tests. (`42e16d1`)
- Extended the context MFA-enrollment tests to cover sessions that stay on the step-up routes while still enrolling a factor. (`316c8bd`)
- Added request-context handling for MFA enrollment state, with a new context-mfa-enrollment test covering it and updated context and request-context modules. (`a964505`)
- Added a test that keeps Core's hand-mirrored marketplace kind lists in step with the Marketplace model. (`741d318`)
- Added the kinds parameter to the marketplace router and switched catalogSearchFilter to per-word clauses requiring every word to match a listing field, with updated release and search-kinds helpers and tests. (`f87278e`)
- Merged the mega branch into the API package, resolving test files, the feature-waitlists and marketplace routers, worker scripts, and the package and TypeScript configs. (`e912933`)
- Switched TypeScript approver validation to the Core-parity isValidSubject helper and updated the vault policy extension logic and its tests. (`9a9e878`)
- Pulled in test isolation tooling, updated TypeScript configs, a billing-quota worker script, and changes across the feature-waitlists and marketplace routers with their test suites. (`2c46957`)
- Changed the org-domains store fixture to decode route update documents and created challenges with z.strictObject, and to model the requestedByUserId field the route stores, so a route writing an unmodelled field now fails the test instead of being silently stripped. (`7a56dcc`)
- invitePassAllowance now logs billing lookup errors instead of swallowing them in a bare catch, while keeping the base-allowance fallback. The fallback test asserts the log. (`c22844c`)
- POST /waitlist/invite-passes now returns an allowance value, and the router test asserts the allowance per plan and after a downgrade where 10 passes are listed with an allowance of 3. (`d18c099`)
- Added tsconfig.json and a second tsconfig.desktop-contracts.json program plus a check-types script, so the package's tests and scripts are type-checked while the desktop billing stream contract proofs keep desktop's settings. (`a989e12`)
- Test fixtures and scripts in api were brought under the shared base type-checking settings, which surfaced 50 errors in drifted fixtures. Fetch fakes now use the package's Object.assign(handler, { preconnect }) fixture, org-domains tests build real Mongoose queries through nativeQueryFixture, fixture types gained the fields the tests already seed, and NODE_ENV writes use Object.assign(process.env, ...). No assertion was removed. (`534a093`)
- Feature flag evaluation now combines #718's catalog audience rule and server audience traits with the plan-gated rollouts: billing and the /evaluate route pass audience traits as attributes and the plan as plan in the FeatureFlagCallerContext, the per-member billing publisher feeds each member's own account fields, and the duplicate planTraits/rolloutFlagTraits were dropped. The core flag claim, feature flags, control-plane and feature waitlists routers and their tests were updated. (`f909fe8`)
- The waitlist record and avatar style boundary schemas now declare an unknown input via an identity preprocess, so the strict type-check no longer rejects the five asRecord calls in feature-waitlists.ts and the cleanAvatarStyle call in marketplace.ts. Parsing behaviour is unchanged. (`20616ad`)
- Merged router changes to step-up and user procedures along with user-password tests and an organization invitation email proof test. (`026a0d8`)
- Platform-identity POST and PATCH now return 400 instead of 500 for malformed bodies: the organizationId field is validated with safeParse and a shared readJsonBody helper handles bodies that are not valid JSON. Tests cover malformed organizationId values, non-object bodies and non-JSON bodies on both routes. (`42a2961`)
- Reworked the Discord community invite helper and router, milestone passes, and program persistence, and adjusted the enterprise identity router, all with accompanying tests. (`042616a`)
- Mail webhooks and the mail router, marketplace membership opt-in, and template rewards logic were updated together with their tests, including persistence-proof tests for template rewards. (`df5bb91`)
- The mail router now marks stranded queued rows unresolved when a draft is confirmed, so a confirmed resend is dispatched instead of answered by an old row. Unbuilt messages now surface as a refusal, and the draft send route parses a non-object body without a 500. (`c096927`)
- The account merge confirmation mail is now sent with skipRateLimit, so the one-minute cooldown started by the emailed step-up code no longer rejects it and cancels the merge with a 500. (`76fce4a`)
- Confirming an email change now completes through Better Auth's internalAdapter.updateUser instead of a Mongoose write, so the normalized address lookup key and the Polar profile follow the new address and the old address and password no longer sign in. (`579c705`)
- When the confirmation mails for an email change fail to send, the pending change is now cancelled instead of answering 429 for retries over the next 24 hours, and the 500 response states the email was not changed. (`12305da`)
- The passwordless email-change confirmation mail is now sent with skipRateLimit, so the cooldown started by the mailbox step-up link no longer makes the change answer 500; the mail is still counted and only goes to the signed-in account's own address. (`a95a110`)
- POST /api/user/set-password now applies the sign-up passwordSchema after its length checks and answers 400 with the failing rule's message, with matching assertions added in user-password.test.ts. (`0375e77`)
- Setting a password on a passwordless account now writes through Better Auth's setPassword and internalAdapter.updatePassword instead of building the credential row by hand, so the row carries issuer local:credential and an ObjectId userId and the password can be used at sign-in; passwords longer than 128 characters are refused up front. (`5781114`)
- Added proof tests for organization invitation email delivery, covering failed invitation writes and failed deletion of an unsent invitation. (`1586241`)
- The mail pixel route now claims the first open with a conditional update on openedAt: null, so concurrent pixel loads record one open and emit a single message.opened event, and the status only advances from an earlier delivery state so a bounce or complaint is not overwritten. A test loads the pixel four times at once and expects one event. (`53fbd85`)
- Draft sends that fail with an unknown outcome, scheduled sends that do, and drafts left sending past the lease now move to an unresolved status with sendAt cleared, and the send and edit routes answer 409 until the caller passes confirmNotSent: true. Draft sends now replay only an earlier send that went out or may have, so a confirmed resend is not answered with its own failed attempt. (`1d89a9c`)
- Both send paths now record provider failures through one helper: a proven SES 4xx refusal still stores failed, releases units and key, and emits message.rejected, while any other failure stores the row as unresolved, keeps units and key, emits no rejection event, charges no overage, and returns 502. Tests assert the stored status, events and units on the send route and the reply path. (`4c23241`)
- runProvisionTask now performs watch enrollment and default-channel setup before calling enableServerBackups on both the fresh-create and adopt-on-resume paths, and the provision test asserts enrollment runs before the create-action wait. (`22070fa`)
- sweepServerBackups now visits at most BACKUP_SWEEP_BATCH (25) servers per run, least recently touched first, touches servers it could not enable so later runs rotate past them, and stops early when Hetzner returns 429. (`29f942c`)
- Made student-enrolment confirmation approve in a single findOneAndUpdate whose filter pins status, school email and code hash, returning 409 when a concurrent re-request changed the row. Added a real-Mongo persistence proof that interleaves a re-request between the read and the write. (`92a4904`)
- Added a credits test pinning that reversing a standalone top-up credit on a partly spent balance drives the standalone bucket negative while general top-ups stay untouched. (`c02bf0f`)
- The standalone subscription cancel route now wraps the Polar subscription update in a try/catch, logs the failure and returns 502 like the sibling checkout route. A rejection case was added to credits.test.ts. (`ec9105e`)
- A credits.test.ts case covers the guard. (`52e6331`)
- Added node delegation library and router code with tests, and extended the OAuth apps router with revoke test coverage. Added a proof test for support access against services auth. (`a776b9a`)
- Tracked an explicit seatsChangedAt, set on activation or when the billed seat count changes, and read seatsChangedAt ?? createdAt in the unassigned-seat reminder window so renewals with unchanged seats no longer restart the three-day grace. (`69ea392`)
- Replaced the read-then-upsert per-user mint limit with an atomic conditional findOneAndUpdate slot reservation before calling Discord, retrying a duplicate-key collision once, refunding on Discord failure and returning 429 with Retry-After when no slot is available. (`cc35330`)
- Template usage reports are written only when an organization the caller belongs to holds a servable Marketplace license, storing verification="license" and the licenseId and responding with { accepted, ignored }. Period compute and the creator dashboard count only license-verified rows, excluding legacy unverified rows, refunded or disputed licenses, and usage tied to a license bought by a member of the publisher org. (`60cd606`)
- resolvePricing now persists pricing.membershipOptIn only when an opt-in was requested and aMajorPassEnabled() is true, so both publish write paths store false while the offer is off; a test drives the flag-off and flag-on cases. (`ca0370a`)
- The mail router now binds a gateway credential to its node and requires agent ids of the form &lt;nodeId>:&lt;agent>, returning 403 agent_inbox_forbidden otherwise. inboxScopeFilter limits by-id inbox, message, draft, list, event and webhook reads to shared inboxes plus the key's own node, and webhooks record createdVia and gatewayNodeId so agent inbox events and mutations reach only the owning node's webhooks and session webhooks. (`cb21bf1`)
- createContext now decides the waitlist MFA exemption from the stored role whenever the session still reports a cached waitlist role, and gained a test covering that case. (`a77ef29`)
- createContext now withholds the principal from sessions without an enrolled factor and fails closed on lookup errors, and requireAuth answers 403 with mfa_enrollment_required while password status stays reachable for setup. (`0ee5d05`)
- core-flag-claim now builds the flag claim for the active organization, with audience handling in feature-flag-audience and matching changes in the billing router and tests. (`180be34`)
- Routed the Enterprise SSO domain verification path through `claimVerifiedDomain` so re-verifying a domain transfers it from other orgs, drops their challenge rows, and records `organization.domain.transferred` audits. (`7d33a53`)
- Added `as const` to four Zod `.catch()` factory fallbacks so literal types survive the factory form and the API source type check no longer reports those TS2769 errors; runtime behaviour was unchanged. (`56a9f62`)
- Milestone pass lookup now falls back to a member's latest earlier milestone pass, showing it when the current threshold is out of reach and reusing it instead of minting a duplicate when it was earned at an equal or higher threshold. (`2321af6`)
- Added router-level tests for the programs gates and student confirm flow, covering the rollout-flag 404, admin 403, attempt counter and cap, expiry, and duplicate school email checks. (`265ecc1`)
- Student verification now writes the school email and a code hash covering id, email and code in one atomic `$set`, and confirm checks it through `studentCodeMatches`; codes issued before this change stop verifying. (`99ae4ee`)
- Merged changes to the step-up router and added a proof test for organization invitation email. (`ce2f3a6`)
- The step-up router now uses the shared retry-wait helper, and a proof test was added covering organization invitation email delivery. (`e1834e3`)
- Updated the marketplace search kinds and router to word-by-word matching, with a test covering the new kind handling. (`4b317dc`)
- recordTemplateUsage now writes a row only when an organization the caller belongs to holds a servable Marketplace license for the listing, storing verification="license" and the licenseId and returning { accepted, ignored }. periodUsageRows counts only license-verified rows and drops rows whose license was refunded or disputed, and new persistence-proof tests cover unlicensed, other-org, legacy, and refunded-license cases. (`b494ded`)
- resolvePricing now stores pricing.membershipOptIn only when the opt-in is requested and aMajorPassEnabled() is true, and only reads the flag when an opt-in is requested, so a direct publish call cannot persist an opt-in while the offer is off. A new test drives resolvePricing with the flag off and on. (`10dabdd`)
- Mail now records the node bound to the presenting gateway credential and requires gateway-key callers to use agentId of the form nodeId:agent on GET and POST /mail/agents/:agentId/inbox and on POST /mail/inboxes, answering 403 agent_inbox_forbidden otherwise independent of inbox existence. The stored agentKey shape and session callers are unchanged, with a new node-binding test suite. (`a5b05af`)
- Added tests for the interim ledger statuses: a complete row replays the stored message, a fresh pending row returns 409 still in progress, and a pending row past the stale window returns 409 outcome unknown, with SES never called twice. Also corrected a stale comment about the address-list factory form. (`b10b5f4`)
- Changed GET /api/marketplace/catalog to accept a comma-separated kinds= parameter, with all and template aliases, for cross-kind search. (`b623f30`)
- Converted 52 shared array and object Zod .catch() fallbacks, including the named ZERO_PRICING_BASIS fallback, into factories that return a fresh value so one failed parse cannot leak mutations into later requests. (`8fd9459`)
- Merged the latest commits across the API routers and lib modules, resolving conflicts in the aggregation, mail, and mail-send-authorization files while taking updates to the many other router and helper files in the package. (`13adf61`)
- Legacy OAuth consents now map _id to an id string before reaching the shared reader, so a live consent with an unreadable createdAt and no updatedAt is no longer dropped from Settings > Authorized apps and keeps its Revoke button. Tests cover ObjectId, string and non-ObjectId legacy rows. (`7ddb132`)
- Updated the node-delegation helper together with its router and unit tests. (`9c2bad2`)
- Settings > Authorized apps now lists a live consent whose createdAt cannot be read, dating it by updatedAt or by the creation time in its ObjectId, and every revoke deletes the grant's consent rows in both id forms after revoking tokens. The mocked revoke tests record each store call and assert that order. (`e7b0fd2`)
- Replaced array and object .catch() fallbacks with factories across routers and lib modules, including api-key-auth's metadataFallback, so each parse receives a fresh value. Adjusted the boxes.test.ts expectation to match trimmed organization ids in token maps. (`1edf5e5`)
- Formatter fixes were applied to the marketplace router as part of a checkpoint pass over files touched by recent PRs. (`aa8f9ad`)
- Checkpoint of in-progress API work updating billing, mail, marketplace, academy, boxes, credits, CMS and desktop-settings test suites and the coverage-proof tsconfig files. (`7d3f1c1`)
- Regenerated the academy questions data file used by the API package. (`05795ef`)
- Added marketplace app rollout logic with accompanying tests and updated the marketplace router and its test suite. (`3b0e412`)
- Integrated the runtime-chain merge across the API package, reconciling marketplace manifest signing, billing and purchase flows, org integrations, mail and server routers, step-up routes, and their tests. (`2a72a08`)
- Added a marketplace app rollout helper with tests and applied it in the marketplace router's /catalog handler, filtering the page window after public marketplace filtering while keeping the existing aggregate and cursor pagination. Router tests were extended to cover the new behavior. (`ad9974c`)
- Added programs and template-rewards routers and libs with rules, persistence and security tests, and updated plan entitlement handling and the billing router. Router index registration and feature-flag router tests were updated to match. (`d514ac0`)
- Reworked the marketplace router together with marketplace license-status and release helpers and the purchase module, adding coverage for marketplace performance and router behavior. (`fade797`)
- The Composio relay now tracks closers and epochs, has a rotated token's successor inherit the epoch with the event sequence, refuses revoked tokens on subscribe, and parses epoch cursors to replay from zero past the newest event. Mail routes wrap prepareOutbound, overage charging and provider acceptance in idempotency claims, dedupe SNS delivery events by sesDeliveryEventId, apply them forward-only, and read bodies through readMailJsonBody; rewards-store keeps PLAN_WINDOW_ATTEMPTS and request-body-limit, boxes, servers, step-up, login-approvals, marketplace and org-integrations routes were also merged. (`71765ad`)
- Extended the API library layer with composio pricing, credit debit reasons, organization debit, email send quota, gateway manifest signing, inbox webhook, ledger charge lookup, mail domain, mail overage, mail webhook, org spend and usage ingest, receipt charge claim, request body limit, secret matching, service billing config and status, service credit, service usage adapters and settlement, and standalone credit funding modules with tests. Routers for boxes, composio relay, credits, mail, mail quota overrides, marketplace and service billing status were updated alongside the router index. (`8009a0a`)
- Added template-rewards rules, persistence helpers and a router, registered in the router index, with rule and persistence-proof tests. (`6f2542b`)
- Added programs library logic and a programs router, extended plan entitlements and the billing router, and updated feature-flag tests. Added tests covering programs and entitlement customer security. (`3b3a0bc`)
- Added family sharing logic across lib and routers, including admission impact, transitions, signals, account merge policy and run, channel user quota, and admin family sharing endpoints; billing status publishing now isolates per-member failures so one failed push does not block the others. (`e6c40cd`)
- Removed the unused principal resolvers from the billing router and updated the step-up and support-access routers. Node delegation logic and a broad set of persistence and native HTTP proof tests were added or refreshed, with new tsconfig coverage proof projects. (`e923dfd`)
- Marketplace license-status and release helpers, purchase handling, and the marketplace router were updated along with their test files to carry #676's changes through the merge. (`a87e9e3`)
- Added own-supply catalog, matching and store modules plus their routers, and updated credits, campaigns, challenges, usage breakdown, billing, key vault and control-plane bootstrap code and tests to use them. (`55b56f7`)
- Updated lifecycle email policy and lifecycle email handling, with notification router tests. (`7241b36`)
- Updated account merge, billing scope, connector catalog, credits, effective policy, organization feature, and related router logic across billing, credits, fleet, org admin, organization features, registry, rewards store, servers, team connector catalog, and watch, with corresponding tests. (`a44b668`)
- Merged the mail router so the address claim flow carries allowance gating, signed inbox webhooks, live-domain filtering, purge-then-retire delete and outbound preparation, with tombstones counting as taken after the hold and burst caps running before the monthly reservation. It also combined the organization debit path with the 402 standalone-credit pre-check, added service usage adapters and settlement, credit debit reasons, ledger charge lookup, composio pricing and quota override routes. (`cd8464b`)
- Added a template-rewards router with its persistence proof and rules modules, and registered the router in the API index. (`f05ac52`)
- Reworked billing, marketplace, and payout paths across the Polar and Stripe webhooks, affiliate payouts, purchases, refunds, and server transfers, and added a request body size limit helper now used by the mail and waitlist routers. Also updated the auth, org-integration, quest, rewards, step-up, and waitlist routers with their tests. (`4c7c6d4`)
- Added own-supply catalog, match, and store logic with an own-supply router, and updated credit debiting with a drawGrants opt-out used by the Polar shared mirror. Also updated Polar billing, challenge prize projection, usage breakdown, campaigns, control-plane bootstrap, and the key-vault router. (`f68e3aa`)
- Added a programs router and program grant helpers used by billing, alongside plan entitlement changes, and wired billing to apply program grants next to pricingCheckoutAttribution. Entitlement customer security and program tests were added, and feature-flag override expectations now include the startup and student program flags. (`329c185`)
- Added account merge policy and execution, family-sharing enablement, transitions and signals, billing scope checks and family-aware plan entitlements. Added admin family-sharing routes and updated the credits, feature-flag, organization, fleet and connector routers together with their tests. (`1f2b399`)
- Added marketplace license-status and release helpers, updated the purchase and marketplace routers, and covered the new logic with tests. (`84e9a3b`)
- Added lifecycle email policy and lifecycle email sending modules to the API package, with tests for the policy and for the user-notifications router. (`e4e672a`)
- Changed the node delegation helper and the billing, step-up and support-access routers. Added persistence-proof tests for billing, profile, invitations, admin usage, support access and v1 routes, along with dedicated tsconfig files for the coverage proofs. (`5ac2a31`)
- Reworked the credits router so top-up uses the billing-manager gate and renamed standalone subscription create/cancel routes to require billing-manager permission. Also updated organization feature, team connector catalog, billing, fleet, gateway tool policy, control-plane, watch, servers, registry, and rewards-store routers with matching library and test changes. (`c41ab31`)
- Added a marketplace publish preflight module under the API package's library directory. (`166bd22`)
- Added a Discord community invite library and router, and registered the router in the API router index. (`a90effe`)
- Added affiliate and milestone-pass logic and updated the waitlist access-code router and tests. (`6b59259`)
- Added email send burst limiting and mail send authorization to the mail router, including agent address handling, with accompanying tests. (`e40980f`)
- Added the managed agents runtime, including backend adapters for Anthropic, Gemini, OpenAI, Ryu node, and Ryu serverless with normalization, tool, and wire modules and fixtures. Supporting modules cover billing, quota, leasing, idempotency, SSE events, credentials, errors, and persistence-proof tests, and the tRPC routers expose the managed agents endpoints alongside key-vault scope handling. (`95ef2ab`)
- Added pricing rollout, standalone credit funding, credit top-up, plan entitlement, and Polar billing/webhook changes, with router and test updates for credits and feature flags. (`30f2dc0`)
- Exposed blog, changelog, help, pages and updates routers backed by a shared Notion utility, with Notion type definitions and tests. (`54c4f74`)
- Routers across billing, boxes, community, quests, servers, marketplace, org admin, org integrations, login approvals, step-up, waitlist, and user settings were updated together with new and revised tests. Supporting libraries for payouts, purchases, refunds, webhooks, mail delivery, and account merge were changed alongside persistence-proof tests. (`d8a51d1`)
- Updated the marketplace publish preflight helper as part of the merge. (`05426c7`)
- Added template-reward rules and persistence-proof tests, plus a template-rewards router registered in the API router index. (`3de52e5`)
- Added the Discord community invite library with tests and a discord-invite router registered in the router index. (`25a1659`)
- Credit and debit helpers were moved into lib/ and a web_search debit reason was added to the credit-debit-reasons module, rolled up in org spend. Billing, mail, boxes, Composio relay, marketplace, and service-billing modules and their tests were also updated during the #688 merge. (`9a8f19a`)
- Added affiliate and milestone-passes libraries and wired milestone passes into the waitlist router, with tests covering affiliate logic and waitlist access codes. (`84e4587`)
- Extended the API package with family sharing libraries and routers, including enable-impact and transition helpers, plus updates to channel user quota, billing, fleet secrets, and marketplace routers so they account for family plans. (`2f749d2`)
- Brought in the own-supply catalog, match, and store modules with their router, wired pool allowances into the control plane, and updated credits, campaigns, challenges, and usage-breakdown logic. (`11a6be0`)
- Added a programs router and an entitlement overlay for program grants and personal-scope gifts, with billing, feature-flag, and entitlement security updates. (`33cfe9a`)
- Fixed mail address-list fallbacks to produce a fresh array per parse and made the reply route build its own recipient list, so a reply recipient no longer leaks into later sends. Applied the same fresh-value rule to other array and object fallbacks, with a regression test covering quota usage. (`fe99f34`)
- Changed mail send handling so a keyed send claims an in_progress idempotency row before reserving quota or contacting SES, with completed replays, 409 conflicts, unresolved outcomes, and retry behavior driven by the claim state. Updated mail host quota and send authorization tests. (`b137bb3`)
- The marketplace router kept `deprecated` as its deprecation view and folded lifecycle metadata into it, adding `deprecationReason`, `yanked`, and `yankReason` to the detail response. License-status and release helpers and the purchase module were updated, with router, lifecycle, and performance tests adjusted to the merged shape. (`e2954c8`)
- The hosted pixel route `GET /mail/track/:id` now records the first open only when the message row's `openTracking` flag is true, with rows stored before the flag falling back to checking that the stored HTML names the row's own pixel path. The test file was extended to cover this behavior. (`c6a323d`)
- Added family sharing libraries covering admission impact, signals, transitions and enable impact, along with account merge policy and run logic, and extended plan entitlement lookups to take strict and customer context. Routers for billing, control plane, family sharing, org admin, marketplace, organization features and others were updated to serve the merged family and A Major Pass surfaces. (`77757e7`)
- Changed the authorized apps router to read each consent row independently and to match both stored forms of the user id on the legacy branch, so a single legacy-shaped row no longer breaks the consent list or causes every Revoke to answer 503. Revokes now clear the grant's provider access and refresh tokens on either branch. (`9ff6e64`)
- The node delegation exchange and router now read Bearer or DPoP tokens with the DPoP proof and check the stored jkt binding, with tests covering the delegation flow. (`b752d9d`)
- Updated the billing, step-up, support-access, blog, and CMS routers and added persistence and native-HTTP proof tests for billing streams, profile, invitations, desktop settings sync, and support access. New per-surface tsconfig files cover the API-owned, CMS, services-auth, and support-access proof runs. (`e0d1472`)
- Added a lifecycle email policy module and worker wiring, with tests for the policy and the delivery paths it drives. The user-notifications tests now assert seventeen notification kinds. (`df0eba9`)
- Added an email send burst limiter with tests, and updated the mail router with tests covering agent addresses and send authorization. (`6832cd7`)
- Added standalone credit funding and pricing rollout modules, and extended the credits and billing routers with the standalone funding field and pricing surface. Updated Polar webhook, top-up and plan entitlement handling, with tests across credits, pricing rollout, entitlement security and webhook paths. (`a0aa545`)
- Added the Managed Agents subsystem, including Anthropic, Gemini, OpenAI, ryu-node and ryu-serverless backend adapters with wire and normalize layers, plus driver, store, events, SSE, quota, lease, idempotency, billing, credentials, sweeper and HTTP modules and their tests. Added the managed-agents router, mapped the managed_agents reason in org spend and Polar billing, and added control-plane scope handling to the key vault router. (`539b833`)
- Tightened hasLiveSupportSession so an impersonated session counts only when an open audit row matches its sessionId, with a proof test. (`178f165`)
- Organization feature, connector catalog, billing scope, credits, watch and fleet router changes arrived with the merge, with conflicts resolved across the corresponding library and router files. (`59131bc`)
- Blog, changelog, help, pages, and updates routers were reworked to serve content from the new source, with shared Notion type and utility updates backing them. (`c0b65d3`)
- Added organization domain and verification routers and a domain TXT helper, and updated the router index and marketplace router with tests. (`943fbea`)
- Added server-side feature-flag helpers and a feature-flags router, and referenced the flags from the billing and marketplace routers. Tests were added for the flag helpers, the router, and billing-customer security. (`de9f0d6`)
- Updated the waitlist router and its access code tests. (`e591b9e`)
- Federation, fleet enrollment, vault core, aggregation, campaigns, credits, feature waitlists, marketplace share codes, and platform identity modules were updated with accompanying tests, including a new aggregation ingest fence test. (`a790397`)
- The marketplace router was updated with corresponding test changes. (`8f6e1fc`)
- Changed the cloud provisioning logic in the API package and updated its tests. (`b21364f`)
- Added team seat reminder logic with tests and updated the billing notifications module. (`81c79e2`)
- Added a proof test for the step-up email cooldown at the daily cap. The test asserts a 429 with Retry-After 3600 and a 60-minute wait message. (`522d20a`)
- Family enable is now refused while SSO providers or active SCIM credentials exist, rechecked after the kind write; channel-user claims recount family members inside the quota transaction; the member-exit sweep bumps the same guard; and org-private marketplaces stop being served while the workspace is a family. (`4cdc1a7`)
- Fleet secret routing now creates bindings scoped per organization, team and name, backed by a persistence proof test. (`70187ff`)
- DELETE /mail/domains/:id now claims the row as deleting, deletes the SES identity, then the row; if SES refuses, it answers 202 with cleanupPending and retries later. Registration of a name still being removed returns a transient 409, and a check's lease release no longer clears a deletion claim. (`efc89c3`)
- The hosted verifier and node-delegation path now read user and session references as either a string or an ObjectId hex, and consent, session and revocation queries match both stored forms. Check order is unchanged. (`4a9ca58`)
- Billing now reads the owner's personal Polar customer first for the owner of their own personal workspace or family, then falls back to the workspace customer for subscription status, invoices, plan changes, cancel, portal, and live status. Members, admins, Teams orgs, Teams checkout guards, and seat purchases keep the org customer behavior. (`dac1039`)
- Organization ids in service billing token maps are now trimmed like their bearers, and two keys that collapse to the same trimmed id invalidate the map instead of being silently merged. (`61a6bf3`)
- Mail custom-domain expiry now claims a lapsed row first and deletes its SES identity only if it won, new registrations claim a unique per-scope domainSlot before identity creation, and related root-name registrations serialize under a short lease. (`8707fbf`)
- Merged family-sharing server work: account merge run and persistence proofs, family plan surfaces, sharing enable-impact and transition logic, channel user quota, hosted bot audience, plan entitlement for personal owners, family bot grant proofs, and the family-sharing, control-plane, org-admin, platform-identity and telegram-login routers with tests. (`5309687`)
- Account merge now re-checks family ownership including an in-flight enable claim and stops before moving data, while family enable reports in_progress during a merge for any workspace member. A family with sharing paused by the rollout flag keeps the owner's Max bot limit from the personal customer, and team-scope writers such as projects, gateway keys, policy layers, config apply/rollback, fleet enrollment, assignments, rules and stack templates refuse a team in a family workspace. (`f15f111`)
- Family sharing now reads Max from the owner's personal Polar customer as well as the org customer, Telegram linking claims channel-user capacity in the same per-org quota transaction as grant enables, and direct team creation re-checks the kind after the write and removes a team that landed in a family. Member exit and kind changes disable enabled bot grants beyond the family's new channel-user limit, keeping member-linked and oldest first. (`0586710`)
- Enabling a channel-user grant now claims capacity inside a transaction that bumps a per-org guard row, preventing concurrent enables from exceeding the family or plan channel-user limit, and the default team counts as configured when it holds any team-scoped runtime state. Family-sharing and platform-identity paths gained persistence-proof tests, and a repeated enable reruns the idempotent bot-grant sweep. (`88b664f`)
- POST /api/step-up/challenge now answers a per-recipient email cooldown with 429, a Retry-After header and a retryAfter value, phrasing the daily cap in minutes or hours, while other errors still return 500. Added a router proof test covering cooldown after sign-in, resend inside the minute, provider outage and the daily cap. (`d9a5a97`)
- Both quota seeding paths now sum to/cc/bcc lengths, repeats included, over every row the provider accepted, matching the acceptance rule the overage sweep settles on, instead of counting only messages still in `sent`. The accepted-status list moved to the email model so the sweep and seed share it. (`d391b0b`)
- debitOrganization now claims every Composio receipt refId before debiting, so exactly one org wins and another org's debit is skipped as a duplicate charged elsewhere. The pre-claim (reason, refId) ledger lookup moved inside the claim, settlement reads the debit result instead of doing its own lookup, and a failed debit releases its claim. (`09c2d6a`)
- Marked the hosted Mail legacy webhook secret fixture the same way as the other webhook signature tests, so secret scanners stop reporting the fixed base64 placeholder. (`2a59a15`)
- Mail router inbox creation now claims a contracted slot after insert, hands open slots to the scope's unslotted inboxes oldest first, and removes a new inbox left without a slot so the request gets the same 403. Quota tests cover the parallel-create path. (`e795beb`)
- Marked the webhook signature test vectors in the inbox and mail webhook tests so gitleaks and DeepSource no longer flag them. (`697b82f`)
- Changed claimVerifiedDomain so the organization that last proves DNS control takes the domain from other orgs, and added a daily recheck worker that revokes a domain after three consecutive missing TXT records while ignoring resolver errors. The org-domains router now returns the recheck warning. (`daec915`)
- Account merge now claims the survivor's family place for each membership it moves, preventing an invitation accepted after preflight from exceeding the five-family cap; added a persistence proof test. (`76c16c6`)
- Added an org-domains router that issues a TXT challenge at _ryu-verification.&lt;domain> and handles verify and remove, writing the verifiedDomains summary used by Enterprise SSO. Gold requests return 409 until Stripe identity and a domain are verified, /mine returns a goldRequirements checklist, and admin queue rows carry Stripe status and domain names. (`80435f1`)
- Changed the marketplace and org-verification routers to resolve publisher trust from plan signals, batch-read Polar billing and Enterprise grants, refuse gold requests for non-Business orgs, report planEligible from /mine, and show each org's plan tier in the admin queue. (`18b3e4a`)
- Added an authenticated POST /api/discord-invite route backed by a community bot invite helper. The helper mints a max-uses-1, 24-hour invite, re-serves live invites, and caps users at three new invites per rolling 24 hours. (`b2af7a6`)
- Family sharing transitions now re-count teams under the transition claim, restore personal when a team appeared, and log a failed place confirmation after promotion rather than failing a completed enable. Persistence and router tests cover the transitions. (`7fc95d4`)
- Personal-org resolution, billing kind, control-plane org listings, account merge counting and admin signals now read the top-level organization kind first. A family admission whose settlement check cannot complete removes the new member and returns a retryable 503. (`66887e6`)
- Teams checkout claims now re-read the org kind and refuse a family, while enable and disable hold the same per-org claim around their kind writes. Disable re-checks members and live seat claims before and after its write and restores the family if an admission slipped in. (`7195b97`)
- Family bot grants are now disabled when a member leaves or is removed and when a workspace enters or leaves family mode. Added an enable-impact computation used by the confirmation flow, with router, persistence-proof and unit tests. (`dc0509e`)
- The mail domain helpers moved out of the router into lib/mail-domains.ts so the routes and the new worker share provisioning, the strict DKIM plus DNS-CNAME refresh, expiry and conflict filters. The pollMailDomains worker re-checks pending domains on a ten-minute-then-hourly backoff up to the seven-day expiry, leases rows so replicas never check one twice, and stops after 50 SES calls per run. (`d3c3de0`)
- Overlapping Polar deliveries now settle a transfer concurrently, and a delivery that paid but lost the final write records the payout on the row. The Stripe Connect account idempotency key now rotates every minute so a failed onboarding retry is not blocked by Stripe replaying the first answer for 24 hours. (`ff25519`)
- The service usage adapters and settlement code now meter Box snapshots in byte-seconds through a snapshotByteSeconds meter, emitting one exact line per snapshot inside the window's single round-up. Windows are refused for snapshots that outlive the window, exceed the 2 TiB ceiling, or carry a negative or fractional size. (`e4c72ab`)
- Reworked the billing status feed to serve polls from memory with a background refresher, single-flight computation, a 2-second per-org lookup timeout, 60-second cross-service answer caching, and an 8-second wait before answering 503. (`cd69cd6`)
- Changed org and member spend calculation to add Composio, Treg, sandbox, box, notify, passport, and mail ledger debits on top of rolled-up spend, with tests pinning each reason to one side. (`71e53f7`)
- Added GET /api/service-billing/status serving per-service suspended bearer digests behind a constant-time bearer check, mounted ahead of the session middleware, with per-service 30-second caching and fail-open credit lookups that leave a failing org out of the list. The secret comparison helper moved to lib/secret-matches.ts and the credits router was updated alongside it. (`333fd06`)
- Enforced family workspace policy across billing, credits, control plane, fleet secrets, connector catalog, organization features, servers, rewards store, and watch routes, so team-only surfaces refuse family workspaces and family billing requires the owner. (`50a28e7`)
- Claimed server transfer completion and moved the node in one transaction with resumable settlement, guarded Connect onboarding with a params-scoped idempotency key, chained points plan windows through a unique index, and keyed creator purchase attributions to the purchase Idempotency-Key. (`c46af93`)
- Updated challenge prize projection and challenge router logic to keep credit prizes in the winner's personal workspace, return 409 when none exists, and avoid re-reserving pool budget on retried awards. The credits router test now expects the capped $1,000 preset quote. (`0a8e5ba`)
- Family bot channel-user allowance is now the live family member count with a maximum of 6, and a linked non-member is refused on a family bot. The admin family-sharing router and platform-identity code were updated accordingly. (`45417bf`)
- Revised the family sharing and admin family sharing routers and support libraries, including account merge, channel user quota, family sharing signals and hosted bot audience, along with their accompanying tests. The changes formed an in-progress second round of review fixes to family sharing. (`2131d14`)
- Settlement now stops claiming cursors and starting hours after RUN_BUDGET_MS, moves Box exhaustion into runBoxExhaustionCheck on its own five-minute tick, and routes both ticks through guardedJob, which skips overlapping ticks and restarts a run that exceeds RUN_WATCHDOG_MS instead of going silent. (`675d459`)
- Settlement now records lastSeenAt for each configured org on claim, renew, advance, or touch, and fast-forwards the cursor to the next whole hour when the previous sighting is older than SIGHTING_GAP_MS; claim() moved inside the try/finally so a failed claim still releases the lease. Fixtures and settlement tests were updated. (`9bc7c77`)
- A new ledger-charge-lookup checks for a composio charge with the same refId in any wallet before debiting a Connect receipt, skipping and logging cross-org charges, and treats a Polar reused-event-id error for a composio refId as already charged elsewhere instead of failing the hour. (`d49fb47`)
- A debit that fails after the provider accepted now records an emailOverageHold, and reserveMailSend settles the org's accepted pending charges before returning 503 while any remain; the provider message id is written as acceptance evidence immediately, and pending charges with no evidence are dropped after an hour without charging. (`704ccab`)
- Settlement now reads Connect one page at a time, renews the lease every minute or every 100 receipts, and saves the next page's cursor as a checkpoint after each page so a new owner resumes there; conditional cursor writes check matchedCount to confirm the lease is still held. (`5548e45`)
- Malformed service billing settings are now reported by name, without their values, and logged as errors at worker start and once per settlement run instead of being read as not configured. (`a606c7c`)
- Settlement skips exempt orgs for every service, the Box bridge no longer answers 402 for them, and exhaustion does not stop their Boxes; the worker logs the exempt count at start. (`bda5679`)
- organizationHasServiceCredit now returns true when either the remaining plan pool or the unrestricted balance is positive, rather than netting the pool against top-up debt, and readOrganizationServiceCredit returns both balances; exhaustion also stops Boxes in error status. (`0b15f16`)
- All send paths now reserve through reserveMailSend and, past the allowance, overflow only when service billing is enabled, the scope is an organization and a paid plan is live-confirmed; the overflow is priced per recipient, debited after provider acceptance with refId mail:{messageId}, retried before the next send, and refused with 503 while unsettled. (`74bb33c`)
- The budget-reason parity test widens readonly reason tuples to string arrays so it type-checks under tsc. (`b15400d`)
- Service debits carry no member, so they count toward the organization scope only, and a test pins the list to every debit reason except the bookkeeping ones. (`779153b`)
- Passed the Polar meter a plain copy of the ledger attribution and widened two literal-typed size assertions in the service usage adapter test so the billing code type-checks. (`b62db50`)
- Box create and resume now return 402 insufficient_credits in the Box error envelope when hosted service billing is on and the organization has no plan pool left and no positive unrestricted balance, while stop is never gated. (`9cd28ac`)
- priceComposioUsage now reads the shared composio-rates.json fixture, with tests covering the TypeScript pricing against the same rate card used by the Gateway. (`85993e5`)
- Added box, notify, passport, and mail debit reasons to the shared reasons module so the debit route and wallet ledger accept them, with a contract test keeping every debit reason a non-credit ledger reason. (`4516431`)
- The credits debit route and the debit-organization helper now accept the hosted-service ledger reasons, with tests covering the debit path. (`81be005`)
- Added in-progress channel user quota and hosted bot audience helpers for a family-sized bot allowance, with accompanying platform identity and Telegram login tests. (`b30c61b`)
- Added family-sharing routers and helpers covering up to five family memberships per account plus platform-admin abuse signals, and adjusted account merge for family accounts, behind the billing.family_sharing flag. (`3dfb67a`)
- Typed the account-merge family-owner check against Mongo rows, collapsed the Teams-on-family webhook branch, and applied formatting so typechecks and lint return to baseline; the billing router carries owner-only billing in family workspaces, enable refused unless the owner is alone with no open Teams checkout, family-aware merge blockers, compare-and-set kind writes, and seat status resolved before any Polar lookup. (`cdeb311`)
- Bound exact-version installs to the reviewed package digest instead of re-inspecting a version label, limited approvals to moderator decisions with recorded digests, and hid refusals behind the existing visibility checks. Trimmed release history while preserving latest decisions, excluded yanked versions from approvedVersions, and added tests. (`f20e04c`)
- Added a family-sharing router with admission and policy logic, feature-flag handling, seat and credit accounting, account-merge and org-admin updates, and control-plane surfacing, with tests, all gated behind billing.family_sharing. (`22a10fb`)
- Routed the catalog detail and GitHub download paths through the historical version gate, added the `approvedVersions` field to the detail response, and covered the gate with release and router tests. (`ea80b47`)
- Made the approve path recompute `yanked` and `deprecated` from the recorded history entry via `stableLifecycleFlags`, so a flag scoped to a previous version no longer hides a republished build; the write is guarded on the reviewed version and returns 409 on a concurrent republish. (`bdef4c2`)
- Added a services-auth proof test for the support-access router and adjusted support-access.ts so native Stop and sign-out notify the owner's support banner, with a dedicated tsconfig for the proof build. (`6e9e8ad`)
- Updated the documents sync router test as part of an in-progress test-fix checkpoint. (`51082d9`)
- Updated the fleet enrollment source test. (`860de26`)
- Bounded input validation across the aggregation, campaigns, credits, feature waitlists, marketplace share codes, and platform identity routers, plus federation, fleet enrollment, and vault core libraries. Native response contracts were restored and tests updated for each router and library. (`d0b66ba`)
- The Stripe transfer id is persisted on the payout as soon as transfers.create returns, so a database failure afterwards saves it with the failed row and the retry finalizes it without a transfers.list lookup. The regression test now asserts the id is kept and no lookup or second create is needed. (`6bbce6f`)
- When revoking a dead transfer's receiving subscription fails because another delivery of the same payment already revoked it, the release now checks Polar and logs the subscription as already ended instead of raising a critical manual-revoke warning. A test covers two refused deliveries of one payment revoking once. (`0fcb3c6`)
- A single isLifecycleRecipient rule now gates every lifecycle email path, including personal recap, team recap recipients, idle-agent spend and check-ins. It requires a verified email that is not anonymous, merged, banned or on the waitlist, and team recipients resolved from org roles are checked individually. (`3124ef9`)
- Added webhook test coverage for the watermark claim's duplicate-key retry, including concurrent first delivery of the same snapshot and an older event losing the first-insert race. (`e3eee29`)
- Corrected the plan rate-ceiling and control-plane bootstrap tests. (`c80b5cb`)
- Hardened custom domain registration and verification in the mail router: verification requires sendable SES status with the identity's own Easy DKIM tokens and resolving DKIM CNAMEs, registration refuses names held by another scope or by operator-created parent identities, and unverified registrations lapse after 7 days. Added coverage in mail-hosted-security.test.ts. (`69b3618`)
- Added a test in mail-hosted-quotas.test.ts pinning the webhook delivery retention window to MAIL_LIFECYCLE.retentionDays. (`f87bef7`)
- Mail domain routes now create an SESv2 Easy DKIM identity, return the DNS records to publish, add POST /mail/domains/:id/verify for status checks, remove the identity on delete, and refuse the shared domain, cross-scope registrations and identities SES already holds, with router tests. (`0a021cd`)
- Added GET, PUT and DELETE routes at /api/mail/admin/quota-overrides/:organizationId that require platform admin access, a fresh platform.admin step-up for writes, native schema validation, and emit mail.quota_override.set and .removed audit events; the routes mount ahead of the mail-configured guard. Tests were extended and the list-entry send cases typed. (`d253391`)
- The desktop settings sync push response now lists unchanged keys alongside the exact edit time and value already stored, with tests covering the behavior. (`0e994ae`)
- Draft PATCH saves now apply only while the draft is unclaimed, returning 409 when a send has claimed it in the meantime, and the draft conflict message is shared with manual send. Tests cover the PATCH/claim interleaving and the conditional save filter. (`7b04e2e`)
- Allow and block list entries are now stored as parsed, lower-cased addr-specs for email entries and without a leading @ for domain entries, and matching normalizes rows stored before this change. GET and DELETE by path accept either spelling, with tests covering quoted display names containing commas, bare angle brackets, cc/bcc comma lists, and legacy rows. (`17cb70d`)
- Stripe transfer recovery now adopts transfers that were already committed before a retry, and affiliate payout and marketplace membership settlement paths were updated alongside new recovery tests. (`75d9cc9`)
- Server transfers are now resumable, account merge counters and persistence are corrected, and control-plane bootstrap config revisions were fixed, with accompanying tests. (`660fe96`)
- Polar subscription webhook events are now processed in order and server resizes are locked, with changes to cloud provisioning and the servers router plus new tests. (`e921250`)
- Updated control-plane input handling, core proof key logic, feature flags, plan entitlements and rate ceilings, organization limits, and the admin, billing, org-admin, and control-plane routers, with tests for each. (`6b92c05`)
- License writes from subscription events now apply only when the event's billing period is the same or later than the stored one, so a late checkout or retried older invoice can no longer reactivate a refunded or disputed license or repoint it away from its PaymentIntent. The insert became a separate setOnInsert-only upsert with a single re-apply for concurrent first events, and persistence proofs cover late checkout, older invoice, post-refund redelivery and concurrent first events. (`bf8cfa9`)
- Tightened the step-up-session burst test so it asserts exactly five Better Auth comparisons (four 401s plus the one that spent the budget) instead of at most five, so a reservation that skips the compare now fails. (`d4259be`)
- Enabled Hetzner automated backups in cloud provisioning for fresh creates, adopted and snapshot-restored servers, added a provision-worker sweep that backfills active live servers, and disabled backups before server deletion on retirement and confirmed destroy. (`1f4d324`)
- Added timeouts to Polar billing calls, made plan-pool projection apply updates in order, and gave refund reconciliation a persisted cursor so interrupted passes resume where they stopped. Failing paths now surface as errors instead of silently dropping state. (`ca9d1e6`)
- Draft sends are now claim-guarded and mail delivery is idempotent, with SES events processed in order. Delivery-status tracking and request body limits were tightened, and the mail router gained authorization tests. (`b7254b6`)
- The desktop settings sync router now applies revisioned writes so stale clients cannot overwrite newer state, covered by router and native Mongo tests. (`c5aa3f4`)
- Stripe webhook handling now expires licenses correctly, writes refund tombstones so refunded purchases stay refunded, and serializes creator budget updates to avoid races. Affiliate and purchase paths gained persistence-proof tests. (`8634a63`)
- Fixed the Composio relay so a reset cursor can be recovered and dispatch runs asynchronously, and added timeouts to relay download handling. Regression tests were added alongside the router changes. (`1b6ae14`)
- Made audit timestamps and the org integrations store persistent, and tightened the community and org-admin routers accordingly. Added persistence-proof and router tests covering the new behavior. (`34e7693`)
- Reworked step-up password and session routes to use an atomic attempt budget, and added timeouts to the user email-change flow. Added regression tests for both routers. (`8f12e50`)
- Added a mail-hosted quotas test that pins EMAIL_EVENT_RETENTION_DAYS to the deactivated-inbox mail retention in MAIL_LIFECYCLE. (`1cfeba5`)
- Mail event webhooks now use whsec_ secrets and send webhook-id, webhook-timestamp and webhook-signature headers repeated as svix-*, verifiable by Standard Webhooks and Svix libraries, with pre-existing rows kept on the legacy raw-key HMAC until rotateSecret moves them. Inbox webhookUrl deliveries gained a sealed per-inbox webhookSecret minted on set, replaced by rotateWebhookSecret, dropped when the URL is cleared and returned once; signature header names and content-type are reserved from custom headers. (`960fcd2`)
- Added POST /api/composio-relay/rotate, which swaps a RelayNode's relay token under the same session-owner scoping as register and subscribe, returns the new relay_token and public_url once with no-store caching, and revokes the old token immediately by dropping its cached owner, rate window, replay buffer and live SSE subscription. Rotations are capped at 10 per minute per owner, and subscribe now replays from the start when a cursor is past the newest event. (`92dc361`)
- Persistence-proof and native-http tests across billing, profile, updates and CMS routers were updated, the billing router changed, and dedicated tsconfig proof configs added for API-owned, CMS, support access and general coverage. (`de4237a`)
- The managed agents driver and adapters now share the platform wallet across sessions that are mid-dispatch, gate new turns on a one-cent session-budget floor, keep Gemini tool-result batches inside the cursor limit, price Gemini usage at turn start, and reuse the shared redirect check. (`4379bfd`)
- Addressed review findings across the managed-agents runtime, billing, and backends. The driver and lease now repair crashes between the terminal event and finalize, keep close wake-ups, refuse inputs after a terminal status, stop provisioning on cancel, and treat non-HTTP dispatch failures as not sent; billing applies markup once, stops sessions on a non-positive wallet, bills Anthropic cache writes as deltas, and keeps the Polar ledger reason; Anthropic budgets are per turn, OpenAI shell containers and reconcile cutoffs are handled, and the Gemini input shape is valid; the router returns 422 for non-text content, emits JSON errors from the support-access gate, enforces sender budgets on events, and the client refuses redirects. (`8bf82cf`)
- Dropped the stale 'including Ryu's markup' note from the org usage ingest code. (`27dc341`)
- signManifest now sends the signing master key only for a loopback Gateway base URL and surfaces the loopback requirement in the 502 when the URL is remote, with tests covering the behaviour. (`f679d5c`)
- The API error handler on /api/mail/inbound now logs only the request path, so the ?token= inbound secret no longer appears in HTTPException logs. (`ce6e49f`)
- The signing path gained test coverage. (`bafe6dd`)
- Settled the testing helper names used by the router and driver so the module aligns with the runtime. (`ab30821`)
- The reconcile order schema keeps billingReason, customer and subscriptionId, so a paid standalone funding checkout can be verified instead of failing with a 502. Standalone subscription pages are decoded across provider envelopes rather than assuming result.items, with a reconcile test added. (`ed882fa`)
- Reworked the support-access persistence proof cases to be independent and order-free. (`b9dbb96`)
- Changed the relay's process-wide replay budget so an owner within its fair share can take room from the owner holding the most replay above that share, evicting the oldest frame of that owner's largest channel first. Owners whose delivery would exceed their share are still refused, and admission is still decided before any state changes. (`639fa60`)
- Kept the relay's global unknown-token rate window from being evicted when the bounded window map fills, and trimmed a full map to 45,000 entries in batches so the sweep cost is amortized instead of rescanning all 50,000 windows per new key. (`940d2fe`)
- Free-baseline storage checks now sum the inbox's whole owner scope, including paused and deactivated inboxes, plus the owner's slot-holding inboxes elsewhere. Send units are now counted per listed recipient instead of being deduplicated case-insensitively. (`6fb291d`)
- Added the credit debit reason definitions and fixture-backed validation in the credits router, with a test asserting the control plane accepts every reason the Gateway can send. (`37f55bb`)
- Added regression tests for hosted mail allowances covering one free allowance per person across organizations, downgrade lapse, per-recipient send counting, opt-in open tracking, storage caps, the unconfigured 503 guard, and PATCH /pods/:id. (`905b636`)
- Hosted mail metering moved to one free allowance per person, with sends counted per distinct recipient and storage caps extended to outbound messages and drafts. Over-cap or deactivated inbound records a message.received.blocked event, and a confirmed paid plan is snapshotted on inboxes for 72 hours. (`bc39a94`)
- The boxes router received a partial edit that was left as a work-in-progress snapshot, to be completed in a later unit. (`6036690`)

- Relay ingress now refuses malformed tokens and signature-less deliveries before any shared budget, lets known tokens skip the unknown-token budget in favor of their per-token limit, and charges unknown tokens a per-client budget before the global one. Per-owner replay pressure evicts the largest channel's oldest frames instead of rejecting, and the rate-window map is bounded. (`5555764`)
- The mail security router now treats a sender as authenticated only when DMARC passes and the message carries exactly one From mailbox equal to from, and block entries apply to every claimed From mailbox. Tests cover the ambiguous-From cases. (`65a1370`)
- Extended the fleet, gateway tool-policy and organization features routers so fleet secrets can be scoped to a team and tool-policy accepts relay credentials, with tests covering the new paths. (`03aad6f`)
- Hardened the hosted mail router with reserved role local parts on the shared managed domain, inbox deletion that purges stored MIME and attachments before retiring the address with a tombstone, bare-address allow/block matching, DMARC-gated inbound allow lists, SNS MessageId deduplication, and live mail.manage re-checks when scheduled drafts fire. Read-only members now see webhookConfigured instead of the legacy webhook URL, and custom headers use the shared denylist. (`321fe18`)
