- Referral invites are now capped at 100 per sender in a rolling day, in addition to the existing per-recipient limit, with tests covering the cap. (`cf06368`)
- The shared-budget reserve route now writes a gateway's contribution slot and the recomputed total in a single pipeline update, so concurrent gateway reports no longer overwrite each other. (`b228707`)
- Repaired stale billing mocks in the auto-topup identity and servers-capacity suites, stubbing the credits, customer-identity and plan-entitlement exports and giving the ProvisionedServer fake a countDocuments method. Added an MPP sidecar test pinning that a paid request failing after its signed credential was sent keeps its budget reservation. (`3be8b89`)
- Node-transfer completion now refuses a payment from any organization other than the transfer's recipient before handing over the node and crediting the sender. Added server-transfer coverage for the new check in the Polar webhook path. (`a9f1ff6`)
- Refused purchase attribution when the buyer org is the seller or when the buyer or creator belongs to the selling org, and required platform.admin step-up for campaign create/edit and creator application review. (`2b598ac`)
- Required billing.manage for affiliate payout onboarding, moved account merge consent to an explicit POST, and restricted usage point awards to real calendar days within the last 7 days while stats still accept older buckets. (`93baf36`)
- Capped platform-funded Marketplace commissions at the platform fee collected on the sale, recorded nothing when no fee was kept, required platform.admin step-up on routes that grant value, and bounded UserStats operation ids to the latest 500 with a ledger uniqueness check. (`6a0a3ea`)
- Made the top-up leg of the credits transfer an atomic conditional debit, treated Stripe Connect purchase metadata as untrusted and bound connected-account events to server state, settled creator attributions only for their original buyer and item, and refused gift claim tokens using the public fallback key in production. (`0cae723`)
- Merged upstream work into the API package, reconciling conflict resolutions across billing scope, gifting, marketplace creators, node capacity resolution, rewards entitlement, and the billing, gifts, marketplace, and rewards-store routers. (`4f2bfb3`)
- Adjusted the marketplace router so recovered features line up with the current API contracts. (`b0e15df`)
- Added the marketplace creators library with tests and exposed it through the marketplace router. (`695f53c`)
- Billing scope, gifting, node capacity resolution, and rewards entitlement logic were updated, along with the billing, gifts, and rewards-store routers. Tests were added for rewards entitlement. (`2b3568a`)
- A test was added covering conversation share revocation, proving that the revocation persists and that the operation retries. (`574dda5`)
- Resolved merge conflicts across the API package's library modules and routers, including billing, credits, marketplace, public agents, managed SSH, step-up, telemetry, and waitlist code together with their tests. (`1b8bdef`)
- Merged credits and billing logic covering auto top-up with a plan guard, credit top-up, plan entitlements and the credits and control-plane routers. Money-path invariant and Polar webhook tests were updated, including customer security coverage for the credits router. (`22ab0db`)
- Updated API library modules covering cloud catalog, credits, gateway credentials, Polar billing, public agent admission, egress and execution, analytics, step-up, and wide events, plus routers for aggregation, billing, control plane, credits, profile, public agents, servers, telemetry, and waitlist access codes. (`5be3771`)
- Credit handling and box-viewer authorization were corrected so consumed allowance is preserved and authorized invitation expiry is respected, with tests covering both paths. (`f718c1d`)
- The certifications and academy routers were changed to return public projections and to verify current team authority, with accompanying test coverage in both areas. (`9a0ea6a`)
- Marketplace community statistics are now bound to their originating source and public items go through the public projection, with the marketplace router updated and covered by a new public-stats test. (`49560ca`)
- The control-plane router now enforces recurring authority, with a bootstrap test covering the new check. (`525d737`)
- Enforced node entitlements in capacity resolution, included and paid grants, scheduled actions, billing, and server routing, with new entitlement tests. (`744c730`)
- Changed the referrals router to preserve hosted identity and added router tests for it. (`808fe35`)
- Changed the step-up password router to await password proof before granting account changes, with corresponding router tests. (`9ca3fd3`)
- Added and updated authorization checks across the account merge, billing, boxes, control plane, credits, mail, platform identity, and user routers, along with the shared org authorization, outbound attachment, and Polar return URL helpers. Tests were added for the merge, authorization, and return URL behavior. (`8ad0bc7`)
- Updated the billing and control-plane routers to expose the Composio rollout flag and the standardized ZDR behavior. (`c6fedf3`)
- Added billing-scope helpers and updated billing and control-plane routers to meter Composio usage and enforce managed ZDR gating, with credit tests. (`e55b1b8`)
- Adjusted the marketplace router test to match the updated Codex reset watch forecast source. (`aae95a8`)
- Cloud node provisioning now fails closed in production when a resize runs without a live Hetzner node, instead of recording a size the server never received. Tests cover the new path. (`a87cd7a`)
- Added marketplace router tests and router changes for the Stripe Link agent wallet provider. (`143222e`)
- Added a context session cache in the API context module, with test coverage. (`b0202e4`)
- Updated the profile router to save public profile banners on the node. (`ed346ae`)
- Updated the profile router and its wrapped-profile tests to support Marketplace wallpaper banners. (`166cb2f`)
- Cloud provisioning and billing-server logic now derive outcomes from verified results rather than assuming success, with new policy and test coverage. (`017e454`)

- Added no-plan managed Gateway PAYG handling to auto top-up, plan entitlement, control-plane, and credits router code, with updated tests. (`6dc6deb`)

- Added test isolation for the feature flag router authentication boundary. (`5e19ca1`)
- Bounded responses in the Composio relay and conversations sync routers, with tests covering both. (`551520b`)
- Updated cloud provisioning and control-plane bootstrap code for scoped agent credentials, with corresponding test changes. (`f68feff`)
- Added a node delegation library and wired the control plane bootstrap router to it, with tests covering both the delegation helper and router bootstrap flow. (`ec262ab`)
- Updated node delegation checks so secret mutation requires vault-write consent, with corresponding tests in node-delegation.test.ts. (`aec79ac`)
- Bound server transfer pricing to the server region in billing and Polar webhook logic, with server-transfer tests and billing router updates. (`473a75f`)
- Bound fleet projects and adopted nodes to their issuing scope across enrollment, project-scope, credential, and fleet router code, with tests. (`da8cd52`)
- Bound registry project scope to the gateway key in gateway credential handling and the registry router, with tests. (`8d5d157`)
- Added admin managed-node API logic and router endpoints, updated fleet secret handling, and registered the router with tests. (`81bc940`)
- Platform identity claim handling and the platform identity router now require sender proof before global identity routing, with accompanying unit and router tests. (`66abd7a`)
- Updated platform identity routing to enforce the public pinned HTTPS origin restriction for grants. (`736d255`)
- Capped and expired relay webhook replay buffers and added composio relay tests for the limits. (`b542d13`)
- Changed the marketplace subscription policy and Stripe webhook handling so a license is only extended when the associated invoice has been paid. Added policy tests. (`7523839`)
- Changed the mail router so scheduling a draft is rejected unless the caller holds send permission. (`361b08d`)
- Added a mail list policy and applied it in the mail router, and changed the control-plane bootstrap path to pin server fetch destinations. Tests were added for the policy and the bootstrap behaviour. (`4509500`)
- Changed credit top-up handling so the full quoted amount must be paid before credits are granted, and adjusted the Polar webhook and credits router accordingly. Added top-up and money-path invariant tests. (`7331486`)
- Bounded sync pagination and SSE queues by bytes, updating conversation and document sync routers plus tests. (`06c1f51`)
- Reduced repeated aggregation and marketplace catalog work, and added a usage streaks benchmark with updated tests. (`a063969`)
- Updated user password router tests to align password changes with step-up verification. (`8935b3d`)
- Updated dependency versions in the API package to clear the reported Snyk findings. (`01b2aa8`)
- Updated the marketplace router in line with the item regating changes. (`cf8c1e8`)

### `@ryu/app-studio`@0.5.0

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amajorai/ryu-marketplace/134dad3aef109140ff9aaaa0fe4224b7ab8c5b63/app-icons/app-studio-light.png) ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amajorai/ryu-marketplace/134dad3aef109140ff9aaaa0fe4224b7ab8c5b63/app-icons/app-studio-dark.png) [GitHub release](https://github.com/amajorai/ryu-app-studio/releases/tag/v0.5.0)

#### Minor changes

- Added the App Studio Companion with starter-based app creation, a shared visual and chat editor, script-enabled sandbox preview, source editing, permission selection, and install or update; drafts persist in app storage. Also added its manifest, plugin metadata, and compiled UI entry point. (`6ef71fc`)

#### Patch changes

#### Minor changes

#### Patch changes

- Merged main into the branch, splitting the public widget into separate panel, chat, morph, page-context, page-tools and runtime-controls modules with matching schema, error and theme files. Test coverage was extended with deferred, theme, interaction and runtime-controls test files. (`41ee7a7`)

- Widget settings choices, page-tool rows, recent chats, toggles, inputs and stats switched to foreground tints (/10 selected, /5 hover) so selection and hover states are visible on the popover surface. The language select hidden over the More button now shows a focus ring. (`ab96db9`)

### `@ryu/auth`@0.5.0

#### Minor changes

- Updated landing-announcement auth helpers and tests for the new background presets and off state. The helpers now cover the saved and unsaved announcement states. (`2c6d1b5`)
- Added the shared landing-announcement contract: the icon set, link safety that rejects javascript:, data:, http:, //host, backslash and whitespace tricks and embedded credentials, save validation, and the half-open live-now resolver. (`dc9972d`)
- Added catalog.workflows, catalog.agents_as_a_service and catalog.red_team as default-off public flags in the feature-flag catalog, with a new product-launch-flags module mapping them by slug. (`ca7bb4f`)
- recipient-locale now falls back to the request-scoped locale context, so email-change verification, invites, and account merge or delete emails follow the requester's locale cookie or Accept-Language. Stored user locales still win for other recipients. (`8102af4`)

### `@ryu/blocks`@0.5.0

#### Minor changes

- Replaced the static home product card markup with per-product animated scene components, each with its own CSS module, a shared Scene backdrop and a single Stage-based in-view gate. Added a stylesheet test covering animation shorthands that Lightning CSS previously left unscoped or dropped. (`9da0882`)
- Added shared assistant entries, prompt wording and icons for page AI actions, with tests. (`1b53e69`)
- On phones, DownloadMenu opened a bottom drawer with share-sheet, WhatsApp, Telegram, Messages and Email links, a copy-link field and a fallback to the download page. Phone detection ran after mount and the drawer chunk loaded lazily. (`30d5648`)
- A shared FeaturedUpdates layout puts the newest item in a large card, the next two side by side, then a row of three, with the rest as a compact list, and is used by both the blog index and the home page. Images fall back from a failed frontmatter banner to the opengraph card and then to a muted frame, with URLs passed through safeMediaUrl. (`e5c2769`)
- The hero download beam now takes its tone from the sky through heroBeamFor, the Halloween night horizon glow became violet, and the drifting clouds were sped up to cross the hero in under a minute. The seasonal sky and startup programs modules were updated, the latter adding the Anthropic svgl wordmark. (`ecce4e4`)
- The header's Docs link now opens in the same tab, the Research Preview badge became a translucent glass pill, and the Products and Resources menus read a HeaderLinkOrigin context so other sites can render them with absolute links. DownloadMenu accepts an optional siteOrigin for its signup link. (`57fc78f`)
- The homepage product cards under the hero now render every released product from the shared product menu list, each with a new minimal scene and copy from its catalogue entry. Wide rows were balanced so the lead cards share the first row and the rest fill rows of up to four. (`2c0ea40`)
- The footer and product-realm data take the same hidden product ids, and standalone rollout tests cover the launch-flag filtering. (`ca7bb4f`)
- The Bot product hero moved to the starfield stage, and Desktop gained DesktopWindows, a 2D-canvas backdrop of a faint dot grid with window frames floating at the stage edges and focus moving between the near ones. The canvas sleeps offscreen, caches the grid per size, and draws one still frame under reduced motion. (`0f9519b`)
- Added a WebGL cloud sky shader for the hero with morning and night palettes, made stage heroes follow the light theme, added a footer back-to-top button, and added explainer section components with per-product explainer data. Menu items became pills and the download split button lost its divider.
- Added BentoFigure and 327 Anatomy-style card drawings across 69 bento groups, lazily loaded one group per page and guarded by a coverage test. Stage heroes gained a blur-and-fade into the page background via a root --page-background, and the mobile nav dropped its solid surface.
- The pricing plan grid now uses the adaptive seat stepper instead of the previous slider, with the pricing copy test updated to match. (`27c0cfc`)
- Added seasonal landing themes driven by the visitor's local calendar, with a sky tint, per-season particle layers, a Halloween night-sky variant, and a hero-corner picker that previews or disables the theme for the tab session. Particle rendering is skipped under reduced motion and the season resolves after mount. (`cc4e5df`)
- Modified clicks and no-JS visits still open the playbook, and the hero uses the updated button. (`c29264f`)
- Reworked the footer bottom bar so the release line, legal links, credit and display controls group into two rows, with the language, sound and theme controls and the release info and credit right-aligned. (`1e9793a`)
- Added shared card motion to the Cards view: cards arc and turn over when entering or leaving the fan, decks slide as one pile, and cards deal face down on mount before turning face up. Fixed deal and move timers were replaced by per-card zone and slot decisions, and card-table-spread.tsx was split into deck parts, decks, cards list and card, placement and chrome modules. (`480b26a`)
- Added a shared card-motion module with springs, arc paths, stagger timing and a useCardMove frame hook, plus unit tests. Split the card table hand into face, marks and extras modules while re-exporting the same names from card-table-hand.tsx. (`f964291`)
- Added a halloween-season helper with tests for resolving season on the visitor's clock, and taught realms-hero to render a night sky with a harvest moon and pumpkin glow in season and in the dark theme. (`da832ed`)
- Added Datadog for Startups to the landing page startup programs strip component. (`ac0648c`)
- Added plan badges and the gradient card ring to the public pricing page and split pricing.tsx into sibling pricing-* modules while preserving its named exports. (`3baa2ed`)
- Restored the earlier hero layout, made the footer span the full viewport and removed the live desktop demo component along with its tests. (`3544013`)
- Updated the gateway canvas to accept link counts with a counter snapshot, keep an aggregated host's median, and draw no request counts on infrastructure nodes. (`4fe98a8`)
- The shared gateway canvas gained the Policies palette, drop targets, confirmation dialog and keyboard selection, plus policyCanvasAssignment, which binds to the policy workspace client as a create-only write through the step-up wrapper and surfaces scope_already_assigned for an occupied scope. The table and panel views show no counts when a map has no feed. (`de4b9ab`)
- Added the gateway canvas block: topology and pulse types, traffic-event to pulse mapping with bounded dedupe on seq and request id, a live store keeping counters outside the React Flow node array, longest-path layered layout, accessible nodes and edges, a click-to-edit panel, a table view, and an SSR mount guard. (`d334f29`)
- Added shared guardrails pieces for desktop and web: a policy view model, a rules editor with firewall and DLP cards in add-only mode, a scope picker, a preview with per-field provenance, a policy list and a workspace handling create, edit, assign, remove, archive and version_conflict reloads. (`3e95dac`)
- An interactive isometric figure was added for the Gateway product page, simulating a request through the eight pipeline stages in their fixed order with the 429 and 403 outcomes. (`c1800a7`)
- An interactive isometric figure was added for the Core product page, swapping one of 15 local chat engines into the player while voice, image and embedding engines stay seated and a health dial tracks the 30 second supervisor sweep. (`bf5c514`)
- Vendored the MIT-licensed anatomy isometric figure kit under blocks, including its license, README, stylesheet and React draw and live components. The code stays verbatim apart from explicit import extensions and a ts-nocheck header. (`754eae2`)
- Renamed the desktop agent-edit block and the web header, hero, platform-story, product data and console-landing blocks to Agent, Bot, OS and Console, with their tests. (`315c4a0`)
- Added renderer settings for arcade, lobby, quiz, rides, world-2d and world-3d, with live parameter reads, overlayDensity and workBubbles handling, and tests for defaults, overrides and live changes. (`7b10e16`)
- Added per-game settings across the six desktop game interfaces, including town speed and data view persistence and kit overlay settings applying to town board lines and work bubbles. (`b7980f7`)
- Added useInterfaceSetting and wired Board layout and grouping, Timeline and Calendar scale, Calendar side rail, Canvas arrangement and minimap, and Knowledge Graph controls to save through port.updateSettings. (`cb3c6eb`)
- Made the arcade, farm, market, passport, rides and workers interfaces accept KitGameParams props, with the game3d props test updated. (`8c2036b`)
- The Aquarium diorama stage was rebuilt as a glass tank on a wooden cabinet inside a room with a board floor, rug, skirting-boarded walls, window and potted plant, replacing the island-and-sea backdrop. Tank, reef, creatures and act layer were left unchanged. (`5666ac0`)
- The web footer gained a "Designed with love & powered by Ryu" line. (`59dbd99`)
- The 3D stage, act stage, villager and kit settings now read GameKitSettingsContext from live params and HostReducedMotionContext; overlayDensity "minimal" reduces station boards to limit and cue lines, and workBubbles false hides plain work bubbles while keeping asks, problems, limits and results. Host animations-off is treated as reduced motion. (`8fd77b2`)
- Desktop settings items render SettingsCard without a fill inside the onboarding backdrop while keeping its hairline border. (`43a54e7`)
- The 3D kit's placement checker keeps alarm plates off agents' name plates, derives an estimated figure for agents without head and feet probes, and halves the overlay cap when the measured stage height is under 480px. (`a7c8a1e`)
- WorldHelpers now mounts the kit Apprentices with follow for each agent's running helpers around its walking body, with curved ApprenticeTally words, keyed by helper counts and hidden while a conversation holds the frame. The local CurvedAnchor was replaced by the kit's game3d-anchor. (`89a0dee`)
- Added opt-in VillagerSpec.follow so villagers, their pose, plate anchor and life script are offset by a moving body's ground position, with apprenticeSpecs({ follow }) passing it to the helpers. Promoted CurvedAnchor from World 3D, added curved and follow to MeterText and ApprenticeTally, and moved the tally's words onto a station group at the same world positions. (`c712256`)
- Added alarm lamps for counted and stale failures, per-step tools and following helpers, a next-step signpost, zzz on returning limits and waitBand tinting on the wait plaque across the world-2d act sprite, act, palette and render modules. (`b1b7af1`)
- Added opt-in 3D kit seams for seasonal extras: a candle wait-timer shape, headline tray tags, dressed helper looks, and a nextRunOf/renderNext prop for the next-run sign. Defaults are unchanged, and data-iso-insets moved into a layout effect so passport's legacy golden is preserved. (`955bc67`)
- Changed the path streak and goal card week to count days with a finished outcome, dated by finishedAt, runEndedAt or the last update, rather than counting messages. Also moved the trailhead queue deeper on the island so its fourth slot sits on the grass at 1280 and notices keep the you-spot gap at 390. (`e3ada75`)
- Wired the path act layer into the Path interface, adding hikers walking to their stones, trailhead queues, stop props, stone alarms, boards, pips and unread marks, and the HUD need-you and Queue controls with the summary line, blind-spot caption, ask queue and agent list. (`ab0fa03`)
- Added CottageSpec.pips so one of a cottage's five round windows lights per share of done steps, exported litWindows() and COTTAGE_WINDOWS, and covered lit and dark glass counts in tests. (`7f130ab`)
- Added per-worker data-act-figure head and feet markers in the workers diorama at each worker's chair, queue slot or rest spot, so the alarm-cover check has probes to measure in the office scene. (`9b98d1c`)
- Measured alarm sides from the figure's position via StationLayout.figure while keeping alarmSide and alarmRows as overrides, kept every plate and bubble inside the stage rect before and after separation, and ordered blockerThread so equal blockers open separate threads. Also tied gameTitleHeight to the theme spacing step and wrapped-plate leading, with tests for stageShift, ActStation side choice, rows and title heights. (`a21bd00`)
- Villagers in the world-2d pixel village now act out useful state, with new acts, act sprites, stage, render, palette and HUD modules plus an acts test. (`521bd3f`)
- Brought in the world-2d useful-state implementation: acts, act sprites, stage, render, palette, HUD, panel and interface changes with tests. (`6bb6e6a`)
- Added path-acts.tsx and path-palette.ts for the desktop Path interface, covering hikers, stops and a trailhead act layer and its palette. The pieces are not yet wired into the interface. (`bcbe7a2`)
- All three seasons adopted the act layer, with per-season you-spots, villagers stationed at their focus thread's door, pips, season-specific limit wording and wrapped-gift outcomes. Opened state comes from thread.unread, the HUD gained a keepStatus summary and ActAgentList for no-WebGL, and the no-ask DOM stays byte-identical. (`4987a60`)
- Villagers now mark each figure's head and feet with data-act-figure and data-figure-edge on the plate anchor so the harness can read figure bounds. (`f09311b`)
- The aquarium interface now drives creatures' acts — asking, stopped, limited and waiting — from agent state with matching plate badges, pointer-only props and an act-named roster. The HUD gained the ask queue, Queue and Need-you buttons, announcer, blind-spot caption and act summary. (`d3a7807`)
- LifeBubbleTag gained a side prop (left, right, up, auto) and VillagerSpec gained bubbleSide, with plate separation choosing the first clear side in screen order and falling back to the least crowded one. Animated stages hold their chosen side while reduced-motion renders re-pick each frame. (`1b6d244`)
- Alarm plates now hang to the right of their anchor beside the figure and stack on screen one plate row apart at any zoom, with ALARM_STEP reduced to an optional world climb, the station layout putting alarms screen-right, GameTitlePlate keepStatus wrapping status to two lines on compact stages, and scale and ledger tools added to VillagerTool. (`7919629`)
- Added the act-driven passport interface, with officers' island stations on the kit ActStation showing pips, departures sign, DENIED stamp, alarm plates, limit wording, unread page and suggestion, plus a harbour with sailing boats, berths, lighthouse lamp and quay pages. Added the HUD act summary with need-you and Queue buttons, AskQueueList, ActAnnouncer, ask and blocker cards, and act-described island list rows, keeping the legacy view unchanged and covering acts, HUD, redaction, limit wording and the 15a/21 checks in tests. (`b56ed27`)
- World 3D now renders asks, stopped and limited runs and working state from acts through door lanterns, rig body language and a HUD tracker; dialogue gained per-ask answer rows opening the shared ask card, alongside an AskQueueList and ActAgentList text equivalent and a non-WebGL agent list. (`c9bb0a1`)
- Rides now drives car actors from acts: asking drivers pull up at a pickup kerb with a taxi meter, broken-down cars show hazard lights and limited ones a red light, car plates carry ask, step and answer bubbles, and legacy ages, clock times and automatic selection were removed. (`228e22d`)
- Added a kneel LifeAction, blockedPose and askItem act skins, an amber limit line driven by LIMIT_TONE or a game's limitTone, and reduced-motion plate-fit handling that waits for placed plates and moves an existing nudge. (`e780858`)
- Added theming hooks to the 3D kit: ActStation gained pipSkin and limitText props, and YouSpots gained timerSkin plus tray wrapping via trayMax, trayRowStep and trayPositions. Tests for the act stage were extended. (`948cb1d`)
- The town interface now renders act props as anchored overlay buttons: one alarm per counted blocker with dim marks for older ones, unread and suggestion openers at each building, and at City Hall's steps the ask queue, delivery crate and tally, with status text following the overlay budget. Townsfolk walk to the steps and inbox on actLife, the camera frames every building in act mode, happiness falls with blocking asks by wait band, the HUD carries the act summary, caption, need-you and Queue buttons, and TownDirectory rows gain act names and ActStatus. (`f9222f0`)
- Reworked the quiz interface to stage up to four agents by act order, with an off-stage tally that opens the Queue sheet and contestant movement to the host's lectern. Added the HUD summary, need-you and Queue buttons, blind-spot caption, ask queue, announcer, cards and ActStatus on contestant rows. (`c3e56d2`)
- Changed card-table seating to stageAgents order so urgent acts, failures and asks are seated first, and made asking agents slide a face-up card to the player's seat with a dealer timer. Added the act summary HUD, need-you and Queue buttons, blind-spot caption, progress pips, off-table tally plate and act-named seat plates and rail rows. (`22dd426`)
- Farmers now play their agent's act: asking farmers carry a letter or scroll to the mailbox line at the front gate, delivering farmers set a basket on the gate's tray, and limited farmers rest on the bench with a return clock. Focus crops grow to the plan's done over total, beds show pips, elapsed, next step, run cues, a lantern column, unread marks, suggestion notes and helpers, and the HUD plus FarmList ActStatus come from the acts. (`91d58af`)
- The squad now stages through stageAgents(acts, 4, picks), with the most urgent agents on the podium, picks reordering within an act, and an off-stage tally that opens the Queue sheet. Members work at their places, step to the ready-check pad to ask, drop loot on its tray, and show alarms, limit clocks, unread marks and suggestion notes, alongside the HUD summary, need-you and Queue buttons, blind-spot caption, ask queue, announcer and cards, ActStatus rows and a fallback off-stage list. (`6802bc0`)
- Implemented warehouse picker acts: stations per aisle, walking to the shelf a step's kind needs, asks carried to the dispatch queue, answers as parcels on the dispatch desk, and intake waiting. Stations gained pips, next signs, alarms, limit cues, unread marks, suggestion notes and apprentices, the HUD gained the act summary with need-you and Queue buttons, and the picker list gained ActStatus. (`9f48f3f`)
- Implemented workers acts: asking agents queue at your office door with a moving name plate that opens the ask card, delivering agents drop a folder in the inbox tray, and limited agents wait in the coffee corner with a return clock. Desks gained plan pips, elapsed, next step, run cues, per-blocker alarms, unread marks, suggestion notes and interns; the HUD counters come from act totals with need-you and Queue buttons and the desk list gained ActStatus. (`9348883`)
- Implemented arcade acts: players work at cabinets with real progress, queue at the prize counter with their ask (with notices for parked and unowned asks), set answers on the counter tray, and show alarms, limit clocks, unread marks and suggestion notes. Added the shared DOM queue, HUD summary with need-you and Queue buttons, blind-spot caption, announcer and cards, ActStatus on fallback cabinet rows, and fixed the waiting state to appear only when the user spoke last with observedAt as the floor clock. (`7af9ccf`)
- The market interface now gives each shopkeeper its own station, queues asks at the market cross, lands answers as parcels on the stall and lists a shop's upcoming runs as its customers, with pips, alarms, limit cues, unread marks, suggestion notes, an act-summary HUD and ActStatus in the fallback list. Old-host snapshots render as before. (`c0c5df2`)
- Exported the demo's per-agent ActStation and YouSpots blocks together with unreadAsksOf, oldBlockersOf and useStageWidth, and moved LifeDemo onto them. (`e6068c1`)
- Chefs now act out agent state, carrying tickets to the pass, plating dishes on delivery and holding tools while working, with plan pips, elapsed time, next ticket, run cues, blocker alarms, limit clocks, unread marks, commis cooks and a HUD act summary; the no-WebGL line gains ActStatus per chef, ticket patience drains from ask.since toward expiresAt, and typicalRunMs delegates its median to medianRunMs. (`768cd53`)
- Adjusted the live message flags utility, with tests, to support the chat-tab live state publishing. (`c048c1d`)
- The desktop agent chat element was updated for the useful-state host mapping, including question cards and in-place answers. (`0951745`)
- Made LifeDemo the act layer's reference scene built from agentActs on the snapshot, with per-agent stations, a you-spot queue, DOM queue, HUD summary and blind-spot caption. actLife now takes askBubble and workBubble for overlay budgeting, icon-only villager plates keep queue labels on narrow stages, and the ask and blocker cards got clearer first lines and larger phone gutters. (`0f1ac92`)
- The 3D act layer now builds and passes against the protocol types and canonical fixture, including actLife, stageAgents, actTotals and actSummaryLine, blockerEntries, toolForActivity, and overlayBudget, alongside the meters, alarm, signs, and apprentice props and the ask and blocker cards. The act fixture re-exports the protocol fixture with its clock and ids, and tests cover the acts, props, ask card, and blocker card cases. (`47ae2b8`)
- Added kit groundwork for the act layer without changing current renders: villager tools gained quill, lens, clipboard, wrench and globe, plates call activate instead of onSelect, and plates dropped aria-pressed while staying focusable. It also added plate hiding, iconOnly collapsing, IsoMarker activate support, GameTitlePlate keepStatus, scroll and tablet life items, partial and warn bubbles, and act prop scene colours. (`6cf9462`)
- Added a column layout for planets on portrait phones using columnSystem, columnFrame and columnRoom, with bodies swelling less so stacked worlds never touch, and turned the system card into a bottom sheet, covered by a new column test. (`183c7fc`)
- Reworked the Card Table interface, hand, pieces, and seat components to show timers over 3D name plates, add readable card faces, and add a tappable phone hand fan. Updated the Card Table interface tests. (`2f8c2c4`)
- Reworked the Arcade diorama and interface so cabinets sit in camera-facing rows with wider aisles, players stand beside their cabinets, screens are larger, and reel symbols are pixel-art glyphs. IsoStage gained a fitPlates option and game3d-stage was adjusted to match. (`54f4009`)
- Added portrait camera fitting and isPortraitStage, automatic plate decluttering, reading-order arrow focus with order overrides, focusZoom on IsoStage, and compact phone HUD behavior. (`eafd100`)

- Adjusted the compact single-row composer textarea so its "Ask a follow up" placeholder stays on one line at narrow pane widths around 400px, instead of wrapping and sizing the empty box to two lines. (`3e77f03`)

- Split the image lightbox into model, gesture hook, stage and controls modules with no behaviour change. (`dea232e`)
- Fixed the floating date pill so it re-observes its IntersectionObserver when paging in older same-day turns moves a divider to a newly mounted row, keying dividers by day plus row instead of by the run of day keys. (`66d3ed0`)

- Moved MCP tool-name parsing out of the desktop tool registry into its own tool-mcp-name module, with no behaviour change. (`0eaa72f`)

- Split the terminal interface in blocks into logic, hooks and view modules without changing behaviour. (`92aa4c0`)

- Split the blocks agent UI registry into shared, display, chart and control modules without changing behaviour. (`54ffb12`)

- Split the consent cards into shared, plugin-install and connect-app modules, with no behaviour change. (`4a9a071`)

- Split markdown rendering into content, mermaid, table and renderer modules, with no behaviour change. (`5c93202`)

- Fixed composer auto-grow keeping a wrapped placeholder's height by requiring a non-empty previous draft and the same textarea element before taking the append-only fast path. The reveal test's layout model now reports scrollHeight as the max of content and box height and lays out the placeholder. (`3104a1b`)
- Composer auto-grow now measures scrollHeight without collapsing the textarea to zero when a keystroke only appends to the end of the draft, and reads width before any style write. Edits elsewhere, width changes and expand/collapse still collapse and re-measure. (`41eefc9`)
- Settled transcript turns keep their object identity across streamed chunks and render through a memoised TranscriptTurnRow whose comparator skips per-chunk bindings a settled turn never reads, while the live flag reaches AssistantParts only on the streaming turn. Measured with message-list-stream-renders.test.tsx (30 prior turns, 200 chunks, happy-dom), commit time went from 9374ms to 1565ms. (`c7528d7`)
- Reworked the ISO bento figures to satisfy tsc --noEmit under noUncheckedIndexedAccess using const tuples, literal index unions, and entry-based loops instead of non-null assertions. Rendered markup for all 38 figures stayed byte-identical. (`7233b3b`)

### `@ryu/blueprint`@0.5.0

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amajorai/ryu-marketplace/134dad3aef109140ff9aaaa0fe4224b7ab8c5b63/app-icons/blueprint-light.png) ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amajorai/ryu-marketplace/134dad3aef109140ff9aaaa0fe4224b7ab8c5b63/app-icons/blueprint-dark.png) [GitHub release](https://github.com/amajorai/ryu-blueprint/releases/tag/v0.5.0)

#### Minor changes

- The blueprint UI package now declares a dependency on @ryu/i18n so its interpolated copy can use tl() and tlRich(). (`ed130b2`)

#### Patch changes

- Updated the blueprint companion UI package manifest and its review bar, step strip, plan document, plan graph, plan revisions, and main view sources. (`41ee7a7`)
- The review bar, step strip, plan document, plan graph and plan revisions were split into their own files. Their strings were converted to whole-sentence translation.
- Merged origin/main's changes into the app's backend Cargo manifest. (`1903ef3`)
- Merged the blueprint backend manifest and the handoff_auth integration test from main into the branch. (`1438289`)
- The blueprint backend Cargo manifest and its handoff authentication test were updated during the branch merge. (`974ca98`)
- Checkpointed in-flight splits of the blueprint UI into review bar, step strip and main modules. (`cab4e23`)
- Migrated interpolated sentences in the plan document, plan graph and plan revisions views to whole-sentence messages. (`190fd1e`)
- Merge of origin/main updated the backend handoff auth test. (`e7ec356`)
- Updated the handoff_auth Rust test. (`b321168`)
- Merged upstream changes into the blueprint backend, updating its handoff authentication test. (`73d58d0`)
- Added an integration test covering handoff authentication for the blueprint backend. (`88574c8`)
- Added backend tests covering handoff authentication. (`25ff12d`)
- Refactored the blueprint backend across its manifest, main, MCP, seal-key and sidecar-link modules and updated the HTTP diff feedback test. (`5c03086`)
- Updated the HTTP diff feedback integration tests. The crate's test suite was run with cargo test and passes. (`6981d50`)
- Moved the backend onto ryu-crypto / ryu-sidecar-runtime rather than core, adding a seal_keys module and reworking the MCP and sidecar_link wiring. The README and manifest were updated to match. (`d7b9cf5`)
- Added an HTTP test for diff feedback handling. (`26461ae`)
- Merge brought the Rust backend onto the shared sidecar_link module, with corresponding changes to main.rs and mcp.rs, Cargo.toml, and the README. (`597c91b`)
- Updated the README handoff section to name ryu_sidecar_runtime::handoff as the implementation behind the per-app sidecar_link.rs re-export shim. (`a8909eb`)
- The backend auth gate now calls ryu_sidecar_runtime::token_ok directly instead of the one-line local bearer_ok wrapper, and the wrapper-only tests were dropped. (`91eeb16`)
- The blueprint MCP server's mcp.rs now uses the shared ryu_sidecar_runtime::mcp_protocol module for protocol-version constants, ProtocolError, modern-request detection, protocol_error, finalize_response and discover_result. It passes its own CARGO_PKG_VERSION so responses keep stamping the blueprint version, and the duplicated protocol tests moved to the shared module. (`87f34ec`)
- The backend `sidecar_link.rs` became a re-export of `ryu_sidecar_runtime::handoff`, enabled through the new `handoff` feature in its `Cargo.toml`. Existing `crate::sidecar_link::...` paths are unchanged. (`a1f15ad`)
- Corrected stale comments in the backend `Cargo.toml` about which files still need `base64` and `rand`, now that the root-key code lives in `ryu_crypto::plugin_keys`. (`6cf3e63`)
- Replaced the vendored seal_keys.rs with a one-line re-export of ryu_crypto::plugin_keys, leaving every crate::seal_keys::* path in the crate unchanged. (`79ab882`)
- Reworked the Rust backend (API, host, MCP, store, seal keys, sidecar link) and the UI API/schema layer, and extended companion e2e coverage and interaction mapping. (`0af1456`)
- The Blueprint interaction map test was repinned to line 373 for the Retry loading plan button after the component moved. (`e303b7c`)
- Remapped the companion interaction map after source lines moved during the embedded bundle refresh. (`6259a39`)
- Corrected seal key handling in the blueprint backend's seal_keys module. (`1cc077c`)
- The Blueprint backend gained a seal_keys module and stores agent grants sealed, uses opaque plan ids, and keeps the cross-process plan lock. Host, sidecar link, MCP and store paths were reworked to read sealed rows. (`07be026`)
- Updated the blueprint README, the backend path and store modules, and the UI API client with its tests, and added the companion interaction map with an end-to-end spec. (`ddf18f0`)

- Checks state is now stored as a single encb:v1 envelope, and each retained screenshot and DOM snapshot is written once as an RYU-SF01 file under the @ryu/checks subkey. Plaintext state is resealed on open and the sidecar seals legacy evidence in place in the background; MCP and CLI modes still generate no standalone key. (`f9a5fb9`)

- Adjusted the backend entry point and added a seal_keys module as part of moving the satellite off core and onto ryu-crypto / ryu-sidecar-runtime. (`d7b9cf5`)

- Replaced the vendored seal_keys.rs with a one-line re-export of ryu_crypto::plugin_keys, leaving every crate::seal_keys::* path in the crate unchanged. (`79ab882`)
- Split the Rust backend store into dedicated modules for activities, codecs, crypto, fields, imports, lists, merge, objects, records, reports, schema, search, validation and views, and updated events, models, seal keys and store tests. (`0af1456`)
- Corrected seal key handling and list storage in the CRM backend and added a sealing test. (`1cc077c`)
- The CRM store layer was restructured around new crypto and codec modules so records, fields, activities, imports, lists, reports, views and search read and write sealed rows, with sealing tests added. (`07be026`)
- Merged the cloud worker branch into the crm app, updating the Rust backend entry point, path helpers, and store, along with the README, manifest, and plugin metadata. (`ddf18f0`)
- Updated the Rust backend paths and store code, the manifest, plugin descriptor and README for the Agent/Bot/OS rename and the web dashboard becoming Console. (`a01db11`)
- Backend entry point, path and store modules were updated along with the README, manifest and plugin metadata. (`cdb7957`)
- Record queries now open title and data once through a non-flattenable subquery instead of calling crm_open in the WHERE clause and per sort key or filter. The total comes from the same pass, board columns take their total and sum from the page query, and the pipeline report groups every stage in one pass. (`1073438`)
- Deal-move and task notifications now name only the stage label and a generic follow-up notice, so sealed CRM content no longer appears in the unsealed notify.db. (`e87b785`)
- Index rebuilds now skip CRM rows whose title or value bag cannot be opened, so a single bad row no longer fails reindex_all, searchable field deletes, or the open-time terms index rebuild. The crm.db connection sets temp_store to MEMORY so sorts over opened values stay in memory. (`3e2470f`)
- Changed the CRM search index to store only whole-word tokens so nested prefix tokens can no longer be used to rebuild words from crm.db alone. An index built with prefix tokens is dropped and rebuilt at the next open. (`37b83e0`)
- Sealed record titles and value bags, activity text and change values, list entry bags and import files per value under the @ryu/crm subkey, with key-bound SQL functions opening values inside SQLite so filters, sorts, reports, duplicate scans, import matching and unique checks keep their semantics. The plaintext FTS index became a blind term index with prefix tokens for search as you type, legacy data migrates on open, and an applied import's CSV is dropped. (`68539ed`)
- The backend Cargo manifest gained rand and base64 for the standalone root key file. (`bde7e67`)
- Declared the ryu-crypto dependency with the sqlite and test-ephemeral-host features in the backend manifest so the store can seal content in phase 2. (`371898a`)

- Merged the dashboards backend against the new handler signatures, threading the request HeaderMap through the API, refresh and source handlers. Updated the dashboard manifest and plugin metadata alongside the source and store changes. (`9caf05c`)
- Merged the cloud worker branch into the dashboards app, updating the Rust backend API, store, path helpers, and entry point, plus the README, manifest, and plugin metadata. (`ddf18f0`)

- Made dashboard app calls carry the grant of the restricted agent being served, across the API, refresh, source and store paths. The manifest and plugin metadata were updated to match. (`a976834`)
- The Dashboards backend gained changes across its API, device, refresh, and sources modules, with the manifest and README updated. (`b4f7dfd`)
- The dashboards backend sources module was updated as part of the #748 merge. (`cbd2f53`)
- Merged #756's changes to the dashboards app, updating its manifest, README, and backend api, device, lib, main, refresh and sources modules. (`7494894`)
- Updated the dashboards backend across device, refresh and source handling, its manifest and README. (`e3a5e18`)
- Header placeholders are now resolved only when the incoming widget URL matches the stored URL's scheme, host and effective port; otherwise the save errors and the API returns 400 asking for the header to be re-entered. This covers create-with-existing-id, update_widget and replace_widgets, with a test that a changed origin is refused while a same-origin path change keeps the sealed value. (`f943148`)
- replace_widgets, used by the device dashboard PUT path through set_device_config, now loads the dashboard's stored widgets before deleting anything and calls keep_redacted_headers per widget id, so a GET-edit-PUT round trip keeps sealed header values and an orphan placeholder refuses the batch. The manifest now declares the crypto:seal grant so the sidecar receives the seal key. (`2749cc3`)
- HTTP responses, the device-dashboard feed and the WidgetUpdated SSE event now carry redacted header values, and echoing the placeholder on update keeps the stored credential. (`16aed2f`)
- Let create_widget and update_widget skip the supported-source gate when the request names an existing widget on the same dashboard and resends its stored source unchanged, so legacy core_endpoint, monitor, workflow and agent widgets can be moved again while new or changed unsupported sources are still refused. Added a test covering rearrangement and retitling of a legacy widget alongside the remaining rejections. (`e2a111c`)
- Deleted the sidecar's loopback Core self-call code and endpoint path allowlist. Core-read source kinds now resolve as unsupported with a per-kind "not available yet" message recorded once per widget, every write path goes through ensure_source_supported and validate_widget_source (so replace_widgets also rejects traversal Composio actions), and the catalog lists only resolvable source types. (`09ea10d`)

### `@ryu/db`@0.5.0

#### Minor changes

- Updated the landing-announcement database model to store background presets and the off state. The model now represents the settings used by the admin and landing pages. (`2c6d1b5`)
- Added the singleton landingAnnouncement model that stores the configurable landing bar. (`dc9972d`)
- The auth user model now stores a locale, updated on sign-up and sign-in but left alone for impersonated sessions and admin-created accounts. (`6458952`)
- Added an occurredAt index to violation events for the cross-org read and updated the abuse models backing the traffic summary. (`84dec02`)
- Added the abuseAppealGrant model that stores only sha256(jti) for emailed appeal links. (`37b94dd`)
- The abuse model gained a partial index on pending receivedAt to back the sweep read, with a test covering the model. (`d76fe9c`)
- Abuse models gained the levels and case kinds used by the enforcement ladder and upstream signal intake. Model tests were updated for the new levels and case kinds. (`33adc79`)
- The abuse signal model gained the fields that record an ended action and its suppression window. (`66ee21e`)
- Added the abuseSignal collection model, deduped per detector, kind, subject and window bucket, and updated the abuse model with its tests. (`d4230ac`)
- Added the abuse engine and abuse models, moving violation event retention to an expiresAt TTL. (`980bed2`)
- The platform floor model gained an optional top-level screener field — roles, per-code rules, adult-permitted models, deadlines, qualification records and remote-processor records — parsed to mirror the gateway's screening policy, with an absent field left absent so existing content hashes do not move. (`11e97d8`)
- Added the violationEvent and violationEvidence collections with validation and idempotency coverage, and extended the control-plane model for the new resolve fields. (`3de04de`)
- Added database models for guardrail policies and effective policy records. (`68e2c6c`)
- Updated the prompt-registry model tests. (`ae575df`)
- Updated the public agent publication model test alongside the screened gateway routing change. (`752b20e`)
- Added a platformFloor model storing append-only versions (pending_approval, active, superseded, rejected) with a partial unique index allowing one active row and transactional activation, and updated the abuse model alongside it. (`c56b5fc`)
- Moved the abuse reason class labels into the abuse model so the auth and api packages can share them, with model tests. (`5e7fd66`)
- Added the abuse model used by the root-admin ban, standing, and key-suspension enforcement API. (`122e64f`)
- Declared banned, banReason and banExpires on the user schema, added organization standing and gateway credential suspension fields, and introduced abuse.model.ts with abuseCase, userBan, abuseAppeal, adminApproval and platformAdminAudit and their queue, open-appeal and pending-approval indexes. Added model shape tests. (`0ce8b2a`)
- Added the OrgPrompt and OrgPromptVersion models, with versions stored append-only. (`1a68bcd`)
- Added an account-deletion model and stored the accepted Terms version and timestamp on the auth model. (`3c2de4a`)
- Added the Template Rewards data model for per-template, per-user, per-day usage records. (`426fb0c`)
- Extended the waitlist access code model to represent multi-seat milestone passes. (`4bf123f`)
- Added a program partner-code model and extended the program enrolment model to record partner-code enrolments. (`31bee77`)
- A program-enrollment model was added to store student and startup enrolments. (`bfeafc1`)
- Added the own-supply model schema for storing the admin-managed free-model table. (`2279585`)
- Updated the credits database model for own-provider allowance expiry and free-credit allocation. (`4765fb9`)
- The auth model now records the client a session was issued to. (`a6e8fa1`)
- The challenge model gained fields for prize kinds, shipping details, and the per-challenge submission channel. (`6b1a095`)
- The provider key vault model now includes the anthropic_credits key. (`3213c91`)
- Added an organization notification kind used for team usage digests and extended user notification preferences to cover the new lifecycle email types. (`1c03499`)
