### `@ryu/decks`@0.5.0

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amajorai/ryu-marketplace/134dad3aef109140ff9aaaa0fe4224b7ab8c5b63/app-icons/decks-light.png) ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amajorai/ryu-marketplace/134dad3aef109140ff9aaaa0fe4224b7ab8c5b63/app-icons/decks-dark.png) [GitHub release](https://github.com/amajorai/ryu-decks/releases/tag/v0.5.0)

#### Minor changes

- Added @ryu/i18n to the decks Companion UI's dependencies so its interpolated copy can use tl() and tlRich(). (`ed130b2`)

#### Patch changes

- Updated the decks companion UI package manifest and its view controls, keys, lights, status, controller and instrument note modules, key editor descriptions, and main deck view. (`41ee7a7`)
- The deck view was split into controls, keys, lights and per-controller note modules, and key editor descriptions moved into dedicated describe-key files. Strings were converted to whole-sentence translation.
- Merged origin/main's changes into the app's backend Cargo manifest. (`1903ef3`)
- Merged main's decks backend changes covering the library root, binary entry point, path and settings modules, and the touchbar driver module, plus the Cargo manifest. (`1438289`)
- Decks backend touchbar, paths, settings, library, and entrypoint modules were updated with its Cargo manifest during the branch merge. (`974ca98`)
- Split the Decks UI into separate modules for view controls, keys, lights, per-controller note views (Akai, HID, keyboards, MIDI, Novation, surfaces), status, the main deck view, and the key editor. (`cab4e23`)
- Merged backend changes to the decks app covering settings, paths, the touchbar driver and the lib and main entrypoints. (`1b4b24f`)
- The HID and Touch Bar switches now come from settings.json in the plugin's data folder, read synchronously at startup by the new ryu_decks::settings module. (`74ca697`)
- Reworked the deck backend across the driver modules, catalog, dispatch and host paths, and updated the deck UI key editor, styling and model tests. The manifest, plugin metadata and README were updated alongside the backend and UI changes. (`0af1456`)
- Moved the backend to zip 9.1.0, replacing the 0.6.6/8.6.0 versions covered by RUSTSEC-2026-0367/0368/0369, and adapted the Ulanzi driver to fallible zip entry names. (`9ea0295`)
- Regenerated the decks plugin manifest so plugin.json matches the current app-store definitions. (`4446e10`)
- Applied review fixes across the decks backend device drivers and manager, and updated the deck UI model, key editor and deck view with their manifest and model tests. (`1cc077c`)
- Added hardware control deck support to the Decks sidecar, covering a large set of MIDI, HID and macro-pad drivers along with a deck editor UI, key editor and driver dispatch. The manifest now declares the dial-light, deck-light and Vial unlock routes so the extension proxy forwards them instead of returning 404. (`ef73cc1`)
- Exquis set_brightness now flushes, so the brightness slider and the saved level applied on connect reach the LEDs immediately. Corrected the Xone:K2 help text and README to say Ryu follows whichever X-Link unit it hears first, and updated the deck view and regression test. (`6267d2a`)
- Added a driver for the M-Audio Oxygen Pro 25, 49, 61, Mini and Hammer 88 Pro over USB MIDI, including a new Family::MAudio and Protocol::MAudioOxygenProMidi over the shared MIDI transport. Catalog, manifest, deck view, key editor and README were updated with the new layout, dials, LED handling and udev entries. (`93aebc4`)
- Added an Intuitive Instruments Exquis driver over USB MIDI: a 14x6 grid with 75 keys and four lit dials, Developer Mode LED output, and channel-16 input for pads, buttons, encoders and the slider. (`06b9704`)
- Added a KORG padKONTROL driver over USB MIDI that matches only the Native Mode port, exposes a 6x8 grid with 37 keys and five dials, and drives pad LEDs with a periodic refresh and an all-off drop. (`11b6787`)
- Added the first-generation Novation Launchkey Mini driver over USB MIDI, matching only the InControl port and exposing a 2x13 grid with 22 keys and eight dials with bi-colour pad lighting. (`88e20cc`)
- Added a DJ TechTools Midi Fighter 64 driver over USB MIDI with an 8x8 grid of 64 keys, Launchpad-palette colours and steady brightness modes. (`a45fd92`)
- Added an Allen & Heath Xone:K2 driver over USB MIDI with a 9x4 grid, 34 keys and 22 dials, relative encoder CC handling and lighting repainted when the channel changes. (`bc43ed8`)
- Added Ableton's short product ids to the Launchkey MK2 25/49/61 catalog rows and the 1235 udev line, and corrected UI help text for the MPK mini Plus, Midi Fighter Spectra and Dicer. (`b724758`)
- Added a Livid Base and Base II driver over USB MIDI with a 6x8 grid, 48 keys and nine dials, including Live pad mode setup, local control off and palette-based lighting. (`01b680f`)
- Added a Midi Fighter Spectra driver and protocol over the shared MIDI transport, covering note mapping across four firmware banks, key and deck lighting, and open/drop behaviour, plus catalog, manifest and UI key editor updates. (`15a3e28`)
- Added an Akai MPK mini Plus driver over the shared USB MIDI transport, exposing the five transport buttons as a 1x5 grid with on/off light feedback. Registered it in the catalog and manifest and extended the deck view and key editor. (`9ea526f`)
- Added an Akai MPK mini IV and MPK mini Plus II driver over USB MIDI, served by a new Protocol::AkaiMpkMk4Midi in the existing Akai family. It finds the devices by their DAW port and maps a 7 x 4 grid with 25 keys and 9 dials, driving pad lights and screen text through the shared midi.rs transport. (`18dfdce`)
- Added an Arturia KeyLab Essential mk3 driver for the 49, 61 and 88 key models over USB MIDI as Protocol::ArturiaKeyLabEssential3Midi. It maps a 5 x 8 grid of 34 keys and 19 dials, finds the unit by its DAW port name, and queues connection, screen text, knob realigns and RGB lights through the shared midi.rs transport. (`aede0d6`)
- Added a novation_dicer driver that drives a chained pair of Dicers as one 2 x 5 deck, collapsing notes on each unit's three channels into single keys and adding a green_orange key light kind. The first poll sends a reset, changed keys are painted with the attested green, orange and off bytes, and the port matcher accepts any name containing "Dicer". (`b1b8e67`)
- Added a launchkey_mk2 driver for the 25, 49 and 61 models that drives the Launchkey MK2 through its InControl port on channel 16, painting pads and round buttons with the MK3 palette and handling absolute knobs and faders. A section or extended mode leaving InControl is re-asserted and repainted, and Drop releases the port. (`b9f25b1`)
- Added a launchpad_pro driver for the pre-MK3 Launchpad Pro over its Standalone port, sending the open sequence, 6-bit RGB messages chunked from a sent cache and a release sequence on drop. The logo LED is mapped as the deck light, and the port matcher refuses Live, DIN and MK3 names. (`bb91d65`)
- The Mackie MCU driver now queries and accepts a chained XT Pro's ids on macOS so that deck drives the MCU Pro layout, re-greets and relights a live deck that repeats its ready answer and answers a fresh Logic Control challenge, and logs an unconfirmed challenge once before resuming the device query. iCON QCon Pro G2 rear user switches no longer trigger the MCU-mode hint, and the deck UI help text was updated. (`f2b0b7c`)
- Added an Arturia MiniLab 3 DAW-program driver over USB MIDI with a 3 x 8 grid, 22 keys, 14 dials, and software-scaled brightness, matched by a port name containing minilab3 or minilab 3 and never the DIN THRU, MCU/HUI, or ALV ports. Port spellings and several behaviours are inferred and untested on hardware. (`e7b449e`)
- Added an iCON Platform X+ extender driver over USB MIDI matched by port names containing PLATFORM X+, exposing a 6 x 8 key grid and 16 dials. Opening queues 32 paced LED offs and dropping resends them unpaced, with no ring CCs, scribble-strip or iCON display SysEx, handshake, or brightness. (`03eec00`)
- A Mackie family and driver/mackie_mcu.rs were added for the MCU Pro and XT Pro over USB MIDI, with device query and Logic Control challenge handling, port-name matching, key and dial maps, and LED darkening plus LCD branding on going live. (`ce53867`)
- Added driver/icon_p1.rs and Protocol::IconP1Midi for the iCON P1-Nano, with keys limited to Mackie notes on channel 1, V-Pot dial lights driving the eight RGB scribble-strip backlights, and one motor fader read from pitch bend on channels 1-9. (`992dd59`)
- The QCon Mackie Control driver was extended with Protocol::IconQconG2Midi for the iCON QCon Pro G2 and its EX G2 extender, matched by port name, with V-Pot ring centre dots as dial lights, Ardour's wake-up SysEx, 55-character LCD lines and read-only motor faders. (`c218adb`)
- Added a Zoom family, Protocol::ZoomR16Midi and driver/zoom.rs for the Zoom R16 and R24 in audio interface mode, matching ports named R16_R24 and mapping a 3 x 9 grid of 24 keys plus ten dials, with no handshake, SysEx or keep-alive. (`3d24d67`)
- Added driver/icon_qcon.rs and Protocol::IconQconProMidi for the iCON QCon Pro X and QCon Pro XS1 in Mackie Control mode, with port-name matching, paced queued writes for LCD, meter and LED state on opening, and Select over V-Pot push labels on the main LCD. (`3d53dcc`)
- Added a new Icon family, Protocol::IconPlatformMMidi and driver/icon_platform.rs for the iCON Platform M+ and Platform M over USB MIDI, matched by port name, with a 6 x 9 key grid, 18 dials, queue-drained LED setup and read-only faders. (`3a9f7d9`)
- dial_light_colors for the Launch Control XL 3, MK1 and MK2 now counts only lit encoders, so the UI no longer offers colour pickers for the unlit faders, with regression assertions in both drivers' tests. The decks README was corrected on FaderPort 8/16 global button order. (`8d5f363`)
- Added a new driver for the first Akai APC40 (MK1) and the APC20 over USB MIDI, driving both in Ableton Live mode with queued identity and introduction SysEx messages so startup never blocks the poll loop. Catalog entries, manifest, deck view and key editor help text, README rows and udev lines were added for akai-apc40-mk1 (13x9 grid, 112 keys, 27 dials) and akai-apc20 (10x9 grid, 88 keys, 10 dials). (`028e3cc`)
- Added the Behringer BCR2000 and BCF2000 drivers over USB MIDI, with BCL preset loading, key/dial mappings, encoder re-centring, fader handling, and LED control, and updated the catalog, manifest, README, and deck/key UI for both models. The commit notes they are untested on hardware. (`c3d1337`)
- Added the Faderfox EC4 driver over USB MIDI, including port-name matching, firmware 2.0 SysEx setup/group reporting, encoder and push-key mappings, label writes, and re-centring, and updated the catalog, manifest, README, and deck/key UI. The commit notes it is untested on hardware. (`23d9d9c`)
- Added PreSonus FaderPort, FaderPort 2, 8, and 16 drivers over USB MIDI, with port matching, native-mode setup, key/dial mappings, LED control, and paced writes, and updated the catalog, manifest, README, and deck/key UI for the four models. The commit notes the drivers are untested on hardware. (`164acf8`)
- Added the PreSonus ATOM SQ driver over USB MIDI, including port matching, native-mode setup, pad/button/encoder mappings, RGB light output, display text, and touch-strip handling, and updated the catalog, manifest, README, and deck/key UI. The commit notes it is untested on hardware. (`e93210d`)
- Added a PreSonus ATOM driver over the shared MIDI transport, covering port matching, pad and button input on channel 1, encoder dials, queued pad and button light output, and drop handling, with matching catalog and manifest entries. (`8e81857`)
- Added Novation Launch Control XL 3 and Launch Control 3 drivers over the shared MIDI transport, including DAW-mode start-up, encoder, button, and fader input, exact RGB output, and the 128x64 OLED info screen, plus catalog and manifest entries. (`e5cbe0a`)
- Added a Novation Launchkey MK4 driver over the shared MIDI transport, covering port matching for the Mini 25/37 and 25/37/49/61, DAW-mode start-up and mode reports, pad, button, knob, and fader input, RGB pad and palette output, plus catalog and manifest entries. (`8fcf4b5`)
- Added a Novation SL MkIII driver over the shared MIDI transport, covering InControl port matching, channel 16 pad, button, knob, and fader input, SysEx light and screen-label output, and release handling, plus catalog and manifest entries. (`8a69e68`)
- Added an Ableton Push (2013) deck driver over USB MIDI with User-port matching, display and light output, pad, button, encoder, and touch-strip input mapping, and companion deck and key help. Updated the manifest, README, and Push 2 help keying; the driver is untested on hardware. (`db787a2`)
- The BeatStep pacing test now resets the pace before the deck drops, so it no longer waits a 60-second pace between each of its 15 pad-off writes. (`dc0a4fe`)
- Moved KORG nanoKONTROL and Arturia BeatStep MIDI setup off the shared poll loop, queueing BeatStep writes one per pace interval, and reduced X-Touch Mini dial light colors to 8 so setting dial 9 is rejected. Updated Intech Grid deck-view help to say each page's first encoder, knob, or fader move is a starting point every time Ryu opens the module. (`ea7fcd8`)
- Added an Intech Studio Grid family and protocol driven by a new intech_grid driver over the shared midir transport, input only, covering the EN16, PO16, BU16, EF44, PBF4 and TEK2 modules as one generic row. Includes port matching, the factory-profile element mapping, deck and key help, udev lines and the manifest description. (`2d69482`)
- Added a DJ TechTools family and Midi Fighter Twister protocol driven by a new midi_fighter_twister driver over the shared midir transport, handling factory-configuration knob turns, pushes, side buttons and bank switching, with per-dial colour and dim output. Includes deck and key help, udev lines and the manifest description. (`9d3634e`)
- Added an Akai Fire protocol and driver over the shared midir transport, mapping the 64 pads and 20 buttons to keys, five relative CC dials, pad RGB via Akai SysEx and the 128x64 OLED as an info screen refreshed on a heartbeat. Includes deck, key and OLED help, udev lines and the manifest description. (`225fb3b`)
- Added the original Akai LPD8 (MK1) protocol and driver over the shared midir transport, mapping pads PAD1-8 and knobs K1-K8 under PROG 1 in PAD mode, with on/off pad lights resent every 300 ms. Includes deck and key help, udev lines and the manifest description; MK2 is not covered. (`b368944`)
- Added an Arturia family and BeatStep protocol driven by a new arturia_beatstep driver over the shared midir transport, writing Ryu's mapping to working memory on open, reading pads, Shift, Stop, Play and the encoders as keys and dials, and driving pad LEDs by hue. Includes deck and key help, udev lines and the manifest description; BeatStep Pro is not covered. (`0fc0468`)
- Decks added the Akai MIDImix as a Family::Akai row on Protocol::AkaiMidimixMidi, driven by driver/akai_midimix.rs over the shared midir transport, with its own port matching, channel-1 note input on a 3 x 9 grid, absolute CC knobs and faders mapped as dials 1-33, and LED output for notes 1-26. Deck and key help, the README, manifest and udev lines were updated, and the mapping is untested on hardware. (`cb4c497`)
- Decks added the KORG nanoKONTROL2 and nanoKONTROL Studio as a Family::Korg on Protocol::KorgNanoKontrol2 and Protocol::KorgNanoKontrolStudio, driven by driver/korg.rs over the shared midir transport in KORG Native Mode. midi::normalise now drops KORG jack-direction suffixes so the ports pair, and the change adds CC knob and slider dials, native button handling, LED output on change, heartbeat resends and per-model help. (`fa2edb1`)
- Added the Behringer X-Touch One as a deck family on a new protocol, with a driver over the shared MIDI transport handling buttons, encoder, jog wheel, fader, button LEDs and an LCD SysEx readout. Added deck and key help, catalog and manifest entries, and fixed the X-Touch Mini's matching to use its own id. (`1702178`)
- Added the Behringer X-Touch Mini as a deck family on a new protocol, with a driver switching it into Mackie Control mode and mapping buttons, encoder turns and pushes, layers and the fader, plus LED and encoder-ring output. Added family, catalog, help and manifest entries. (`abad1f3`)
- Raised the shared MIDI parser's SysEx limit to 128 bytes, fixed APC40 MK2 relative Tempo/Cue encoder decoding, and reopened a MIDI deck when its listed ports change after a replug. Added dedicated APC40 MK2 and Launchpad MK2 deck help text and described the APC40's on/off and A/B crossfade buttons in the key editor. (`2d20d8c`)
- Added the Novation Launchpad MK2 over USB MIDI with port matching, Session-layout pad and button input, RGB output with brightness scaling, and key names and cells. Added recording-fake tests for frames, input mapping, and port names, plus catalog identify_midi handling. (`077fb6c`)
- Added the Ableton Push 2 over USB MIDI with User-port matching, pads and buttons mapped to keys 0-127, encoders and the touch strip as dials, palette-based lighting with brightness, and a 13 x 14 key_cells layout. The shared transport now keeps the ALSA port number and logs port-name changes. (`71de94e`)
- Added the Akai APC Key 25 and APC Key 25 MK2 over USB MIDI with port matching, clip-matrix and control input, knob handling, and per-model pad lighting. Added key names by printed Shift functions, a 7 x 9 key_cells layout, and shared APC palette and colour mapping. (`6ef3901`)
- Added the Akai APC40 MKII driver over USB MIDI with port matching, an identity handshake, 120 key mappings, 28 dials and RGB pad lights. Registered the deck in the catalog and manifest descriptions. (`23d8eaf`)
- Added the first-generation Akai APC mini driver over USB MIDI with pad, scene, track and fader input, nearest-colour pad lighting, and shared key cell and colour definitions. (`45dde9b`)
- Added the Akai APC mini MK2 driver in session pad mode, including SysEx mode handshakes, pad and fader input and RGB SysEx light groups. Updated key layouts and colour handling for the new deck. (`41843cc`)
- Added a Novation Launchkey MK3 driver covering the Mini and 25/37/49/61 models over USB MIDI in DAW mode, including port matching, start-up handshake, pad/button/knob input mapping and palette-based LED output. Updated the shared MIDI transport to pair Windows port names cut at 31 characters, exposed key names, cells and lit keys in the ModelView, and updated the catalog and manifest. (`643b30c`)
- Added Novation Launch Control XL MK1/MK2 and Launch Control MK1 drivers with case-insensitive port matching, factory template selection on open, dial/pad/button input mapping, and per-LED colour levels on changed lights only. Added a shared byte-stream parser, ModelView key colours and dial lights, and extensive tests against the recording fake, and updated the README, guide, udev line, manifest and catalog. (`f2136f6`)
- Added the original Launchpad, Launchpad S, and Launchpad Mini MK1/MK2 as bi-colour Novation decks over USB MIDI, with a new protocol and driver, X-Y note and CC input mapping, diffed LED updates, brightness scaling, and ModelView key colours and cells. Added recording-fake tests for reset, rapid LED order, the 40-change threshold, input mapping, drop, and port-name matching. (`eccfddc`)
- Added Launchpad Mini MK3, Launchpad X, and Launchpad Pro MK3 as Novation decks over a shared USB MIDI transport, with per-model port matching, changed-only RGB LED messages, brightness scaling, Programmer-mode re-entry, and drop cleanup. Added MIDI candidate discovery to the manager and recording-fake tests for init bytes, key and LED mapping, flushes, brightness, drop, re-entry, and port names. (`ad5a862`)
- Logitech RGB decks including the G815, G910, G513, G Pro and wired G915 are now matched on the HID++ collections hidapi reports, via a new per-model HID interface override used by the manager's scan filter. GameSir light writes that go unanswered now rest with a 5 second backoff doubling to 320 seconds before repaint, brightness or poll retries, and the docs and Companion copy were corrected. (`0241b8e`)
- Added driver/logitech_rgb.rs for five Logitech G keyboards over HID++ 2.0, covering G-key diversion and lighting for the G915, G815, G910, G513 and G Pro. Added the catalog rows, manifest entry, README wire notes, deck view model updates and driver tests against a fake board. (`747c0cb`)
- Added a Griffin family, a GriffinPowerMate protocol and driver/griffin.rs for the USB PowerMate on 077d:0410 and 077d:04aa, with HID reports and vendor light requests on macOS and Windows and an evdev transport on Linux where the kernel keeps the device off hidraw. Catalog, manager, manifest, deck view and udev notes were updated; the driver is untested on hardware. (`6c7f5df`)
- Added a SteelSeries family, two OLED protocols and driver/steelseries.rs for eight Apex keyboard rows, writing the 128x40 panel by row packing, column paging or eight chunked reports depending on the board, and claiming only the OLED HID interface (interface 1, or 3 on the wireless Gen 3). Family schema, deck view, key editor, manifest, catalog and udev entries were updated; nothing was tested on hardware. (`f97d958`)
- Added a gamesir family, a GameSirConfig protocol and a gamesir driver for the GameSir Cyclone 2, with a catalog row covering the dongle and cable PIDs, 27 keys across 3 rows of 9, 4 dials and the light zones as the deck light. The driver claims only the configuration collection, polls for state, maps input from the physical block, writes the deck light through the stored light profile with backup and restore, and never touches game profiles. The README, manifest, udev rules and API/UI types were updated; the device facts came from published reverse-engineering notes and nothing was tested on hardware. (`aad3b98`)
- Added an adafruit family, an AdafruitMacroPadHid protocol and a macropad driver for the Adafruit MacroPad RP2040 running the Companion CircuitPython HID firmware, with one catalog row for 4 rows of 3 keys and per-key RGB. The driver validates the report descriptor before claiming the Consumer collection, keeps every Windows top-level path as an alternate using the now-shared keeps_alternate_paths helper, diffs held keys into presses and releases, spaces colour writes 4 ms apart, and resends all twelve keys every fifth heartbeat. README, manifest, wire notes, udev rules and UI types were updated; the driver is untested on hardware. (`4d636fc`)
- Added a SonyBuzz protocol in the sony family and a buzz driver for the Buzz! quiz buzzers on 054c:0002 and 054c:1000, mapping the 20-button HID mask to keys and switching the four red domes on and off past the channel threshold, with no brightness control. The catalog, manifest description and deck view were updated; the support is noted as untested on hardware. (`079623c`)
- Added a sony family with PlayStationDualSense, PlayStationDualShock4 and PlayStationAccess protocols and a playstation driver for the DualShock 4, DualSense, DualSense Edge and Access controller over USB only, mapping gamepad keys and sticks and driving the light bar as the deck light. The catalog, manifest description, deck view and API client were updated; several Edge and Access details are noted as unverified on hardware. (`2671805`)
- Deck driver work now reads Vial layouts and LampArray lamps on a separate read thread so a slow device no longer stalls polling and heartbeats, remembers unrecognised 16 x 16 monome grids instead of reopening their port, and restores the G510's prior colour when the deck light is cleared. The busy-device message names more conflicting apps, and the G15 family UI copy was corrected. (`8586a79`)
- Added a Wooting driver covering the One, Two, Two HE, 60HE, 60HE+, 60HE V2 and 80HE, pairing the analog and lighting collections by usage page instead of interface number. Analog input is read from the 0xFF53 or 0xFF54 reports, and per-key colours are written as whole RGB565 frames, with a separate path for the first firmware. (`fb50426`)
- Added a LampArray HID driver for Windows Dynamic Lighting devices, claiming any device that exposes a Lighting and Illumination collection and building a model from what it reports rather than from a device id list. Report ids, sizes and offsets come from the HID report descriptor, the first 255 lamps become keys, and changed lamps are written as range and multi-updates at most once per update interval. (`39f5497`)
- Added a LogitechG15 protocol and driver for the G15, G15 v2, G11, G510 and G510s, and G110 G-key, mode-key, and LCD blocks, including key-report decoding, backlight and LED and LCD output, catalog entries, manifest updates, and deck UI support. (`804eb85`)
- Added a monome driver and protocol support for mext grids 64 and 128, arc 2 and 4, series 64 and 128, 40h, and arduinome, including serial-port matching and probing, key and encoder input, LED and brightness output, a levels key-light mode, catalog entries, manifest updates, and deck UI support. The driver was untested on hardware. (`e2421e4`)
- Added a KompleteKontrolHid protocol and driver in the native_instruments family for the HID control section of the Komplete Kontrol S25, S49, S61 and S88 MK1, matched by USB id alone. Reports are decoded into the 23 buttons and nine encoders with names and grid places, and the 25-byte LED report plus the per-key light guide are driven from key and deck colours. The driver was not tested on hardware, and the MK2 and later keyboards are not driven. (`c0290c3`)
- A TraktorF1Hid protocol and driver for the Native Instruments Traktor Kontrol F1 in HID mode was added, covering its button bitfield, browse encoder, knobs and faders, pad and button keys, and light report output, with catalog, manifest, UI, and README updates. (`8b02dd5`)
- Added a MaschineHid protocol and driver for the Maschine MK2, Mikro MK2 and Jam in a new native_instruments family, covering button, encoder, pad and touch-strip input plus light and display output with a new MonoRows image mode. Wired the devices into the catalog, deck view and key editor, with README, manifest and udev entries; untested on hardware. (`eec6564`)
- Moved serial port probes off the polling thread so slow probes no longer stall deck polling, flushes, or heartbeats. Reported Vial keys_off_layout for unlock keys outside the drawn layout, refused start_unlock and POST /unlock for those boards, and corrected unread-board, dial-press, 3Dconnexion LED, and numbering copy. (`a8db145`)
- Added a SurfaceCoreHid protocol and driver in a new haute42 family for the Haute42 B16 running SurfaceCore firmware, opening only the vendor HID collection on usage page 0xff00. The driver sends a device-info request on open to disambiguate the shared 0xCAFE vendor id, scales per-key colour on the host, blanks all 16 lights on open and the lit ones on drop, and the catalog, manifest and UI were extended for the new family. (`9113fb4`)
- Added a DjiDuml protocol and driver in a new dji family for the DJI RC-N1 remote, reading DUML channel replies over CDC-ACM at 115200 baud and exposing each stick direction and the gimbal wheel as keys and dials. The manager now probes both ports presented under one USB serial, the shared dead zone, level and rate helpers moved into the Xbox driver for reuse, and the catalog, manifest and UI were extended. (`99bc7ff`)
- Added a PrehPosKey protocol and driver in a new prehkeytec family for PrehKeyTec POS keyboards, opening only the POSKey vendor collection and identifying the model through an identity query whose serial line replaces the USB serial. Keys are flipped from the device's bottom-left numbering into Ryu's top-left-first grid, sparse layouts are described through key_cells, and the catalog, manifest, key editor and deck view were extended. (`4c4778e`)
- Added a microsoft device family and an XboxGip protocol and driver that read Xbox Wireless Controller, Xbox One S and Xbox Elite Series 2 pads as HID gamepads, with collection acceptance checks, 24 keys, dead-zoned triggers and stick-direction dials. Wired the driver into the catalog, manager and deck UI; input only, with the GIP layout verified only on a Series X|S over USB on macOS and untested on hardware. (`50a956e`)
- Added a YamahaCc1Serial protocol and driver plus a new yamaha family for the Yamaha CC121MK2 USB serial deck, covering the device-info handshake, 300 ms keep-alive, 12 screen keys, 17 buttons with palette LEDs, RC1 to RC6 dials and the motorised fader. The manager opens the port with DTR and RTS held and, on unix, clears HUPCL so closing keeps DTR. (`59fe1e5`)
- Added a qmk family and VialRawHid driver that claims a Vial raw-HID collection, reads the VIA protocol version, keyboard UID and XZ-compressed KLE layout, and builds a per-session board model. Keys are polled from the switch matrix every 20 ms, a new Unlock action drives the board's unlock sequence with progress reporting, and VialRGB key lights run in direct mode while the board's saved effect is restored afterwards. (`1b83a60`)
- Added a Logitech G13 protocol and driver covering the 8-byte whole-state input report, stick-as-direction keys, a MonoColumns LCD image mode, M1-MR key lights, and RGB backlight control. (`981b893`)
- Added a 3dconnexion family and SpaceMouse HID protocol and driver for supported 3D mice, mapping translation, rotation, buttons, and the puck's six dials, with LED control and info-screen handling for supported models. (`4b8ed60`)
- Added a cooler_master family with a MasterHub protocol and driver covering the Base, Keypad, Slider, Knob, Roller and 1xDial modules, including keypad and dial-screen image upload, brightness, light reports and roller/fader-to-dial mapping. Decks with no keys are now allowed, and the Companion, catalog and deck model reflect the new family. (`639c08c`)
- Added a corsair family with an ElgatoGalleon protocol for the Corsair Galleon 100 SD panel, covering 12 keys in four rows of three, two dials with per-LED rings, and the 720 x 384 screen as two strip keys under a new StripPlacement::Above. The driver sends the keep-alive feature report from poll, matches only on interface 0, and assigns a path-derived id when the serial is all zeros; the UI and docs do not promise screen touch. (`1f323d4`)
- Set the Blackmagic jog wheel to relative mode after the first handshake and made a failed first handshake a refusal retried after 15 s. DisplayPad and MX Creative Keypad now keep unsent faces staged through a stalled flush, and on/off lights come on above 16 instead of 64. (`05ffc5c`)
- Added a TourBox Elite and Neo driver over USB serial with an 8-byte unlock, a haptic-off config write and byte-by-byte input decoding. Generic device ids are claimed only after a qualifying unlock reply, and the port baud is now set per protocol. (`2162b87`)
- Added a VEC footpedal driver matching 05f3:00ff that reads two-byte state reports and raises press or release only on bit changes. It never writes to the pedal and falls back to a hashed HID path for its device id. (`352aa43`)
- Added a framework family and a FrameworkRawHid driver for the Framework Laptop 16 RGB Macropad, matching only the firmware's 0xffdd raw-HID collection and leaving stock VIA, keyboard and console collections unopened. Lighting uses the 0f and 0b colour commands with per-channel brightness scaling, and key events map to the 4 x 6 grid. (`c4137a6`)
- Added a 203systems family and a MystrixRawHid driver for the 203 Systems Mystrix, talking to the Matrix OS Companion app over 0xff reports and holding staged lights while another app is active. The manager now keeps a deck's other same-interface paths as alternates and opens the first that accepts a protocol's open probe. (`5a28fed`)
- Added a Blackmagic family and BlackmagicPanel driver for the Resolve Speed Editor, Replay Editor and ATEM Micro Panel over USB, with a feature-report handshake, held-keycode diffing, jog and T-bar dial turns, whole-state light bitfields and handshake retries from the heartbeat. The deck model view now carries lit_keys, key_names and key_cells so keys are shown under their printed legends with only the lights a key actually has. (`cc3e4ae`)
- Added a Xencelabs family and Quick Keys driver for the wired and dongle variants, sending labels to the OLED as UTF-16 text, mapping brightness to the display's four levels and binding to one deck behind the dongle. The model view now offers brightness for decks that show text labels. (`82919cc`)
- Added a Mountain family and DisplayPad driver that opens the control and pixel HID interfaces together and sends 102 x 102 faces as raw BGR in chunked pixel writes, with one retry after a fresh init on a stalled transfer. The model view now reports whether a deck takes brightness so the Companion can hide the slider. (`a43ad9b`)
- Added a Logitech device family and a LogitechHidpp driver covering the MX Creative Keypad and Dialpad, including the nine screen keys split into 118 x 118 JPEG tiles, page keys, brightness control, dials and roller. The driver serialises HID++ 2.0 requests with an input queue, diverts controls 100 ms after opening with up to three write retries, and matches only the vendor usage pages; catalog, manifest and UI model were updated to match. (`0a79db7`)
- Added support for the Mirabox M18's 24 body RGB lights, set as one colour or Off under "Deck lights" and sent as CRT SETLB with the colour repeated 24 times. The catalog gained a deck_lights count, the store a deck_lights table, the driver trait set_deck_light, the API a PUT /devices/:id/light route, and the device list a deck_light field. (`9fe731f`)
- Added per-dial light colours: a dial_lights table and catalog capability, a set_dial_light driver trait that is a no-op by default, colour painting alongside faces, and a PUT /devices/:id/dials/:dial/light endpoint with dial_colors listed per deck. Implemented for Stream Deck Studio rings and knobs, Ajazz AKP05 and Mirabox N4 knob lights, and the shared side lights of the Stream Dock XL. (`ebf1a5a`)
- Renamed the X-keys family to "xkeys" so the Companion can parse it, added a test checking model families against the Companion's list, and made the Supported decks list count strip, wheel and info keys toward total key counts. (`87df262`)
- Added a driver for the Contour ShuttleXpress and ShuttlePro, mapping the jog wheel to dial 1 and the shuttle ring to dial 2, and listed the new models in the catalog and manifest. (`16cf3b4`)
- Added a driver for the X-keys XK-12 Jog-Shuttle and XBA-4x3 Jog-Shuttle module, mapping the jog wheel to dial 1 and the shuttle ring to dial 2, and listed them in the catalog and manifest. (`1fd8b37`)
- Added a driver for eight P.I. Engineering X-keys panels (XK-24, XK-24M-RGB, XK-80, XKE-128, XK-16 LCD, XBK-4x6, XBK-3x6, XBK-16x6) with their column/row input reports and 36-byte output reports. Per-key backlights follow the key colour, the API view exposes key_light_colors, and the key editor explains the blue/red light banks. (`2f548e0`)
- Added a dedicated driver for the Infinitton iDisplay 15-key panel, with a new Bgr24 image mode for mirrored 72x72 faces sent as two paged reports and brightness set through a feature report. The manifest description was rewritten and the UI API view updated. (`2c304cf`)
- Exposed the Stream Deck Neo 248x58 info screen as a tenth key with no touch input, drawn as a wide key under the grid and filled with a 180-degree-rotated JPEG. The catalog gained info_image, the API view gained info_face, and the wheel/knob key now renders after the grid on decks without side strips. (`374ea45`)
- Added Mirabox-protocol support for the Redragon Streamcraft SS550 and SS550 v3, the Womier DUO87 screen module that repaints its faces after screensaver code 50, and the MagTran M3/ActionRing/VSD Inside with three dials. Docs, udev rules and manifest list the new panels. (`d109105`)
- Added the Stream Deck Studio: 32 tall keys in a 2 x 16 grid with 80 x 120 faces plus two dials. The API view gained `key_face`, and the Companion draws non-square grid keys and their faces at that shape with a wider 16-column grid. (`a52e767`)
- Added the Mirabox Stream Dock 293 V3, M18 / VSD Inside M18, Stream Dock XL and N1, with per-model layouts, flipped face ordering and, for the N1, a switch to host mode after wake. The driver now selects a Mirabox layout by model id, and the catalog gained `extra_image` for extra keys with their own screen. (`0e3b400`)
- Added the Stream Deck + XL: 36 keys in a 4 x 9 grid, six dials and a 1200 x 100 touch strip split into six strip keys. Its quarter-turned panels use a new `Rotation::ThreeQuarter`, strip rectangles are written transposed, and touches are mapped along the strip's long axis whichever coordinate arrives. (`f8e68fb`)
- Added the Loupedeck CT's round 240 x 240 wheel screen as bindable key 38 ("Wheel"), rendered through a new big-endian RGB565 image mode on the CT's `W` display. Touches with touch id 0 press the key, the catalog exposes `wheel_image` and counts it in `total_keys`, and the Companion shows it as a round key with a round preview. (`73909f8`)
- Bound the Loupedeck Live, Razer Stream Controller, and Loupedeck CT side strips as three 60x90 strip keys per side, with RGB565 faces and a new strip_placement catalog field. The Companion lays side strips out as columns beside the grid, sized to a key row and named Left/Right strip 1-3. (`922e8b7`)
- Added strip keys to deck models, including Stream Deck + and AKP05/N4 touch strips, and a macOS Touch Bar deck of eight strip keys. The Companion renders strip keys below the grid and fixed saved face images being painted under the colour layer. (`2236348`)
- Added drivers for the Ajazz AKP815 and AKP05 / Mirabox N4 decks and their rebrands, including reversed key numbering on the AKP815, image-slot mapping for the AKP05, and release events for knob pushes. (`bb09749`)
- The app gained drivers for Loupedeck Live, Live S, CT and Razer Stream Controller over USB serial, and for Mirabox/Ajazz AKP153, HSV293S, AKP03 and N3 over the shared CRT HID protocol. touch_keys became extra_keys and key_lights now means the screenless keys are lit, per key in the Companion. (`6b74aa2`)
- Each press now runs in its own task, a deck that failed to open is retried every 15 seconds, USB is preferred over Bluetooth, and a second serial-less deck gets its own id. Key faces have their PNG header checked before decoding, Work Louder RPC is framed with a leading CRLF, and Stream Deck Neo touch buttons map to keys 8 and 9. The editor waits for the layout to load before allowing edits, brightness shows "Deck default" until set, and screenless keys get corrected copy. (`bdf0b74`)
- Added the new @ryu/decks satellite with a sidecar that drives Elgato Stream Deck, Ulanzi D200 and Work Louder Creator Micro 2/OpenAI Codex Micro decks over HID, exposing key presses as @ryu/decks#key.pressed and dial turns as dial.turned. The Companion renders deck layouts to faces and offers Test, brightness and a press log. (`ca40fb5`)

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amajorai/ryu-marketplace/134dad3aef109140ff9aaaa0fe4224b7ab8c5b63/app-icons/forms-light.png) ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amajorai/ryu-marketplace/134dad3aef109140ff9aaaa0fe4224b7ab8c5b63/app-icons/forms-dark.png) [GitHub release](https://github.com/amajorai/ryu-forms/releases/tag/v0.5.0)

#### Minor changes

- Inserting a question block in the forms editor now focuses the new block, with the forms workflow end-to-end spec updated to cover it. (`eeef7ba`)
- Reworked the forms editor into a Tally-style block flow with a new insert block dialog, updated app shell, question editor and Tailwind styling, plus an updated bundle and workflow end-to-end spec. (`9892d5e`)
- Blended the form preview into the inline question editor in the forms sidecar UI, restyled the combined view through the Tailwind stylesheet and rebuilt the sidecar bundle; the workflow end-to-end spec was updated. (`6ae0531`)
- Added the Ryu Forms store app with a sidecar server, form store, respondent flow, API client, builder UI, preview, question editor, responses panel, tests, and build configuration. (`a0e55bc`)

#### Patch changes

- The merge was applied to the forms sidecar, touching its contract and server modules and their accompanying tests. The UI Playwright configuration was updated as well. (`1438289`)
- The forms sidecar contracts and server modules were updated along with their tests and the UI Playwright configuration as part of the merge. (`974ca98`)

- A merge from origin/main updated the forms sidecar entry point and Playwright configuration. (`ace7670`)

- Updated the forms sidecar contracts and server modules together with their tests. (`b321168`)
- Merged upstream changes into the forms sidecar, updating its contracts and server modules with their tests. (`73d58d0`)
- createFormSchema now rejects the reserved link names admin and status after the existing lowercase normalization, and the sidecar requires the node bearer only for /admin itself and paths under /admin/, so a published form linked as admin-feedback is reachable by respondents. Tests cover the schema rejection, the 400 on create, and a public 200 for the admin-feedback form. (`a973105`)
- Refactored content sealing and the store in the forms sidecar. The respondent test suite was updated. (`5c03086`)
- Updated the sidecar respondent test file. That bun test file was run and passes. (`6981d50`)
- Moved the sidecar's content sealing and store code onto the shared seal handling used by satellites, which depend on ryu-crypto / ryu-sidecar-runtime. (`d7b9cf5`)
- Added sidecar tests covering respondent behaviour in the forms app. (`26461ae`)
- Moved the sidecar's sealing code over to the shared content-seal module and updated store.ts accordingly, removing the locally vendored implementation. (`a3b7160`)
- Deleted the local copy of content-seal.ts and pointed store.ts at the shared ./content-seal export from @ryu/sidecar-runtime. (`21e3737`)
- Changed the sidecar's content sealing, store sealing and respondent handling, with server and contract types updated. Matching seal and server tests were revised and the manifest and README updated. (`0af1456`)
- The Forms sidecar added content-seal and store-seal modules so form content and stored submissions are sealed, with server, contracts and store updated and new seal tests added. (`07be026`)
- Updated the forms app README and manifest alongside the sidecar entry point in sidecar/src/index.ts, and adjusted the seeded responses used by the UI end-to-end tests. (`ddf18f0`)
- Updated the forms sidecar entry point, manifest and README to the new naming. The e2e seed response fixture was adjusted to match. (`a01db11`)
- Merged origin/main into the working branch, updating the forms sidecar entry point along with the app manifest, README and the end-to-end response seeding script. (`cdb7957`)
- The Forms manifest now declares the crypto:seal permission grant so its pre-installed seed row matches the sealing sidecar. (`0c0c28b`)
- Content sealing now rescans and seals values under a sealed column that lack an envelope prefix, covering plaintext written after a rollback. StoreSeal.open refuses a store whose recorded min_reader is newer than this build reads, and writes keep the highest min_reader. (`8d0b850`)
- Corrected the README wording that said the free-page scrub needs no extra disk space, so the documented requirement now matches the guarded scrub behaviour. (`aa4b72f`)
- The TypeScript content seal now zero-fills freed pages one chunk per transaction with a WAL truncate after each, only when one chunk plus headroom is free, and no longer lets a failure escape StoreSeal.open. A finished scrub is recorded as 'scrubbed' so a deferred VACUUM does not repeat it, and the zeroed scratch table is dropped without secure_delete; tests were updated. (`f976ee6`)
- The content-seal finish step now runs whenever the store records its first key and always zero-fills the freelist before the size-gated VACUUM. Compat mode refuses values that start like a Ryu envelope, and only a recorded key check value marks a store as sealed. (`f5e5c80`)
- Brought the content-seal helper in line with the shared implementation so NULL key parts bind as empty and a public skip counter is maintained. (`86027df`)
- Form respondent answers are now sealed on write with the plugin subkey and opened by the shared submission decoder. Schema version 2 migrates existing plaintext answers on open and compacts the database, lists skip rows that fail to open and report them in the count, and a store sealed under a different key refuses new responses. (`603ded2`)

### `@ryu/i18n`@0.5.0

#### Minor changes

- Added the 483 strings introduced by the main merges across all 11 locale files, including 92 corrections from independent review of the translations. (`b328a82`)
- Added a rich text React module with tests, exposing useRichLiteralMessages() which returns tlRich(source, values, tags), and extended the import-graph test to cover the new module. (`ed130b2`)
- English-identical strings were audited: 1,072 UI strings received 1,558 new translations, 430 names and 1,207 same-spelling words were recorded with reasons in untranslated.json, and 127 non-UI strings were dropped from extraction. (`9643f1e`)
- The catalogs now cover all 36,531 extracted UI strings across ar, de, es, fr, hi, it, ja, ko, pt-BR, ru and zh-CN, with 385 review corrections and ICU selects rewritten to match the source arguments. The CLI, email, extension, native and top-level subsets were rebuilt. (`6b7d27d`)
- All 275 main-catalog chunks received an independent review pass with 4,625 corrections across the twelve locales, fixing wrong senses, broken word order around code spans, and inconsistent brand and glossary terms. The cli, email, extension and native subsets were rebuilt. (`971b6b0`)
- Added the @ryu/i18n/account-locale entry point holding the shared save logic that writes the official locale email can render, debounced and fire-and-forget, with an export in package.json. (`73158e8`)
- Added host-backed translation for whole-sentence messages inside Companion apps, caching answers per language and values and re-rendering components when an answer arrives. (`7939ccd`)
- All 90 chunks of newly extracted CLI, email and native strings were translated and independently reviewed with 1,277 corrections, and the locale subsets were rebuilt. (`239ddf9`)
- Merged 311 translation chunks across 11 locales and rebuilt the native, extension, cli and email subsets. Reviewer corrections fixed wrong word senses, inverted subject and object order in Arabic and Russian, translated brand names, and glossary drift. (`8263583`)
- Added official translations for 20.8k UI strings across 11 locales from the first 232 validated translation chunks, covering 58.2% of extracted UI literals. Rebuilt the native, extension, cli and email locale subsets from them. (`eb1e6ac`)
- Updated the English locale catalog with the strings surfaced by the widened extraction rules. (`adce80d`)
- Canonical ids now match only the exact whitespace-collapsed English message, keyed t() calls fall back to literal catalog entries, and unknown literal copy is returned verbatim rather than through ICU. The DOM localizer covers more aria attributes, button values, document titles and shadow roots, defers its first scan until hydration, and react.tsx was split by responsibility. (`48c3b46`)
- Added cli/ and email/ locale catalogs for Arabic, German, Spanish, French, Hindi, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian and Simplified Chinese, plus the official catalog modules that expose each subset. (`2aad6c1`)
- Added official literal catalogs for the extracted UI strings across the supported locales, split core into constants, pack, format, runtime and literal-catalog modules, and added catalog loaders for host, native and extension surfaces. messageIdForLiteral was changed to index canonical messages once and hash exact text otherwise, so near-duplicate strings no longer share an id. (`de356ad`)
- Added common.more-count, common.show-more-tabs and common.show-more-tabs-count messages, including the ICU count variant, to the 11 official language packs. (`b74bcfa`)
- The i18n runtime gained app message overlays — a locale-to-English-literal-to-text map consulted after the selected pack — exposed through the core and React entry points with accompanying tests. (`c7197e0`)

#### Patch changes

- Merged locale file updates across the app, CLI, extension and native locale sets, plus the untranslated listing. The DOM localizer, literal templates, rich text and runtime modules were updated alongside their tests. (`41ee7a7`)
- Added locale catalogs for the native, CLI, and extension surfaces across the supported languages, plus an untranslated-keys report. Added DOM localizer and rich-text React components and literal-template handling with tests.

### `@ryu/mail`@0.5.0

#### Minor changes

- Added @ryu/i18n to the mail Companion UI's dependencies so its interpolated copy can use tl() and tlRich(). (`ed130b2`)
- Added short-window send caps, profanity blocking, and self-host address uniqueness checks to the mail backend's API and store. (`79d8bbc`)
- Updated the Hugeicons dependency in the mail app's UI package manifest, which refreshes the icon set used by that app's chat surfaces. (`d7cfb24`)

#### Patch changes

- Merged upstream changes into the mail UI package, updating the composer, inbox creation dialog, drafts panel, message view, messages panel, shared helpers, sidebar, webhooks panel and app shell. (`41ee7a7`)
- Converted mail UI text to whole-sentence translation keys and split the App into composer, drafts, message view, messages panel, sidebar, and webhooks modules.
- Merged origin/main's changes into the app's backend Cargo manifest and lockfile. (`1903ef3`)
- The merge updated the mail backend's Cargo manifests along with its main and standalone token modules. (`1438289`)
- Extracted shared mail app code into a dedicated shared module. (`c9aa390`)
- The mail backend's main entry point and standalone token module were updated, with Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock carried along in the merge. (`974ca98`)
- Split the Mail UI into modules for the composer, create-inbox dialog, drafts panel, message view, messages panel, shared helpers, sidebar, and webhooks panel. (`cab4e23`)
- Resolved conflicts in the mail backend main entry point and the standalone token module. (`32f1a85`)
- Merged origin/main into the working branch, bringing in updates to the mail backend entry point and the standalone token module. No standalone change description was provided beyond the file set. (`ace7670`)
- origin/main was merged into the branch, carrying changes to the backend main and standalone token sources. (`7379155`)
- Moved scoped API tests into their own file and extracted seal key handling into a dedicated module. The mail API module was refactored. (`5c03086`)
- Updated the backend API module and its scoped-access test file. The crate's test suite was run with cargo test and passes. (`6981d50`)
- Added a seal_keys module to the backend so the satellite depends on ryu-crypto / ryu-sidecar-runtime rather than core. (`d7b9cf5`)
- Added scoped API tests for inbox isolation and corrected the backend so webhook access no longer crosses inbox boundaries. (`26461ae`)
- Replaced the local seal_keys.rs copy with a re-export of ryu_crypto::plugin_keys. The crate::seal_keys path is unchanged. (`79ab882`)
- Changed backend key sealing, store and API code and updated the entrypoint, Cargo manifest and lockfile and Dockerfile. The mail manifest and README were updated to match. (`0af1456`)
- Re-derived the backend lockfile with the updated zip and tokio releases. (`9ea0295`)
- Hosted Mail kept its mailbox and alias model in the backend API and store while picking up the API-key mount, realtime sockets and attribution from the merged branch. (`cbf38ec`)
- The mail backend's standalone Cargo.lock was re-derived with the lockfile sync script. (`3970ebe`)
- POST /mail/inboxes began resolving create replays by the clientKey the create would store, falling back to the legacy { clientId, clientKey: null } lookup only for rows created before the key existed. This kept a node's agent inbox and an org-visible inbox that shared a clientId from being confused. (`5c091ee`)
- Inboxes created with a clientId now store a scope-qualified clientKey under the one_inbox_per_client_id partial index, and an overlapping create maps E11000 to the inbox the other create made. Message search pages with before/after like the list, and the self-hosted create_inbox_once path does the lookup and insert under one lock so a retry gets the inbox rather than a 409 address_taken; blank names are refused. (`b577e2c`)
- The backend Cargo.lock was re-derived with the standalone lock sync script for wasmtime 48.0.7. (`f0bd07b`)
- Self-hosted Mail realtime now accepts the camelCase eventTypes and inboxIds filters the SDKs send, via serde aliases, with a unit test. (`a856ecb`)
- Applied the integration-branch review fix pass to the mail backend's content seal key handling in seal_keys.rs. (`1cc077c`)
- Updated rustls-webpki to 0.103.16 and webpki-roots to 1.0.10 in the mail backend lockfile. (`0c10d21`)
- The mail backend's require_mail_token now reads every Sec-WebSocket-Protocol header line per RFC 6455 to match selected_subprotocol, instead of only one line. A split-header test was added and a stale test comment updated. (`e16445c`)
- Updated the mail backend lockfile as part of the merge carrying the Tailscale installation security changes. (`d92c2d6`)
- Added seal and seal-key modules to the mail backend and routed stored data through them, so send approvals and agent mail views open sealed rows instead of hashed or raw content. Arrival notifications were changed to carry no message content, and the manifest, Dockerfile and Cargo files were updated to match. (`07be026`)
- Reworked the Rust backend, touching api.rs, email.rs, main.rs, paths.rs, seal.rs, store.rs and webhooks.rs, and updated Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock plus the Dockerfile. The UI changed in App.tsx, schemas.ts and schemas.test.ts, with new companion interaction e2e specs and fixtures, and refreshed README, manifest.json and plugin.json. (`ddf18f0`)
- Updated the mail backend, including its seal, webhook and path modules, to the renamed terminology. The UI schemas and their tests, the e2e companion interaction fixtures, the README and the Docker build files follow the new naming. (`a01db11`)
- Merged origin/main into the working branch, carrying the review fixes into the mail backend's API, email, seal, store and webhook modules, plus its Cargo files and Dockerfile. The UI app, its Zod schemas and tests, the manifest, plugin metadata and end-to-end companion-interaction specs were updated to match. (`cdb7957`)
- Regenerated the mail backend lockfile with the patched quinn-proto, rustls-webpki and webpki-roots versions. (`e98e55a`)
- Moved thread listing and search paging into SQL, selecting and totalling the page with the message list's plaintext filters, and opened only the newest messages per thread for addresses, subject, preview and attachment names while bodies and headers stayed sealed. (`b1d7590`)
- Mail list queries now apply direction, created_at cursors, labels and the trash filter in the WHERE clause with LIMIT set to the page size, and attachment metadata loads in one query per page. Thread views select a single thread, free-text search scans in bounded batches while releasing the store lock, and usage metrics sum stored columns instead of opening messages. (`c6f4e5c`)
- Deferred read-then-write transactions on the serving connection now begin IMMEDIATE, so they wait on the busy timeout instead of failing immediately with SQLITE_BUSY when a background sealing batch commits between their read and first write. (`de061a8`)
- The mail background-migration test module now qualifies the store name so it compiles, and expects vacuum_pending after the next start only when the disk lacks room for a VACUUM. (`af4a173`)
- Changed blob reads to open each file once and check the digest for both sealed and legacy forms, so a blob replaced by the background sealer between opens no longer came back as ciphertext. Background migration compaction is deferred to the next start instead of scrubbing or vacuuming under traffic. (`2f4250e`)
- Message and draft text, headers, addresses, draft attachments, file names, event payloads and stored send responses are sealed per value under the plugin subkey, while attachments and raw MIME become write-once RYU-SF01 files keyed by plaintext digest. Legacy rows migrate on open, in the background for large stores, the sidecar seals legacy blobs in place, and a store sealed under another key refuses to start. (`c523d70`)
- Enabled the ryu-crypto sqlite dependency in the mail backend for its content migration and updated the Cargo manifest and lockfile. (`bde7e67`)
- Regenerated the backend lockfile to include ryu-crypto with its new sqlite and test-ephemeral-host features. (`371898a`)
- Inbox inbound secrets, webhook signing secrets and webhook header values are now always sealed as encp:v1 envelopes under the mail plugin subkey, with the older enc:v1 scheme kept as a read-only legacy path and plaintext rows resealed when the store opens. Secret writes fail closed when no key is available, and the sidecar removes the delivered key from its environment before the runtime starts. (`f129a5e`)

- The scheduled-send path now claims a due draft as `sending` before handing it to the transport and re-checks policy against the claimed row. A refused or failed scheduled send is parked `failed` via finish_draft_send with its sendAt and a message.rejected event, and parked drafts remain editable and explicitly sendable. (`71765ad`)
- The mail backend scheduler now claims a due draft as sending before handing it to the transport and re-checks policy on the claimed row, so a refused or failed scheduled send is parked as failed through finish_draft_send with its sendAt and a message.rejected event. Due-ness in claim_due_draft is judged on the parsed send_at, and parked failed drafts stay editable and explicitly sendable instead of returning to the scheduler. (`8009a0a`)

- Merged #640 into the mail backend, updating the README, the binary entry point, the path helpers and the store module. (`4a480b1`)
- The startup orphan sweep, cleanup drain and inbox deletion now count raw MIME blobs referenced by messages.raw_blob_path as well as attachments, so stored raw MIME survives restarts and shared blobs are removed only when unshared. A partial index on messages(raw_blob_path) keeps the reference count cheap. (`aa7b1ad`)
- Inbound message storage now runs the duplicate check, the replay-tombstone upsert pointing at the new message, and the message rows in a single SQLite transaction under the connection lock, so an interrupted insert leaves no claim behind and retries are stored. Legacy NULL-message tombstones are taken over, and the separate settle/release steps and find_inbound_by_raw were removed. (`6922e3e`)
- Annotated the Mail webhook signature test vector lines with gitleaks:allow and skipcq so secret scanners stop flagging the fixed base64 placeholder. (`697b82f`)
- Updated the companion interaction map JSON in an unreviewed checkpoint of store-suite test fixes. (`8cdfdc3`)
- A keyed draft send that is refused before claiming its idempotency key now returns the draft to its previous state instead of leaving it stuck in 'sending'; only a claim that may hide a delivered message is kept. Draft send body construction was extracted so the send and its request hash share one shape, and the Mail Companion UI disables draft rows while a send is in flight or the draft is 'sending' or 'sent'. (`9c9a918`)
- The route stays on the tokenless public router, with a router-level test pinning it outside the bearer gate. (`59a5263`)
- Changed the mail backend API and store so sends are claim-guarded and writes are snapshot-safe. (`30d6248`)
- Added Standard Webhooks signing for outbound deliveries with whsec_ secrets, svix-style headers and a secret rotation path via PATCH rotateSecret, keeping earlier webhooks on a stored legacy scheme. Inbound accepts an optional X-Ryu-Timestamp signed over "{ts}.{body}" within a five-minute window, a per-inbox require_timestamp opt-in and per-inbox SHA-256 replay tombstones pruned after 24 hours. (`247cc66`)
- Updated the backend paths and store modules plus the README to follow the in-progress data directory re-layout. (`d2e32fa`)
- Reworked inbound webhook signing to compute the HMAC with the hmac and sha2 crates already in the tree, dropping the ryu-crypto, keyring, and D-Bus build dependencies. The Dockerfile no longer copies core or installs libdbus-1-dev, and webhook docs and comments now describe svix-style headers plus the raw whsec_ key derivation, with a test pinning the signature vector. (`a855213`)
- Updated the path helpers, store, and main entry point for the re-laid-out data directory structure. This is a work-in-progress checkpoint. (`4a19e1d`)
- Restricted the mail data directory, database, WAL/SHM files, blob directory and blob files to owner-only modes, narrowing an existing store on open while leaving a shared parent directory's mode alone. Open tracking now requires the tracking environment variable, and the pixel route only records opens for an outbound message carrying its own pixel. (`75a52b4`)
- Webhook create and patch bodies now accept snake_case event_types, inbox_ids and pod_ids alongside the camelCase names, the realtime upgrade selects an offered subprotocol, and rotate-secret additionally returns the inbound secret. (`fc7259c`)
- Plugin hooks and workflows now receive the metadata-only event payload with the store message id, scheduled sends emit the same message.sent shape as direct sends, and an inbound re-delivery with identical raw bytes is dropped as a duplicate. (`98f1b7a`)
- Raised request body limits to the documented 25 MiB inbound and 12 MiB JSON, enforced the 8 MiB decoded attachment cap, and applied the outbound policy to scheduled drafts both at scheduling and at send time with sendAt stored in UTC. Draft create and update now require the send permission, allow/block lists match the parsed address, reserved envelope headers are refused, and the UI converts its datetime-local value to a UTC instant. (`5e919c9`)

### `@ryu/mail`@0.5.0

#### Minor changes

- Added address validation and lower-casing plus profanity and slur filtering in the shared mail address module, with tests. (`79d8bbc`)
- The address module now classifies availability as invalid, reserved, taken or held, returns claimable suggestions and enforces reserved local parts. Random local parts are generated with crypto.getRandomValues instead of Math.random. (`698b49d`)

#### Patch changes

- Updated mail alias, screening and verification-code handling with matching tests and golden/case data. (`0af1456`)
- Touched address parsing, the AWS/SES transport, Cloudflare integration, config, DKIM DNS lookup, inbound handling, message parsing, and storage, with accompanying tests for each. (`ddf18f0`)

- Updated mail address handling, inbound parsing, DKIM DNS checks, SES and AWS transports, Cloudflare integration, configuration and storage. Each module's tests were changed alongside it. (`cdb7957`)
- Added alias parsing with golden cases, message screening, and verification-code extraction modules, each with its own test suite and case fixtures, exported from the package index. (`a9b90d7`)
- Added alias normalization and screening helpers and verification-code parsing, with golden-case fixtures and tests for alias and screening behavior. (`53c73f4`)
- Narrowed brand reservation so ryu matches only as a prefix of the alias skeleton or of a hyphen token, letting names such as kiryu and mitsuryu through while amajor and anthropic still match anywhere. (`b7f571f`)
- Handle validation now rejects xn-- punycode, applies reserved and brand checks on the confusable skeleton and brand substrings, and caps suggestion lookups at three, with golden cases added for aliases and verification codes. (`d96366b`)
- Added alias, screening and verification-code helpers to the package entry point with golden case fixtures and tests for aliases and screening. (`a71cd50`)

- Added address handling, AWS and SES transports, DKIM DNS lookup, inbound message parsing, and storage modules, each with tests. Updated the package entry point and configuration to surface them. (`859b517`)

- Reworked address handling, SES and AWS transports, Cloudflare integration, DKIM DNS records, inbound parsing, and storage, adding tests for parsing, DKIM DNS, SES, inbound, and storage. Config and index exports were updated to expose the revised modules. (`7b203e4`)
- Updated address handling, parsing, inbound processing, storage, and config, along with SES, AWS transport, Cloudflare, and DKIM DNS modules and their tests. The package index was updated in the same merge. (`28e5be5`)

- Updated the SES integration and its test file in the mail package. (`21c1ab1`)
- Replaced sesSendOptions with sendWithDeadline, which races the send against a timer and aborts the SDK signal, so a response body that stalls after headers no longer hangs an SES send past SES_SEND_TIMEOUT_MS under Bun. (`21c0cb9`)
- Reworked the SES mail integration in ses.ts and its tests, along with the package index. (`e650a39`)
- sendEmail now throws MailMessageInvalidError before calling SES when MIME construction fails, such as a subject or In-Reply-To containing a line break. Tests cover that SES is never reached for an unbuilt message. (`c096927`)
- Corrected the SES_SEND_TIMEOUT_MS comment to state that a timed-out keyed send marks its key unresolved and only the quota reservation is released. (`b10b5f4`)
- Integrated the runtime-chain merge into the mail package, reconciling address handling, inbound parsing, SES and AWS transports, Cloudflare integration, DKIM DNS checks and storage, with tests. (`2a72a08`)
- Merged the SNS signature verification path, which now takes the message, a current time and a timeout and fetches the certificate with a bound. SES identity commands and retries were limited to throttling responses, DeleteObjects calls were bounded by s3CallOptions, and the storage and SES test suites were combined. (`71765ad`)
- Merged the mail package covering address handling, DKIM DNS lookup, inbound processing, parsing, SES sending and storage, each with accompanying tests. (`8009a0a`)
- Consolidated reserved local-part detection into a single isReservedLocalPart that combines operator prefixes with brand tokens, and carried the merged changes through config, DKIM DNS, inbound, parse, SES and storage modules with their tests. (`cd8464b`)
- Updated the AWS transport, Cloudflare, inbound, SES, and storage mail modules with their tests. (`4c7c6d4`)
- Added mail address parsing helpers to the shared mail package and exported them from the package index, with tests. (`e40980f`)
- Touched the AWS transport, Cloudflare, SES, inbound and storage modules along with their tests as part of the merged branch. (`d8a51d1`)
- Landed the mail package's address handling, message parsing, DKIM DNS lookup, inbound, SES and storage modules together with their test files during the #688 merge. (`9a8f19a`)
- Added address handling to the mail package with tests, and exported it from the package index. (`6832cd7`)
- The per-call deadline builders for SES sends and S3 calls plus the S3 client options are now exposed for testing. Regression tests cover the SES send deadline cutting a stalled body, the S3 client timing out a hung PUT while keeping idempotent retries under its call deadline, and hang tests guarded by a race so a regression fails fast. (`18549bf`)
- Added connect and request deadlines with per-call aborts to SES and S3 transports, and SendEmail retries now occur only on throttling so ambiguous failures are not resent. (`1e63c93`)
- Added DKIM CNAME resolution checks and SES identity status helpers, including distinguishing Ryu-created identities from operator-managed ones, with tests for both. (`69b3618`)
- Added SES helpers to create Easy DKIM identities, map GetEmailIdentity onto pending, verified and failed statuses, and delete created identities, tested against a mocked SES client. (`0a021cd`)
- Inbound mail processing was made idempotent so repeated deliveries of the same message are handled once, with tests covering the duplicate case. (`b7254b6`)
- Message parsing now exposes fromAddresses, reporting every From mailbox rather than a single parsed one, with tests for duplicate From fields and multiple From mailboxes. (`65a1370`)
- Corrected the stale @ryu/email note in the mail package config. (`92bb4c4`)
- Added mail primitives for reserved local parts, single-address parsing, a shared custom-header denylist enforced when building raw messages, SES inbound verdict extraction, and batched S3 object deletion that fails on any per-key error. (`72584de`)
- Inbound SNS verification now pins the signing-certificate host to a region-shaped sns.&lt;region>.amazonaws.com(.cn) endpoint and requires the SimpleNotificationService-&lt;hex>.pem path, parsing the body as an X.509 certificate. It caches signing keys by URL, refuses SignatureVersion values other than 1/2, rejects notifications older than one hour, and only confirms a subscription URL for the signed topic. (`50ef7ea`)
- Added address, inbound and URL-guard tests. Cloudflare, SES, parse and storage transports were revised along with branding and config. (`465ed08`)
- Fixed lint violations in the inbound mail test file. (`593826f`)
- Merged origin/main, changing inbound mail handling and its tests. (`45385db`)
- Bounded inbound mail payload parsing and validation, with corresponding test coverage.

- Updated the mail package manifest and adjusted address parsing, branding, Cloudflare, config, inbound, SES, storage, URL guard, and transport tests. (`5d86778`)
- The mail URL guard and its tests were updated as part of the merge. (`205244f`)
- Merge conflicts were resolved in the mail package's URL guard module and its tests. (`a2c4927`)
- Merged changes to the URL guard module and its transport-level tests, resolving conflicts between the local and origin branches. (`1b8bdef`)
- Reworked the mail URL guard to tighten outbound request validation, with tests covering the guard and the guarded transport. (`8ad0bc7`)
- Added URL guard logic and tests restricting grant targets to public pinned HTTPS origins. (`736d255`)
- Added a URL guard that restricts destinations used for mail fetches, with accompanying tests. (`4509500`)

- The GET view of each credential-bearing notify target now carries an opaque secret_ref, a keyed SHA-256 of the stored credential under a random per-process key, and keep_redacted_targets resolves a placeholder by that ref among stored targets of the same kind instead of by array position. Without a ref a placeholder resolves only when exactly one stored target of that kind holds a credential; anything else is a 400 and is never stored. The manifest also declares the crypto:seal grant. (`2749cc3`)
- Telegram bot tokens, webhook URLs and Expo push tokens in monitors.json are sealed under the monitors plugin subkey on write and opened on read, with record_check patching the stored form and legacy rows resealed on open. ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amajorai/ryu-marketplace/134dad3aef109140ff9aaaa0fe4224b7ab8c5b63/app-icons/mpp-light.png) ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amajorai/ryu-marketplace/134dad3aef109140ff9aaaa0fe4224b7ab8c5b63/app-icons/mpp-dark.png) [GitHub release](https://github.com/amajorai/ryu-mpp/releases/tag/v0.5.0)

#### Minor changes

- Added @ryu/i18n to the mpp Companion UI's dependencies so its interpolated copy can use tl() and tlRich(). (`ed130b2`)

#### Patch changes

- Merged upstream changes into the mpp UI package, covering the approval dialog, formatting helpers, icon and policy panel, receipt detail and receipts panel, status rail and app shell. (`41ee7a7`)
- Translated mpp strings as whole sentences and split the App into approval dialog, policy panel, receipt detail, receipts panel, status rail, format, and icon modules.
- Split the MPP UI into modules for the approval dialog, format helpers, icon, policy panel, receipt detail, receipts panel, and status rail. (`cab4e23`)
- Split content-seal and paid-endpoint tests into separate files and refactored the client, store and server schemas in the sidecar. Sidecar dependencies, the lockfile and the TypeScript config were updated. (`5c03086`)
- Added skipLibCheck to the sidecar tsconfig so tsc ignores type errors inside the mppx dist typings, and refreshed the stale mppx version noted in the client.ts safety comment.
- Merged the conflicting dependency bumps by keeping both mppx 0.15.0 and viem 2.57.10 and regenerating bun.lock so the frozen-lockfile check passes. (`2f445ab`)
- Merged the sidecar package.json and bun.lock dependency update, deferring the viem peer, skipLibCheck and stale-comment follow-ups to later commits. (`daad7f9`)
- Updated the mpp sidecar package.json and bun.lock as part of the repository-wide sidecar dependency refresh. (`c921225`)
- Updated the sidecar paid-endpoint test file. That bun test file was run and passes. (`6981d50`)
- Reworked the sidecar's content sealing and store code onto the shared seal handling and updated the server schemas. Its content-seal tests were updated and pass. (`d7b9cf5`)
- Added sidecar tests covering paid endpoint behaviour. (`26461ae`)
- Switched the sidecar to the shared content-seal implementation, updating store.ts and server-schemas.ts, and replaced the local content-seal tests with tests against the shared module. (`a3b7160`)
- Removed the duplicated content-seal.ts and its test, and updated store.ts and server-schemas.ts to import the shared implementation from @ryu/sidecar-runtime. (`21e3737`)
- Bumped viem from 2.54.0 to 2.57.10 in the mpp sidecar, updating its package manifest and lockfile. (`759dfeb`)
- Bumped mppx from 0.8.17 to 0.15.0 in the mpp sidecar, updating its package manifest and lockfile. (`8d652cc`)
- Updated the mpp sidecar's package manifest and Bun lockfile as part of the @types/bun 1.3.14 to 1.4.3 bump. (`af019e7`)
- Reworked the sidecar client, content sealing, store sealing and server schemas, with matching seal tests updated. The sidecar dependencies, UI package manifest and README were refreshed. (`0af1456`)
- Bumped `@modelcontextprotocol/sdk` from the pinned 1.25.3 to 1.32.1 in the mpp sidecar, which resolves from its own lockfile rather than the root workspace, and regenerated that lock with express-rate-limit moving to 8.7.1. The bump clears four advisories that affected the old pin. (`ca55243`)
- Moved the MCP SDK from 1.25.3 to 1.32.1, bumped zod to 4.6.6+, and added overrides for ws, hono, qs and proxy-addr in the sidecar lockfile. (`90ccdb2`)
- Updated the sidecar package.json and lockfile along with the UI package.json, regenerating bun.lock with a lockfile-only install. The sidecar resolution now reflects the consolidated overrides and the reverted hoisting drift. (`f0bd07b`)
- Patched the advisory-affected dependencies in both the MPP UI manifest and the sidecar, regenerating the sidecar lockfile so the fixed versions are locked in. (`f4b5f95`)
- Added content-seal and store-seal modules to the sidecar and threaded them through the server and schemas. Both modules ship with their own test files. (`07be026`)
- Updated the Bun sidecar with changes to catalog-schemas.ts, network-schemas.ts and server.ts, refreshed bun.lock and package.json, and revised the README, manifest.json and plugin.json. (`ddf18f0`)
- Merged main into the branch and re-applied the rename in the MPP docs and manifest/plugin metadata, updating the sidecar's catalog and network schemas and server along with its lockfile and package configuration. (`a01db11`)
- Merged origin/main into the working branch, updating the mpp sidecar's catalog and network schemas and its server module, along with the package manifest, lockfile, app manifest, plugin metadata and README. (`cdb7957`)
- In compat mode, a merchant settlement reference that resembles an envelope is now stored behind a reversible escape prefix instead of making commit() throw after the credential was spent, which had left a pending reservation with no receipt. (`12b4ed4`)
- Content sealing now rescans and seals values under a sealed column that lack an envelope prefix, covering plaintext written after a rollback. StoreSeal.open refuses a store whose recorded min_reader is newer than this build reads, and writes keep the highest min_reader. (`8d0b850`)
- The TypeScript content seal now zero-fills freed pages one chunk per transaction with a WAL truncate after each, only when one chunk plus headroom is free, and no longer lets a failure escape StoreSeal.open. A finished scrub is recorded as 'scrubbed' so a deferred VACUUM does not repeat it, and the zeroed scratch table is dropped without secure_delete; tests were updated. (`f976ee6`)
- The content-seal finish step now runs whenever the store records its first key and always zero-fills the freelist before the size-gated VACUUM. Compat mode refuses values that start like a Ryu envelope, and only a recorded key check value marks a store as sealed. (`f5e5c80`)
- Brought the content-seal helper in line with the shared implementation so NULL key parts bind as empty and a public skip counter is maintained. (`86027df`)
- Sealed the origin, payee and settlement reference fields in payment reservations and receipts under the @ryu/mpp subkey, migrating existing plaintext rows on open. Lists now skip and count receipts that fail to open, and new payments are refused when the ledger was sealed under a different key; wallet secrets keep their Core-sealed custody. (`d7e0ac7`)
- Updated the sidecar client as part of the #747 merge. (`e49d1db`)
