### `@ryu/places`@0.5.0

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amajorai/ryu-marketplace/134dad3aef109140ff9aaaa0fe4224b7ab8c5b63/app-icons/places-light.png) ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amajorai/ryu-marketplace/134dad3aef109140ff9aaaa0fe4224b7ab8c5b63/app-icons/places-dark.png) [GitHub release](https://github.com/amajorai/ryu-places/releases/tag/v0.5.0)

#### Minor changes

- Added @ryu/i18n as a dependency of the places Companion UI so its interpolated copy can use tl() and tlRich(). (`ed130b2`)
- Added import from links, pasted text, and Google Takeout/CSV/KML saved lists, with side-model place naming, geocoding checks, and a confirmation step before saving. Added AI trip-day drafting that reuses saved places and commits accepted plans as a single batch, plus SSRF-guarded link fetching and the import_link, suggest_itinerary, and add_stops agent tools. (`cdae793`)
- Added the Places app with an org-shared SQLite-backed map, saved places, and a trip planner covering day-by-day itineraries, ideas, route optimization, bookings, split expenses, and checklists over REST and MCP. The companion UI uses a full-bleed map with a floating panel, Saved and Trips tabs, and e2e tests against the real sidecar. (`c15e6e5`)
- Added the Places app: a Rust backend covering the HTTP API, geocoding, place storage, state, paths, validation and MCP, plus a Vite/React map UI with a shared model, app bridge and API client. Included manifest, plugin and MCP metadata, domain and transport tests, and a Playwright workflow spec with evidence screenshots. (`e8eebd8`)

- Added a package-owned interaction map tying 67 of the 134 Places controls to named tests in places-workflow.spec.ts, with assertion markers and an evidence boundary covering the sidecar bridge and geocoder/model stubs. Fixed a race in the spec's MCP helper that truncated replies split across chunks by waiting for the frame's trailing newline. (`b18f71a`)
- Also corrected the standalone-run bearer-gate statement, regenerated plugin.json, and added a manifest test pinning the wording to the geocoder default. (`303fb84`)
- Moved the trip-day validation in update_stop before any UPDATE so a rejected patch such as {note: "x", day: 99} leaves the stop untouched. Changed split-expense deduplication to keep the first mention of each member via a HashSet, so ["a", "b", "a"] no longer charges member a twice. (`5176ea9`)
- Added a MAX_AMOUNT_MINOR cap of 10^12 minor units for trip expense, booking cost, and budget amounts, rejecting larger values with InvalidAmount and advertising the same min/max in MCP tool schemas. Switched trip totals, balances(), and settle() to saturating arithmetic so previously written oversized rows still read without panicking. (`be225f0`)
- Changed addStops to send drafted stops in order in batches of at most 60, resolving with the trip after the last batch. Added PartialStopsError for failures after the first batch, and the trip view applies the partially saved trip while accept() trims the draft to unsaved stops for retry. suggest_itinerary now geocodes at most MAX_GEOCODED_ROWS stops and reports the rest in a new skipped list. (`133d01f`)
- Moved the Places map databases under the plugin data directory so `places.db` and tenant databases resolve through the plugin data dir instead of the data-dir root, and added an integration test pinning both resolutions. (`0a02c2e`)
- Host::complete now reads Core's `{result: ...}` model-completion envelope, accepting a bare string or a text/content/output object or array, and treats blank text as no text. This restores link and caption import, AI trip drafts, and the places.import_link and places.suggest_itinerary MCP tools; the e2e Core stand-in was updated to answer with the same envelope. (`fed5f60`)
- Landed the @ryu/places backend, UI, manifests, MCP definitions, and e2e evidence, covering imports, link handling, trips, tenancy, geocoding, store, and validation modules. The backend and UI include their domain, imports, transport, trips, model, and API tests. (`6cfdb6c`)

- The Research engine seals campaign goals, attempt text and logs, and analyses with the @ryu/research subkey through a vendored content-seal module, sealing history.jsonl and results.tsv rows after the digest is computed. ### `@ryu/social`@0.5.0

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amajorai/ryu-marketplace/134dad3aef109140ff9aaaa0fe4224b7ab8c5b63/app-icons/social-light.png) ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amajorai/ryu-marketplace/134dad3aef109140ff9aaaa0fe4224b7ab8c5b63/app-icons/social-dark.png) [GitHub release](https://github.com/amajorai/ryu-social/releases/tag/v0.5.0)

#### Minor changes

- Added @ryu/i18n as a dependency of the social Companion UI so its interpolated copy can use tl() and tlRich(). (`ed130b2`)
- The Composio provider now stages local video for YouTube and TikTok: it validates the file against the media root, hashes it, requests a file_upload slot from the Gateway-vaulted router, streams it through ryu-egress screening to the presigned URL, and runs the upload action, failing the publish with a reason on a refused upload or missing post id. (`2454558`)
- Added chunked media import sessions to the Outpost backend with create, chunk, finish and delete routes under /media/import, plus workspace binding, video/image type limits, a 2 GiB cap, 1 MiB chunks, eight concurrent sessions and 15-minute idle expiry. Manifest routes, OpenAPI paths and the README were updated, and session unit tests plus an end-to-end handler test cover ordering, workspace binding, hash mismatch, bounds and abort. (`00db076`)
- Updated the Hugeicons dependency in the social app's UI package manifest, which refreshes the icon set used by that app's chat surfaces. (`d7cfb24`)

#### Patch changes

- Overhauled the social app UI across its panels, including the activity feed and analytics, compose targets and validation, inbox rows and detail, library templates and media, overview sections, queue, calendar month view, AI assists, and account and scheduling settings. (`41ee7a7`)
- The social UI was broken into per-panel and per-section files across activity, compose, inbox, library, overview, queue, calendar, and settings, with strings converted to whole-sentence translation keys. Compose, target, validation, and scheduling form logic were extracted into their own modules.

(`91487ba`)

### `@ryu/ui`@0.5.0

#### Minor changes

- OgCard draws on a generated still of the Spell Prism preset, with white type anchored bottom-left, an optional description under the title and the README logo as the mark. The frame and downscaled logo are emitted into og-frames.generated.ts. (`a6cc431`)
- Updated the UI package manifest as part of the Effect v4 migration.
- Global styles gained the root --page-background variable that lets stage heroes keep the page background through the forced-dark stage.
- Added an adaptive-stepper motion component and a liquid component, with package metadata updated accordingly. (`27c0cfc`)
- Added a mystery-box 3D scene component to the shared UI package for the Store's gift-box stage. (`28ae45c`)
- Updated the managed tab strip overflow trigger to read localized labels from the host packs and fall back to English when no I18nProvider is mounted. (`b74bcfa`)
- Added the copy glyph to the app icon glyph map. (`3024cc9`)
- Updated the app-icon glyph bundle with entries used by the places surfaces. (`c15e6e5`)
- Updated the credit balance breakdown component and tests for the revised free-credit and own-supply balance display. (`4765fb9`)
- The composer editor now moves a dropped mention void itself and pads it with spaces, and Markdown serialization drops the U+200B characters that kept `@label` from re-importing as a mention. (`8b7b64a`)
- Changed CommandDialog to render as a vaul bottom drawer below the mobile breakpoint, while the full-screen OS launcher keeps its dialog. (`cd57896`)
- Added a named card-table appearance to the dialog component that does not clip its contents, so cards can fly off the table. (`8111cd4`)
- Added plan badge palette support, updated the tabs component, and extended global styles for the pricing card gradients. (`9e9d2e6`)
- Added avatar parts, shapes, style art, and contribution components, a Styles tab in the glyph picker, and Marketplace entries in the costume part lists, with fallback to built-in looks when a part is missing. (`2cd5518`)
- Added a tracing logo loader component with CSS module styles, type declarations, and tests, and updated the logo component to support the variant. (`62470da`)
- Added an optional passCompanion prop to WaitlistQueue and a HalloweenPassCompanion component that renders a costumed ghost over the pass from 1 October to 2 November, with costume changes persisted in localStorage and nothing rendered outside the season. (`0b39570`)
- Added ghost costume options, presets, parsing, and costume artwork to the UI package. GhostAvatarSpec accepts a costume variant, GlyphDisplay renders it, and the avatar controls expose a preset picker plus per-slot selects. (`8878301`)
- Bumped the Hugeicons dependency in the shared UI package manifest to the updated version. (`d7cfb24`)
- The standalone editor HTML export and its export toolbar button were updated to carry copyright attribution. (`2778028`)
- Added a nested overflow toolbar component and wired the markdown editor fixed toolbar buttons, mark toolbar button and toolbar to use it. (`bc58d69`)
- Added the tear-ticket component and cut-to-confirm interaction, and updated the invite pass, pass card shell and waitlist pass components to use them, with unit tests. (`601ddcf`)
- Added a dropdrawer component and wired it into the dropdown menu so menus can render as drawers responsively, with package metadata updated. (`888f9ef`)
- Added the backdrop module with shader, canvas 2D and CSS renderers, param schemas for generated controls, stored-param validation, and motion caps. (`eca7988`)
- Updated the overflow actions component for use by the image editor toolbar. (`4db080a`)
- Added a prism-gradient motion component, registering its dependencies and third-party notices in the package configuration. (`0dd6c52`)
- Added an opt-in sticky mode to the tabs component. (`677f577`)
- Added a goal-gradient helper with tests and applied progress cues to the waitlist queue component. (`0645939`)

### `@ryu/video-studio`@0.5.0

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amajorai/ryu-marketplace/134dad3aef109140ff9aaaa0fe4224b7ab8c5b63/app-icons/video-studio-light.png) ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amajorai/ryu-marketplace/134dad3aef109140ff9aaaa0fe4224b7ab8c5b63/app-icons/video-studio-dark.png) [GitHub release](https://github.com/amajorai/ryu-video-studio/releases/tag/v0.5.0)

#### Minor changes

- OTIO export now writes a generic Effect.1 named Ryu.SpeedCurve.1 after the average LinearTimeWarp, carrying each curve keyframe's t, speed and source_time. readOtioSpeedCurves reads the curves back and validates them against the stored schema, with round-trip tests for pitch-kept and tape-style curves and rejection of out-of-range keyframes. (`382150b`)
- Completed the 17 extra locale catalogs so each carries all 2,262 English keys with the locale's CLDR plural categories and intact ICU placeholders, added the missing Wan first/last-frame host-locale entry, and added a catalog test covering all 28 shipped locales. (`e7621e3`)
- Added a WebGL2 compositor that draws the canvas background and every visible media clip bottom to top with the render's maths whenever a clip at the playhead uses a blend mode, during playback as well as paused. It is backed by plan.ts for placement, blend-glsl.ts for every mode of shared/blend.ts, 8-bit ping-pong framebuffers in compositor.ts and mask SVG rasterization, with the CSS stack and paused exact frame retained for stages it cannot draw. (`ff80823`)
- Generate motion gained a Local engine model choice that sends both boundary frames as `input_images` with provider `local` and no model id, offered only for first/last-frame motion while other tasks refuse a local choice. Cloud presets remain the default because the app cannot detect the node's active diffusion model. (`482d3c0`)
- Updated the Send to Outpost handoff panel and its i18n messages so local renders can be sent for YouTube and TikTok publishing, while the copy for providers that still refuse local media is explicit. (`2454558`)
- Added ICU runtime templates and studioFormat for host-locale copy, messageCode and params on sidecar errors, and 17 partial machine-drafted locale files. Font imports grew to 24 MB with chunked 512 KiB upload sessions and a Fontsource catalog restricted to cdn.jsdelivr.net and three licenses, the font picker gained an Online fonts tab, paused playback requests an exact inspect-frame render for approximated blend modes, and autosave merges a remote save under unsaved edits. (`940f5c3`)
- Added shared/project-merge.ts, an entity-level three-way merge over clips, tracks, titles, captions, markers and other id-keyed lists. The revision watch now merges a newer revision under unsaved edits when the saved base is known, keeps the edits dirty on the newer revision, and records conflicts for the Changed elsewhere banner. (`4125669`)
- Added sample-exact speed-curve audio rendering with preserve-pitch and tape-style modes, curve-aware FCPXML/XMEML/OTIO interchange, sample-delayed audio mixing, per-frame ASS title style animation, and uncapped PNG-sequence shape rendering. (`591b5d9`)
- The inspector, avatar, soundtrack, search and export panels gained AI edit, AI matte, Generate motion, photoreal lip-sync with a required consent checkbox, generated music and SFX, AI shot descriptions and a Send to Outpost handoff, all routed through the host bridge with an unverified preset picker and 62 new strings across 11 languages. (`8d06127`)
- Added reference-input generation presets with provider input field maps, bounded clip, frame and audio extraction, gap-fill boundary frames, AI matte alphamerge, shot captions and tags, soundtrack and sfx conform, photoreal avatar and lip-sync inputs, and registered sidecar routes; generation requests record task and consent in asset provenance. (`b355bea`)
- Added an optional `stabilize` level to the reframe request schema and route, swapping each eligible target video onto its stabilized derivative before tracking and reporting the outcome in a new `stabilized` result. The ReframePanel gained the Image stabilization select, and the verification script covers the swap and derivative reuse. (`f4e164a`)
- Added optional `music` and `avatar` input to script assembly, with style selection, rising scene-aligned bed placement on a free audio track, a background soundtrack job that places its result into the latest project on finish, and lip-synced per-scene presenters. The ScriptToVideoPanel exposes Music bed and Presenter avatar controls. (`27378e0`)
- Replaced the remaining plain number inputs in TitlesPanel, TitleStyleControls, GraphicsPanel, the effect seed and overlay keyframe values with the shared NumberField, which now supports expression entry, clamping, arrow-key nudge and label scrub. NumberField also gained ariaLabel, blank/placeholder/onClear, disabled and className, and GraphicsPanel's private copy was removed. (`5f9f8a2`)
- Added a go-start-enter binding so plain Enter triggers navigation.start alongside Home, and let bindings set skipInteractiveTargets so the key is left to a focused button, link or menu as well as to the existing editable and dialog guard. (`8ac479d`)
- Added hue, saturation, color and luminosity to blendModeSchema with matching export math: CSS mix-blend-mode preview flagged approximate via the component-ycbcr gap, and FFmpeg YCbCr reconstruction through mergeplanes or a geq chroma rescale. The BlendSection offers the new modes and verify-blend.ts checks them against the reference math. (`2cf21ab`)
- Added an Output resolution menu to the Export panel with Match timeline, 720p, 1080p, 2K and 4K tiers plus a Custom size option, scaling the canvas short side to the tier and rounding to even dimensions. The render route accepts the same tier as outputResolution, replacing stored or preset sizes and rejecting the tier alongside an explicit outputWidth and outputHeight. (`412f8b0`)
- Duck under voice clips gained amountDb, attackMs and releaseMs in the segment schema, the paste-settings group and detach/reattach, with inspector fields for duck amount, attack and release. Export replaced the fixed sidechaincompress with a shared ducking filter chain, and the Web Audio preview now ducks with the same threshold, depth and curves. (`c54387e`)
- Added optional backgroundPaddingX/Y and backgroundOffsetX/Y to titles, with export padding and offsetting square BorderStyle 3 and rounded \p1 boxes and matching per-axis padding and offset rendering in the preview. Style and motion exposes the four fields, the Pill lower third uses per-axis padding, and a new Offset block social template uses an offset box. (`c01602b`)
- Shape graphics gained up to four static masks, applied to the raster in shared/graphic-masks.ts so static, rotating and shape-keyframed graphics carry them, with masked graphics leaving the legacy drawbox path. Added the graphic-masks route, preview SVG masking, Vector panel editing through MaskListEditor and a verification script that runs real FFmpeg. (`84adf6f`)
- Masks gained optional stroke color, stroke width as a fraction of the frame height, and stroke alignment of center, inside or outside on every shape but text. The render composites the band after alphamerge from a signed distance to the mask edge, the preview draws a matching SVG overlay under the clip's transform, the Masks inspector edits the fields, and verify-masks.ts checks the band against real FFmpeg output. (`63826fb`)
- Added keyframe channels for title text styles and for graphic shape and colour parameters, with shared evaluation in text-animation.ts and shape-geometry.ts. Rendering overrides ASS title style tags and bakes shape-keyframed graphics into a bounded raster sequence, the keyframes route accepts clipId, titleId or graphicId, and the panels and timeline edit the new lanes. (`5fb8c24`)
- Expanded i18n catalog coverage to the whole ui/src tree and added 861 feature-panel strings in 11 host languages, with tests for catalog scope, duplicate definitions and German heading and aria-label switching. (`abcc70b`)
- Added customFont and systemFont support to caption styles and text templates, with an Imported or system font picker shared across title style, Caption style and Text templates. Fonts resolve in the ASS Caption style, ASS titles and the preview, a GET /system-fonts route lists installed families from fc-list with a queryLocalFonts fallback, and project archives carry imported caption fonts. (`de473f8`)
- Added continuous speed curves stored on clips with exact video and audio remapping, preview mapping, split handling, and curve speeds from 0.1x to 10x. Added speed-curve create, remove, and bake routes plus Smooth/Steps, Bake to clips, and curve-aware Reset in the Speed & beat panel. (`2bc5969`)
- Moved the sticker catalog, search, credits, raster size and placement into shared/stickers and embedded the catalog SVGs in the sidecar. Added the sticker list and add routes declared in manifest.json, a panel fallback to those routes, and verification scripts for sticker behaviour and binary packaging. (`eb41e23`)
- Added a voice picker that reads the host's installed speech engines and groups voices by engine and language, wiring it into generation, caption dubbing and script-to-video, with free-text fields kept as fallback. Titles gained a Text to speech action in the Titles panel and a title lane context menu, placed by the new title-narration sidecar route at the title's start on the first free audio track, with a verify-title-narration script covering placement and onset. (`8c46282`)
- Expanded the UI string catalog from 112 to over 1,200 entries across the editor workspace and added a coverage module listing the covered UI sources. The catalog test now fails on uncatalogued strings, composed shortcut and color labels, and duplicate keys. (`4ef44ae`)
- Added a preview tab strip with a fixed Timeline tab and closeable per-asset source tabs opened by double-clicking a tile or choosing Open in viewer. Source tabs play stored media with audio, route Space and J/K/L and I/O marks while active, share marked ranges through the editor store, keep back/forward history persisted per viewer and project, and close when their media is deleted. (`6b23cc2`)
- Added a Timeline colors settings pane with a swatch per clip kind and a Reset all action, persisted the preference in viewer storage, and applied it through CSS custom properties on timeline tracks, clips and overlay lanes. (`6baf3b8`)
- Project archives now bundle imported LUT and title font files with their library records and re-adopt them on import; the lutId and customFont walkers moved to shared/library-refs.ts, and the archive verification script now checks a LUT-graded clip and an imported-font title against a fresh store. (`441e04f`)
- Added a catalog of 112 high-visibility UI strings in ar, de, es, fr, hi, it, ja, ko, pt-BR, ru and zh-CN, wired into the app entry point, with a test that keeps every catalog key present in the UI source. (`c7197e0`)
- Added model selection from the host's secret-free catalog, a planning cost estimate with remaining budget, @image mention resolution, prompt enhancement through model.complete with undo, and per-project prompt drafts to the Generate panel. New pieces include the GenerationCostEstimate, GenerationModelField and PromptTools components plus shared generation-assist helpers. (`3564ad3`)
- Added a font library with GET/POST/DELETE /fonts routes that validates TrueType and OpenType files and reads the family from the name table, plus a customFont field on titles. The export passes libass a single fontsdir with bundled and imported fonts, the preview registers the file with FontFace, and verify-imported-fonts.ts checks the render against bundled Lobster. (`680a8f1`)
- Embedded the title fonts and the RNNoise model in the sidecar binary and extracted them to a private directory on first use, since Core's downloader installs only the bare binary. GET /capabilities now reports bundledAssets, the title Font picker and Voice isolation control show a notice when an install is missing them, and verify-embedded-assets.ts and verify-package.ts check the extraction and embedding. (`6e531a0`)
- Added a revision watcher that polls the open project and, while nothing is unsaved, adopts a newer revision saved elsewhere as an undoable Agent edit history step. (`3f333a3`)
- Enabled LUTs on adjustment layers in the layer editor and added clip backgrounds from a library image or a video's first frame, scaled to cover the frame and drawn in both the clip render stage and the preview. Backgrounds are settable from the inspector or the background route with a clipId, and verify-adjustment and verify-background prove both with real renders. (`1bd5bc9`)
- Added word-slide and word-highlight-block title in-animations, a per-glyph left-to-right gradient fill, and text blur, wired through the shared project schema, ASS title rendering, preview and title style controls. The verify-text-styles script checks each with real FFmpeg renders. (`2fcd47b`)
- Title and graphic transform boxes now carry rotation, with a preview rotation knob that snaps to 15 degrees on Shift and gestures that write rotation. Clips gained edge handles that stretch one axis through scaleX or scaleY within schema bounds while corners scale uniformly. (`7ad216d`)
- With Ripple mode on, pointer edge trims now go through the Ripple trim so later clips, linked partners and sync-locked tracks shift, and clip moves run through shared rippleMoveClips to extract the clips, close the gap and insert them at the nearest edit point. Each operation is one undo step. (`7076772`)
- The FCPXML and XMEML interchange writers now emit clip fades, Cross Dissolve transitions, speed retiming and audio levels, and the FCPXML writer builds a primary storyline with gaps and connected clips for other tracks. (`47b99f9`)
- Added GET /projects/:id/package-archive (alias package?media=1) to build and download a ZIP of the editable package plus referenced media, and import now accepts that ZIP, re-ingesting missing media under original asset IDs and opening the project as a new copy. (`093bbc7`)
- Added a bounded ZIP reader for dotLottie v1 and v2 archives, and Import Lottie, Import media and OS drops now accept .json and .lottie files, inlining archive images as data URIs before routing to the Lottie importer. (`3357798`)
- The preview Guides menu gained a Grid with viewer-set columns and rows and a Custom guide with margins and a W:H aspect box, both remembered per viewer, plus three unbranded vertical layouts. Preview actions, editor store, toolbar, and guide geometry were updated with tests. (`6c6d095`)
- Added review-marker handoff to the agent bridge, the Markers panel, the ruler marker editor, and the timeline markers, so markers overlapping a handed-off range are listed for the agent. (`b2a337d`)

- The video-studio content-seal helper now opens content sealed under retired roots, reseals it under the current key, and records the current KCV only when all values open. (`4ec916a`)
- Content sealing now rescans and seals values under a sealed column that lack an envelope prefix, covering plaintext written after a rollback. StoreSeal.open refuses a store whose recorded min_reader is newer than this build reads, and writes keep the highest min_reader. (`8d0b850`)
- The TypeScript content seal now zero-fills freed pages one chunk per transaction with a WAL truncate after each, only when one chunk plus headroom is free, and no longer lets a failure escape StoreSeal.open. A finished scrub is recorded as 'scrubbed' so a deferred VACUUM does not repeat it, and the zeroed scratch table is dropped without secure_delete; tests were updated. (`f976ee6`)
- The store now deletes caption files, rendered frames, audio windows and probe results left behind by crashed jobs when it opens, without following symlinks, and the README documents it. (`991cc0d`)
- The content-seal finish step now runs whenever the store records its first key and always zero-fills the freelist before the size-gated VACUUM. Compat mode refuses values that start like a Ryu envelope, and only a recorded key check value marks a store as sealed. (`f5e5c80`)
- The Video Studio store now narrows media, import and render trees to 0700/0600 on every open without following symlinks, since mkdir's mode never narrowed existing folders or files written under the umask. A store-seal test and README note were added. (`1f4df21`)
- Video Studio projects, history, transcripts, search indexes, generation jobs and analyses are sealed at rest as one encb:v1 document per row under the plugin subkey; schema version 6 lifts generation status and project id into plaintext columns before sealing, the key is captured before anything spawns, and key variables are removed from the environment while media, imports and renders stay as plaintext files in 0700 directories. (`67c5a9d`)
- The Video Studio app gained its shared editing modules covering adjustment, animation, audio, captions, keyframes, masks, multicam, reframe, speed curves, interchange and render options, along with schema and legacy fixtures, manifest, plugin and build updates, a README, and the sticker, emoji and flag asset catalog with licenses. The 207-commit branch was merged onto main with the editor UI (timeline components, preview compositor and GL passes, inspector sections, shortcut catalog, i18n catalogs and bundled OFL fonts) plus Playwright evidence specs, while hard-coded app ids were replaced by an OwnerExclusiveGrant-based media:record grant, sd.cpp's Wan frame models moved onto video_models_dir(), and zip inflation during project import was bounded. (`cbd2f53`)
- The video-studio sidecar changed across its sequence, stock, uploads, store, upscale and server modules, with matching edits to the shared insert helpers and tests, the UI bridge, and the app manifest. (`e3a5e18`)
- Regenerated the Playwright evidence screenshots from the 19 interaction and W2-W7 evidence tests at the branch head, including W7 AI video tool captures that now show the Local engine choice. (`e9c44a1`)
- The soundtrack job tests' afterEach hook now polls the sidecar-wide held-slot count until it reaches zero instead of pausing a fixed 10 ms, so a canceled launch that frees its slot late no longer causes the next test to hit a 429 from a full synthesis budget. (`3b14f15`)
- The OTIO speed-curve reader now accepts both Clip.1 and Clip.2, so a file re-saved by opentimelineio keeps its curves, with a regression test in interchange.test.ts. Added a sidecar verify-otio script that loads the export with opentimelineio 0.18.1 and checks the LinearTimeWarp average, the Ryu.SpeedCurve.1 effect keyframes and the ryu.speedCurve metadata, exiting non-zero with a reason when the package is missing. (`a427177`)
- Added a catalog test requiring each plural to cover the CLDR categories an integer count up to 1000 selects in its locale, rejecting selectors outside that set and requiring number interpolation where the English template shows it. Fixed the Hindi templates that used a plain {count} and added an explicit Arabic zero category, and recorded the extra catalogs' 2.7 MB eager load as a known cost. (`c48a58a`)
- The core speech host e2e harness now reads generated Gateway keys through print-key or keeps its own key files. (`1f0b58b`)
- Updated the video-studio app's manifest, shared insert helpers, sidecar sequence/server/stock/store/upscale modules, upload tests, and UI bridge as part of the merge. (`064e1f6`)
- Extended the blend parity spec so it mounts the real PreviewStage — including the rAF playback loop and z-ordering — on an animated scene and checks each frame against inspect-frame. Mask rasters now report their age from the frame that requested them, so a continuously animated mask stays drawable while a stalled load ages out after STALE_INPUT_LIMIT_MS. (`788b2d7`)
- Each clip now keeps its last ready mask raster and draws with it while the current one decodes, with one load in flight per clip, and a clip that drew before may reuse its last picture or mask for at most STALE_INPUT_LIMIT_MS before the frame counts as waiting. PreviewStage suppresses the paused exact server frame only once the compositor has a frame on screen and keeps it while a title or graphic above the canvas uses an approximated blend, and the canvas z-index now comes from the plan's on-screen visual clips, clamped below graphics, captions and titles. (`a4d009e`)
- The blend parity Playwright config now stops the host with SIGTERM and the host also cleans up on exit, so parity runs leave no store under the temp directory. (`8ed5ebc`)
- With the Local engine, gaps over about 20.6 s are now refused before any admission or extraction, and the panel disables Generate motion with the reason shown instead of failing after a long local run. (`154d883`)
- The handoff panel and i18n messages now state that large uploads take minutes, that an 'upload outcome is unknown' post is not retried and must be checked on the platform, and that local-file publishing is not yet verified against a live account. (`ae1085b`)
- Reworked two Playwright specs to remove races: a category tab click that lands in the overflow menu now times out and falls back to the menu, and the W7 evidence spec records every status text to find the AI edit success line rather than reading the current one. (`3903413`)
- The W5 evidence spec now proves the clean three-way merge of a title saved elsewhere under an unsaved duplicate, then forces a real clip overlap to trigger the conflict banner, with updated conflict screenshots showing the listed conflict. (`9871fd9`)
- Plain and ripple Delete now go through the shared withoutClips helper, so reveal transitions left without a predecessor are dropped instead of failing autosave validation. Regression tests cover removeClips and both delete modes. (`397ff61`)
- Proof process helpers and their tests were added and the sidecar:process comment corrected. (`82f6c7b`)
- The blend section's note now says the exact paused frame appears only once edits are saved and the frame can be rendered, rather than claiming it is shown while edits are unsaved or a render failed; runtime messages and tests were updated. (`df0fe4c`)
- Imported font bytes now count against the media storage allowance without taking a media asset slot, renders include only the imported fonts a project uses, GET /fonts requires an offset for chunked reads above the inline limit, POST /uploads accepts purpose: font with a 24 MB cap, and the JSON project package carries font credits matching the credits route and archive. (`3a06e0b`)
- The three-way merge now infers whole-track renumbering on the remote side from shared clips and remaps base and local clips when certain, otherwise reporting a tracks conflict, including for local track-setting and adjustment-layer edits. Autosave indicator messages were updated to match. (`84f584c`)
- mergeAfterConflict now re-reads the timeline when it changed during its fetch, replaces only the project it merged from, runs inside act so the revision watcher stands aside, and records an Agent edit history step. Autosave tests were extended accordingly. (`500c845`)
- verify-core.ts now installs the builtin from Core's catalog, reinstalls an install left by an older build, and enables it directly instead of installing plugin.bundle.json through the Community-tier path. The manifest no longer requests sidecar:process, since Core-tier builtins run their managed sidecar without that grant. (`d0c41cb`)
- Made status messages transient through runtime.setStatus(text, {clearOn}), so Media imported notices clear on the next timeline edit or after 6 s without wiping a newer message. AssetLibrary now resets the library column's scroll on first layout, the Credits panel lists online fonts with their license, and a Playwright check asserts scrollTop 0 and notice clearing after an edit. (`db7fa6d`)
- Exports and nested timelines now draw shape-keyframed graphics ahead of the graph with prepareShapeSequences into the work folder, bounded by budget, deadline and a 432,000 frame-entry cap per render, with chunk seeks to each window's first frame. Curve audio rendering stops at the operation deadline, checks total file size against the work budget before writing, renders only clips the export range can hear, and starts the encode budget from what was already written. (`a2ccf8c`)
- Clip frames now carry the head trim and the curve's source origin; curveRemapPoints maps clip frame t through the curve at t + headShift, knots shift by the trim, and buttedFrames derives in and out points from the exact curve mapping. Snapshot tests cover a curved clip at a reveal cut in both FCPXML and XMEML. (`389be89`)
- Catalogued the OpenTimelineIO download button, its toast and the four speed-curve pitch strings in every host locale so the catalog coverage test passes. (`ff593ca`)
- putAsset now deletes the media file and thumbnail it refused to insert at MAX_MEDIA_ASSETS, leaving files belonging to an existing row untouched, and Openverse and Unsplash imports reserve a storage slot via reserveMediaStorage. Tests cover the refused insert, kept existing media, and admission refusing further slots. (`55f84a8`)
- Kept the existing translated description and added the local-file publishing limitation as its own catalogued line in the Send to Outpost handoff. (`978113f`)
- Updated the Send to Outpost editor copy to state that handed-off renders attach as local files, which Outpost's YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn and X providers refuse. (`16b4210`)
- AI matte and cutout derivatives now get a VP9 WebM copy with alpha through the shared alpha-preview encoder, registered as their preview proxy, and the preview always uses that copy rather than an H.264 proxy, as with Lottie masters. The editor reports when no alpha copy could be made, and a real-FFmpeg test plus verify-ai-matte check that the preview keeps its alpha. (`6f252f0`)
- Offset AI takes — AI video edits, lip-sync takes and AI mattes — now start at the source range they were made from rather than the source's time 0. sameMediaTimebase and the split-edit evidence lookup treat them like reversals so continuity detection and speech/waveform evidence do not read the source's clock. (`98d193f`)
- AI edit and AI matte now place takes at the clip's own speed over the same source span and refuse speeds or ramps the overwrite edit cannot place. AI edit, AI matte, photoreal and both gap-fill placements carry a plan stamp of the prepared timeline, so a placement against a since-edited timeline is refused as a conflict, and generate motion refuses gaps over 100 s or clips too short even at 10% speed. (`f7450ee`)
- Upscale and nested-sequence assets now reserve node media storage and an asset slot, cap upscale output by remaining quota, and refuse inserts past MAX_MEDIA_ASSETS. - Regenerated the Video Studio end-to-end evidence screenshots after the W4b fixes, covering category tabs, timeline edits, mixer, export, keyframe, and template flows. (`599f8e9`)
- Span-mode waveform drawing in the timeline now renders every column a draw span needs, up to 8192, instead of capping at 2048 columns from the overscan edge. Wide lanes that previously lost the waveform on the right of a wide clip now draw in full. (`e105fd4`)
- Tracked blur and mosaic region layers now record the source moments they cover and are moved and stretched by trimEdit and retimes, being cut at a clip edge that trimmed part away. A layer moved or reshaped by hand stops following its clip. (`1a3b9c5`)
- Nested-sequence renders now run buildRenderProgram steps with script files and chunking in the sequence folder, with each step's output counted against the 10 GB nested work budget, avoiding the E2BIG failure on nested timelines past roughly 215 clips. RenderQueue intermediates now share a 64 GB work budget capped by free disk space less 1 GB, and an export past it fails with a clear message. (`d0a5ef2`)
- reframeToSubjects no longer resets a clip's own crop and x/y/scale/crop keyframes when following a subject; such clips keep the centred crop with a per-clip note, and the shorts route skips measuring tracks for them. (`7a22467`)
- The W4b evidence spec now imports a uniquely named w4b-clip.webm fixture so it no longer collides with the W4a spec's import, and the e2e evidence PNGs were regenerated from one passing run of all 13 specs. (`b026ed2`)
- Changed the long-timeline verification to compare the one-pass audio-only mix against the chunk mix per clip block with a one-sample shift allowance, check the queue export against the chunk program audio, and report the export difference. (`82ab648`)
- Added a test asserting the chunked render program's audio mix pads the sidechain and ducked group one second past the timeline, matching the one-pass graph. (`db04bce`)
- Timeline clips wider than 4096 px now draw filmstrip and waveform only around the viewport through a draw window, so a long clip at high zoom no longer needs a canvas tens of thousands of pixels wide. Mask handles now transform with the project and media sizes so they line up with a cropped fill clip. (`e92b9e8`)
- RenderQueue now renders through buildRenderProgram so long timelines chunk and large one-pass graphs move to a script file. Both sidechain compressor inputs are held with silence one second past the timeline so ducked tails are kept and one-pass and chunked exports carry matching audio. (`34c3715`)
- Added tests pinning W4b reframe pan and tracking keyframes to their source moments under head and tail trims, and checking that chunked exports hide, mute and duck the same clips as a one-pass export. (`135fe46`)
- Integrated parity W4 part b, adding auto reframe and motion tracking (shared modules, sidecar routes and tracker/saliency code), chunked long-timeline rendering, per-frame avatar motion, the Reframe and Tracking panels, preview transform and crop stages, and verification scripts. (`0c638a2`)
- Nest/decompose now carries child track mute, solo and hide state, folds track gain and pan into copies, drops fades on trimmed-away edges, and only lands audible copies on audible tracks. Templates keep keyframe curves on shortened fills and restore detached-audio volume, script-to-video narration lands only on audible tracks, and AutoCut captions come only from heard clips; copy updates and regenerated e2e evidence were included. (`9e77ef0`)
- Regenerated the Video Studio e2e evidence PNGs from a run where all 12 Playwright specs passed on the merged W4 a and c tree. (`309a3d4`)
- Changed highlight and shorts scoring to read transcripts and loudness only from clips that pass clipHeard, so muted, hidden, silent, or high-speed-muted speech does not rank a short or become word captions. The shorts room check now counts projects in SQL. (`3ef75e7`)
- Integrated parity W4 part c: shared gap-fill, script-to-video and auto-edit modules with matching sidecar routes and verify scripts, the GapFillAction, ScriptToVideoPanel and AutoCutPanel UI, a HighlightsPanel change, and W4c e2e evidence screenshots. (`1368ffe`)
- Decompose now restores a clip's reveal or exit transition only on the edges its trimmed range keeps, using fitEdgeTransitions the way split pieces do, and template fill clamps reveal and exit through fitEdgeTransitions and judges coverage with the shared revealCovered helper. (`8e69fd0`)
- Integrated parity W4 part a: shared nest, template library and template modules with sidecar nest and template routes, sequence rendering, the SequencePanel, TemplatesPanel, per-clip keyframe lanes, a graph editor with easing presets, a dB volume line, and regenerated e2e evidence. (`bb19b46`)

### `@ryu/voice`@0.5.0

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amajorai/ryu-marketplace/134dad3aef109140ff9aaaa0fe4224b7ab8c5b63/app-icons/voice-light.png) ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amajorai/ryu-marketplace/134dad3aef109140ff9aaaa0fe4224b7ab8c5b63/app-icons/voice-dark.png) [GitHub release](https://github.com/amajorai/ryu-voice/releases/tag/v0.5.0)

#### Minor changes

- Voice Studio moved to manifest 0.2.0 and split into Studio, Library, History, and Stories views. The sidecar now honors seed, instruct, reference_text, effects chains with presets, loudness normalization for peak, podcast, and ACX targets, wav/mp3/ogg/flac output, sentence chunking with inline [pause] tags, per-engine paralinguistic tag filtering, and pitch-preserving time-stretch; it added Chatterbox and Qwen3-TTS engines with licence and capability fields and refuses conflicting torch-family co-installs. Library gained mic recording, auto-transcribed reference text, preprocessing warnings, multiple samples per voice, edit sheets, tags, search, favorites, portable profile import/export, and per-sample consent; History gained search, favorites, replay, regenerate, restore settings, format download, and stats; Stories supports multi-voice scripts with per-line audition and script import. (`78371b8`)

#### Patch changes

- Updated the voice app's interaction-map e2e test. (`41ee7a7`)
- The e2e interaction-map test expectations were updated to match the reworked translation strings. No runtime source files were changed in this package.
- Merged main's changes into the Voice sidecar's Qwen TTS backend, device selection, engine installer, request models, server and time-stretch modules, and updated the backend tests and README. (`1438289`)
- Adjusted the interaction-map test to scan components together with their split siblings, and to expect a scope of partial for the map covering 24 of 146 rows. (`a074cb6`)
- Updated the voice sidecar's TTS stack, touching the Qwen backend, device selection, engine installer, request models, server and time-stretch modules, with backend tests and the README updated. (`974ca98`)

- Torch TTS engines always auto-detect the device, Qwen3-TTS loads the first cached checkpoint and its size error points at the 1.7B model, chunks stay at 400 characters, and pedalboard is used whenever its optional extra is installed. The /generate request models moved unchanged into request_models.py because server.py was over the file limits, and the sidecar README describes the fixed behavior. (`1420fec`)
- Updated the voice app's Python sidecar dependencies and adjusted the studio view, queue panel, engine install flow, library profile card and import-profile dialog, plus the companion interaction fixtures. (`0af1456`)

(`28e5be5`)

### `@ryuhq/client`@0.5.0

[Published package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@ryuhq/client/v/0.5.0)

#### Minor changes

- The inbox() normalizer in mail.ts keeps hosted Mail's createdWith and MailInboxCreatedVia, preserving absent as absent and null as null, dropping undocumented keys and omitting malformed values so an inbox read never fails on them. (`29f73e3`)
- Mail and Managed Agents now resolve ids through a shared whole-path scan, and forward() accepts a MailForwardInput with an optional subject. Added tests for the path-id scan and the mail client. (`ae575df`)
- Added the agent.tool_approval_request and user.tool_approval event types, the requireApproval option and sessions.respondToApproval. (`3dd0fa9`)
- HarnessAPI.startRun accepts a multitaskStrategy and the related types are exported. (`2736713`)
- Updated the client Spaces test so its drift guard targets collect_candidates rather than the previous retrieval entry point. (`58672d7`)
- Added a box client and its contracts, with tests covering the new box operations. (`93c2c49`)
- Changed the client mail module alongside the mail send-limit and address-rule updates. (`79d8bbc`)
- Added checkAddress, ensureAgentInbox, getAgentInbox and changeInboxAddress to the mail client, plus MailInbox.agentId, with boundary and mail tests. (`698b49d`)
- Added createManagedAgentsClient with typed resources, cursor-based event listing and a resumable SSE event stream. Contract types and tests ship alongside it. (`b89b8d4`)
- Added createBoxClient along with a Box tunnel helper, and updated package exports, build config, README, and tests for the new Box client surface. (`0a90987`)

#### Patch changes

- Merged origin/main into the branch and reconciled the client package manifest with main's changes. (`1903ef3`)
- Updated the package manifest to take main's dependency security bumps. (`1438289`)
- Updated the package manifest as part of the merge. (`974ca98`)
- Updated client modules for agents, box/tunnel, harness, mail, managed agents, messaging, notifications, spaces and path IDs, with tests and type changes. (`0af1456`)
- The TypeScript Core harness client now raises a typed invalid_id error for empty, "." and ".." ids before issuing a request. Exported the change from the package index and covered it with tests. (`6f2e9c5`)
- Added a box tunnel module and expanded box, mail, notify and managed-agent client modules, including path-id encoding helpers and their tests. Package metadata and README were refreshed. (`cbf38ec`)
- Agent, box, harness, and notify client modules were reconciled with SSE stream bound tests added, keeping the stricter variant of each conflicting change. (`21f287f`)
- TSDoc now states that isSafeRequestPath takes a request path rather than a full URL and that a trailing slash is refused, with a new test covering the full-URL case. (`cf41a21`)
- Updated the Mail client list handling and its tests to match the stricter shared list-limit validation. (`59bf020`)
- Updated the Mail client and its tests in line with the prefixed-integer parsing parity between the JavaScript and Python Mail ports. (`01c63fb`)
- Mail input types gained explicit declarations: UpdateMailInboxInput declares podId and description, MailForwardInput declares text and html, and CreateMailInboxInput adds agentId and description while dropping the internal source path from its TSDoc. MailAttachmentInput's contentId and contentType now carry TSDoc. (`ae5d374`)
- CreateMailInboxInput in the Mail client gained a hosted-only localPart field and an optional address field. (`20f8adc`)
- The CreateMailInboxInput JSDoc now describes how hosted Mail picks the inbox address. (`434e29c`)
- Exposed Notify's checked module-level request wrapper as an internal test seam named notifyRequest, kept out of the package root exports, and added tests confirming it refuses //, %2e%2E and \.. paths before fetch. Also added MessagingTransport.json tests using paths only the whole-path scan catches and retitled the org-id refusal test. (`22dec75`)
- The client box, harness and notify modules were edited and an SSE stream bounds test was added. (`85b0971`)
- Exported RyuPathIdError from the client package entry point and added path-id tests. (`a856ecb`)
- MailWebSocketConstructor now returns a structural MailWebSocketLike so the ws package's class type-checks without a cast; the return type stays WebSocket. (`052e596`)
- Mail's path guard now reads segments the way the WHATWG URL parser does, with backslash as a separator, tab/CR/LF dropped and edge controls and spaces trimmed, so the inputs that previously slipped past are refused. Messaging rejects an empty or dot organization id on org-scoped requests with invalid_id, while credential-free status() keeps working. (`df4632b`)
- Notify Title, Tags and Click are wrapped in a single UTF-8 B encoded word when the text is outside Latin-1 or contains "=?", so free text round-trips exactly, and lone surrogates are refused locally. (`e0b0307`)
- MailRealtimeTicket gained a url field, and connectRealtimeWithTicket now takes a WebSocket constructor and refuses before minting when none is available. Both ticket methods are marked hosted-only and refuse mailRealtime "standalone". (`5445a72`)
- The agents client and the package index were updated with corresponding test changes in the in-progress audit remediation snapshot. (`f5cb5be`)
- The client now checks a standalone token against the RFC 7230 token character set before opening a WebSocket, throwing a redacted error instead of letting the runtime quote the credential. In Core mode it fails fast with ticket instructions when no one-use ticket is passed. (`e16445c`)
- Brought the checkpoint's client changes into client, covering the agents client module, its tests and the package manifest. Conflicts were resolved file by file in favour of main's newer behaviour. (`3a960fa`)
- Added Managed Agents client entry points and contract types, and changed the harness and spaces client surfaces, with accompanying tests. (`b1b04f3`)
- Package repository metadata was updated to cover the client, services and services-cli packages. (`25e016b`)
- The box-tunnel module header now documents the `npx -y -p @ryuhq/client@^0.4.0 box-tunnel <id> <port>` invocation, and the README plus the managed-agents and messaging modules were updated in the same pass. (`5773fcd`)
- The client gained managed-agents contract types and a managed-agents client module, plus a reworked harness. Space-related tests were adjusted with the merge. (`dac9704`)
- Added a messaging client slice with contracts, tests and boundary tests, and updated the package manifest and README. (`8918d18`)
- Updated the harness and managed agents client methods and their contract types, and re-exported them from the package index. (`d65aa91`)
- Updated the spaces client tests to cover the revised retrieval behavior. (`3f09390`)
- Added Box client contracts and updated the Box client implementation and exports. (`1a4ce6b`)
- Added a messaging client module and its contracts with tests, updated the package exports and README, and taught the client's messaging error handling to read `code` before falling back to `error`. (`a00d2f8`)
- Extended the agents client module and its types for identity mode and account access, and re-exported the new surface from the package index. (`ad3eb64`)
- Updated the box, mail, notify, and managed-agents client modules and their contract types, with matching tests and README changes. (`ddf18f0`)
- Updated the box, mail, notify and managed-agents client modules and their contract tests to the renamed product terms after merging main's content. The package README and manifest followed the same rename. (`a01db11`)
- Updated the box, mail, notify and managed-agents clients along with their contract modules, boundary checks and tests. The package entry point and README were updated to match. (`cdb7957`)
- Added identityMode and accountAccess to agent types and to agent create and update calls, with tests. (`6289b51`)
- Added createMessagingClient to the client SDK with reply validators and webhook verification, documented in the package README. (`4123af0`)
- The mail client module gained mailbox and alias parsers alongside the existing core mail WebSocket path, with new exports from the package index and matching tests. (`a9b90d7`)

### `@ryuhq/core-client`@0.5.0

[Published package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@ryuhq/core-client/v/0.5.0)

#### Minor changes

- Added typed get and set client functions for GET/PUT /api/primary-bot with a zod codec, a shared wire fixture that Core's serializer test asserts against, and a helper that opens a bot's own main thread. (`eecd9d6`)

- Added client methods for annotation queues, along with tests covering the new API. (`8003109`)

- core-client added a trace tree and list client plus a Gateway audit usage join, covered by new trace tests. (`65d072e`)
- Added get, update and delete working memory calls, and extended the agent memory slot with the working memory and compaction fields. (`fcda385`)
- Added a space-retrieval client covering hybrid, filter, parent and expansion search plus chunking get and set, and extended the retrieval client with filter, hybrid, expansion and metadata fields. (`58672d7`)

- Added hardware client calls for pairBegin, pairReveal, pairConfirm and pairCancel, resetHardwareIdentity, tolerant v1.1 device fields with node_identity, and structured error codes. (`5b2ca7f`)

### `@ryuhq/sdk`@0.5.0

[Published package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@ryuhq/sdk/v/0.5.0)

#### Minor changes

- The SDK Agent gained a multitaskStrategy option passed through to harness runs, with session tests covering the new strategies. (`2736713`)
- Added @ryuhq/sdk/server with a Web-standard fetch handler serving agents, workflows, tools, run traces, bearerAuth, and per-resource OpenAPI 3.1, plus ryu build targets for node, docker, vercel, cloudflare, and netlify, ryu deploy, and ryu dev --studio. (`885a4fa`)
- Added @ryuhq/sdk/prompts with prompts.get resolution from the Core node or organization registry, TTL caching, stale-on-error handling, caller fallbacks, and TextPrompt/ChatPrompt template compilation. Agent instructions now accept a registry reference resolved at the start of each run. (`b205998`)
- Added the @ryuhq/sdk/evals entry point with deterministic and Gateway-backed scorers, createScorer, JSON/JSONL/CSV and in-code datasets, runExperiment with concurrency and thresholds, and uploads to Core prompt-suite runs. (`a5758a8`)
- Added a @ryuhq/sdk/loaders entry point covering web pages, sitemap crawling, GitHub, Notion, Google Drive, Confluence, feeds, structured CSV/JSON/JSONL, and local files. Network loaders share an SSRF guard, per-hop redirect checks, capped bodies, and timeouts. (`12173f8`)
- The agent now accepts working memory and compaction options: it injects the Core-stored scratchpad into model calls, mounts the memory API and update tool, and summarizes older turns once a token threshold is passed. (`fcda385`)
- Added the @ryuhq/sdk/rag subpath with Core-parity text splitters, a metadata filter evaluator and weighted RRF, and made ctx.rag.retrieve validate and forward filter and hybrid options. Package exports and the tsup config were updated for the new entry point. (`58672d7`)
- Added the agui module with event types, a stateful AgentEvent and harness-stream mapper, JSON Patch state deltas, and a Fetch-to-SSE handler that surfaces approvals as interrupts and supports in-process resumption. Added the voice module and agent.voice for speak, listen and realtime over Gateway audio endpoints or Core local engines with an egress check, plus the package.json and tsup export entries and mocked-transport tests for both surfaces. (`4306546`)
- Added the @ryuhq/sdk/a2a client with Agent Card discovery, Core endpoint policy, same-origin JWKS signature verification using JCS and Ed25519 JWS, JSON-RPC and HTTP+JSON bindings, SSE streaming, task and push-config operations, peer credentials, and a2aAgentTool. (`a501498`)
- Added agent.asTool(), handoff(target), AgentNetwork and createSupervisor to the agent runtime, with handoffs transferring the transcript inside one run and network events tagged by active agent. Local tool descriptions are now sent to the model. (`4b64bad`)
- Added the @ryuhq/sdk/workflow module with createWorkflow and createStep, combinators for sequence, parallel, branch, foreach, do-while/do-until, map, sleep and nesting, and agent, tool, MCP, human-gate and raw node steps. It includes an in-process executor with suspend/resume, snapshots, retries, timeouts and event/update/value streams, compilation to Core's workflow JSON, and a Core client that deploys workflows and polls run state. (`7063843`)
- Updated defineTool and ryuTool to accept any Standard Schema with run() argument inference, converting it to JSON Schema for the wire while leaving the hand-written ToolSchema path unchanged. Agent outputSchema now validates replies against a Standard Schema or JSON Schema and re-asks the model with the issues up to maxRepairAttempts (default 2) before raising StructuredOutputError, with helpers added under a new @ryuhq/sdk/schema subpath. (`26ef0b3`)
- Updated the manifest labels to the new mode names. (`315c4a0`)
- Regenerated the plugin manifest TypeScript contracts to include the new interface settings field. (`dc75fef`)
- Regenerated the plugin manifest types and updated manifest helpers so SDK consumers can declare `agent_profile_tabs`. (`e6f8c75`)
- Regenerated the plugin manifest TypeScript types to include the new contributes.interfaces field. (`cda6d8c`)
- Regenerated the plugin manifest types and taught the manifest schema validation to accept the `deprecated` field, with schema tests added. (`c1cc4cc`)
- Regenerated the plugin manifest types to cover the avatar_accessories and avatar_styles contribution fields. (`2cd5518`)
- Reserved the `core` plugin id and defined the `core#<name>` kernel-event namespace with an empty reviewed `KERNEL_EVENTS` allowlist, and added a root-level `subscribes` manifest field pairing an event with a sidecar and a fixed POST route. The generated plugin schema snapshot was regenerated and the public SDK schema synced. (`cb6639c`)
- Regenerated the plugin manifest types and schema JSON to include the optional sidecars[].sandbox block. (`6ef30b3`)
- Added the `engines.host_api` field to the manifest types and the generated plugin manifest typings. (`9f2bc76`)

- Extended the manifest fixture tests to cover the new view-action hook surface. (`ac6601f`)
- The Agent loop gained a middleware option with wrapModelCall, wrapToolCall and afterTurn phases that compose in array order, exported from the agent and package entry points and covered by tests. (`a56fbf8`)

- Regenerated the plugin manifest TypeScript types to include the new panel placement definitions. (`f6a7f62`)

- A user-role note is appended after a member's reply so the supervisor's next model call never ends on an assistant message. The A2A client fetches card JWKS without following redirects, refuses opaque browser redirects whose target cannot be re-checked, and rejects `.` and `..` task and config ids on the HTTP+JSON binding. The A2A tool bounds streamed tasks by timeoutMs, returning the current state at the deadline, and stops reading once a task settles. (`c06f1c8`)
- The SDK workflow compiler now emits path-safe derived node ids and validates step ids at compile time. Serialized code steps get shims for local-only context members, step timeouts abort abandoned attempts via a per-attempt signal, the remote client validates run ids and stops leaking abort listeners, and stream() unsubscribes when start or resume throws synchronously. (`860d58f`)
