### `@ryuhq/services`@0.5.0

[Published package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@ryuhq/services/v/0.5.0)

#### Minor changes

- Updated the mail conformance test suite alongside the Effect v4 adoption.
- The package exports MailInboxCreatedWith and MailInboxCreatedVia from its index and adds a tool-output test case covering the carried createdWith data. (`29f73e3`)
- Added box_get (read-only) and box_resume (idempotent, non-destructive write) to the tool registry so MCP and the agent adapters expose them, and pointed box_create and box_stop at the new tools. (`ab6f43f`)
- Added a Sites visitor-listener hint, a default hint for a 429 after failed authentication, and tool-selection errors that name each missing service's settings. (`ae575df`)

#### Patch changes

- Merged main's mail conformance test into the services test suite. (`1438289`)
- The mail conformance test was updated during the merge of main into feat/primary-bot-port. (`974ca98`)
- Brought in main's mail conformance test alongside the branch's services changes. (`32f1a85`)
- Merged an updated mail conformance test. (`5011e6c`)
- Added service namespaces and route modules for box, connect, gateway, mail, managed agents, messaging, notify, passport and sites, plus transport layers for retry, rate limits, idempotency, deprecation and fetch shims. Added webhook handlers and crypto, a tool adapter layer with framework tests for Hono, Next routes and edge runtimes, and conformance tests with JSON fixtures per service. (`0af1456`)
- Listed the Sites PUT settings and DELETE project routes as nonReplaySafe in the TypeScript route table, so the shim no longer auto-retries them and no longer produces a spurious 409 from an already-consumed expectedRevision. (`88f5dfe`)
- Added box, connect, gateway, mail, managed-agents, messaging, notify, passport and sites namespaces with tool adapters, idempotent transport and webhook handlers. Conformance fixtures and framework tests for Hono, Next routes, edge and agent tools were added. (`cbf38ec`)
- invalidUrlHint now matches the Python implementation and only offers the missing-scheme hint for host-like values, originOf requires a full http:// or https:// scheme, and the three Connect bare-code denials were reworded to grant framing. (`98f87a1`)
- Added a test covering a full URL passed to the path check and corrected a stale comment in the path-segments test. (`cf41a21`)
- TypeScript passport importState began refusing a missing or non-string state before making a request, matching Python. Webhook timestamp checks began failing closed on a NaN skew. (`6e9611a`)
- Notify request-approval idempotency handling began emitting the documented 409 idempotency_conflict hint, and the idempotency header stopped listing notify_request_approval as sharing the wording. A path-segments parity test checked hasUnsafePathSegment against the client's isSafeRequestPath on one path table. (`4e8dfc2`)
- drafts.list, events.list and webhooks.deliveries.list now refuse a limit that is not a positive integer with invalid_limit before any request, via assertMailListLimit run after the id checks. (`59bf020`)
- Added nested Sites client schemas, reworded the mail_create_inbox retry guidance, and changed the Hono and Next.js webhook snippets to answer webhook_payload_invalid with 422, with tool and framework tests. (`b577e2c`)
- Hardened the service-title guard to reject hard-coded "Ryu &lt;service id>" literal prefixes to match the Python guard, and stated both early-access requirements in the README Messaging bullet. (`acedd54`)
- Revised the Sites client, namespace and tools TSDoc to describe what the Sites sidecar stores, and extended the tool output tests. (`01c63fb`)
- The services config module and its tests were updated to cover the credential-free tool list alongside the MCP server registration. (`535aebe`)
- mail_create_inbox now rejects a clientId that starts or ends with a space, marks description as hosted-only, and documents the clientId retry guarantee as covering sequential retries only. Tool behaviour, tool and agent-tool tests, and the output cases were updated to match. (`4257338`)
- Adjusted the mail tool definitions and their tests to state that no tool creates an inbox. (`27223c2`)
- Added the hosted mail draft-approve, agent-send and agent-reply routes to the mail route definitions, with conformance tests covering them. (`ffdfd5b`)
- The sites client's runtime npm note no longer appends the @ryuhq/client latest-version freshness clause, leaving the note to describe only publication status. (`ae5d374`)
- The tool registry gained credentialFreeRyuTools, with mail and agent-tools tests covering both paths. (`4e24ae7`)
- Tool output schemas made mail attachment size and status inboxCount nullable so a non-number count serializes as null, and approvalData.value became required and nullable. Stub replies moved to tool-output-cases.ts with variants for approvals, sites_list, self-hosted snake_case Mail and non-numeric counts, and the TS tests gained list_events timeout and host-cancel cases. (`12e6e2e`)
- Added includeReleased to messaging_list_numbers, kept `all` as a deprecated alias, and exported mailPageSize along with the Mail page-size constants. The TypeScript SitesStatus type now names the 13 *Available capability flags as optional booleans, backed by a drift test against the Sites sidecar's GET /status. (`3c3e617`)
- messaging_send_sms gained messageType and ttlSeconds options, with accept and reject parity vectors and a regenerated tools manifest. (`db1c236`)
- Synced the Box, Notify, Sites, Connect and Mail SDK surfaces with the newly added routes, including Box and Notify error codes, namespace definitions, conformance tests and fixtures. (`4446e10`)
- Updated box service tests, box error codes, and transport retry behavior to match fork idempotency replay and conflict handling. (`dedca3e`)
- Added tests for x-request-id on Gateway errors, Mail inbox creation, and the edge worker running without its secret binding. (`20f8adc`)
- Updated the framework tests for edge, Hono and Next.js route handlers to match the tightened Python samples and docs. (`0359608`)
- An unset or empty webhook secret is now webhook_invalid_secret in every verifier, checked before the headers including Notify, instead of raising a TypeError or AttributeError that answered 500. webhookHandler no longer throws at creation for a missing secret, how-to knownServerHint flags an error whose problem type or docs name another service's API page, Connect operator-configuration 503s get a hint, and SERVICE_URL_ENV is module-private again. (`b8d8620`)
- messageWithHint now dedupes only a trailing hint, ignoring a final period, and copyRyuError/withRyuErrorFields unhint an override message equal to the error's hinted message. Tool result projection and transport fetch shim were adjusted to keep one hint per message. (`0a7fd33`)
- SitesSettingsPatch is built from the named settings so typos and wrong types are type errors again, and refineSitesError marks the 503 unavailable state retryable:false so the settings PUT is sent once. updateSettings refuses clearing settings other than workspaceId/spaceId, and sites_update_settings drops editors and is idempotentHint:false. (`0777412`)
- Trimmed and pattern-validated the Sites create name, attached the Mail SMTP configuration hint when parsing errors, and limited the Sites slug fallback and wrong-id hint to the Site lookup so UUIDs and over-long values are skipped. (`2b64958`)
- Added passport connections.importState mirroring the Python binding, alongside updated mail, notify and box tool descriptions. Tests cover the new call, including the edge framework test. (`2c08b4e`)
- Exported MailWebSocketLike from the services package entry point. (`a856ecb`)
- Updated the services errors module alongside the client path-id changes. (`df4632b`)
- Added notify tests covering RFC 2047 encoded-word decoding across UTF-8, ISO-8859-1 and US-ASCII, rejection of control characters, and the shared notifyHeaderText parity vectors for header round-tripping. (`e0b0307`)
- The services facade refuses a standalone mailRealtime connection with realtime_websocket_unavailable and re-exports MailRealtimeTicket and MailWebSocketConstructor, with namespace tests covering the new behavior. (`5445a72`)
- The fetch shim refuses empty, "." and ".." path segments, including percent-encoded spellings, as RyuInvalidRequestError invalid_id before any request is sent, covering the wrapped Box, Messaging, Notify and Managed Agents clients; stream and follow check the session id before the reconnect loop. ConnectNamespace declares a SAFE_VIEW so object-mode usage.iterate type-checks, and the ConfigResolution type is exported. (`445a3be`)
- Updated the mail namespace and the tools registry, including the box and managed-agents tools, with tests added for the mail namespace and the agent-tools framework. (`0a9e1de`)
- Caller idempotency keys from .with({ idempotencyKey }) or an Idempotency-Key header are now always sent on capability-gated routes, while only the SDK-generated key and keyed-replay decision depend on the advertised capability. (`618ee72`)
- Added idempotency tests for the services transport. (`2715d44`)
- Updated the package README to cover the shared tools helpers. (`dc0a58b`)
- The tool facades bind every namespace to the host signal, so cancelling stops box_exec, gateway_chat and other waits, and box_read_file takes maxChars (default 20,000) returning path, content, truncated and totalChars. box_create, managed_agents_create_session/send_message, notify_publish and notify_request_approval accept an optional idempotencyKey, needsApproval defaults to !readOnly || openWorld, and the tools entry reaches the package only through core.ts so CJS consumers share CALL_META and the RyuError classes with the root entry. (`1dc512f`)
- approveTool, denyTool and respondToApproval share one answer path whose derived Idempotency-Key covers the message and retries once with a fresh key on a 409 unknown_tool_use. The follow/run approval ledger now matches server abandon semantics, stops at an unanswered requires_action idle in terminal mode, and surfaces handler errors as tool_approval_handler_failed with the cause. (`a7ffacc`)
- Ryu#isConfigured treats hosted Mail as configured with only a ryu_ key, {error, code} bodies keep extra members in RyuError.details, and verifyWebhook()/webhookHandler() pass requireTimestamp through. (`25e016b`)
- Mail key resolution now prefers a key passed as an option over every env credential, with the ryu_ key never sent to a non-control-plane URL, and connectRealtime throws realtime_unavailable rather than putting a ryu_ key in a WebSocket URL. Notify webhook verification now fails deliveries carrying only some webhook-* headers instead of falling back to the body-only signature, and the Box routes, fetch shim and conformance fixtures were re-recorded. (`df701be`)
- Added provider_refused to the non-retryable codes so a same-key retry of a refused Messaging send or number purchase replays the first answer instead of running a new send. optOuts.iterate now follows a non-null nextToken past empty pages with its own repeated-token guard, and the messaging webhook handler was added to the webhook exports. (`f3ae566`)
- The package manifest now points its repository field at `amajorai/ryu-sdk` with the package directory rather than relying on the hub's URL rewrite. (`5773fcd`)
- The SDK landed namespaced clients for box, connect, gateway, mail, managed-agents, notify, passport and sites sharing transport handling for idempotency, rate limits, deprecation headers and retries. Webhook handlers, error and pagination helpers, and conformance fixtures with recorded responses came in with the merge. (`fac7b6d`)
- Updated the SDK idempotency replay test to supply an authenticate resolver, so replays are scoped to the authenticated caller the way the server's idempotency middleware now requires. (`7f77e5b`)
- Added the standalone services SDK with namespaces for box, connect, gateway, mail, managed agents, notify, passport and sites, transport handling for retries, rate limits, idempotency and deprecation, webhook verification helpers, pagination and typed results, backed by conformance tests and fixtures. (`dcd0782`)
- Auth errors now name the credential variables a call sends, with 401 listing all of them and 403 naming the key variable; connection errors and timeouts name the configured origin and its URL variable rather than the failing request's origin. (`1bdacad`)
- Added namespace tables for mail, notify and box exported from the root entry and checked against the client classes, kept the flat client names as deprecated aliases that send the same requests, and updated service tests and README. (`a640429`)
- Notify webhooks now take deliveryId and eventId from the signed body and reject disagreeing id headers, validate toleranceSeconds in the 0..86400 range, and verify raw bytes under a maxBodyBytes cap that returns 413. (`2cac23c`)
- Framework tests for edge, Hono and Next route handlers were updated to cover process.env being read only when the runtime supplies one and an env object replacing it entirely. (`6849a31`)
- Integrated the service slices: namespace definitions gained decorateError, refineErrorCode and syncMethods, the fetch shim refines error codes before retrying and keeps the last failure, and retry.ts no longer retries configuration-class codes. (`dcc1e20`)
- Connect's tools.exec now decodes the 200 ok:false exec reply from compatibility mode with an optional result, and Gateway retry handling and docs were aligned accordingly. Conformance cases were added for native exec, describe, compatibility-mode exec and composio.execute. (`484d48c`)
- box.run now collects its command from the streamed route so commands longer than timeoutMs complete and aborts stop the server-side command, and its default name is derived from the idempotency key so resumed runs replay. The ready timeout uses its own box_ready_timeout code, and array command executables are quoted for shell-like splitting. (`157363a`)
- Notify's requestApproval rejects timeoutMs or pollIntervalMs over 2^31-1 ms with invalid_timeout and gained a waitMs option that stops waiting while leaving the request open. Options.signal is linked into the publish and polls, and linked-signal listeners are now disposed instead of leaking. (`95e2b1f`)
- Mail client errors now carry a mailErrorCode and retryable flag across the transport, including the self-hosted replay-record 500 reported as outcome_unknown, and resolveInboxId rejects path-unsafe ids via MAIL_ID_PATTERN. Conformance tests check server statuses and per-code retryability for 409/500/502 cases. (`930b4cd`)
- sessions.follow now reads the log head first so an idle from an earlier turn or a provisioned idle no longer ends the follow, and a new headSeq option was added. sessions.run links its signal into the create and get requests, stream signal links are disposed when the stream ends, and conformance tests cover the behavior. (`4993e6f`)
- Hardened webhook verification: Mail resolves newer event types as UnknownMailWebhookEvent with an isKnownMailWebhookEvent guard, signed non-JSON or non-envelope bodies return 422 webhook_payload_invalid, and onError receives onEvent failures. Also fixed Standard Webhooks legacy signature handling, stripped comma separators from repeated Headers values, and documented the Notify destination body. (`d33fadd`)
- Added Ryu#isConfigured so callers can decide which services are configured from the instance. (`3323a19`)
- Added a services SDK with a hardened fetch shim: facade iterables reject with RyuAbortError when the call signal fires, caller signals are linked with AbortSignal.any, and retry waits listen to every caller signal. Also scoped meta.replayed through a per-service body field, limited retryAfterSeconds to server-requested delays, deduped onDeprecation per route template with a 256-entry cap, stripped query strings and service keys from network errors, renamed the error envelope to messaging, and treated empty or whitespace keys and URLs as unset. (`3aabc95`)

### `@ryuhq/services-cli`@0.5.0

[Published package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@ryuhq/services-cli/v/0.5.0)

#### Minor changes

- Extended the Box tests in the services CLI to cover the get and resume tools. (`ab6f43f`)

#### Patch changes

- Reorganized the services CLI into a program plus per-service commands for box, connect, gateway, mail, managed agents, messaging, notify, passport, sites and webhooks, with a shared MCP server, tool registry and output/list formatting layer. Added tests for doctor, dry-run, hints, MCP output schemas and exports lockstep. (`0af1456`)
- The services CLI package.json was bumped as part of the repo-wide direct dependency updates. (`3d5d932`)
- Added a `--allow-body-only-signature` flag to the CLI webhooks command and documented the new default in the README. (`fae813b`)
- Extended the CLI with commands, MCP tool registrations and output handling across box, connect, doctor, gateway, mail, managed-agents, messaging, notify, passport, sites and webhooks. Added list-output, hints and dry-run modules with broad test coverage. (`cbf38ec`)
- Doctor and the MCP server now use hintProgram, so a workspace build names its `bun <bin.ts>` launch line instead of an uninstalled ryu-services; CLI and doctor tests were updated to match. (`98f87a1`)
- The notify request-approval command added a hint on a 409 idempotency_conflict pointing at notify events get and events list, and the command summary stated the same. CLI tests covered the hint. (`4e8dfc2`)
- The `ryu-services mcp --help` output now names the credential-free status tools, with CLI test coverage. (`b577e2c`)
- Added complete and note fields to dry-run --json output so a stdout-only reader sees that the send was omitted, and aligned CLI and MCP command behaviour with the updated docs. (`2caaceb`)
- The doctor command's credential-free line now reads "(unless --services leaves &lt;service> out)". A test compares doctor's credentialFreeTools against createServicesMcpServer's registration.credentialFree across a table of environment combinations. (`535aebe`)
- The mail command test suite was updated to match the tightened mail_create_inbox clientId validation. (`4257338`)
- Doctor hints and managed-agents approval notes now take the running program name, so under a host they print ryu-cli services commands rather than ryu-services ones. The root help --version line was reworded, MCP toolFailure adds env-block advice to configuration errors that had no hint, and the notify and MCP test suites were extended. (`27223c2`)
- The npm-status note is now built by npmStatusNote({ publishedVersion, bundledWith }), with CliIo.bundledWith and DoctorOptions.npmNote/npmPublishedVersion added so hosts and tests can cover the published branch. The runtime note no longer appends the @ryuhq/client "latest is 0.3.0" freshness clause. (`ae5d374`)
- Doctor, mail, mcp and messaging tests were extended. (`4e24ae7`)
- The MCP output schema check and tool registration were updated so nullable mail attachment size and status inboxCount values validate instead of failing as output validation errors. (`12e6e2e`)
- The mail command's next-page note now uses the exported mailPageSize constant instead of a local copy, with the mail tests updated. (`3c3e617`)
- runCli's CliIo takes a program argument whose first word becomes the example's command and whose remaining words lead the args; mcpClientExample() is exported and the default stays ryu-services. (`39f8112`)
- Configuration error messages and hints now name CLI flags such as --api-key, --base-url and --timeout, the Connect-only MCP text no longer claims no env var is missing, and doctor --help lists the Messaging settings probe. (`db1c236`)
- Fixed ryu-cli so value flags before `services` are forwarded instead of being treated as commands, including --base-url, --api-key, and --timeout, and corrected --version handling. Gateway models and managed-agents pending-approvals now use listPage output, while doctor problem building and MCP unregistered-tool reasons were split into separately tested functions. (`ee43cd2`)
- `ryu-services mail inboxes create` now resolves the Mail mode, requires --address only on self-hosted Mail, and accepts --local-part for hosted Mail while not sending --address to hosted Mail. The flags-before-services refusal now names `ryu-cli services`. (`20f8adc`)
- box stop now pairs the re-read Box with the stop call's meta, so --json reports the stop's request id, and a failed or slow re-read returns data:null with that meta inside a 5 s deadline that includes retries; a failed stop is not re-read. The help output lists -V/--version under a "With no command only" heading, and MCP initialize instructions carry Connect's /mcp hint by env-var name while the resolved URL stays on stderr. (`2e7cdff`)
- notify events list now prints the events and reports the cursor on stderr, with the notify command tests updated. (`434e29c`)
- Mail and MCP tests were updated. (`0a7fd33`)
- The Sites and Managed Agents commands refuse an empty --workspace id and use --no-workspace instead of the `none` sentinel, with help text updated. Sites update-settings no longer accepts editors. (`0777412`)
- Addressed review findings in the box and doctor commands and the managed-agents MCP tools, with matching test and README updates. (`1cc077c`)
- The MCP mode line no longer suggests --allow-writes when no tools are registered, and serveServicesMcp now prints the "no service is configured ... run doctor" line before it so an empty tool list points at configuration. The mcp, passport and agent-tools docs were updated to note that read-only mode still serves passport_fetch, and that --read-only and --allow-writes cannot be combined. (`7b75cc3`)
- Updated the messaging test suite to cover the SDK forwarding caller idempotency keys on capability-gated routes. (`618ee72`)
- Moved the gateway, managed-agents and notify commands onto the shared gatewayChatBody, NOTIFY_TOOL_LEVELS, defaultNotifyUsageWindow and listPendingApprovals helpers from @ryuhq/services/tools. (`dc0a58b`)
- MCP tool handlers now parse arguments with the registry schema, so bad arguments return the same invalid_arguments contract as the adapters instead of the SDK's text error. The registry reports unknown services, rejects connect with a pointer to mcpConfig(), rejects object-mode clients, and listPendingApprovals is built on pendingToolApprovals with read-only filtering through the shared ryuToolPassesFilter. (`1dc512f`)
- Managed Agents send, approve and deny accept a --follow flag, approval notes appear on every follow and on stream, waiting requests that opened before the follow are looked up, and a read-only sessions pending-approvals command was added. The MCP list_events wait result reports requiresAction, pendingToolUseIds and next. (`a7ffacc`)
- Hosted Mail now counts as configured with only a ryu_ key, so the MCP registry exposes the Mail tools the SDK already serves. (`25e016b`)
- Updated the box, dry-run and notify command tests to cover option-first Mail key precedence, the scope-limited doctor result, and the stricter webhook header verification. (`df701be`)
- Capped the messaging send MCP tool's metadata at 16 entries during input validation and adjusted the messaging, webhooks and doctor commands, MCP registry and CLI tests for the new retry and credential handling. (`f3ae566`)
- The package manifest now points its repository field at `amajorai/ryu-sdk` with the package directory, because these tarballs publish from the monorepo. (`5773fcd`)
- The CLI landed its command set and MCP tooling across box, connect, gateway, mail, managed-agents, notify, passport, sites and webhooks, with matching tests, argument handling, output helpers and registry entries. (`fac7b6d`)
- Introduced the services CLI with commands for box, connect, gateway, mail, managed agents, notify, passport, sites and webhooks, plus doctor, dry-run and curl helpers and an MCP server exposing the services as tools. (`dcd0782`)
- Moved the mail CLI command and the mail and box MCP tools onto the canonical namespaced call spelling, with tests updated. (`a640429`)
- Updated the README to describe all eight namespaces as implemented and to add install and environment quickstarts. (`4afbf96`)
- MCP tools now receive the request abort signal, so notify_request_approval cancels cleanly, and the tools use the exported SDK types. README doctor probes were refreshed. (`dcc1e20`)
- Adjusted the Gateway CLI command, MCP tool and tests for the corrected retry rules and error rows. (`484d48c`)
- `ryu-services box exec` now exits 1 with command_failed on a non-zero exit, and --buffered plus the MCP box_exec tool raise the request timeout to cover the command. (`157363a`)
- MCP notify_request_approval now waits at most waitMs (default 45 s, max 50 s) under the common 60 s MCP request timeout and returns pending with the event instead of republishing, with matching CLI and test updates. (`95e2b1f`)
- Hardened the mail_send MCP tool so idempotencyKey is required and restricted to printable ASCII of 1-255 characters, with exactly one of text or html accepted and id inputs limited to [A-Za-z0-9_-]. Mail command and doctor tests were extended to cover the send-key behavior. (`930b4cd`)
- The managed_agents_list_events MCP tool with wait:true now aborts its SSE stream when the wait stops on timeout or maxEvents instead of leaking the connection. The CLI rejects --until unless --follow is also set. (`4993e6f`)
- Made doctor and webhooks verify reject unsupported flags with exit 2, reported a default-only Gateway as default (not set), labeled probes authenticated or reachable, and pre-bound ctx.ryu idempotency key and timeout. Split the bin entry, changed MCP registration to use Ryu#isConfigured, and added webhooks verify secret and scheme options. (`3323a19`)
- Removed build and check-types scripts until sources land, and made the test script pass with no test files present. (`3aabc95`)

### `API server (api.ryuhq.com)`@0.5.0

#### Minor changes

- Adopted effect 4.0.5, moved about 20 boot workers including hosted drafts onto scheduledWorker with an awaitable stop and shutdown latch, and added a background stop drain that runs first in the single shutdown handler. Startup seeds and the credentials-at-rest migration were reworked with Effect retries, and tests were added for the background stop drain, start-background-work and graceful shutdown.
- Extended the API server's environment example file with the variables used by the new abuse ingest route and the gateway credential changes. (`3de04de`)
- The server now releases shared Mail realtime leases and stops the Bun server on SIGTERM or SIGINT, with tests covering the shutdown path and serve options. (`ae575df`)
- Updated the API server environment example for the new public-agent and guest-chat Gateway configuration variables. (`752b20e`)
- Hosted MCP service handling now enforces per-grant and per-organization tool-call rate limits, applies the org session max age, aborts a Mail dispatch after 30 seconds, and wraps plain-text Mail errors as {error, code}. An end-to-end test exercises reads and sends through the real mailRouter at the /api/mail mount. (`b1558ab`)
- Updated server/.env.example for the admin abuse enforcement API. (`122e64f`)
- Updated the example environment file for the platform-admin allowlist configuration used by the hardened admin gate. (`0ce8b2a`)

- The server environment example now documents the new billing configuration, including the standalone pay-as-you-go flag. (`9e9d2e6`)

### `bot-native`@0.5.0

#### Patch changes

- Updated the bot-native contract document to reflect the refactored interfaces. (`5c03086`)
- Updated the contract document after the sidebar split. (`adbd19b`)
- Added native client applications under a shared contract: an Android app (phone, TV, Wear and automotive surfaces, with auth, chat, speech and voice-call modules), and Apple targets (iOS, tvOS, watchOS, CarPlay) backed by a shared RyuBotKit Swift package for auth, chat streaming, projects, speech and voice sessions. Brand assets, build configuration and test suites for the shared core were added with them. (`0af1456`)

- Apple clients picked up review fixes: a single voice-ticket refresh on 401 before falling back to push-to-talk, mic shutdown before hang-up, Sign out on the Watch and TV gates, sticky watch sign-out with token comparison when adopting a phone session, Try again and a parked-permission message in CarPlay, and an Open Settings offer after dictation permission denial. (`264f9bd`)
- Android clients now attach media only to the newest message, refresh once on a voice-ticket 401, keep the stored session across transient Keystore and DataStore errors, retry session checks, preserve a user-muted mic after audio focus returns, and drop stale voice connects. Sign out was added to the Wear and TV gate screens, a Settings offer follows mic denial, the Gradle distribution checksum is pinned, and the Wear minSdk in the README is corrected. (`3e05ebf`)
- Added the bot-native client apps: an Android app with phone, Android Auto, TV and Wear OS modules on a shared Kotlin core, and an Apple app with iOS, CarPlay, tvOS and watchOS targets built on the RyuBotKit Swift package. Device auth, chat streaming, voice, speech and markdown rendering code ship alongside unit tests and per-surface READMEs. (`deb3a68`)
- Work in progress caps member voice calls, rejects audio-file names passed as voice names, and addresses an edit retry race in the Android and Apple voice session code. (`7667232`)
- Work in progress hardens member voice admission on Android and Apple, updating the CONTRACT note, VoiceSession implementations and their tests. (`4831c56`)
- Added realtime voice mode over the Core voice WebSocket with barge-in, captions, mute and an orb, plus a tap-to-talk fallback of on-device dictation, a chat turn and read-aloud when the voice ticket is refused. Also added composer dictation, read-aloud, voice-first CarPlay and Android Auto flows, and chat basics including copy, share, edit and resend, regenerate with a version switcher, retry, fork and attachments. (`c7e0bd9`)
- Snapshot of in-progress native Ryu Bot work covering voice mode, voice input, read-aloud and chat basics across the Android phone, TV and Wear modules and the Apple RyuBotKit package, with accompanying tests. Builds and review are not re-verified at this commit. (`3b9b75f`)
- Added a standalone native Ryu Bot tree: a SwiftUI app with a RyuBotKit package and iPhone/iPad, Watch, TV and CarPlay targets, plus a Kotlin/Compose Android build with core, phone/tablet/Auto, Wear OS and TV modules. Both cover sign-in, a managed-workspace gate, chats and projects. (`8793af5`)

### `box`@0.5.0

#### Minor changes

- The filesystem driver now kills whole process groups on interrupt, cancel and timeout, with a test covering it, and the README documents the opt-in end-to-end run. (`648392d`)
- The Box service added managed prompts with cwd, env and timeout, get and cancel routes, terminal states for canceled, destroyed, restarted and timed-out boxes, and redaction of environment values in stored summaries. Contracts, response contracts and the store were updated to match. (`93c2c49`)
- Extended local Box mode with streaming and background commands, process logs, stdin, kill and interrupt, up to 16 concurrent commands, file operations, tar upload and download, preview URLs with WebSocket and HMR proxying, WebSocket terminals, raw TCP tunnels, and SSH via an unprivileged sshd and box-tunnel ProxyCommand. Added named snapshots, restore, network-preserving fork, create-time setup commands and repository clone, encrypted tenant secrets, allowlist egress through a filtering proxy, managed agent prompts, per-second usage that pauses while stopped, and a gVisor/Kata runtime option. (`0a90987`)

#### Patch changes

- Ported main's hosted VM fleet work into the box app, covering the fleet and placement modules, pool and reconciler, the environment contract, settings, and the accompanying docs. (`1438289`)
- Reworked the box VM layer, including the fleet environment, placement, pool and reconciler, and updated the environment contract and settings, with matching tests and documentation. (`974ca98`)

- origin/main was merged into the branch, carrying changes to the app's index entry point. (`7379155`)
- Expanded the box service with agent-side state save and restore (golden index, overlay, CDC, exclusions, tar and sealing), agent-link enrollment, hub, mux and protocol handling, and a VM layer covering pool, placement, provisioning, reconciliation, ledger and alerts across DigitalOcean, Hetzner and Vultr providers with fakes for each. Also added billing rates and status, tenant handling, desktop and driver modules (docker, filesystem, VM), and process, secrets and upstream plumbing. (`0af1456`)
- Updated the Box filesystem driver, error types, HTTP conventions, service and store layers, plus upstream and workspace handling. Tests were added or adjusted alongside each of these modules. (`cbf38ec`)
- Changed service and tenant handling in the box app, with the service tests updated to match. (`21f287f`)
- The box service's create replay lookup began using clientKey and fell back to the legacy clientId-only row only when the key was absent, with updated HTTP convention tests. (`5c091ee`)

- Moved the box Dockerfile, package manifest and Docker driver/service to Bun 1.4.4, and the Docker integration test was updated alongside the change. (`f07101a`)
- Fork replay now looks up the Idempotency-Key before loading the source Box, returning 200 box.existing or 409 idempotency_key_resource_deleted even after the source is deleted. Fork keys now hash the request body with the fork route and sourceId, and http-conventions tests were added. (`dedca3e`)
- Linked Claude account sign-in under state/plan-accounts was excluded from backups and exports, and the Docker commit check was narrowed to skip only the bare CLI login mount points. (`d5066b4`)
- Moved the Box path-id check into assertSafePathIds(), anchored on the first non-empty v1 segment, so //v1/boxes//stop is refused and a single trailing slash works again. The check is skipped in hosted-proxy mode, which forwards the path unchanged. (`df4632b`)
- Updated the box desktop and workspace code, the Docker and VM drivers with their tests, and the package README as part of the review fix pass. (`1cc077c`)
- Snapshot of in-progress remediation in the box service and its tests. Not verified. (`f5cb5be`)
- Conflict resolutions from merging the security-audit checkpoint into main landed in the box service and its tests. (`3a960fa`)
- The workspace test was updated for the new `npx -y -p @ryuhq/client@^0.4.0 box-tunnel <id> <port>` form handed out by the Box `/ssh` endpoint. (`5773fcd`)
- Connected-provider mode now forwards Idempotent-Replayed and Vary, and the filesystem driver reports a command that cannot start as exit 126/127 with a stderr line instead of an HTTP 404/400. Filesystem errnos map to typed 404/400/403 errors matching the Docker driver, and quota guidance gained a separate hint for service-wide quotas. (`949d807`)
- Made the Docker driver serialize commits per container, always restore the original login file, and skip the start for stopped Boxes with no login in the layer, with driver tests covering the changes. (`5268418`)
- Added provider login files to the Docker snapshot exclusion list for box sessions, with a driver test covering the exclusions. (`bec7fec`)
- Installed the Brotli fetch guard from @ryu/portable-packages alongside the existing signed-tenant and claim-token code, with the guard and its test type-checking under exactOptionalPropertyTypes. Bumped the MCP server dependency to @modelcontextprotocol/server 2.3.1, kept core-client as a dev dependency, and updated the Dockerfile, service, docker driver and integration test. (`69f6758`)
- Added Brotli request mitigations to the box service and Docker driver, pinned the Dockerfile runtime image and refreshed package dependencies. The README and Docker integration test were updated alongside the driver changes. (`dbca3d8`)
- The Box service gained session-scoped handling, agent-link enroll, hub, mux and remote modules, state save and restore with a golden index and CDC, billing rates and status, plan sign-in and a minimum waiver token. VM drivers were added for Docker plus DigitalOcean, Hetzner, Vultr and overflow providers, with pool, placement, ledger, fleet, alerts and reconciler components. (`1a4ce6b`)
- The box app gained docker and filesystem drivers, egress proxy and source modules, environment and response contracts, previews, workspace handling, and a Dockerfile, with matching test coverage. (`ddf18f0`)
- Merged main's content into the Box package's files and re-applied the product rename that drops the Ryu prefix from Agent, Bot and OS and calls the web dashboard Console. The service, Docker and filesystem drivers, egress proxy, previews, workspace handling and billing-status code were carried over on the merged tree. (`a01db11`)
- Merged origin/main into the box app, combining changes across the Docker and filesystem drivers, the egress proxy and source, the environment and response contracts, previews, service and store. Billing status, workspace handling, upstream config, the Dockerfile and tsconfig were updated to match. (`cdb7957`)
- Merged the subscription-cloud-sessions branch into the box app, bringing changes to state exclusions, the Docker driver and plan sign-in. (`cd60fdb`)
- Extended Box agent state exclusions so CLI logins under ~/.claude, ~/.claude.json and ~/.codex are never saved, deduplicated, snapshotted or restored, while a repository's own .claude/ folder is still saved. Mounted ~/.claude and ~/.codex as tmpfs in the Docker driver and masked Anthropic keys and OAuth tokens, OpenAI keys, bearer headers, JWTs and *_token fields in run summaries. (`ff477b4`)
- Box gained per-session desktop support: per-size billing rates with a five-minute minimum per paid server hour and a signed minimum waiver token, overflow stock handling for out-of-stock hosts, and updated fleet placement, Hetzner provider, VM driver, store, and response contracts. (`418a3a7`)
- The Box service was reworked across the agent runtime and its state layer (save, restore, seal, overlay, tar, CDC, exclusions, golden index), agent-link enrollment, hub, mux, protocol and remote transport, billing rates and status, the Docker and VM drivers, and the VM fleet, placement, pool, provision, reconciler, ledger, fill and alerts modules with new provider adapters for DigitalOcean, Hetzner, Vultr and overflow. Supporting contracts, secrets, tenants, processes, desktop, store and workspace code were updated alongside their tests. (`b4f7dfd`)
- The Box service now decides per start whether the five-minute minimum applies, waiving it for a resume that reattaches to the Box's own parked VM inside the provider hour its last charged start already paid for. The charged lease and hour end are stored per Box, usage intervals record minimum_waived and paid_hour_ends_at with an ALTER TABLE for existing databases, /v1/usage billableSeconds honours the flag, and PublicBox.billing and the box.resumed event carry it. (`bd81831`)
- Removed the overflow host while the cx53 is not orderable, so placement skips from Hetzner straight to Vultr/DigitalOcean, and added an overflow_host_orderable alert raised once when the type becomes orderable again. Hetzner server type stock reads, the overflow stock monitor, and the related fleet, placement, and provider tests were added. (`597dded`)
- The Box service now refuses create, resume, fork and snapshot once a tenant hits its maxStorageGib limit while always allowing a stop, and carries storage usage fields through its contracts. Overflow sizing, placement and provider types were updated so a cx53 holds 7 one-vCPU units across the hel1, nbg1 and fsn1 Hetzner locations. (`1e64376`)
- The Box service adopted per-size rates with a 300-second minimum per start, reporting billableSeconds and VM saved-state bytes in /v1/usage, and reading rates from the shared fixture. (`d387d82`)
- Placement now tries the warm pool before a fresh Hetzner create, with Hetzner locations defaulting to nbg1, fsn1 and hel1. The pool idle alert fires at a configurable monthly threshold whose cost splits across month boundaries, and reserved overflow capacity is driven by host count and server type settings. (`e82091c`)
- The state RPC handler now passes the agent's boxId to state.missing, so a save opens its own Box's session and closes it on commit instead of holding the tenant-wide anonymous session. A regression test in vm.test.ts covers the per-Box session. (`b138c0a`)
- The view-only RFB filter also strips Fence, ContinuousUpdates and the QEMU key, gii and xvp pseudo-encodings from SetEncodings, and stream_jti rows are retained until exp plus 60 seconds. (`bb9b619`)
- A lease whose VM has vanished at the provider now goes through onVmVanished, which closes the running interval, moves the Box to error and ends its usage interval. (`85ac492`)
- Golden-deduped chunks are recorded as g:&lt;sha256>:&lt;id>, uploaded once per tenant, and fetched during restore when the VM image lacks the chunk or its bytes no longer hash to it. Saves now spool sealed chunks up to 128 chunks or 128 MiB before presigning and uploading the batch with a retry on expired URLs, and GC is fenced against open saves through state_save_sessions with atomic re-claim at delete time. (`39de9ec`)
- The Box service contracts and health-feature reporting were updated so a desktop is advertised only when the Box runs a desktop image, with the corresponding health-features test. (`1603eff`)
- Closed several Box VM leaks: interrupted stopping or provisioning Boxes are recovered, stray live or pinned leases are released on start and park, and overflow-host containers are destroyed with their slot and swept when their Box has no slot. Async setup commands are now metered from provision with open running intervals credited to fleet usage, the agent hub is seeded with every running lease to report VMs that never reconnect, and save/restore walks the upper directory fd-relative with O_NOFOLLOW and rejects restore archives that are out of order, repeated, or under a non-directory. (`ed51c76`)
- The overflow-host state RPC handler was changed to accept forks and snapshot restores by checking the host against the tenants it hosts, while VM links reached state only while their lease was live or pinned. VM driver tests used the shared handler, and AgentHub dropped wait-only entries for VMs that never dialed in. (`47221ae`)
- The Box app gained a VM driver covering placement, lease-epoch identity reset, park/save retries, same-VM resume, restore onto a new VM, fork, named snapshots, and lost links, alongside a content-addressed StateService using presigned S3 operations. It also added AgentHub enrollment and lease binding, a LinkMux for bidirectional RPC and flow-controlled streams, and an ryu-box-agent path for dispatch, deterministic overlay tar, FastCDC chunking, per-tenant HMAC ids, sealed state, golden-index dedupe, and streaming restore. (`75b6fac`)
- Keepalive handling now renews the liveness lease even when Core's tick index arrives lower than the stored one, so Boxes are no longer parked after a Core restart or a new run on a resumed Box. Lease time is taken from the service clock so a late retry cannot move it backwards. (`ddea8a0`)
- The reconciler now raises save_pin_expired and calls onPinExpired before the delete result is known, leaving the row releasing for the next pass if the delete fails. Fill alerts repeat the raise on each sample while raised so the sink retries failed deliveries, and createFleet.report falls back to the last persisted overflow sample until the sampler has a reading. (`15e642e`)
- Added test coverage for the agent link routes the Box service carries for the VM hub. (`5add128`)
- Added the Box service API for per-session Boxes: 202 create, stop, and resume with a stopping state, metering from ready, and a capacity_unavailable answer as 503 with Retry-After. (`7fbce69`)
- Added a provider-pluggable VM fleet under box: Hetzner, Vultr, DigitalOcean and overflow-host adapters behind a single ComputeProvider seam with mocked-HTTP fakes, a write-ahead VM ledger, tiered no-queue placement with quota skip and 503 capacity_unavailable, a bounded warm pool, a fleet-scoped orphan reconciler, HMAC-signed fleet alerts, overflow fill EWMA, a monthly fleet report and createFleet wiring from the environment. (`8d32d2b`)
- The agent-link protocol now adds driver.diagnose to the RPC table and exports DRIVER_STREAM_METHODS, DRIVER_SERVICE_MEMBERS, DriverRpcMethod and AgentDriverRpc so a new BoxDriver member fails to compile until classified. (`851dae9`)
- Froze the WP0 contracts for per-session Boxes: Box status `stopping` and its transition matrix, the desktop feature, v2 admission limits, desktop and label create fields, `DesktopAction` parsing, park reasons, tenant claims, keepalive and session-credential requests, new error codes with `Retry-After`, desktop access claims, VM provider and billing types, and the agent-link frame codec and RPC table. (`28e5be5`)
- Reworked the box service with filesystem and Docker drivers, an egress proxy with source handling, previews, billing status, environment and response contracts, workspace and store modules, plus tests, a Dockerfile and README. (`0932854`)

- The box contracts, response contract, service, store, workspace and filesystem driver were merged with both sides kept in the conflict resolutions, and their tests updated. (`f909fe8`)
- Filesystem driver TTY processes now run in their own process group and are killed as a group on interrupt, cancel and timeout. (`b573838`)
- Reworked the box service, Docker and filesystem drivers, egress proxy, previews and billing status while resolving the runtime chain merge, with matching contract and integration tests. (`2a72a08`)
- Consolidated on a single PROVISIONING_PROVIDER_ID in the driver and combined the earlier createBox cleanup and unforced fork-image removal with placeholder-aware destroy in the service and Docker driver, updating the driver tests accordingly. (`71765ad`)
- Consolidated box provisioning onto a single PROVISIONING_PROVIDER_ID in the driver, keeping the createBox cleanup, storage quota and unforced fork-image removal alongside placeholder-aware destroy. Both test suites were retained, with the fork-failure test expecting the unforced image removal. (`8009a0a`)
- Box gained billing-status gating, egress proxy and source handling, an environment contract, previews, a response contract, Docker and filesystem driver changes, and store, service, upstream and workspace updates. (`cd8464b`)
- Merged the box driver interface, the Docker driver and its test, and the service module into the mega branch. (`4c7c6d4`)
- Changes were merged to the box driver interface and service, with the Docker driver and its tests updated together. (`d8a51d1`)
- Expanded the box service with environment and response contracts, Docker and filesystem drivers, an egress proxy with source handling, previews, workspace handling and billing-status checks. The Dockerfile and TypeScript config were updated alongside the new module and integration test files. (`9a8f19a`)
- Snapshot deletion now writes the tombstone and an image_delete_pending flag before removing the image, then clears the flag on completion, retrying pending removals at startup and on the tenant's next usage report. DockerDriver.deleteSnapshot became idempotent and reports non-missing failures, and an unknown size is measured before removal. (`45fde75`)
- Snapshot creation now calls assertBillable before status, storage, quota, name, and driver work, so a suspended tenant receives 402 insufficient_credits. Listing, reading, and deleting snapshots remain available for cleanup, and the suspended-tenant and cleanup tests were updated. (`a52e52c`)
- Snapshot size measurement now distinguishes nothing-to-measure (null) from a failed read (throw): failures leave size_bytes NULL and are retried by the background pass, usage reports and deletes, while usage reports that still cannot measure a snapshot answer 503 driver_unavailable instead of pricing it at 0 bytes. Deletes measure before removing the image, and settlement keeps the org cursor to retry the hour. (`39a8236`)
- Snapshot image sizes are measured on commit (docker image inspect for Docker, on-disk copy for the filesystem driver) and stored, with unmeasurable sizes recorded as 0 bytes and a warning. Deletes now tombstone the row with a partial unique index on live names, sizes for older snapshots are backfilled in the background, and GET /v1/usage returns a snapshots array of snapshotId, sizeBytes, and storageSeconds. (`35811b9`)
- Hardened the billing status feed in Box: startup and the feed constructor reject secrets shorter than 32 characters or outside printable ASCII without spaces, failures log only a fixed reason, 404s warn at most once per 10 minutes, the URL must be https or loopback http with service=box, and the staleness window and warning throttle use performance.now(). README and contract tests updated. (`e1277b2`)
- Made destroying a Box that still holds the provisioning placeholder remove its container by name strictly, so a daemon error keeps the row for retry, and made a failed fork remove the image it committed. (`5d8de07`)
- Box gained an optional billing status poller that hashes tenant bearers once and matches them against the control plane's suspended digests, returning 402 insufficient_credits on create, fork, resume, commands, managed prompts, SSH, new previews, and terminal and tunnel opens while leaving stop, delete, reads, snapshot listing, /v1/usage, and /health working. The feed fails open for 15 minutes of failures, a 404 refuses nobody, and startup fails when only one of the two settings is present. (`2d38ecb`)
- Failed provisions now remove the container, egress sidecar and network they created, and destroy also removes those resources by their deterministic names instead of relying on the stored ref. (`495f8d3`)
- markError makes a best-effort driver stop for an errored Box under the Box's gate, keeping disk and image so resume works, while preserving the error status and original lastError and only logging a failed stop for retry on the next error. (`5db14b9`)
- markError now closes the Box's usage interval at the moment it errors, so an errored Box stops accruing compute charges while its storage seconds are still reported; resume reopens the interval. (`59b5432`)
- GET /v1/usage now reports size, storageAllowanceGib, and storageSeconds for every Box that existed in the window, including stopped Boxes and Boxes deleted inside it. Lifetimes are backed by a new deleted_at column, and windows longer than 31 days or running backwards are rejected with 400 invalid_request. (`4ec8332`)
- Overage is now tracked as an episode from the first pass that finds a Box over its disk allowance until one finds it back under, so only the first resume opens a cleanup window; later resumes neither reset nor extend it. Once the window passes, a still-over Box is stopped on the next pass and resume returns 429 quota_exceeded, with the deadline carried in lastError and box.resumed. (`57d1ac6`)
- The route stays ahead of bearer auth, and preview hosts continue serving their own root. (`5241a21`)
- A Box stopped by the disk watchdog for exceeding its storage allowance can now be resumed for cleanup: lastError keeps the overage reason, box.resumed records it, and the watchdog leaves the Box running for one interval before stopping it again if it is still over. Fork and snapshot stay refused while over, and a pass that finds the Box back under clears the notice. (`ffbf0d8`)
- While over, resume, fork and snapshot answer 429 quota_exceeded; the watchdog is off by default and fails open on a failed measurement. (`4863ba8`)
- Capped concurrent preview traffic per Box at 32 request slots and 16 WebSockets, with tenant-level limits of 96 and 32, queueing extra requests for up to 30 seconds before answering 429 quota_exceeded. (`3728131`)
- Readiness probes now settle within 5 seconds and kill a hung docker info after 20 seconds, a sidecar start reporting a missing network recreates the pruned egress uplink once, and preview responses drop the workload's Clear-Site-Data header. (`41f21e7`)
- The Box image now builds from a frozen lockfile with a build stage that bundles @ryu/box-service, and the runtime stage starts that bundle with bun --no-install. (`008821d`)
- Connected-provider mode now verifies all tenant bindings together before forwarding and refuses tenants sharing an upstream account, retrying transient /me failures and re-checking refusals after a minute. The SSH response now pins @ryuhq/client@^0.4.0 for box-tunnel. (`71d2748`)
- Stopped placing Boxes on Docker's shared default bridge, moving egress Boxes to per-Box internal networks behind the filtering proxy and proxy sidecars to an uplink bridge with inter-container traffic disabled; added an opt-in storage quota flag, and made the driver report distinct unreachable-daemon and rootful-daemon reasons through create, /health, and /ready. (`60d2bad`)
- The preview proxy now streams bodies through a single growable buffer with validated chunked encoding and pull-driven forwarding, caps WebSocket frames and reassembled fragments at 16 MiB, and re-roots workload cookies away from platform names and domains. When a preview domain is configured, preview URLs redirect to it and the preview cookie no longer routes requests; startup warns when tenants share a service without a preview domain. (`3bb14e2`)
- Box names are now unique only among live Boxes via a partial unique index with a table-rebuild migration, failed creates and forks that never received a driver resource are retired and release their Idempotency-Key, and the Docker driver cleans up containers, sidecars, networks and fork images on failure and destroy. In-flight snapshot commits count toward the 20-snapshot quota and name check, and a commit whose row cannot be written is deleted. (`81dc163`)
- Malformed request paths now return 400 invalid_request instead of a 500 with a logged stack trace, and a fork releases its reserved idempotency key when the source Box is not ready so retries can fork. Stop now checks the transition first and permits error to stopped, ending metering on an errored Box instead of returning 409. (`f28992c`)
- Merged the coverage sweep into the box app, updating the service, store, drivers, workspace and preview handling, secrets, upstream, and contract modules. Added service, workspace, wire, Docker driver, and Docker integration tests. (`465ed08`)
- Applied lint repair updates across the box service, Docker and process drivers, wire and contracts, workspace and preview modules, plus service and integration tests. Package metadata was updated with the source changes. (`5ebf41c`)
- Validated Box wire contracts and used native process APIs, updating drivers, service, store, secrets, previews, workspaces, and tests. (`fea5d74`)
- Added the native contract dependencies to the app's package manifest so lint migrations resolve against declared versions. (`2303fc6`)
- Merged origin/main into the box app, resolving conflicts across the agent, contract, driver, egress proxy, preview, process, secrets, service and workspace modules so both branches' changes were kept. README and integration/service/workspace tests were updated alongside the merged sources. (`205244f`)
- The box app was extended with driver, process, preview, secret, store and egress proxy modules, along with service, workspace and Docker integration tests. (`2bdea06`)
- Merged updates across the box service, its docker, filesystem, process and output drivers, the egress proxy, secret handling, previews and workspace store, along with their tests. (`7f74be4`)
- Reworked the Box package across sandbox drivers, egress proxy, previews, processes, secrets, store and workspace service, with new contracts and errors plus integration and workspace tests. (`7c45373`)
- Hardened box previews by stripping platform cookies and recognized Box-service bearer tokens on every hop and by capping streamed request bodies at 32 MiB. The egress proxy now rebuilds the Host header from the validated URL, background commands count against the concurrency limit, oversized file reads cancel instead of draining, and tenants are limited to 20 snapshots. Also gave unprivileged commands a writable HOME, made kills wait for the PID marker, and let box create accept a snapshot name. (`ed3795a`)
- Replaced the repository token fixture in the workspace test with a neutral placeholder so it no longer matches GitHub token detectors. (`7e863ff`)
- Changed the workspace test to build its credential repository URL fixture at runtime instead of using a literal user:token URL, after DeepSource Secrets flagged the literal. (`34b5b32`)

- box-desktopd gained a reworked desktop daemon surface spanning actions, browser control, CDP, the HTTP/1 layer, RFB, screen capture, sessions, snapshots, the server and main entry points, plus its Dockerfile, package manifest and tsconfig. (`b4f7dfd`)

### `cli`@0.5.0

#### Minor changes

- CLI command output, help and error text now pass through tr()/tf() with whole-sentence ICU messages, including the builtins for account, auth, catalog, doctor, lifecycle, package, plugin doctor, runtime and session. JSON envelopes stay English and table output aligns double-width text. (`a1c3ee3`)
- `ryu services` now rejects Ryu flags placed before `services` with exit code 2 and a hint rather than dropping them. Added tests for tokens before `services`, a literal `--`, `--json` after `services`, `services mcp --help`, stdin passthrough in `webhooks verify`, an MCP initialize round-trip, and import aliasing in the CLI tsconfig. (`5dbae2d`)
- `ryu eval` now accepts --dataset, --scorer, --threshold, --judge-model, --concurrency, and --json/--junit, and exits 1 when a threshold is missed. `ryu redteam` gained --max-attention and --junit. (`cc7a556`)
- Renamed the mode labels and messages in the product-mode overlay, sidebar, command palette and chat surface, and updated the interaction tests that asserted the old text. (`315c4a0`)
- Added container-isolated execution to `ryu secrets run` via `--isolation=container` and `--container`, with `--image` and `--mount` options implemented in new vault isolation and forwarder modules wired through dispatch and types, plus an isolation test suite. (`281e132`)
- Added `ryu secrets items put --type card`, reading the number and CVC from stdin, and `ryu secrets cards approvals` for managing spend approvals, with CLI test coverage. (`7ceb888`)
- Added `ryu secrets pm` and CLI tests for managing password-manager accounts and references. (`0981352`)
- Added `ryu secrets run --broker` to mint a broker session, inject only the proxy environment, and revoke the session after the child exits, writing a 0600 CA bundle when Core's CA paths are not local. Also added broker, totp, items, token, wrap, and unwrap subcommands, and pointed the vault and bao clients at the /v1 API on login. (`5652175`)
- Errored chat turns now report a sanitized 80-character error message to the Herdr pane until the user types, submits or starts a new chat, and the focused tab's conversation title and streaming spinner are mirrored into the terminal title. Chat surfaces publish focus, streaming, title and model state through an external store, and Herdr metadata is sent on a latest-wins queue that stops asking after a rejection of the verb. (`35e6d27`)
- Finished assistant turns end with a muted receipt line of agent, model, duration, tokens and speed, and the workspace bar shows session usage and cost that resets on /new, /resume and /fork. Core's data-ryu-stats and data-acp-usage frames are handled through onUsage, buffered per turn and written once the turn settles. (`36b5c18`)
- Tool permission requests now replace the composer behind a warning bar, showing the tool-kind glyph, the question and a height-capped body with the command, cwd, path or edit diff plus numbered option pills. Digits 1-9 choose and submit, h/l and arrows move, enter confirms and esc rejects, the pending tool row reads "awaiting permission", and permissionToolDetail parses ACP toolCall metadata. (`28c351a`)
- Chat autocomplete now ranks slash commands by exact, name prefix, alias prefix, fuzzy and description matches, windows the list to ten rows with more-indicators, and floats the popup above the composer. Bare no-argument built-ins run on first Enter, Enter on an empty composer is a no-op, and @path completion covers one directory level for local nodes. (`c0a4f0a`)
- Added humanized load errors, a shared Core health poller with backoff, and a guided Core-unreachable ConnectionCard with start, switch-node, and retry actions. ErrorView now shows retry only when a surface supplies it, and ensureCoreRunning reports progress in the TUI. (`790c572`)
- Replaced the single-line chat input with a wrapping textarea that grows to max(6, h/3) rows, with Enter to send and Shift+Enter, Alt+Enter, or Ctrl+J for newlines. Added paste placeholders for 3+ lines or over 150 characters and routed app-driven composer changes through setComposerText. (`faa0d2b`)
- Replaced wrapping tabs with a single-row indexed chip strip that truncates titles, shows overflow markers around the active tab, supports click, middle-click, and close, and adds Alt+1..9 tab jumps. Store section tabs now use the same no-wrap padded row with selection fill and click-to-switch. (`7c0b8b4`)
- Replaced the empty chat command wall with a centred hero showing a wordmark, version, wrapped hint chips, and up to three recent conversations resumable with Alt+1..3 while the composer is empty. Moved recent-conversation fetching into core/conversations.ts and reused it in Spaces. (`f101aac`)
- Added a toggleable sidebar with persisted layout preference, auto-hide below 100 columns with a one-column rail, and F6 or Alt+0 focus mode for keyboard navigation. Unified mouse and keyboard rows through buildSidebarRows and fixed the sidebar meetings fixture. (`b420f2a`)
- Added PgUp/PgDn paging, Ctrl+Home/Ctrl+End jumps and Ctrl+Alt+U/D half-page moves to the chat transcript, routed through ScrollBoxRenderable.scrollBy/scrollTo so they drop and re-arm stickyScroll like the mouse wheel. A reserved one-row strip below the transcript shows the jump-to-latest prompt with a count of new replies while scrolled away, and the shortcuts were documented in the keymap overlay. (`9584423`)
- Replaced the bare streaming status with a fixed one-row indicator showing elapsed time, the running tool's activity and an esc interrupt hint, with the elapsed ticker kept inside StatusLine so the transcript does not re-render every second. The composer placeholder became the queue-a-follow-up text while a turn runs, and the duplicate agent/team/model chips were dropped. (`43ae1d9`)
- Made core/keymap.ts the single registry for shell, chat and slash-command bindings, with App.tsx dispatching shell keys by registry id and the status bar and palette shortcut column generated from it. Added a keymap overlay opened by F1, Ctrl+? or /help, and a separate overlayOpen flag so closing an overlay no longer clears a surface's own input claim. (`9cf3336`)
- Esc mid-turn now keeps the partial reply with a muted "Interrupted" footer and pauses queued prompts instead of dispatching the next one. Enter on an empty composer sends the next queued prompt, a typed prompt runs first and resumes the queue, and a second Esc clears the paused queue. (`6191244`)
- StatusBar now fits greedily to the terminal width, dropping hints whole by priority and middle-truncating the left node/mode text. A new StatusContext lets the focused pane or Settings overlay publish hints, a left override and a busy state, with Chat leading on a spinner, esc interrupt and elapsed seconds while streaming. (`13d7fb8`)
- Collapsed tool rows gained a single-line argument summary, gerund labels while running, and a persisted duration on settle, with startedAt/endedAt recorded on tool parts and preserved across re-emitted input. Status icons, spinner and caret honor the ASCII fallback. (`b5a9a2c`)
- Ctrl+C now copies a selection, else lets the focused chat surface interrupt or clear a draft, else arms a two-press quit within 2s. WaitlistGate only handles Ctrl+C and `r` while blocking, useCopyOnSelect keeps the highlight for copying, and the keymap and status bar document the behaviour. (`400f879`)
- Transcript text parts and the /btw overlays now render through a new ChatMarkdown component on OpenTUI's markdown renderable, keeping inline runs on one wrapped line and drawing tables, lists and code fences natively. In-flight assistant messages stream only their last part, and interaction tests were updated to poll a bounded real deadline. (`c9c9089`)
- Plugins and Apps uninstall, the plugin cascade, and Services start-all, stop-all and uninstall now open an inline ConfirmPrompt with Cancel focused, sending no request until confirmed. Tabs ignore their own keys while the prompt is open, and the cascade prompt names the blocking dependents. (`f5e4c2c`)
- Finishing a mouse drag over selectable text now writes the selection to the host clipboard via OSC 52 and flashes a two-second confirmation toast, warning instead when the terminal cannot accept OSC 52. Empty selections are ignored, the highlight stays in place, and notify() gained an optional per-call ttlMs. (`2dd2614`)
- Added src/ui/Modal.tsx, a shared floating modal with a dimmed click-to-close backdrop, a clamped centered panel, header, scrollbox body and fixed footer. OverlayHost, NodePicker, the command palette, chat pickers, /help, keymap, /sessions, /btw, theme, delete-confirm and plugin notes now render through it. (`840c66c`)
- Moved toasts out of the in-flow strip into an absolute top-right layer mounted last in the shell, so panes and the status bar no longer reflow on notify. Toasts cap at three visible entries with a "+N more" line, merge identical notifications with a count, dismiss on click, and expire on severity-specific lifetimes. (`09894ea`)
- Replaced the bold turn labels with styled turns: user prompts on a raised muted surface behind a primary left bar, indented unlabeled assistant replies, and spacing between turns. Prompts longer than six lines collapse behind an expand hint, with Ctrl+O added to the chat keymap to toggle all long prompts. (`28d3501`)
- Added a pure command palette ranker and updated the palette to show grouped rows, shortcut hints, hover/click selection, a footer with key hints and result count, and the new Split pane, Close tab, and Reopen closed tab entries. Palette actions gained optional group, aliases, and shortcut fields. (`a121c40`)
- Replaced the vendored ThinkingBlock with a ReasoningRow that shows a spinner and Thinking title while streaming, then a muted timed Thought summary, and made the row expandable on click. Reasoning parts now record startedAt and endedAt and close when later parts follow or the turn settles. (`75804d2`)
- Replaced the TUI's two-pane store with the shared @ryu/workbench reducer while keeping the useWorkspace API, adding Right and Bottom regions, directional focus keys, tab moves, palette layout commands, and layout persistence to workbench-layout.json. Also fixed the toast stack and status bar shrinking under tall content and added region, persistence, and status-bar fit tests. (`0751a0b`)
- The CLI calendar surface renders app_job and legacy monitor/quest rows as read-only system rows. (`41fbc59`)
- Added `ryu acp [--agent <id>] [--node <url>]`, which resolves the installed ryu-core binary, runs `ryu-core acp` with inherited stdio, forwards --agent, and maps --node to --core-url while writing nothing to stdout. (`50730e6`)
- The terminal client no longer claims the `ryu` bin and ships as `ryu-cli`, so it no longer collides with @ryuhq/sdk; `ryu package` points at ryu-cli. (`f4e43cd`)
- Added a `ryu secrets` command with API, dispatch and type wiring plus tests, giving the CLI access to the vault operations.
- Added Herdr lifecycle reporting and session restore support to the CLI, including input handling, target selection, chat surface integration, and tests. (`62940e2`)
- Added automatic update support to the CLI, including a self-update module, settings update controls, interaction tests, and a terminal render proof helper. (`3e1dedb`)
- Seven TUI settings panels now load read-only data from Core for features, memory, meetings, tasks, privacy, storage, and data counts instead of pointing at the desktop app. Settings loaders and tests were added. (`0115401`)
- Added a server-controlled waitlist scope to the CLI waitlist core, with tests. (`5267609`)
- Added a waitlist module, a WaitlistGate component and quest-event wiring, and mounted the gate from the CLI app entry so unapproved accounts are held at the waitlist screen. (`bf26954`)
