- The Store search, keymap filter, agent and legacy chat inputs now pass focusedTextColor so focused text follows the active theme instead of the theme they mounted under. (`c2f759b`)
- The multi-line composer now passes focusedTextColor so the draft recolours when the terminal theme loads late or changes via /theme, covered by a rendered-contrast test. (`e705129`)
- Markdown emphasis scopes in the transcript now carry the theme foreground, so bold and italic prose no longer render in OpenTUI's white on the light theme. (`ef38136`)
- The Store's section and search keys now ignore modified chords, so Alt+Left/Right pane switching no longer changes the section or drops the query. (`a993697`)
- The agent form editor now only reacts to the unmodified keys it documents, so shell Alt chords such as Alt+0, Ctrl+Alt+S and Alt+Left/Right no longer reset the allowlist, save the agent or flip toggle fields. (`f14e459`)
- Contributed declarative views now fire numbered actions only on a plain digit, leaving Alt+1..9 for the shell's tab jump. A test covering the view was added. (`04fd74f`)
- Confirm prompts in the Store, Apps and Services hosts gained a one-column right margin so their bordered box no longer runs into the pane's last column. (`058d61c`)
- The command palette now treats the option modifier like meta and ctrl, so Alt chords reported as option in kitty-protocol terminals no longer append characters to the filter query. (`59bc644`)
- The keymap now scopes the Ctrl+R shortcuts overlay entry to Console and OS modes, so Bot mode no longer advertises it as opening ACP settings. The keymap tests were updated. (`681d6d0`)
- Home's guided Core-unreachable card gained a one-column right gutter so its right border no longer sits on the last terminal column, matching Chat's copy of the card. (`8395b91`)
- The per-agent inference editor now sits behind the same shell keyboard-capture gate as the agent editor around it, so sidebar focus mode, the palette and shell overlays no longer move its fields, clear values or exit it on Esc. Its edit input follows that focus. (`7f58619`)
- The queued-prompt bar and the Ctrl+Q queue overlay now share the pane's keyboard-ownership gate, so Enter, Esc, arrows and d no longer act on the queue while sidebar focus mode, the palette or an unfocused split pane owns the keys. (`42401b3`)
- The Settings General card now scrolls inside the body, its startup-realm choices wrap, and the body is sized to the rows the Modal leaves, keeping the panel legible at 80x24, below 24 rows and in narrow panes. (`e685efe`)
- The /theme picker now uses the chat overlay's gated focused flag, so j/k, r, Enter and Esc no longer change or reset the theme from an unfocused split pane, the palette or sidebar focus mode. (`549561b`)
- Plugin-contributed declarative views now yield while the palette, node picker, sidebar focus mode or a shell overlay owns the keyboard, so Enter and j/k no longer fire the view's actions or move both lists. (`6257fb7`)
- Running tool-call rows now render their live elapsed time with the same duration formatter and `·` separator used by settled rows, the reasoning row and the turn receipt, replacing the raw millisecond counter. Tests for tool-row summaries and timers were updated. (`065ebd6`)
- StatusMessage now paints its label with the theme foreground colour instead of OpenTUI's default white, fixing the near-invisible busy row and Store load error text on the light theme. (`5ffc45a`)
- Half-page transcript scrolling via Ctrl+Alt+U/D now matches both the `alt` and `option` modifier spellings reported by Kitty-protocol terminals, and the composer no longer acts on those scroll keys. Transcript scroll tests were added. (`a56f477`)
- Shell-level bindings such as Ctrl+K and Ctrl+W now call preventDefault so a focused composer textarea no longer also runs its own delete-to-line-end or delete-word edits, while Alt+Left/Right remains shared for word motion. Shell interaction tests were extended. (`c3bfb9a`)
- Composed the TUI UX shell chain into the CLI: overflow-safe layout, floating toasts, copy-on-select, two-press Ctrl+C, StatusContext hints, a global keymap overlay inside the shared Modal, a hideable sidebar, a tab strip and a Core-unreachable state. Chat newline, scroll, Ctrl+O and recent-resume keys moved into one keymap registry, the palette gained keymap and sidebar actions, Ctrl+C stops a stream like Esc, inline error rows use humanizeError and recheck Core health, and muted-text contrast was fixed in the sidebar, home and tab strip. (`a2dabaf`)
- Merged the TUI UX palette chain: palette ranking and windowing modules, the shared Modal, OverlayHost and product-mode overlay updates, chat surface and NodePicker changes, plus the associated palette, modal-layout and bot-mode parity tests. (`c182a72`)
- Merged the TUI UX lists chain across banner, status-message and toast components, the list window hook, selectable rows, DeclarativeView, ConfirmPrompt, settings and gateway overlays, the palette, sidebar, and the agents, apps, chat, home, setup, spaces, store, tasks and workflows surfaces and tabs. Tests for short terminals, services performance, colour contrast, theme usage and per-surface interactions were updated. (`98755eb`)
- Merged the TUI UX chat chain, reworking the chat surface — tool-call rows, reasoning rows, markdown transcript presentation, transcript scrolling, permission prompt, autocomplete, keymap, terminal title and Herdr integration — together with their interaction tests and the interaction census. (`a416d7c`)
- Added an interaction test that streams the renderer's output to a recording stdout and asserts the window-title control sequence is written on each title change and at no other point. SIGINT/SIGTERM quit now hands the terminal its title back, and comments were corrected to note OpenTUI emits OSC 0 rather than OSC 2. (`236885a`)
- Releasing a Herdr pane now sends pane report-metadata with --clear-title and --clear-token model so the leftover shell stops showing the last chat. Only Herdr's usage-error exit code disables metadata; socket errors and timeouts no longer turn it off for the session. (`a4abe13`)
- The chat stream now maps Core's data-ryu-usage and data-ryu-usage-stats parts, treating the former as a cumulative meter and the latter as per-turn stats, and reads a local engine's nested contextWindow so its turns show a context percentage. Workspace bar chips stay on one row at 80x24 and the receipt truncates only agent and model names. (`c795ca9`)
- The permission prompt body now measures its laid-out height so long commands wrap correctly in a narrow pane, and bodies taller than the row budget page with PageUp/PageDown. Ctrl/Alt+digit no longer submits a choice, the single-option hint reads "1 select", and option pills can be clicked. (`db6e09a`)
- The floating completion list now measures the composer dock's screen offset and sizes its window to fit short terminals, dropping the header before list rows. The header collapses to a single "Complete · keys" line and descriptions align in one column. (`c941772`)
- Kept the Core connection card from shrinking at 80x16, clipped Home quick actions instead of overlapping them, and made Chat's banner compact by sharing one row for actions and the Home pointer. Added an 80x16 regression test and fixed a misleading test comment. (`2f7d7b2`)
- Fixed the multi-line composer in short terminals and wrapped drafts: the prompt glyph no longer shrinks, the composer shrinks to one text row, and the transcript scrollbox takes zero flex basis. Up/Down history now keys off visual rows, and Ctrl+J in the completion list only moves selection. (`65a3ec6`)
- Updated tab-strip layout so split panes lend spare columns to crowded panes, active chips truncate with an ellipsis, and overflow markers reveal hidden tabs. The Store section row now measures itself and windows around the active section. (`89a629c`)
- Fixed the chat empty-state hero so it stays centred and inside short terminal heights, budgets its transcript area against the shell and composer, and limits Alt+1..3 to visible recent rows. Updated the content column to shrink to its widest line and centre as a block, with interaction tests for 80x24, 120x36, and 12-row terminals. (`0a5a96d`)
- Fixed sidebar toggle keys to preventDefault so they no longer move the composer caret, suspended sidebar focus behind palettes and overlays, and moved the nav cluster into the sidebar scroll region so short terminals keep focus on visible rows. The collapsed rail is now a full-height tinted strip. (`48f7c88`)
- Submitting a prompt from a scrolled-back transcript now jumps to the latest output first, so the sent prompt and the reply are no longer left off screen behind the jump-to-latest strip. The Ctrl+Alt+U and Ctrl+Alt+D half-page shortcuts were folded into the keymap overlay's PgUp/PgDn row. (`25bd290`)
- Pinned the busy row, WorkspaceBar and composer box with flexShrink 0 so the transcript scrollbox shrinks instead, fixing an 80x24 layout where the composer collapsed onto its border row and overlapped the footer. The busy row now shows waiting-for-permission or waiting-for-answer states, the esc interrupt hint appears only when the composer owns Esc, and long unknown tool names are clamped to the one-row activity label. (`d6b531e`)
- Made input claims per owner so input stays claimed while any component holds a claim, fixing the split-pane case where the right pane's release let a typed question mark open the shortcuts overlay. The overlay filter field now grows to the row, its footer fits on one line with a shorter variant below roughly 80 columns, and the list keeps a 3-row minimum. (`2cca9d4`)
- Updated the keymap entry for Esc to say it interrupts and pauses the queue rather than stopping streaming, and added a test that a prompt typed while the queue is paused is sent first with the paused queue draining after it. (`95ef8e4`)
- Reads of non-2xx error bodies are now abort-aware and capped at 2s so a stalled body no longer hangs the turn, and HTML error pages contribute only their title. The edit-and-resend hint renders only under the latest assistant turn, and the ASCII hint dropped its remaining non-ASCII separator. (`6a5b2b8`)
- Turn failures now render as an inline error row with a muted edit-and-resend hint instead of being appended to the assistant text, shown as a toast, and replayed on the next request. Non-2xx responses include a bounded reason from the body capped at 200 characters, and empty assistant turns left by a failed turn are dropped from history. (`7eb4376`)
- The status bar no longer shows focused-pane hints or the busy clock while an overlay is open, showing only overlay contributions. A new optional `leftPriority` lets the node and mode text keep readable cells at 80x24, with added 80x24, overlay frame, and leftPriority tests. (`d83ab1a`)
- A cancelled tool call now settles as interrupted instead of a struck-through denial, and a tool-output-available frame carrying error or errorText fails the tool even without isError. (`5da2046`)
- Tool rows now settle instead of spinning: the stream handles tool-output-error, tool-output-denied and frame-level isError, and at turn end running parts resolve to interrupted on abort, error on stream error, or done on finish. Resumed transcripts show cut-off calls as interrupted, rejecting a permission strikes the matching row through, and ToolCall gained static interrupted and denied states. (`f2c11d2`)
- Settled tool durations now keep milliseconds only below 100ms, so a 300ms row reads `· 0.3s`. Only success and error rows show the persisted duration, a part that re-entered running shows the live timer, and a bare tool-input re-emission no longer wipes recorded args. Read summaries clamp the path to the budget left by the range so the whole summary stays within toolSummaryChars. (`849e61e`)
- notify() now returns the toast id so the shell dismisses the "Press Ctrl+C again to quit" prompt when a key disarms it, instead of leaving it on screen for up to 2s or re-rendering it as a deduplicated "×2" toast. Added coverage for Ctrl+C stopping an active chat stream without quitting. (`bd0c1d1`)
- Markdown tables in the native transcript now size to content with one column of cell padding and word wrap, fenced code maps tree-sitter capture names to theme tokens, and native SyntaxStyle instances are cached per theme palette and shared across text parts instead of being built and destroyed per part. (`51cf32d`)
- The Store's uninstall ConfirmPrompt claims its hosting surface through ConfirmClaimContext so Left/Right and `/` no longer switch sections or open search while it is open. In narrow panes the buttons no longer wrap, title and key hint truncate to one line, and the prompt replaces the tab's key-hint footer or status bar. (`f90ed99`)
- Sidebar rows now activate on release through useSelectionSafeActivate: a press records whether text was highlighted so that click only dismisses the highlight, and drag-select releases or presses dragged off the row do not navigate. Sidebar labels are no longer selectable and any keypress clears a lingering highlight. (`ad7c798`)
- Modal now caps its panel at an integer row count measured from the backdrop, keeping the footer off the bottom border in pane-local modals. Active-row scrolling is re-applied after the body's first layout, useModalActiveRow keeps overlay selections visible, and a backdrop click closes only when the press started on the backdrop. (`716af17`)
- Fixed short-terminal list layout so viewports no longer squeeze the Setup header and hint into one garbled line, and selected rows now draw status and tone colours in the selection foreground for legible contrast. Added an 80x24 Setup providers frame test and a selected-row contrast check. (`b2f9a46`)
- Fixed floating toasts to draw icons and message text with theme severity colours, word-wrap long messages to a terminal-aware width, and cap the stack above the status bar on short terminals. Added fake-timer, wrapping, short-height, and light-theme contrast tests. (`a4def2e`)
- Tightened the styled-turn frame assertion to match role labels as trailing words, added a check that the reply aligns with the prompt text, and covered click-to-expand on the collapse hint. Removed a redundant role check in the streaming flag. (`92036c3`)
- Replaced fixed 14-16 row list windows with useListWindow, which measures the clipped container and centres rows that fit on the selection, and added SelectableRow plus ListPosition for non-shrinking, truncated rows and an N/M footer. Removed the fixed height constants and added an 80x24 regression test. (`115f677`)
- The palette key-walk tests now render again after the key state commits before capturing frames, so a down-arrow walk no longer intermittently skipped a state. (`fce46a1`)
- The command palette now windows rows by terminal lines through a new pure paletteWindow helper instead of a fixed ten-row count, keeping the bottom border and footer visible in short terminals. The selected row uses selectionForeground for its caret and shortcut, and labels, footer and query render on a single truncating line. (`0f3c71e`)
- The theme picker interaction test now asserts on the picker's own key hint instead of waiting for its title to disappear, which never resolved once the reset toast stayed visible on the 140x36 shell. (`62d1a77`)
- Switched host-owned termcn wrappers, including the toast countdown, neutral banner, and pending status message, from the muted token to mutedForeground, and extended the color guard to those host components. Added rendered-frame contrast checks for Setup step labels and the profile Cancel button using a shared WCAG helper, and removed the dead muted field from the services ThemeLike. (`83b4621`)
- Pinned the toast host as a fixed strip so clipping the main row no longer compresses or overlaps toasts. Added a regression test with a clipped main row, wrapped toast, and status bar. (`dee83ba`)
- Split the reasoning header into a fixed lead, shrinking title, and fixed duration suffix so the + Thought marker and duration remain visible in narrow panes. Added an 80x24 Chat surface test and removed the unused reasoningHeaderLabel export. (`0085d27`)
- Replaced text painted with the muted surface token with mutedForeground across setup labels, profile Cancel, unselected list markers, metadata values and sidebar counts in 30 files. Added a guard test that rejects colors.muted outside background contexts plus a 4.5:1 contrast check for mutedForeground in every palette. (`032a3e2`)
- Pinned TabStrip and StatusBar to fixed one-row strips, made the main row grow and clip, and pinned the sidebar's node selector, mode selector, nav cluster and footer while only the section scrollbox shrinks. Empty sections now collapse to a single header row and SplitView uses a flex left-border box instead of renderer.height divider math; regression tests cover 120x36, 140x36 and 120x24 layouts. (`de249c8`)
- First-run Core and Gateway downloads now abort after a 60-second stall, reset on each chunk, under a 30-minute ceiling rather than a 5-minute total budget borrowed from self-update. Self-update's budget constant stayed private and both bounds are tested. (`6fc3d1d`)
- First-run Core and gateway downloads now require the published .sha256, use the self-update timeout, write per-process temp files, and preserve a binary another launch already installed; regression tests were added. (`1aaafe6`)
- Updated CLI interaction tests across the account, settings, sidebar, waitlist, secrets, self-update, and contributed chat command suites, along with the interaction census and the waitlist core test. (`860de26`)
- Updated the chat surface plus the CLI fixture auth, contract, merged fixture, and PTY proof scripts, with interaction tests covering the changes. (`c80b5cb`)
- Changed chat streaming in the CLI chat surface and chat tab, with new tests around the chatStream core module. (`6b92c05`)
- Merged branch 'claude/ultra-remaining', updating the shell and surface interaction test suites and the calendar surface component. (`0b8d6c1`)
- The CLI shell and surface interaction tests now match the jobs list by path rather than the full URL, so they keep answering now that the client requests /heartbeat/jobs?include=app_jobs. The Calendar/Tasks interaction test that failed against the new client passes again. (`5c3868c`)
- Work-in-progress checkpoint of the data directory re-layout in the CLI command definitions. (`ee2ff57`)

### `cloud-bot`@0.5.0

#### Minor changes

- Routed the public front door through the hosted Ryu Gateway's /v1/chat/completions with an rgw_ key, failing closed when the Gateway URL or key is missing, sending a hashed end-user header per sender, mapping Gateway refusals to short public replies, and capping history per conversation. Removed the direct OpenRouter path and the Pi session dependency. (`ce82f18`)
- Added delivery of approved WhatsApp text templates, with a new template module wired into the WhatsApp platform sender and the push path, plus tests. (`a569b9a`)

#### Patch changes

- Merged main's changes into the cloud bot's frontdoor, push and settings modules and the Discord platform adapter, updating the frontdoor and router tests. (`1438289`)
- Added frontdoor handling for the cloud bot and updated push delivery, the Discord platform adapter, settings and the environment example, with frontdoor and push tests. (`974ca98`)
- Merged origin/main into the cloud-bot app, bringing mainline changes into the frontdoor, Discord platform adapter, router wiring, settings and environment example. (`1b4b24f`)
- WhatsApp Graph version, webhook path, Discord threads, frontdoor model and frontdoor rate limit became typed constants in src/settings.ts, and their environment names are no longer read. (`f7f4750`)
- Updated the cloud bot push module and its accompanying test. (`b321168`)
- Merged upstream changes into the cloud bot's push module along with its test file. (`73d58d0`)
- The /push body schema now validates platformUserId, ryuUserId, organizationId and platformType strictly in the schema, so numeric, operator-object or empty selectors return 400 "invalid &lt;field>" instead of being coerced to undefined and broadcasting to every claimed identity in an organization. The hand-written PushRequest interface was replaced by the schema's inferred type. (`10fc3a7`)
- Refactored the frontdoor and router modules and expanded the frontdoor, grant and router test coverage. (`5c03086`)
- The frontdoor and router modules were modified along with their tests, which also cover frontdoor routing and grant handling. The touched suites are reported as passing. (`c0b8ca8`)
- Per-process rate limits and budgets in the frontdoor and router are now reset between tests, with the frontdoor and router modules adjusted to allow that reset. (`6508ea3`)
- Reworked the cloud bot service around frontdoor routing and the managed-bot store, including persistence and grant tests. Environment example and container build files were updated with it. (`0af1456`)
- Added sender-keyed quota handling to the front door and wired it into the router, with new front-door and router tests plus updated environment example. (`221e088`)
- Reworked managed bot store persistence proof and front-door router handling, with tests updated for both. (`21f287f`)
- Updated the cloud-bot Dockerfile for Bun 1.4.4 and adjusted its HTTP handler. (`fbb3063`)
- Bumped the cloud-bot image to Bun 1.4.4 and changed the HTTP handler to reject inbound Brotli-encoded requests before body parsing. (`f07101a`)
- Applied the formatting and import-order fixes to the managed-bot test during the final audit-validation cleanup. (`a95cb71`)
- Extracted the no-grant branch of routeMessage into answerFromFrontDoor with optional FrontDoorDeps so the limiter-to-front-door wiring can be tested without Mongo, with routeMessage calling it without deps so production behavior is unchanged. Added regression tests driving fifteen answers across two Slack threads from one sender before the rate-limit reply on a third thread with exactly fifteen Gateway calls, and checking that an exhausted Discord sender does not block a bystander in the same channel. (`890a936`)
- The front-door rate limit is now keyed on platform:senderId through a new frontDoorRateLimitKey helper instead of the conversation key, so one sender's Slack threads share a budget and a single Discord sender cannot exhaust a shared bucket. Regression tests cover the Slack, Discord and cross-platform cases. (`a45201b`)
- Modified the managed bot module and added a persistence-proof test covering the managed-bot store. The snapshot was flagged as unverified. (`113293c`)

### `connect`@0.5.0

#### Patch changes

- Merged origin/main into the branch and bumped the package manifest as part of the merge resolution. Main's behaviour and copy were kept for this package. (`1903ef3`)

- Split the oversized Connect README into a short index plus API reference parts under NN-*.md, keeping content verbatim. The operator env table now lists only deployment wiring, and a new "Fixed limits" table names where each tunable lives in code (DEFAULT_TASK_SETTINGS, DEFAULT_SPOOL_SETTINGS, DEFAULT_MEDIA_SETTINGS, DEFAULT_JUDGE_PER_HOUR, DEFAULT_MIN_SIMILARITY, DEFAULT_FREE_ROUTE_SETTINGS, DEFAULT_SWEEP_INTERVAL_MINUTES and OPERATOR_ADMITS_DOCUMENTED_PRICES). (`d89e4e6`)
- Connect's product tunables for task settings, spool and media limits, discovery judging, free-route ladders, health sweep interval, operator price floor and reported version are now fixed in code, with only the whole-volume budgets and deployment wiring still read from the environment. A new src/settings.ts picks the keys handed to the spool, media and discovery parsers, and the ladder settings test moved into relay-config.test.ts. (`cce63f3`)
- Merged origin/main into the working branch, updating the connect app's index module. (`ace7670`)
- origin/main was merged into the branch, carrying changes to the app's index entry point. (`7379155`)

- Expanded the connect service with capability routing and adapters, native client and toolkit handling, Composio billing, usage, triggers and store migrations, relay routes and storage, spend tags with budget checks, tool policy, ladder, search, reliability and reviews modules, and operator pool and quota handling. Added async tasks, event inbox, credential probes and alerts, discovery ranking, and coverage tests across these areas. (`0af1456`)
- Adjusted the Connect usage report schema so minute-precision instants such as 2026-10-01T00:00Z are still accepted under zod 4.6, which now requires seconds in z.iso.datetime(). (`c110554`)

- Updated the Composio billing and usage modules and usage reporting along with their tests as part of the same remediation snapshot. (`25b3cbe`)

- Conflict resolutions from merging the security-audit checkpoint into main landed in the connect Composio integration and billing module with their tests. (`3a960fa`)
- Connect now reads maxCallsPerMinute from configured bindings instead of resolving the composio store, so a store failure no longer escapes service.fetch as a bare 500 and each execution avoids a second SQLite read. Error responses built before a handler had the request id now carry x-request-id, problem bodies drop legacy members that could override RFC 9457 fields, and webhook signature 401s send a WWW-Authenticate Webhook-Signature challenge. (`2b292eb`)

- Tightened composed tool fees so they draw only on top-up credit and uncovered fees are refused, and required version pinning or a ceiling for out-of-org fee-bearing composed runs. Added overranMicroUsd disclosure for routed and arena attempts plus cross-operator routing disclosure, write and upload deadlines with caller-disconnect cancel for spooled and reference media, IPv6 /64 free-route keys with oldest-first eviction, and a policy feed that sends tagBudgets only when the Connect declares the tag_budgets feature. (`22b79ea`)

Relay routes, service wiring, Composio usage and the Dockerfile and entrypoint were updated alongside them. (`dfa5f1a`)
- The connect app expanded its Composio integration with billing, contract, store, trigger, and usage modules, plus an MCP layer, tool host, usage reporting, and service tests. (`ddf18f0`)
- Connect's native toolkits, routing, relay routes and store, token sealer, tool policy, ladder and search, billing status, policy feed and catalog feed were merged to carry both the DB-backed service bindings and the self-serve Connect key feed. Static Connect bindings now read the env map synchronously through envServiceBindings because binding resolution became async. (`6c55e19`)
- Updated the Connect README with documentation for composed tools, agent reviews and comparison arenas. (`6bd40da`)
- Added tool reviews with a shared @ryuhq/protocol/tool-reviews contract and a call journal, /v1/reviews tied to the caller's own call id, per-organization review summaries on describe/search rows, control-plane ingest and browse rows. Added /v1/capabilities/&lt;id>/arena runs that hold every price before sending and charge each of 2-6 named endpoints on its own call id, plus /v1/composed definitions with immutable versions, per-step vendor settlement and a maker fee recorded under the connect_composed reason. (`b35f715`)
- Merged main's content into the Connect package and re-applied the product renaming across its README and source. The Composio integration, trigger and usage handling, MCP bridge, tool host, billing-status and service files were brought onto the merged tree. (`a01db11`)
- The Connect README and operating-guide test were updated to cover the new Connect settings for tags and tag budgets, reconciliation, the ladder, free routes, provider resource headers and reference media. (`071fed8`)
- Merged origin/main into connect, combining changes in the Composio store, triggers, usage tracking and billing status modules with the service, tool host, MCP and usage-report code. Tests, config and the README were updated to match. (`cdb7957`)
- Added tenant reference-media storage at POST /v1/media with leading-byte type checks, per-file and per-tenant byte and count bounds, single-use-shown expiring fetch URLs, list and delete routes and an expiry sweep. Added provider resource kinds declared in the vendor table, recording create responses as tenant-owned, refusing calls on objects that are not the tenant's and active, and listing them at GET /v1/resources. (`447cee7`)
- Added up to eight `x-ryu-tags` labels on metered calls, carried tags onto receipts, usage reports, and settlement debits, and enforced per-tag daily or monthly budgets with a 402 tag_budget_exceeded refusal before a charged call is held or sent. (`0be3017`)
- Added POST /v1/capabilities/&lt;id>/call, which takes a job and policy and routes it across verified, priced candidates with per-attempt disclosure and x-ryu-route-* headers. Plan preview and listings are free, and Idempotency-Key replays a routed answer. (`c1eaac3`)
- Added durable async tasks behind Prefer: respond-async, persisting to tasks.db and answering 202 with a task id, with polling, cancel, queue expiry, idempotency claims and signed webhooks. Also added streamed responses via x-ryu-response: stream and spooled bodies in bounded temp storage behind an expiring /v1/spool/&lt;token> download URL. (`7fe7fe3`)
- Overflow to another operator account is opt-in per call through x-ryu-overflow and disclosed in response headers, while a busy account otherwise refuses with 429 operator_capacity_exhausted or 503 operator_unavailable; per-account capacity evidence is tallied hourly in reliability.db and exposed at GET /v1/admin/operator-accounts. (`8f4b022`)
- Added opt-in hybrid tool discovery to Connect: BM25 fused with embedding similarity to each tool and its taxonomy job by weighted reciprocal rank fusion, an optional judge that reorders top results, the ranking and judge parameters on REST and MCP search, and a new /catalog/search route. Query vectors, verdicts and tool-text vectors are cached, the judge is capped per caller per hour, and any Gateway failure returns the BM25 result with a disclosed fallback reason. (`6275cd5`)
- Required tools:exec for vendor-lane and relay tool calls regardless of method, matched the relay registry by whole segment, and blocked body bindings naming __proto__, constructor or prototype. Also refused operator keys for GitHub, restricted operator pricing to strictly parsed uncompressed JSON, receipted refused 2xx relay answers, made api.github.com path deny rules case-insensitive, and stopped a policy-feed 404 from clearing a held policy. (`d706825`)
- Updated the Connect README to describe the Linear, Notion and Slack toolkits and BYO-app mode. (`6fa630b`)
- Added native Linear, Notion and Slack toolkits alongside GitHub, each recording its provider's OAuth dialect in a table that native-oauth.ts reads. Grants marked oauthClient "tenant" link through a tenant-registered OAuth client at /v1/oauth/clients/&lt;toolkit>, and tokens record the issuing client generation so a replaced client cannot refresh or revoke them. (`b5dfad9`)
- Documented the tool catalog browse API, cost basis and reliability feed in the Connect README, along with the reliability field on search and describe. (`10b17c6`)
- Connect now records outcomes of Composio-shaped tool calls and built-in vendor endpoints in reliability.db, polls the control plane's reliability feed, and reports its changed hours. It also adds a cached reliability field to tool search and describe results. (`c6f0190`)
- Connect now verifies short-lived Ed25519 access tokens offline against issuer, audience, expiry, lifetime, tenant and scope beside static and feed keys, answering refusals with an RFC 6750 challenge. It pulls the tool policy feed and hides refused tools from search, describe, MCP list and the Composio action routes, refusing them before any replay claim or credit hold and blocking denied upstream URLs on native toolkits, relay tools and vendor calls, while keeping the last good policy when the feed fails. (`0a3f54d`)
- Added the relay tool registry and /v1/relay routes with sealed secrets, closed rewrite lists and DNS-screened egress, plus /v1/vendors routes that resolve team, org and operator keys. Also added pre-save credential probes, a scheduled free-probe health sweep and Notify alerts for refused or expiring credentials. (`33ed570`)
- Fixed Connect quote selection to reuse the tenant's stored auth source after restart and to check the caller's cost ceiling against the cheapest source while it is unknown. The billing status feed now lists exempt tenants and reads settlement cursors before each headroom, credit holds apply to self-serve tenants only, and registered MCP servers can no longer forge com.ryuhq/ _meta keys. (`88eb472`)

(`9d5febd`)

- Reworked connect around Composio billing, contract, trigger and usage modules, together with MCP and tool-host wiring, usage reporting and config boundary tests. (`9a8f19a`)
- Raised the default pending receipt bound to 256, classified receipt lookup failures that can never pass, and moved them to a durable unresolved_receipts table with unverifiable or expired reasons. Retry passes now try the oldest 32 pending lookups, and GET /v1/usage includes a first-page unresolved list. (`6e25e49`)
- Added usage.db store version 3 with pending_receipts, so failed Composio receipt lookups are held through the settlement path and retried before later calls and usage reports. A tenant with 16 unresolved lookups is refused with 503 metering_unavailable until one resolves, while retries run at most every 15 seconds with a 5 second per-lookup limit. (`7bca8df`)
- Held Composio settlements are no longer capped and dropped when usage.db cannot be written; all held settlements are written in one transaction on recovery, with admission already refusing new executions while anything is held. The test now holds 2,000 settlements and checks each is written and listed by the report. (`48aca41`)
- Every Composio execute call that reached the provider now settles exactly once, with its receipt or with null counting against the period budget, so ambiguous failures consume the spend ceiling; requests that never left Connect spend nothing. Usage receipts and spend are written in one transaction, and writes that fail are held in memory and retried by admit, which refuses with 503 metering_unavailable (MCP: isError with the refusal code) until they succeed. (`b1ec9d4`)
- Connect now refuses a billing status secret at startup unless it is at least 32 printable ASCII characters with no spaces, using the same rule and wording as Box. Its tests were updated to use valid secrets. (`b746d45`)
- Made a 404 from the billing status feed clear the suspended set immediately, count as a good answer for staleness, and log a fixed warning at most every 10 minutes. Other failures now log once per streak with a fixed reason and once on recovery, and the fail-open window runs on performance.now(). (`0025ac7`)
- The Connect README now documents that a Ryu-hosted Connect returns 402 insufficient_credits for tool execution once the organization's credits are exhausted, while listing, reads, and the usage report keep working, and that self-hosted Connect never refuses for credits. (`0489220`)
- Connect now polls the billing status feed when both settings are set and refuses tool execution for listed tenants with 402 insufficient_credits on /v1/composio, /v1/composio/execute, and native /v1/exec/tool, plus an isError MCP call result carrying the code under _meta. Listing, reads, /v1/usage, /health, and / keep working, and the feed fails open after 15 minutes. (`d72e9a8`)
- The Connect README now documents GET /v1/usage and replaces the unpublished price with the hosted terms: Composio executions at published rates, charged hourly to organization credits with the included pool first, and no separate Connect fee. It also states that self-hosted Connect is never billed by Ryu. (`6196467`)
- Verified Composio billing receipts are now recorded in a usage_receipts table in usage.db (store version 2) at the point the receipt is created in executeComposio, covering /v1/composio, /v1/composio/execute, /v1/exec/tool, MCP call, and limited premium calls; rows are pruned after 400 days. Added GET /v1/usage, which returns a tenant's receipts for a whole-hour window of at most 31 days, ordered by at and transactionId with a keyset cursor. (`b80298b`)
- README and service tests were updated. (`efc66d2`)
- Billing receipts now appear in MCP call results under _meta["com.ryuhq/billingReceipt"] and as a top-level billingReceipt on /v1/exec/tool, with the key stripped from registered MCP server results. (`de8f0c0`)
- Captured a work-in-progress snapshot of interrupted edits to the connect README, to be completed by the resumed unit. (`3c3e3a8`)
- Tool discovery now settles each lane and each registered MCP server independently, lists only the requested lane, returns partial: true when a source was skipped, and reports tool_unavailable only when every requested lane is down. Registered MCP responses are capped at 2 MiB and granted catalogs at 1 MiB, the trigger cap counts live generations only, and /health plus MCP serverInfo report the package version with ready flags for missing Composio and trigger credentials. (`3c7ae41`)
- The Composio store now sets a SQLite busy_timeout so contending writes wait rather than failing immediately. (`c23520a`)

### `hardware`@0.5.0

#### Minor changes

- Firmware now runs RHP v1.1 link states with a single locked emitter, main-loop-only decryption, and Mode A start on LINK_OPEN with capped jittered backoff, alongside pairing v2 with QR v2 and an on-screen or beeped SAS persisted in one commit. Provisioning advertises Ryu-&lt;type>-&lt;last4> with LE Secure Connections and encrypted-link requirements for legacy writes, ws_client fixes a self-memcpy and adds manual reconnect, and board buttons confirm pairing presses and factory reset on a 10 s hold. (`de2ba27`)
- Added the RHP v1.1 pure C core under hardware: crypto vtable with mbedTLS and OpenSSL backends, Noise XX and RHN framing/session code, BLE link codec, pairing crypto and state machine with tones, capability registry and dispatch, and v1.1 protocol messages. Host tests and a rhp_device_sim tool accompany the sources. (`79661b8`)

- Revised the notify service's configuration, egress checks, abuse handling, billing status, usage accounting and response contracts, with matching unit tests and an updated Dockerfile.
- The notify service's standalone sweep was merged, covering abuse checks, billing status, config, egress, response contracts, service and store logic, usage accounting, and TLS test fixtures, plus its Dockerfile, README and tsconfig. (`2a72a08`)
- Notification delivery now surfaces a single DestinationHttpError that carries the Retry-After value from a failed destination, while user-facing failure messages stay tenant-safe and the raw error is still logged. Tests and store code were updated to match the consolidated error type. (`71765ad`)
- Consolidated delivery failures onto one DestinationHttpError that carries Retry-After, while failures keep the tenant-safe message and the raw-error log. The merge also carried the abuse, egress, usage and service modules. (`8009a0a`)
- Notify added abuse checks, billing status, egress handling, usage accounting and updated config, service and store modules, and now keeps its data in an XDG data directory rather than a Core data directory. (`cd8464b`)
- Merged the notify service and store modules along with the service test into the mega branch. (`4c7c6d4`)
- Updated the notify service entry point and refreshed the README. (`2116eb2`)
- The notify service and its store were updated together with their tests as part of the merge resolution. Changes are confined to service.ts, store.ts, and service.test.ts. (`d8a51d1`)
- Reworked the notify service with abuse checks, billing status, configuration, egress handling, contracts, response contracts, usage reporting, store and TLS test fixtures, along with Dockerfile and TypeScript config updates. (`9a8f19a`)
- The notify app's entrypoint and README were updated in the merge. (`4a480b1`)
- Notify now rejects billing status secrets that fail the control plane's rule of at least 32 printable ASCII characters with no spaces, matching Box's validation and wording. Test secrets were lengthened to comply. (`b746d45`)
- Made a 404 from the billing status feed clear the suspended set at once, count as a successful answer for staleness, and log a fixed warning at most once per 10 minutes. The fail-open window and warning limit now use a monotonic clock, with tests covering the 404 path and a wall-clock jump. (`3da63b8`)
- Notify now polls the control plane's billing status feed when both settings are set, validating the URL, hashing tenant tokens once, and returning 402 insufficient_credits on POST /v1/events and POST /v1/topics/:topic before the publish bucket or any storage and counting. Reads, acknowledgements, deletes, streams, /v1/usage, /health, and / keep working, and the last good set is kept for 15 minutes of failures before being cleared with one logged error. (`de999d9`)
- Added a usage_hourly table incremented in the same transaction that stores an event, so idempotent replays and refused requests are never counted; rows are kept 400 days, pruned hourly, and not backfilled on upgrade. Added GET /v1/usage?from=&to=, which returns meters.events for the bearer's tenant over a strictly validated whole-hour window of at most 31 days, with bounds clipped to retention and the current hour. (`a99a965`)
- Added service tests for the new home behavior. (`4a4a051`)
- Event responses now include response.callbackUrlPreview derived on every read, and destination payloads null both callback fields. (`e65022b`)
- Updated the notify service comment to state which slow-reader bound applies on the shipped Bun 1.3.14 runtime versus Bun 1.4. (`f4eed09`)
- Updated the README and entry point for the in-progress data directory re-layout (checkpoint 3). (`d2e32fa`)
- The HTTPS delivery test now polls the delivery list for the recorded result instead of asserting immediately after the local server sees the request, removing intermittent failures on Bun 1.3.14. (`8e65a55`)
- Updated the Notify README to document the hardened contract and correct public claims, including that the service source and image are not yet published. (`1ac702e`)
- Made interactive responses single-use with compare-and-set completion, added HMAC-signed response callbacks with a private secret, raised the SSE idle timeout to 30 seconds with per-tenant and per-process stream caps, replaced raw delivery errors with fixed messages, extended redaction and ntfy action/header handling, added per-tenant caps on activities and preference recipients, changed PATCH /v1/preferences to merge, and defaulted the data directory to an owner-only Notify path that reports its version on /health. (`405b678`)
- Reworked the notify Dockerfile into a build stage that installs from the frozen lockfile filtered to @ryu/notify-service and bundles the service. The runtime stage now ships only that bundle and starts Bun with --no-install instead of auto-installing dependencies at container start. (`f14431e`)
- Fixed the pinned DNS lookup in egress screening to answer both Bun's array and scalar lookup contracts, so DNS-named destinations connect. Each attempt now uses a fresh non-pooled socket, and oversized responses reject instead of resolving truncated data on Bun 1.3.14. (`fccb7b9`)
- The notify service now honors 429 Retry-After responses and records the HTTP status, with store and test updates alongside. (`c23520a`)
- Added service and wire tests alongside contract, egress, error, response-contract, store and index modules. (`465ed08`)
- Lint repairs touched the notify service's contracts, egress, errors, stored and response contracts, wire handling, store, and service tests. (`5ebf41c`)
- Added validation for notification transport and persisted contracts at native boundaries, covering contract, wire, store, service, response, and egress modules. (`b0e471a`)
- Declared native Notify validation dependencies in the notify package manifest. (`621bfe0`)
- Formatting and lint violations were repaired in the notify app's store module. (`c7b73f3`)

### `Browser extension`@0.5.0

#### Minor changes

- Added i18n wiring for the extension: the Copilot no longer rewrites the host page or its &lt;html lang>, and its closed shadow root is translated through the worker. Menus, notifications, and omnibox text are translated and rebuilt on language change, and _locales localizes the manifest. (`1087afc`)
- Updated the extension i18n provider and Copilot mount to use the extension's static official catalog subset for extracted UI literals. (`de356ad`)
- The signed-in New Tab bar now edits the caller's durable primary bot on the active node through a usePrimaryBot hook, with a labelled star and a Clear primary action. The model picker follows the effective primary bot instead of a localStorage-only agent pick. (`7573a47`)
- Replaced the extension icons at 16, 32, 48, 96 and 128 px with the ghost mark. (`f407ca7`)
- Updated the companion host section to expose the shared subscription surface. (`266b704`)
- Added an opt-in background alarm check that notifies "agent finished" from the agent when no Ryu tab is open, with tests and the alarms permission in the extension config. (`a3d000f`)
- Added the optional notifications permission to the extension manifest config so chrome.notifications can be used for agent notifications. (`92e997a`)
- Added an update notice hook and update API helper for the browser extension. (`3e1dedb`)
- Added semantic page find with embedding contracts, in-page UI, message handling, and page-level semantic search. (`78e05ce`)
- Added a WaitlistGate component and wrapped the popup and new-tab entrypoints with it, and updated the email and password change dialogs to match. (`bf26954`)

#### Patch changes

- Merged main branch changes across the extension's popup, new tab, dashboard and settings surfaces. This included updates to the in-page copilot UI, node selector and workflow canvas components, e2e specs for native surfaces and control interactions, and extension package metadata. (`41ee7a7`)
- Split the extension's copilot chat and in-page UI code into separate modules. Converted the user-facing strings in those files to whole-sentence translation keys.
- Merged origin/main into the branch for the extension app, keeping main's behaviour and copy while retaining the branch's whole-sentence i18n and its split component modules. Where both sides split the same files, the branch's split files carry main's changes and main's now-unreferenced split modules were removed; locale catalogs were merged by key. (`1903ef3`)
- Reworked the popup, new tab, dashboard, settings, onboarding and gate screens plus the in-page copilot UI as part of the Ryu Quiet minimal design pass. Chat thread rendering, agent selector, sidebars and theme provider were also updated, and the extension e2e suites were extended to cover the new surfaces.
- Merged main's i18n work into the extension, wrapping background, content-script, popup, and copilot strings with the translation helpers and rebuilding the per-locale _locales message catalogs for all twelve shipped locales. Also added background language-watch and i18n wiring, language-selection handling, and an i18n scope for the mounted copilot UI. (`1438289`)
- Updated AgentSelector and HomeAgentBar to use a new usePrimaryBot hook, plus the package manifest. (`17cec10`)
- The workflow canvas, copilot chat, in-page UI, and workflows page files were split into focused modules for host sections, node configuration, transcript parts, and styles. (`220174f`)
- The agent selector and home agent bar now read the primary bot selection through a shared usePrimaryBot hook. (`44b45cc`)
- The browser extension's dependency set now resolves better-auth 1.7.7.
- Merged main into the primary-bot-port branch, updating extension sources across the background worker and its handlers, the chat port and sidebar, settings tabs, onboarding steps, the account switcher, and the twelve locale message files. The SmartBar, node selector, and popup app were also touched as part of the merge. (`974ca98`)
- The extension's lucide-react dependency now uses the workspace catalog version 0.546.0, matching blocks and web. (`56a0315`)
- Reworked extension i18n plumbing through background language watch, content and copilot scoping, and worker wiring tests, and updated the _locales message catalogs for twelve languages alongside settings and account surfaces. (`adb2bb1`)
- Localized the extension popup, settings, onboarding, shell and copilot surfaces, added _locales message files for all 11 languages, and localized background handlers and run notifications. (`789f045`)
- Merged origin/main into the browser extension, updating the store ID list, the WXT build config and the store submission environment example. (`1b4b24f`)
- Merged origin/main into the branch, resolving the extension's environment example and the Connections settings tab against main. The merged ConnectionsTab keeps the branch's work on top of main's version. (`32f1a85`)
- Moved the Services header into the same max-w-3xl px-6 column as the service rows, so the title and actions align with the list rather than the window edges. (`2a010e8`)
- The Copilot agent/model picker and + menu gained arrow-key, Home and End navigation, with focus landing on the checked or first item and Escape or a pick returning focus to the trigger; the picker sizes to its content and scrolls past 400px. A dot on + marks when Double-check or Browser is on, Services rows reserve the hover menu slot and show progress while Stop, Restart, Stop all or Install missing are pending, and status dots carry text for assistive technology. (`3a8d9b8`)
- Moved interpolated copy in the extension's React components and pages to useLiteralMessages() so sentences with values translate as whole units. (`59f8a43`)
- Sign-in, waitlist, two-factor and OTT handoff gates now share a single GateLayout with a 32px mark, one line of copy and a mono CTA, replacing the local PageHeader; sign-in errors map to one sentence with a Details disclosure. The Services page gained an h-10 header with Start all and an overflow menu, flush hairline rows with a 6px status dot, skeleton loading and single-sentence errors with Retry, and the e2e specs were updated to the new controls. (`e6a26c2`)
- Rebuilt the popup into a three-zone layout with an h-10 header (status dot, Open Ryu icon, account menu), the composer as the hero, and one scrolling list of h-8 page actions plus up to five recents, which fixes clipped page actions. New Tab now uses a 32px mark, a text-2xl greeting, a card-less SmartBar capped at max-w-3xl, and a single ghost picker for agent and browser model; SmartBar drops the idle keyboard row, shows destination pills only when there is more than one, and renders New Tab answers as prose with one-sentence failures and Retry. The popup and New Tab follow the system theme through a shared ExtensionThemeProvider and styles/shared.css, and Hugeicons replace lucide across the popup, account menus, New Tab and SmartBar. (`109b64a`)
- Added lib/shadow-theme.ts, which injects Ryu light and dark tokens by the viewer's color scheme along with one 12/13/14/15 type scale, 10/14/22 radii, Inter and the float shadow, and wired it into the in-page UI, AI-site toolbar, element picker and copilot in place of the hex palettes and forced dark class. Restyled the launcher as a 40px token surface with a Hugeicons glyph and no gradient, glow or scale hover, removed the ornament from Ask Ryu, Prompts and Enhance, made toasts and the connection pill solid with a 6px status dot, and reshaped the copilot with a muted user bubble, plain-prose replies, composer tools behind +, a merged agent and model picker, and flat attachment rows. (`f739474`)
- Split the over-limit native-surfaces and control-interactions e2e specs into numbered sibling spec files in the original order, with shared helpers moved into *-helpers.mjs. No test logic changed. (`7732566`)
- Deleted the unrouted extension page and component tree — pages, layout, sidebar, onboarding, workflow, host and settings-tab sources that no entrypoint imports, as computed from every entrypoint. Kept the tested AccountTab, SessionsTab and account dialogs. (`006e4e9`)

### `create-ryu-app`@0.5.0

[Published package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/create-ryu-app/v/0.5.0)

#### Minor changes

- Added workflow and multi-agent studio templates to the scaffolder, each exporting agents, workflows, and tools for createRyuServer, with tests that scaffold, type-check, validate, pack, and drive them through the real server against a stubbed gateway. (`03f9ac4`)
- The default agent template is now a self-contained Agent with a local defineTool, the Gmail/Composio agent moved to an expense-agent template, and a scaffold smoke test type-checks every template and runs ryu validate and ryu pack against it. (`28aef30`)
- Added an adapter template with a search adapter, manifest, harness and tests matching toolsmith's scaffold, documented in the package README. (`8441d89`)

#### Patch changes

- Merged origin/main into the branch, reconciling the app and widget templates, template-file registry, and tests with main's changes. (`1903ef3`)
- Merged updates to the app scaffolding templates, including the sidecar template package manifest and the template file lists. Tests covering the app template and widget templates were updated alongside the generator and its helpers. (`1438289`)
- Updated the scaffolding entry point, template file handling and templates, including the sidecar package.json in the app template, with matching test changes. (`974ca98`)
- Updated scaffolding, templates and tests for multi-agent, services and workflow templates, including template environment and manifest files. (`0af1456`)
- Added a services project template with app entrypoint, settings, env example and tsconfig, plus a services-template test. README, bunfig and package metadata were updated. (`cbf38ec`)
- Adjusted the ryu entry file in the multi-agent project template. (`1cc077c`)
- The scaffolder's package.json was updated alongside the release. (`7b75cc3`)
- The services template now reads PORT through settings.readPort(), so an empty, non-numeric or out-of-range value falls back to 3000 instead of a random port, and .env.example ships PORT commented out. Scaffolding renames a shipped gitignore to .gitignore, and next steps are printed in install, configure, run order through an exported nextSteps(). (`3a5594a`)
- Updated the multi-agent and workflow scaffolding templates and their manifests, adjusted the generator entry point, and added scaffold and studio template tests plus a test preload. (`b1b04f3`)

### `Desktop app`@0.5.0

#### Minor changes

- Updated the plugin runtime guides proof Playwright config alongside the move to unversioned docs URLs. (`42f5593`)
- A desktop language pick now saves the account locale over the bearer cloud session and writes the choice to Core's ui-language preference, which the Island follows. The first sync in a session only seeds the preference so it never overwrites a newer Island choice. (`73158e8`)
- Regenerated the desktop license list in desktop-licenses.generated.ts and .txt to reflect the dependency changes from the Effect v4 adoption and the removal of the unused uploadthing dependencies.
- The DOM localizer now translates before the agent→bot terminology swap, which applies only to English output. OS notifications, the window title and calendar date labels are localized, and user-data rows opt out of literal translation. (`179c3de`)
- Added a compact agent rail below 1024px that turns a collapsed sidebar into a slim avatar column with pinned agents, the open chat's agent marked, unread dots, and New agent, Search and account controls. Narrowing a window folds a docked sidebar into the rail and widening restores it unless the user toggled it in between; the rail can be disabled from context menus and never appears in detached tab windows or the extension side panel. (`cd5fcb4`)
- Updated the desktop LanguagePackBridge to opt into the official catalog loader, letting desktop host surfaces resolve extracted literals through lazily loaded per-locale chunks. (`de356ad`)
- The drafts card spread now deals from a facedown corner deck that also stores drafts past the 12 in hand and refills the hand as cards are sent, with arcing hand-to-pile moves and a sideways throw for sent piles. Layout, card and table pieces were split into separate modules. (`f964291`)
- Added a PrimaryBotControl star button to the thread bar of a bot's personal main thread that selects or clears the caller's primary bot through the revisioned /api/primary-bot contract. Reads and writes carry the verified user identity and refuse operator-scope fallback when the identity token is missing or the account changes mid-request. (`8e71739`)
- The desktop Traffic map gained a Policies palette for signed-in orgs with gateway.configure: dropping or keyboard-selecting a policy opens a confirmation naming the exact scope before the create-only, step-up-guarded write. The proof harness gained an org mode with two mocked policies and a 409 on an occupied scope. (`de4b9ab`)
- Added a Traffic map section to the Gateway dialog's Limits and safety area that builds topology from /v1/config stages and /health providers, renders live pulses from the Core traffic relay, and offers an expand view with click-to-edit into policy workspaces and Safety filters. The SSE parser now reads frames by event name so non-traffic events and comments are never parsed as traffic rows. (`d334f29`)
- Added a "Guardrail policies" Gateway dialog section under Limits & safety backed by a bearer-auth client for the policy routes, with search rows and signed-out, no-org and no-permission states. (`3e95dac`)
- Added a Prompt library dialog to Prompt Studio for browsing local and organization prompts, comparing immutable versions, moving labels, committing editor text as a version or new prompt, and loading a version into the agent. Added prompt library helpers and tests. (`6a17125`)
- Added an annotation queues review panel and updated the agent evals view and gateway API client for custom evaluators. (`8003109`)
- The desktop run trace panel became a collapsible waterfall showing latency, tokens and cost per span. The runs API client and RunTracePanel tests were updated to match. (`65d072e`)
- Updated the desktop documents API client for the now-mounted document.parse submit and poll routes, with its test asserting the mounted state. (`ebfe144`)
- Updated the desktop Spaces API test so its drift guard checks collect_candidates, where the retrieval mode is now read. (`58672d7`)
- Added icons for for_each and parallel workflow nodes in workflow card previews. (`4f57242`)
- Added a labelled interface switcher button to full-window interfaces' top bar, a Mod+Shift+U Switch Interface hotkey that opens the switcher or a fallback dialog, and a Back to chat entry in the workspace tier. Interface icons and the new switcher dialog were added under the layout and interfaces directories. (`d6e1748`)
- Relabelled the Console built-in interface as Agent and changed the sidebar brand badge to show the Ryu mark with the mode name alone, so the accessible name and window title read "Ryu · Agent". Tests and e2e specs were updated, including surface-renderer defaults carrying the worlds' settings. (`da275bc`)
- Renamed mode labels across the sidebar, route outlet, settings index, window title and OS surfaces, and moved the e2e harnesses and tests to the new names. The window title helper now produces "Ryu · Agent". (`315c4a0`)
- Re-rasterized the macOS menu-bar tray template at stroke width 2.4 instead of 1.5 so the ghost reads at 22pt, with the same geometry and black-on-transparent template colouring. (`90b7a9c`)
- Regenerated the desktop app icon set through `tauri icon`, covering macOS, Windows, iOS and Android sizes, and re-derived the channel tiles with dev staying blue. (`f407ca7`)
- Added the Interface settings panel to Appearance, with an interface picker defaulting to the active one, per-interface fields, reset to defaults and the shared Hide work details toggle. The switcher's "Interface settings…" entry opens it on the active interface, and the Chat settings page is now Chat view. (`8c2036b`)
- Added useInterfaceSettings, which keeps user overrides per interface id in localStorage under "ryu:interface-settings", sanitized on read to bounded scalars, and renders InterfaceSurface with interfaceParamsWithOverrides so renderers get live params. InterfacePort.updateSettings saves a renderer's in-view toggles to the same store. (`8fd77b2`)
- The onboarding WelcomeStep was replaced with a minimal sequence of header-style lines that fade one into the next, ending in "Welcome to Ryu" and one pass of the hello loop before setup continues on its own, with no avatar, body copy or button. An e2e story spec covers the sequence. (`959bf99`)
- First run now opens with a three-beat welcome intro that fades into a personalization prompt with a Get started button, replacing the multi-language hello loop. Onboarding state gained a new intro phase that hands off to the update check in Tauri or the setup fork in the browser. (`df8900e`)
- Added the TrianglePrism dark-mode onboarding backdrop and dropped card fill inside it; the prism holds a still frame on software WebGL and with reduced motion. (`43a54e7`)
- The useful-state e2e harness now checks alarms against name plates and estimated figures, and covers the cramped overlay budget and its default. (`a7c8a1e`)
- Added checker rule S19 for plates staying on stage, updated the alarm-cover hint to name layout.alarms, alarmSide and alarmRows, and flagged you-spot gaps below YOU_SPOT_GAP - 0.5. (`a21bd00`)
- The shoot harness gained figure probes, an alarm check that compares every alarm plate against every on-stage figure and name plate and warns on unmeasured fixture alarms, an S12 stillness check comparing two captures two seconds apart under reduced motion, a you-spot gap check, and settle waits on data-iso-fit. (`f09311b`)
- The useful-state e2e checker now warns under S19 when an alarm plate covers its agent's figure. (`7919629`)
- Added the Agent Mystery Box component and its pull-selection logic to the Store's Agents tab, with interaction and library tests. The box awards a random agent, supports adding it, viewing details, or skipping, and integrates into the agents catalog section. (`28ae45c`)
- Added media-host-services.ts to build generateImage, generateVideo, generateAudio and model.complete for PluginHostPanel and forward every field to Core. Added lib/api/audio.ts to submit to /api/audio/generate and poll /api/audio/jobs/:id, and made video.ts and images.ts pass the new reference-input fields through. (`480c410`)
- A mounted chat tab now publishes its thread's live state into the interface detail store: the open ACP permission prompt as a blocking ask answered through ChatPage's respondToPermission, the exact turn start, the live step at most 4 times a second, and stream errors, agent-login lapses and the failover verdict. (`c048c1d`)
- Interface threads began hydrating from saved message parts while an interface is on screen and the window is visible, with scheduled refreshes for running sessions, threads with an ask or blocker, and a seven-day idle sweep. The snapshot, detail derivation, usage polling, question classification, and in-place answer handling were added across the interface surface and detail store. (`0951745`)
- Extended the interface story harness with a useful-fixture mode, spy ports for answering asks and opening the inbox, a life demo cycle, new shoot-interfaces flags for reduced motion, touch and no-WebGL, and useful-state checks S10 through S20 at 1280 and 390 widths. (`0f1ac92`)
- The interface snapshot now carries run-stream overlay data with per-run first sighting, pending approvals as asks, unread reply asks, workspaces, models, focus threads, routine events, and schedule-failed blockers, with host-side redaction when streaming privacy or "Hide work details" is on. The interface surface latches message previews, reads schedules for every game, answers approvals through answerAsk, and opens the Inbox via openInbox, and InboxCenter uses the protocol's riskTagLabel. (`d2fb479`)
- The Arcade interface now places cabinets in camera-facing rows, adds a second row behind the first when more than six agents are present, keeps portrait stages two cabinets wide, and draws bigger screens with pixel-art reel symbols. Added IsoStage fitPlates and a story-harness agents parameter. (`54f4009`)
- The interfaces story harness gained a `&demo=life` mode that mounts the life demo island with `&phase=` selecting the start and cycles threads through states when paired with an interface, plus a frame-strip shooter. (`a4adcd4`)
- Privacy settings gained the controls for the opt-in OTLP content mode and the diagnostics test-span action. (`77f2802`)
- The desktop voice API client gained a language parameter with wire-contract tests, and the plugin host panel was updated for the new handler surface. (`2c03ad4`)
- Added card spend approvals to the Broker tab and extended the vault API client with the card item and approval calls. (`7ceb888`)
- Added a grant picker on broker credential-use proposals in the vault broker panel and wired the vault API client to the new endpoints. (`0981352`)
- Added a Broker tab to the Vault page that lists broker services and pending agent proposals with Approve and Reject actions, backed by new vault API bindings. (`5652175`)
- Added browser proof coverage for the finished Aquarium 3D rebuild and Planets interface changes. (`dced282`)
- The desktop voice API now passes the sidecar Content-Type through an allowlist, keeps MIME in host data URLs, and threads the new speak parameters with bounded validation. The plugin host panel was updated for the Voice Studio changes. (`78371b8`)
- The cloud task panel gained an Open pull request control, and the feature flag cache is now scoped to account and active organization with a refetch on org switch. (`648392d`)
- Computer Use settings gained an "Allow hardware security key" toggle wired to the Gateway config, and General > System gained a "Use hardware acceleration" option backed by a Tauri module that writes a profile-scoped sentinel applied before the first webview starts. The e2e contract, API client and settings index were updated alongside. (`327d1e9`)
- Moved the usage bar, model picker, chat stats, and OAuth account pool controls onto the shared subscription primitives, added subscription hooks, and exposed window.ryu.subscriptions with grant labels. (`266b704`)
- Desktop hides the box backend, managed agents, and the task panel's diff and push controls when cloud_tasks.box_backend is off. Feature-flag evaluation gained audience handling and the cloud environment picker, task panel and settings were updated alongside it. (`14a41e2`)
- Extended the desktop schedule wire contracts, schedules client and warmup client so schedules can carry the provider_account target. (`93446cc`)
- Registered fourteen new interfaces in the desktop registry and surface renderer, added an account hook backed by the interface snapshot, and extended the interfaces story and registry, snapshot and surface tests. (`39c178d`)
- The interface registry, surface renderer and `InterfaceSurface` were extended for nine placeholder interfaces, with registry tests and the e2e interfaces story updated to cover them. (`d1ef6c7`)
- Scaffolded the Library and Tickets workspace interfaces behind ui.workspace_interfaces, wiring placeholder renderers through the desktop registry, surface resolver, lazy surface and interfaces story. (`2489139`)
- Added an interface registry, surface renderer and lazy interface surface, plus an e2e interfaces story, so the Path, Glance and Hub placeholders can be resolved and rendered behind the ui.workspace_interfaces flag. (`1e8fa4a`)
- Registered sixteen additional interface placeholders and routed them through the desktop registry, surface resolver, lazy surface loader, and interfaces story harness. Card Table gained a layout parameter accepting "poker" or "spread", all behind the ui.workspace_interfaces flag. (`c84e3c2`)
- Registered the Planets interface in the desktop registry, surface resolver, lazy surface, and interfaces story. Updated registry tests and interface surface wiring. (`0dd7983`)
- Added notification onboarding and settings surfaces, agent avatar URL resolution, notification preference handling with platform detection, and a notification-only service worker, with tests for the avatar URL and onboarding helpers. (`a3d000f`)
- Implemented the Sheet, Notebook, Mission Control, Ticker, Focus and Aquarium interfaces in InterfaceSurface.tsx. Card Table, Notebook and Ticker now read scheduled runs and fetch snapshot events alongside Calendar and Mission Control. (`186eba4`)
- Added the plugin host panel and plugins API support for installing a validated app bundle through apps.installBundle. (`6ef71fc`)
- Added the Route traffic through this computer toggle to Gateway network settings, with an API client, settings index entry, and node store state. (`bb8ca65`)
- Added a `show_os_notification` Tauri command that drives notify-rust directly so agent avatar PNGs reach macOS, Windows and Linux notifications, with clicks returned as `os-notification-clicked` and routed to the run or inbox. Added the "Know when your agents reply" onboarding step, a per-device Notifications switch under Settings → Privacy → Device permissions, and agent name/avatar resolution for run replies and approval requests. (`92e997a`)
- Updated the preferences API module for the new `context.max-tokens` settings. (`2dc681a`)
- Updated the Bot chat header so the Bot name bubble morphs to show the live state and reserves its expanded height so the transcript does not jump. The desktop end-to-end bot product shell proof was updated alongside the header. (`8297cff`)
- Added a status line under the Bot-mode contact name that shows Thinking, Typing, Searching the web, Using a tool, Waiting for you, or Ran into a problem. The row stays reserved so the transcript does not jump. (`4c7b426`)
- Gated the family app's store and marketplace visibility through the family.hub feature flag in the desktop catalog host and store search hooks, with rollout and performance tests. (`927772e`)
- Added a consent host mounted at the app root that resolves each card to its tab's node and sends the user's choice through the existing generative-UI submit path. Installs now route through a catalog-entry-install module shared with the Store, and Connect drives Composio or MCP OAuth, opens the sign-in page in the browser and polls until the connection is active. (`8969044`)
- Added forecasts to the subscription quota and usage history dashboards, including per-window pace projections, at-risk notes, pooled headroom for multi-account providers, an on-pace-to-hit-limit tile and month-end API-equivalent projections per total, provider and account. The history chart forecasts per source and across all sources, rendering days without records as zero. (`5163d7f`)
- The agent profile panel now renders app-contributed tabs next to its native views and mounts each companion with the agent-profile mount context. Added plugin contribution fetching through a new hook and API client, plus an end-to-end proof spec and harness. (`e6f8c75`)
- The desktop now remembers the listing behind installed Marketplace agents and reports at most one use per listing per day, never for temporary chats. `ChatPage` also took Biome's safe fixes required by the pre-commit hook. (`426fb0c`)
- Registered the nine new workspace interfaces in the desktop registry, surface resolver, and lazy surface, and added an optional `events` snapshot field fetched only by Calendar and Mission Control from the routines calendar engine. Included the interfaces story harness and registry and snapshot tests. (`b3a033e`)
- Bot and Console are the only interfaces on by default; ui.interface_os and ui.workspace_interfaces now gate OS, Channels, Feed, the worlds, layouts and Marketplace, resolving a requested OS mode to Bot and hiding gated entries from the switcher and listing. Stored interface choices are preserved so re-enabling a flag restores them. (`2c3ceae`)
- Exposed the context.compact-on-cache-expire preference in the memory settings tab and wired it through the preferences API. (`8b910d8`)
- Replaced the action-first selection toolbar with an annotate popover whose note is carried into the chosen action, with the selection kept highlighted and the box following the transcript on scroll. Also applied Biome safe fixes to clear pre-existing lint in ChatPage.tsx and message-list.tsx that blocked the pre-commit hook. (`5d60581`)
- Added the interfaces layouts browser proof, story harness, and screenshot script covering the new Board list view, project grouping, filters, and Mod+K command menu. (`a734615`)
- Extended the interfaces Playwright proof to cover the world talk panels, hotbar, and village map. (`490b8dc`)
- Added a Playwright proof config and spec that drives the eight layouts in the story harness and checks the recorded port calls. (`65f908e`)
- Added pull-request number search to chat list and command palette, with explicit links from conversations and a local index for branch pull requests resolved by the sidebar or watcher. (`d28a62a`)
- Updated the desktop model picker to show one Ryu Router provider with real model names and Free tags for own-supply models, migrating saved selections. Usage, credits, and network settings views now hide supplier ids and show Ryu. (`4765fb9`)
- The composer now appends @image-N and @file-N chips for staged attachments, renumbers them when one is removed, and accepts plain-text files on the chat page and shared composer. A Playwright proof harness for the attachment chips was added. (`8b7b64a`)
- Added the Bring working tree review to the continue-on-node dialog with sensitive files unticked and a frozen manifest on retry, the sidebar on-computer badge, the continued-on banner and the continuity workspace API client. (`4503704`)
- The desktop model router recognises the Ryu-branded managed model ids and their display names alongside the existing raw ids. (`a7a4f50`)
- The node settings dialog now owns a computer scope through NodeScopeProvider, so its picker no longer switches the app-wide computer and every section reachable from the dialog sends requests to the scoped computer's URL and bearer. (`de7b355`)
- Added the "All computers" sidebar mode, per-tab computer-scoped chat history with node-qualified openTab bindings and persisted session restores, and a composer computer chip in the workspace bar. (`152ace9`)
- The desktop agent engine now recognizes bots that run on Ryu's managed engine, so Patrol appears as a built-in agent rather than a marketplace install. (`cc2162f`)
- Chat row menus gained Move to project and Move to another project, which write the chat's folder and detach the previous node project, and Remove from project now clears the node project too. - The universal model picker now includes the Ryu Vision, Reasoning and Code pool rows, with provider-brand test coverage for the new entries. (`02dbb50`)
- Chat sections gained an optional parentId with drag-to-nest in the sidebar, a "Move section to" menu, refusal of cycles and built-in sections, normalization of stale or cyclic parents from synced storage, and children lifting one level when a parent is deleted. - Added a Parameters section to the chat composer settings menu that applies a node preset to the chat's current model or opens the full parameter editor, backed by the inference API client and covered by component tests. (`c7c55a0`)

- The egress pools editor was updated to cover the new anthropic-credits pool. (`3213c91`)

- With the workbench frame mounted, chat panel requests open or focus tabs in the shared workbench panes instead of the chat's own Right and Bottom docks, without taking focus from the chat. Shell-wide requests are served once by the frame, saved chat dock tabs and pinned project tabs migrate in the background, and openPanel gains activate, preserveFocus, command and review path options. (`901edf7`)
- Added the /rewind command, a "Rewind to here" message action and a RewindDialog with file-change preview, backed by a chat-checkpoints API client. The rewound prompt is returned to the composer. (`4a32bd7`)
- Project, branch and run-location pickers now open searchable command dialogs instead of dropdown menus, with manual filtering so create, clone and clear actions stay reachable; the empty-state header and workspace picker were updated and the affected Playwright proofs adjusted. (`8ac66b4`)
- Added a Model parameters editor under Gateway, LLM Providers with local and cloud model pickers, per-field gating, launch settings for local models, and preset apply, save, update and delete, plus an inference API client and an advanced inference section update. (`227083d`)
- Registered Desk in the desktop interface registry and lazy surface, and added it to the interfaces story harness for an initial renderer. (`4e9dd04`)
- Sidebar chat rows now handle Up/Down to move focus between rows and Shift+Up/Down to extend the selection from the anchor, matching shift-click; a story harness and Playwright spec cover shift-click ranges, cmd/ctrl toggles, Esc, shift+arrow keys and the bulk right-click menu. (`b3b9e06`)
- Registered Board, Inbox, Graph, Timeline, Messenger, Terminal, and Arena in the desktop interface registry and switcher, added them to the lazy-loaded interface surface, and extended the story harness and snapshot tests to cover them. (`2fffecc`)
- The interfaces Playwright proof was updated to cover the rebuilt village worlds and the Feed and Channels fixes. (`1452124`)
- Navigation can now be moved between the Left and Right panes, with the docked sidebar swapped for a non-closable Navigation tab and the collapse state kept consistent; palette commands, tab menu entries, Mod+B toggling, layout reset, and a browser proof were added. (`b8eaf52`)
- Added a conversation panel registry that publishes each mounted chat's live context and cowork data by conversation id, and rendered Context, Sources, and Subagents as workbench tabs through ShellWorkbenchItem, with the "+" menu and palette scoped to the focused chat.
