#### Patch changes

- Merged main into the desktop app, bringing in broad rework across the composer and universal model picker, agent panels for routing, observability, routines, schedules and budgets, chat surfaces and conversation sharing, gateway settings, and sidebar and tab layout. The merge also pulled in supporting Playwright end-to-end proofs and test files alongside store, library, marketplace, memory, onboarding, panels, settings, spaces, vault, updater, usage dashboard and plugin host updates. (`41ee7a7`)
- Split the desktop component, page, API client, settings, and workbench modules into smaller files. Converted the user-facing strings across those surfaces to whole-sentence translation keys.
- Enabled the Win32_Security, Win32_Security_Authorization and Win32_System_Threading features of the windows crate in the Tauri Cargo manifest so cli_setup.rs compiles on Windows. No lockfile changes. (`2e38438`)
- Pointed the gateway test support helper and the settings-index test at the merged component file paths. (`1738ebd`)
- Converted interpolated sentences to whole-sentence messages in chat banners and bot controls, gateway provider key and usage cost views, library page chrome, A2A settings panels, background customization, OAuth account pool controls, the Ryu apps tab and mention visuals. (`32e3cc2`)
- Removed the branch's parallel split component files that lost their importers when the merge kept main's module layout, and restored the useLiteralMessages imports and hooks those modules use. Annotation list props are now typed from the merged model. (`426500e`)
- Merged origin/main into the branch, keeping main's behaviour and copy while retaining the branch's whole-sentence i18n and file splits across components, pages, workbench, and e2e specs. Where both sides split the same files the branch's split files carry main's changes, main's now-unreferenced split modules were removed, and locale catalogs were merged by key with embedded UI bundles regenerated in a follow-up commit. (`1903ef3`)
- Updated the gateway mirror test to read GatewayDialog together with its split files. (`451c104`)
- Applied a minimal "Ryu Quiet" UI/UX pass across the desktop app, reworking chat, sidebar, composer controls, settings, gateway, store, library, onboarding, and workspace panel components along with their end-to-end specs. Chat rendering and composer paths were also reworked for chat performance.
- Merged main into the branch, porting edits into the split modules: the desktop shell and app code now live under src/boot/*, native language settings moved to useLanguagePackSettings plus the settings components, and native screen proof areas became partNN specs. Whole-sentence i18n wrappers were applied to the shortened Ryu Quiet copy with catalogs re-extracted, desktop licence notices and the app icon glyph projection were regenerated, and the framer-motion unifier in the Vite build now resolves its canonical copy through motion. (`1438289`)
- Restored an import in the usage-bar meters component and removed an unused binding in the app sidebar, both left over from earlier file splits. (`5a163d0`)
- Updated the provider-routing regressions proof harness Vite config so it follows the split of the agent editor source files. No runtime behavior changed. (`2f8545e`)
- Updated the archived appearance and UGC control fixture comparisons to drop retired corner-shape tokens, including variant-prefixed ones, matching how general-controls already filters them. (`7a21c29`)
- Updated the waitlist page and its e2e story harness so the waitlist queue renders against the current component structure. (`4ce0b9d`)
- Added PrimaryBotControl and ThreadHierarchyBar components with tests, a usePrimaryBot hook, and a primary-bot API client with tests. (`17cec10`)
- Removed the squircle corner styling from PageWrapper and updated the general controls test to match plain rounded corners. (`33ca8ad`)
- Regenerated the desktop license notice files after the motion and lucide alignment. (`bc4505c`)
- Removed the session adversarial test's dependency on the es2023 findLast. (`8495b1e`)
- Extended the chat stream-render spec with budgets for UserMessage renders, TypingIndicator renders, and whole-stream style recalc, and updated the stream test to assert the live user message stays at zero renders. (`477b9dd`)
- Replaced the document-level :has() rule that restyled the window navigation cluster with a useModalLayerOpen MutationObserver hook and a data-modal-layer-open attribute lowered in window-chrome.css. The same layers, phone-width navigation sheet exception, and z-index are kept. (`f96ce01`)
- Oversized desktop components and API modules were split into smaller sibling files covering agent editing, chat, gateway, hierarchy, spaces, settings, home, and workbench surfaces. The commit is an unverified checkpoint of in-flight edits. (`220174f`)
- The settings index integrity test was updated to read the split sibling files. (`a0d6972`)
- A primary bot control was added to chat with a matching thread hierarchy bar entry, a usePrimaryBot hook, and a primary bot API client with tests. (`44b45cc`)
- The desktop app's dependency set now resolves better-auth 1.7.7.
- In narrow windows, the pinned summary floating overlay no longer appears over the transcript by default. It dismisses itself on mount unless the titlebar toggle or overflow menu requested it. (`12b6ff5`)
- The window navigation cluster now stays above the phone-width navigation sheet it toggles but drops below the scrim when any dialog, alert dialog, drawer, or other sheet is open. (`666fd5b`)
- The ChatPage session view now publishes text rewrites in text or reasoning parts that remain in the streaming state after a stopped reply, instead of skipping them. Adversarial ChatSession tests cover stopping mid-stream and before the first chunk, error then regenerate, editing the last user message, in-place part updates, unmount mid-stream, and concurrent sessions. (`c45e39a`)
- Updated the desktop app across the shell and boot screens, sidebar layout, chat components, settings panels, agent views and calendar, along with locale and native-copy handling and the Tauri configuration. (`974ca98`)
- ChatPage now reads the workspace folder and setFolder through atomic selectors instead of the whole store, so recent-folder, project and worktree-pref writes no longer re-render the page. It also stops replacing the follow-up chip list with a fresh empty array on every message update, which had rendered the page a second time per update. (`039ab3c`)
- Streamed text now re-renders only the transcript: the chat session moved out of ChatPage's render path and keeps a live view for the message list plus a page view that skips updates only growing streaming text or reasoning parts. A live slot for the tab-bar model picker keeps title bar actions from being re-pushed on every page render, and a new regression spec covers page, block and title bar render counts across a 200-chunk stream. (`4de9c3a`)
- Chat lists longer than 100 rows are now windowed with @tanstack/react-virtual, with measured row heights so expanded rows, previews and group headers keep their real size. The open chat, focused row, dragged row and nearest unread rows stay mounted, and keyboard navigation, range selection and opening an offscreen chat resolve unmounted rows through a registry that scrolls them into view. (`d501c7f`)

- Stabilised the transcript props in ChatPage so the settled-turn memo holds: the mention list reuses the last committed list when candidates are unchanged, and the contributed message action handler and agent-UI submit handler are stable wrappers over a latest-value ref. - Stopped the composer picker from being a dependency of the chat header actions memo except for tab-bar placement, so ChatPage renders no longer push new actions to the shared titlebar and re-render the shell. (`db2a1fd`)
- Cached memory citations per message object and reused the previous action-state object when unchanged, so messages with reactions, ratings or citations no longer re-render their memoised turn per streamed chunk. Added action-state tests and updated the page helpers and realtime room. (`2c3f387`)
- The chat transport, built once per transcript id, now reads the agent, interface level, model list, worktree mode and target from a latest-value ref instead of the render that created the Chat. (`622ac21`)
- The current user object, goal-completion object and read receipts passed to the transcript are now memoised, so settled turns no longer receive new props on every streamed chunk. Receipts reuse the previous object for unchanged messages. (`623517f`)
- AssistantDock now lazy-loads AssistantPanel behind Suspense, sharing one chunk with the docked layout and warming it when the pointer reaches the launcher. A production vite build measured the panel as its own 48.13 kB (16.59 kB gzip) chunk rather than part of the entry chunk. (`0fbef8d`)
- Replaced whole-store destructuring of the workspace, node and split-preset stores with useShallow field selections or atomic action selectors in the project picker and its dialogs, the project icon dialog, the sidebar projects section, the save-split-preset dialog, the startup chooser and the onboarding node phase. (`b83fed1`)
- Memoized sidebar chat rows by routing handlers through a stable facade, deriving per-row memo keys and reading chat-history callbacks from a narrow row-actions context. A new 40-row memo test measured unrelated sidebar renders dropping from 80 row renders to 0 and active-chat switches from 40 to 2. (`31a97fa`)
- Split the 949-line ProjectPicker into picker, command-list content, folder dialogs and a shared operation guard module, re-exporting the dialogs so the public import path stayed the same. No behaviour change. (`207e370`)

- The desktop_content_key command now returns { key, retired } and app_webview_keys derives the webview key of a store under both the current desktop key and earlier keys, so the webview can open values sealed before a key flip. (`47375c5`)

- Updated the credits and organization API clients so wallet balances and budgets account for amounts held by pre-authorizations. (`5884e54`)

- Sealed desktop localStorage values now live under ryu-sealed:&lt;key> slots; plaintext at the plain key is folded in with suites merged by row and removed only after read-back. (`f283754`)

- Brought the merged cloud worker life branch into the desktop useful-state e2e harness checks. (`35b5f67`)

- The startup Yjs sweep now merges a legacy plaintext snapshot into an existing sealed record for the same room instead of replacing it, stores the result unsynced, and rechecks before writing so a record persisted meanwhile is merged as well. (`f224147`)

The cost chip reads starting until the Gateway's first accrual and shows nothing for a parked Box with nothing accrued. (`9c167ab`)
- Extended the agent Account access panel and identity mode picker to cover provider access and agent-owned Composio apps, with the Composio API client and catalog hook updated. (`88f1858`)

- The sealed localStorage facade now notices through a presence marker when raw storage has been cleared behind it and forgets its cache and pending writes instead of serving or rewriting cleared values. The Tauri key helper is imported as a namespace so suites that mock tauri-ready with fewer exports still link. (`b3c9115`)
- Updated the desktop end-to-end interface harness and useful-state checks as part of the games-d merge. (`2ba643a`)
- Added the AgentAccountAccessPanel and AgentIdentityModePicker components and wired them into CreateAgentDialog and AgentEditPage, with accompanying agents API client updates and publish packaging changes. (`efa6c19`)

- The Toggle Right Panel and Toggle Bottom Panel controls now open or close the narrow-window sheet instead of hiding a pane whose sheet was closed. The workbench end-to-end proof was updated to drive those toggles rather than the removed status bar buttons. (`f77b2f3`)
- A sealed localStorage value left unread because the key was locked at startup is no longer overwritten: the write waits and the existing value is moved aside once it opens. On cold start the key command now queues behind the Tauri IPC bridge instead of reporting the key as locked. (`75ce1b3`)
- The desktop app gained a SessionBoxPanel dock and workbench tab for Box screens with direct and relay grants, park, resume and extend, a BoxCostChip with credit banners, and View screen and stop reasons in CloudTaskPanel. DesktopStreamPanel now renders through the shared VncCanvas viewer, and Shadow computer use names its conversation and maps the routes-to-box 409. (`70d9ad3`)
- Added an agent email alias section to the agent edit page, backed by a new desktop API client for agent email aliases. (`53c73f4`)
- Updated the workbench layout and status bar components and their styles, with tests covering layout behavior and inbox tab switching. (`e63b392`)
- Session tabs, Prompt Studio suites, bot-feed engagement, the workbench layout and the signed-in user now read and write through a sealed localStorage facade hydrated from an in-memory cache before first render. Legacy plaintext is replaced only once the sealed write reads back, nothing is written while the key is locked, and these keys are excluded from settings sync; sign-out and account switches release the previous account's collaboration snapshots. (`6aad8ef`)
- Yjs snapshots in the desktop webview are now stored as sealed {v, kid, iv, ct} records keyed per account, with the content key derived from the desktop app key via desktop_content_key(store) and imported once per session as a non-extractable AES-GCM key. Legacy plaintext is resealed and removed only after the sealed write commits, foreign-key records are kept aside, a locked key changes nothing, and sign-out keeps snapshots with edits Core never received; web hosts fall back to the browser device key. (`6f5ad12`)
- Account access UI fixes: the create dialog step resets on dismiss, the account-limit selection survives toggles, the Treg switch shows in every mode, and unknown identity modes read as individual. The API client in desktop and the agent edit page were updated alongside their tests. (`5572b9b`)
- Removed the VS Code-style workbench status bar (Project, Node, Focused, Inbox, pane toggles) from WorkbenchLayout, reclaiming its 24px grid row and letting narrow-window sheets reach the bottom edge; pane toggles remain in the chat header, the Toggle Right/Bottom Panel shortcuts and the command palette Layout group. (`357363b`)
- The agent sync export checkbox now starts unticked and warns that transcripts are written in plain text outside the encrypted data folder. The choice is persisted on the selected destination profile. (`57e7821`)
- Updated the e2e harness interfaces screenshot shooter and useful-state checks as part of the merge. (`61d0a56`)

- The base-branch merge brought the useful-state e2e harness into the desktop app. (`bee163d`)

- The merge updated the desktop e2e useful-state harness checks. (`6bbc491`)
- Updated the onboarding profile API client and setup step so the run-in-background and continue-setup affordances key off the background flag rather than materialized, falling back to materialized for older nodes. (`5d88015`)
- Updated the desktop e2e harnesses and specs so first-project-proof, keyboard-shortcuts-authority and general settings answer desktop_secret_get/set/delete and desktop-secret-changed, install the Tauri bridge before app modules evaluate, and assert the vault is written only to the sealed slot. (`42bf7b3`)
- Merged the cloud worker life branch into the useful-state check harness used by the desktop e2e suite. (`9348951`)

- Carried the merged bug fixes into the desktop surface, covering the app update handoff and preparation policy, the settings-sync engine and local store, plan-configuration gating, and the login-approval event queue. Also touched permission prompts, deeplink handling, tabs licensing, and recording lifetime controls. (`064e1f6`)
- Desktop now writes node tokens to state/nodes.json in plaintext, forcing the file to 0600 and the state directory to 0700. A token sealed by the previous build is opened on load and written back readable once, plaintext tokens are never rewritten, and an envelope Desktop cannot open is preserved and never sent. (`621541d`)
- The multi-account Better Auth vault and the license key moved out of webview localStorage and the plaintext auth.bin / entitlement.bin stores into enc:v1 sealed desktop_secret_* slots, with former TOKEN_KEY readers calling getActiveToken() and onActiveTokenChange replacing cross-window storage events. First launch moves plaintext copies into the slot and deletes them, an unopenable slot leaves the app signed out instead of falling back to plaintext, and the first render waits for hydration. (`50af6a0`)
- Updated billing and entitlement handling in the billing tab, nav user menu, and useEntitlement hook. (`99e78d4`)
- Added native launch options controls to the inference settings, including a tested NativeLaunchOptions component, and updated the model launch config and engine catalog sections against the revised inference API types. (`56627c5`)
- Introduced the Agent Mystery Box component and connected it into the agents catalog section, with interaction tests covering the new store flow. (`99be1ea`)
- Updated the app sidebar, customize-sidebar dialog, empty tabs state, title bar, tab drag-and-drop, and workbench tab strip, adding e2e proof specs for reorder indicators, tabs layout, and composer attachment chips. (`9c21d16`)
- Remote node tokens in state/nodes.json are now written sealed as enc:v1 (ChaCha20-Poly1305) using a keychain-held desktop key; saving fails closed without the key, and legacy plaintext is accepted and rewritten sealed on load. (`ff11291`)
- Model launch configuration and engine catalog copy were updated for the reviewed native options, and a test was added covering clearing of environment text options. (`c6f400b`)
- Stats consume per-day `active` and `activeDays`, heatmaps shade activity-only days differently, and the privacy toggle was relabelled to state that it covers chat and agents on this device. (`d6b095d`)
- The desktop shell installs a crypto host for its own data dir and seals the original third-party config copies in CLI-setup snapshots while still reading legacy plaintext snapshots, with snapshot reads and writes bounded to 4 MiB. New desktop_secret_get/set/delete commands keep the auth-vault and license-key slots sealed in 0600 files inside a 0700 directory, fail closed without a key, refuse unsealed or foreign-key files, and emit desktop-secret-changed. The identifier migration deletes the legacy plaintext auth.bin and entitlement.bin once a pass completes. (`a3ffc00`)
- Added a "Share as clip" dialog to the Stats tab that renders the trailing year of usage as an 8-second loop in 1:1, 9:16 or 16:9 and downloads it as MP4, WebM or GIF, showing only headline values the tab already displays. The StatsTab coverage test now declares the /api/upsell/pitch route the page fetches. (`eee3028`)
- Updated the provider key safety copy shown in desktop settings to match the new sealing behavior. (`1a8e56d`)
- Added the profile-activity privacy toggle to settings, updated StatsTab streak tooltips to say agent runs keep the streak going, and wired the preference through the desktop API client. (`8508953`)
- The account menu now hides the upgrade and Lifetime Access items for users whose billing verdict resolves as beta while billing.desktop_trial is off; subscribers and licence holders keep them. (`db8176a`)
- Added native launch option controls and engine inference settings sections for the local engines, with component tests. Marked work in progress with checks unconfirmed. (`1c8f91d`)
- The title-bar tab strip, vertical tabs, sidebar sections and header buttons, Customize sidebar, launchpad sections and workbench pane strips now preview a drag-reorder by shifting neighbouring items aside instead of drawing a drop line, with take-the-slot lists resolving targets against resting slots. The e2e reorder, tabs-layout and composer chip proofs were updated for the new preview. (`f2bd091`)
- The Engines pages gained launch settings for the reranker, classifier, Speech Processing, sd.cpp and OuteTTS runtimes, rendered from a generic native-options editor. The per-model launch config editor lets the user choose which engine's options to edit. (`5bc6d14`)
- The entitlement hook now resolves the desktop verdict as beta while billing.desktop_trial is off, skipping the trial clock, trial anchor, paywall and numeric caps on open tabs, remote nodes and agents. The account menu labels only a running trial as Trial and the billing tab reflects the beta state. (`d4b5d41`)

- Changed the useful-state checker to wait until plates stop moving, bounded by --wait with a 30 s default instead of a fixed 9 s, and to read the focus ring two frames after focus. (`951142e`)

- Nightly and canary in-app updates now follow the verdict's versioned tag only when the local node answered, the tag is exactly v&lt;latest>, and its prerelease id matches the client's channel; otherwise no source is chosen and the caller falls back to a manual download. - ShortcutCapture now falls back to KeyboardEvent.key when an event has no physical code, covering named keys, F-keys, and single printable ASCII characters while still rejecting Dead and non-ASCII composed characters. PrintScreen, lock keys, numpad operators and media/volume keys are accepted by code and mapped to Electron accelerator names, with tests for the fallback and the restored keys. (`3084a04`)
- The live-chat fixture can now arm a running turn for a known conversation, served once as a full replay with Core's replay header and 404 before and after. A new case pins ChatPage's Start card and Start behavior against a turn the tab resumed after switching away, and the shared helper waits for Stop and the idle composer instead of a fixed 500 ms sleep. (`f745b97`)
- The POST /api/chat/stream mocks in the companion-page proof and the create-agent dialog harness now answer with Core's UI-message SSE framing, using text/event-stream, the v1 UI-message header, text-delta frames and [DONE] instead of the retired v4 line. (`11c6c5d`)
- The settings-sync engine now adopts a key into the window's dirty set, without re-stamping it, when the shared pending journal holds it at the current local stamp, so a sibling window's unpushed edit goes through the conflict policy instead of being overwritten by a later remote change. A regression test plays a sibling edit and a later remote value and expects a conflict with the local value kept. (`1bc1e67`)
- Added helper text under the Email & alerts STARTTLS switch explaining what turning it off means. (`a1eb118`)
- Scoped clip recordings by node URL, node bearer and the stable identity claims of a managed-node delegation instead of the raw JWT, and added abandonRecording to reset the session and best-effort stop the clip on the owning node. Recording controls now abandon foreign-scope recordings and sync the stop target on same-scope credential changes. (`7b6cbea`)
- The merge brought the cloud worker life work into the desktop e2e useful-state check harness. (`598bcb5`)
- The useful-state checker gained S19 plate checks: text plates overlapping by more than 3px fail at 1280 and are listed as a warning at 390. (`19040db`)
- Corrected the syncTabLabel JSDoc to state that the option changes only the tab label, since the shell renders no page title, and renamed the hook test case to describe the title-bar context it reads without changing assertions. (`3b6bfcb`)
- Extended the ChatPage harness with a bot product mode, a temporary-chat blank scenario, and controls to arm and finish live chats, and added five Chromium cases covering the Bot and temporary-chat gates plus two ownsThread paths. - Updated the useful-state checks harness used by the desktop e2e suite. (`3c76e0b`)

- Fixed the crash when toggling Temporary chat by running the Drafts lookup every render through a shared useComposerDraftsEnabled(context) and combining only its result with persist, keeping the autosave, restore and auto-queue hooks in a stable order. (`7211411`)

- The useful-state checker now reports FAIL instead of throwing on taps, guards each viewport so results print and the browser closes, drops focus after each card closes, and treats aria-hidden Tab stops as failures, among other checker adjustments. (`46728e9`)

- Merged the cloud worker life branch into the e2e useful-state checks harness. (`36947e4`)

- The tab that Start opens for a suggested task now shows the task's title instead of the "New chat" placeholder until the tab has a thread of its own. useTitleBar gained an optional syncTabLabel flag defaulting to true so other pages are unchanged, and six Chromium cases plus three Bun hook cases cover the title, node binding and sign-in behaviour. (`30c15c0`)
- The store catalog host now routes dotted publishers' Get action in the detail hero through the publisher install disclosure using resolved detail and card trust. (`da207a5`)
- The composer now keys an agent-initiated mode switch by its message part, so a newly selected agent that switches itself to the mode the previous agent last streamed adopts it instead of dropping it as an unchanged value. (`42cb058`)
- Extended the ChatPage native-HTTP harness so the window-registry stand-in accepts a conversation key under the second computer's name, an armed live turn can call tasks.suggest before answering, and ?signedOut=1 opens the thread with no account. The dependencies file grew to 5 Bun cases and the live-chat file to 5. (`0e4ae5e`)
- Answers given from a workspace interface are now resolved against the ask on screen on the active node and thread, instead of the first holder of a repeating ask id. Live entries and answered ids are keyed by node, conversation and request and pruned when a turn ends, and interface live state resets when the active node changes; the composer permission card shows only while its turn runs. (`e8c2ab2`)
- The local runtime installs from the build's own v&lt;version> tag, and canary/nightly in-app updates read latest-&lt;channel>.json from the verdict's versioned tag. - The screen ask and create-agent dialog read Core's UI-message SSE stream through a shared reader, reporting an error on an empty answer. (`76d0f32`)
- The desktop stream panel mounts noVNC in a container div and generation-guards connect attempts and RFB events, local Core restarts after a copy-data-folder or failed deep clean, browser open requests use a monotonic nonce, and ShortcutCapture derives accelerator keys from KeyboardEvent.code. (`a602a8c`)
- Uploads now send the file name as an encoded ?name= query parameter instead of a raw x-filename header. Settings sync no longer re-stamps or marks a key dirty on a sibling window's storage event and merges sibling journal entries, workspace links reject . and .. segments in absolute file mentions, and an unresolved entitlement is treated as an unknown plan that fails open rather than the free plan. (`f0d46d6`)

(`9efe374`)
- Merged the live interface state work: snapshot hooks keep retry/unavailable and the omitted-thread count, a running session anywhere below a main thread lifts it with runState 'running', scheduled runs keep those nearest now under the cap, and a selected workspace interface requests conversation previews from the first fetch. Approvals read ApprovalRequest.action through approvalActionFields against Core's PendingAction union, and fixtures carry the newly required ScheduledJob.appId and tool_call action ids. (`72dd596`)

(`49c0c7b`)

#### Patch changes

- Merged origin/main into the ghost crate, updating Cargo.lock, Cargo.toml, and package.json. The journal tool module and its test file were merged with main's changes. (`1903ef3`)

- The profile-shifted Shadow port test now binds explicit ports across the valid offset range from a pid-derived starting point instead of asking the OS for an ephemeral loopback port, so it no longer panics on Windows. The journal inline tests moved unchanged to tests.rs. (`016ead2`)
- Updated Ghost's main entry point, MCP server, reference map, and tools for actions, journal, and perception. The crate's Cargo manifest and lockfile were also refreshed. (`0af1456`)
- Re-derived the ghost lockfile with the patched crate versions. (`9ea0295`)
- The ghost app's standalone Cargo.lock was re-derived to match the re-resolved dependency set. (`3970ebe`)
- Re-derived the standalone Cargo.lock via sync-standalone-locks.sh so the crate resolves wasmtime 48.0.7. No crate source changed. (`f0bd07b`)
- journal.rs was adjusted as part of restoring the Rust build on the merged integration head. (`014c0da`)
- Adjusted the ghost entry point and its reference map implementation. (`1cc077c`)
- Updated rustls-webpki to 0.103.16 and webpki-roots to 1.0.10 in the ghost lockfile. (`0c10d21`)
- Updated the ghost app lockfile as part of the merge carrying the Tailscale installation security changes. (`d92c2d6`)
- Ghost's lockfile and reference-map handling were synced with the root lock and its dependency versions aligned. (`07be026`)
- Kept the Shadow challenge check in the journal tool ahead of any bearer being sent. (`784fd89`)
- Updated the ghost Rust app, including its MCP server and tools modules for journal, recipes, vision, and wait, along with the reference map and vision model files. The Cargo manifests and lock file were updated alongside these sources. (`ddf18f0`)
- The ghost crate's manifest, README, MCP server and tools, refmap, vision, journal, recipes, and wait modules took main's content during the merge. (`a01db11`)
- Merged main's ghost changes into the branch, touching the MCP server and its tool implementations for journal, recipes, vision and wait. Reference mapping and vision model handling were updated alongside the binary's entry point. (`cdb7957`)
- Regenerated the Ghost lockfile with the patched TLS and QUIC dependency versions. (`e98e55a`)
- Applied the security scan patch to the ghost journal tool. (`8aa68aa`)
- Merged ghost's MCP server and tool modules for actions, journal, and perception, along with dependency updates in the crate manifest. (`b4f7dfd`)
- The ghost app now routes raw macOS capture frames through ghost_eyes::capture_scratch, clears crash orphans at startup and removes frames earlier builds left in the system temp dir. (`8192eb1`)
- ghost mcp now prunes expired sealed snapshots when it starts and every minute while it runs, so they no longer outlive the ten-minute retention when no snapshot tool call occurs. (`659b0de`)
- Snapshots are now sealed files under Ghost's component key with a 0700 directory, 0600 files and binding to the id, capped and pruned by TTL on each use. Without a key snapshots stay in the process, and legacy plaintext snapshots are deleted at startup. (`aa7f3ce`)
- Accessibility snapshots are kept only in the long-lived mcp process, capped at 10 entries with a 10-minute TTL, and the component subkey is captured before the runtime starts. Seal variables are no longer forwarded to helper programs. (`62195ea`)
- Pinned a localhost Shadow URL in the journal tool to 127.0.0.1, matching Core, so a process listening on ::1 cannot relay the proof and take the bearer. (`570748d`)
- Ghost's journal tool source was modified, with the crate manifest and lockfile updated to match. (`7494894`)
- Carried core into the standalone tree and added the dependency, refreshing the lockfile. (`371898a`)
- Extended the Ghost MCP server and tool modules for actions, journal, and perception, with accompanying dependency updates. (`e3a5e18`)
- The journal-marker tool now sends a /health challenge probe and verifies the returned proof before POSTing to /ingest, failing without sending the token or marker when the listener does not prove it is Shadow. (`a606709`)
- Routed Ghost's blank-query refusal and drag dom_id through the shared target lookups, and updated the MCP server plus the actions, journal, and perception tools accordingly. (`064e1f6`)
- Updated the tool actions module as part of the #747 merge. (`e49d1db`)
- ghost_click, ghost_type, ghost_hover and ghost_long_press now go through shared focus_requested_app, cdp_target, dom_selectors/dom_target, ax_target, click_at, left_click and type_with_overlay helpers. Lookup order, fallbacks, JSON results and error messages are unchanged. (`a98770a`)
- The Ghost MCP stdio server now answers a non-JSON frame with -32700 and keeps reading; blank-query clicks, hovers, long presses, drags and inspects are rejected instead of acting on the root AX node, and the journal marker resolves Shadow with a required token, status checks and I/O timeouts. ### `Island`@0.5.0

#### Minor changes

- The Island's shared language-selection module now takes part in the saved ui-language preference that the Island follows. (`73158e8`)
- Added Island language-pack IPC and preload wiring, a renderer IslandI18nProvider, and a watcher for language packs. The Island reads a shared ui-language preference over a sender-checked IPC channel and offers the official locales. (`1087afc`)
- Updated the Island i18n provider to resolve extracted literals through the official catalog path. (`de356ad`)
- Updated the island resource icon to the ghost mark. (`f407ca7`)
- The Island plugin host now exposes window.ryu.subscriptions to mounted plugins. (`266b704`)

#### Patch changes

- Merged main branch changes to the Island renderer, including the notch surface, morphing page, shell parts, chat chrome, voice mode panel and plugin host. Island config, shell geometry, footprint reporting and package files were updated alongside their tests. (`41ee7a7`)
- Merged origin/main into the Island app, reconciling the electron-builder and electron-vite configuration, the built-bundle verification script and its guard test, and the main-process overlay, window, ghost cursor, and dictation services. The renderer components, island config and shell geometry, plugin host, and styling were merged as well, keeping main's behavior and copy. (`1903ef3`)
- Restyled and reworked the island shell components, including the notch surface, action dock, morphing page, suggestion chips, chat chrome and voice mode panel. Geometry, footprint reporting and config helpers were adjusted to match the new minimal layout.
- Language pack IPC and service code, the shared language selection channel, dictation service, overlay and window setup, and the renderer i18n provider and plugin host were merged. The Electron Vite config, built bundle guard and verification script, preload typings and sandbox tests were updated alongside. (`1438289`)
- Changed the Island build configuration, added a verify-built-bundles script and a built-bundle guard test, and updated the ghost cursor, overlay, window, dictation service and preload sandbox test. (`17cec10`)
- Upgraded Electron from 42 to 45.1.0 along with electron-vite, electron-builder, and electron-updater. Sandboxed-preload guards were aligned with Electron 45, main-process clipboard calls moved to the async W3C-aligned API, sandbox: true is set explicitly on all windows, and electron-builder npmRebuild is disabled until node-abi lists 45.1.0.
- Added language-pack IPC handlers and a language-pack service, with a shared language-selection module wired through the preload bridge and renderer i18n provider. The command palette, plugin host, and meeting and quest detection hooks were adjusted to watch the selected language packs. (`974ca98`)

- Updated the example environment file. (`32f1a85`)
- Island selection and hover fills now tint the foreground, since bg-muted and bg-accent were invisible against the bg-popover fill. Island tabs got roving tabindex with Arrow, Home and End keys plus a visible focus ring, and revealing Snooze moves focus onto it while More folds back for each new suggestion. (`ab96db9`)
- Updated the Island command, meeting and quest detection hooks, and plugin host to render interpolated copy as whole sentences through useLiteralMessages(). (`59f8a43`)

- Hardened the Island's hover, auto-jump, and window rebuild paths so a released DOM pointerleave clears the last polled "inside" sample, and the at-rest check also requires no drag in progress. (`ec3c326`)

(`aea7ac1`)

- When a recorded key id has no key, the device now probes the secure store and, if the probe item writes and reads back, generates a new device-only key and quarantines values sealed under the old one on read; a failing probe or throw still marks the store locked. (`3efd1fd`)
- Added a resumable sweep at start and foreground that seals legacy plaintext conversations, agent contexts and tasks on device. It re-checks each value before the write, verifies the sealed copy opens to the same text, stops while the key is unavailable and never deletes anything. (`6717f85`)
- The iOS keyboard clipboard ring buffer is now stored as an encb:v1 value encrypted with CryptoKit ChaChaPoly under a content key derived from a 32-byte key in the shared Keychain group with AfterFirstUnlockThisDeviceOnly. Malformed values load as an empty cache, capture stays off while the key cannot be read, and legacy plaintext is resealed on load. (`0e7e021`)
- Local conversations, local agent context and saved tasks are now sealed as encb:v1 under per-store content keys derived from a 32-byte device key held in expo-secure-store with AFTER_FIRST_UNLOCK_THIS_DEVICE_ONLY. A failing or null secure store is treated as locked, deferring reads and writes without generating or clearing keys, unopenable values move to a quarantine key, legacy plaintext is sealed on read, and scheduled task reminders carry generic text because the OS stores them in plaintext. (`f1c0f62`)

- Added the pi-copy plugin, including its manifest, plugin descriptor, Ryu copy extension, README and behavior tests. (`32270d2`)
- Updated pi-copy so line-1 clips from UTF-8-with-BOM files no longer carry U+FEFF into destinations and paste-before-line-1 stays behind the BOM; moving an unterminated last line to the end of its own file no longer adds a blank line. Added golden tests for both cases. (`90cc1bc`)
- Fixed pi-copy same-file moves that place a clip at the start of its own span by applying removal before insertion, preventing corrupted bytes; added a golden test. (`9e879a6`)
- Changed pi-copy to decode strictly as UTF-8, preserve BOMs, and refuse non-UTF-8 files before any write instead of re-encoding them with replacement characters; added Latin-1 and BOM byte-exactness tests. (`82b2b3a`)
- Changed pi-copy same-file move detection to compare inode/dev or realpath instead of path strings, preventing symlink, hardlink, and case-alias moves from overwriting the source; added a symlink-alias test. (`7f434de`)
- Added the pi-copy plugin to the plugins store with its manifest, plugin definition, ryu-copy pi extension, README, and unit and runtime behavior tests. (`3a8cf2a`)

### `Raycast extension`@0.5.0

#### Minor changes

- Replaced the Raycast extension icon with the ghost mark. (`f407ca7`)

#### Patch changes

- Bumped the extension's dependencies and refreshed the lockfile. (`5c03086`)
- Regenerated package-lock.json so the lockfile matches the @raycast/api ^2.9.0 dependency in package.json, bringing updated esbuild and oclif entries.
- Merged the dependabot bump of @raycast/api to 2.9.0 in package.json, with lockfile regeneration handled in a follow-up commit. (`d07af5f`)
- Bumped @raycast/api from 1.104.25 to 2.9.0 in the extension's package.json, a semver-major dependency update. (`8a525e2`)

### `ryu-core`@0.5.0

#### Minor changes

- Added revisioned GET/PUT /api/primary-bot keyed by the verified principal, backed by a dedicated primary-bot.db store with configured-vs-effective readback and fallback to the chat default. Bot main threads outside projects now follow the verified principal, the main-thread index was migrated to a shared index plus a per-principal personal-bot index, and hierarchy/primary-bot routes reject unverifiable user JWTs with 401. conversations_hierarchy.rs was split into defaults, store and test modules and scope routes moved to hierarchy_scope_api.rs with public paths unchanged. (`b5fbfd5`)
- On managed nodes the OpenRouter, Replicate and Fal resolvers now ignore environment provider keys, so only a key the tenant saved in Settings resolves, and the unreachable managed-node branches in push_provider_key_env were removed. Self-hosted BYOK resolution and spawn env are unchanged, and a unix-only tool_exec test is now gated with cfg(unix) so the test binary compiles on Windows. (`ad957a1`)
- Starting a harness run while a session already has an active run now follows a multitaskStrategy — reject, enqueue, interrupt, or rollback — instead of always returning 409. Queued runs are persisted in an ordered session queue and promoted when the active run's dispatch drains, and node-owned sessions resume their queues detached after boot. (`2736713`)
- Added /api/prompts with node-authored prompts and a read-only organization mirror pulled from the control plane's node feed using the node credential. The mirror refreshes on demand or lazily on read and resolves prompts offline with control-plane wire, label, and version rules. (`cd51f69`)
- Gave annotation queue handlers queue-specific operation ids and synced the Core OpenAPI copy. Queue items created in the same millisecond now keep insertion order via a rowid tie-break, making claim-next and exports deterministic. (`21f1895`)
- Added agent-scoped annotation queues with rubric, labels, score range, items from runs, messages, or traces, claim-next, submit, assign, and export, plus server routes and OpenAPI entries. (`8003109`)
- Opened an agent_run scope per chat turn, recorded auto-recall retrieval, long-term memory writes and governed tool calls as child spans, and served GET /api/runs/:id/trace?format=tree and GET /api/traces under the caller's conversation ACL. Telemetry now resolves diagnostics-otlp-preset names with secret references and bridges ended run-trace spans into the consented OTLP provider, forwarding the resolved destination to the managed Gateway. (`9a5fdc7`)
- Added POST /api/spaces/:id/imports/connector, which reads Notion, Google Drive, Confluence, GitHub, and web URL sources and feeds them into the existing Space import pipeline as Markdown pages, CSV databases, or original files. Credentials resolve as vault references, and egress goes through Core's guarded fetch with per-hop redirect screening. (`8b14641`)
- Registered POST /api/documents/parse with its own raw-body limit in /api/uploads/limits and GET /api/documents/parse/jobs/:job_id, and added both to the OpenAPI list. (`ebfe144`)
- Added GET, PUT, and DELETE working-memory routes for threads and resources, per-turn injection of the active agent's scratchpad, the working_memory.update_working_memory tool, and per-agent compaction overrides. Deleting a conversation now removes its thread working memory. (`e17f728`)
- Credentials are env:/secret: references resolved lazily, and unknown or conflicting provider ids remain boot errors. (`07a3c9e`)
- Extended POST /api/spaces/:id/search and POST /api/retrieval/search with hybrid, filter, parent, rerank, multi_query, hyde and expansion_model, running query expansion through the governed Gateway side-model call with a fail-open warning. Added GET and PUT /api/spaces/:id/chunking, accepted Space chunk metadata on /api/retrieval/index, and updated the OpenAPI surface. (`970cfcc`)
- Refreshed the embedded workflows companion UI bundle in the plugin manifest fixture. (`1172dc8`)
- Workflow execution now dispatches independent ready nodes concurrently under a max_concurrency setting, with per-node run copies whose checkpoint deltas merge under a lock. Added for_each and parallel nodes, append-only run checkpoint history served at GET /workflows/runs/:run_id/history, and fork_run plus POST /workflows/runs/:run_id/fork with forked_from lineage and fresh idempotency keys. (`ad28511`)
- Registered the DeepSeek Search plugin manifest among the builtins, extended the hydrated web-capability runtime matrix with its search and extract providers, and added shipped-grant lifecycle coverage for it. (`7b41f53`)
- The core server test literal gained an empty settings vector alongside the new interface contribution field. (`dc75fef`)
- A new `sdcpp::frame_models` classifier recognized installed Wan I2V 14B, FLF2V 14B, TI2V 5B, and Wan2.2 I2V A14B low/high-noise pairs and launched them with the T5, VAE, CLIP-vision, and offload flags they need. The downloader gained pinned, checksummed CLIP-vision H and Wan2.2 VAE entries, fetched only when such a model is active, and frame support is reported only for a recognized model whose transformers are installed. (`736ddb0`)
- The Gateway sidecar client now applies the per-request timeoutMs when forwarding managed provider calls. (`93702fb`)
- Added POST /api/audio/generate and GET /api/audio/jobs/:id behind the Media app gate and host media permission like video, with Fal or Replicate as the only backends. The video and audio submit routes now enforce a 64 MiB body limit and validate poll ids before they reach the Gateway URL, image_host handles provider_input, and host.sideModel accepts up to 8 base64 data URIs totalling 1.5 MiB. (`4c66845`)
- Added invoke_agent turn spans, execute_tool and call spans, inbound traceparent middleware, and traceparent propagation to the gateway and to MCP params._meta. The telemetry module now exports with the updated exporter settings. (`77f2802`)
- Wired RHP v1.1 secure ingress and pairing v2 routes, added node key sealing with the at-rest field cipher, and added reserved device MCP tools with personal-node, app, prefs, and secure-session gates. (`bed4442`)
- Core's `/api/voice/transcribe` and the STT host now forward the transcription language from the request into the engine request config. (`2c03ad4`)
- Added the `card` item kind with a Luhn-checked schema, derived brand and last4, merchant host allowlist, broker `__CARD_<KEY>_<FIELD>__` placeholder substitution, spend approvals and fail-closed auditing, along with the related routes and OpenAPI registration. (`7ceb888`)
- Added vault password-manager providers for 1Password Connect, 1Password service accounts via op, and Bitwarden Secrets Manager via bws, with sealed tokens and connected/reconnect_required state. Added broker credential-use proposals with once/1h/24h/30d grants, fail-closed audited resolution of op:// and bws:// references, routes and OpenAPI registration, and a sealed-token migration. (`0981352`)
- Added static and transit auto-unseal providers with boot-time unseal and authenticated rekey, cert, aws-iam and kubernetes machine auth methods, a Redis RESP ACL provider, and static-role rotation of postgres, redis, webhook and aws-iam credentials into KV versions, with routes in vault_seal_dynamic_api.rs. (`2d684df`)
- Added the vault::items module and the /api/vault/items routes: immutable field schemas, per-field keyring sealing, non-sensitive readback, pending_collection and ready status, idempotent PUT, expectedVersion and expectedId PATCH, and an append-only event timeline with an after cursor and bounded long-poll, authorized on sys/items/&lt;env>/&lt;folder>/&lt;key>. (`2a08fc1`)
- Added a Vault-compatible /v1 API in core with AppRole/JWT login, token lookup-self/revoke-self, KV v2 mount discovery, and secret data and metadata operations over node-scoped values, authenticated by X-Vault-Token digest and authorized through shared machine policy checks. (`e71e546`)
- Added vault/external with store connections whose credentials are sealed by the keyring, KV v1/v2 and Infisical v3 clients, live read-through and scheduled sync sources, and one-way push destinations, exposed under /api/vault/external/*. (`c796984`)
- Added transit key types and lifecycle with derived and convergent keys, associated data, key versioning and trimming, audited one-way export and plaintext backup, soft delete with recover and purge, scheduled auto-rotation and BYOK import; PKI intermediate CSR generation, sign-intermediate, issuer import and tidy with caChain on issued certificates; ES256 identity tokens with role templates, sealed rotating signing keys, OIDC discovery and JWKS; scheduler jobs; and the new routes in the vault crypto API. (`29ea199`)
- Vault policies accept templated identity paths, allowed/denied/required parameter constraints on write rules, and control groups on read rules with pending requests, one-time tokens and named approvers. Added /api/vault/capabilities-self and /api/vault/control-groups routes, excluded gated values from export, snapshot and scan, denied machine tokens, and extended the shared policy fixtures. (`9ff5075`)
- Plugin-secrets schema v3 added customMetadata, per-value and per-environment casRequired, metadataVersion CAS and per-version soft delete and undelete, with a v2 backup during migration. A new kv_meta module provides metadata merge patch, JSON-object value merge patch under CAS, subkeys and keyset-paginated authorization-filtered listing, vault_kv_api exposes metadata, data, subkeys and version delete/undelete, GET /api/vault/secrets gained after, limit and detailed, PUT gained expectedMetadataVersion, and the scheduler enforces deleteVersionAfterSecs. (`0b89ded`)
- Added a TOTP engine that generates or imports keys, seals seeds in encrypted storage, validates without replay and returns otpauth URLs and QR images, plus named password policies with charset rules, satisfiability checks, OsRng generation and scheduler rotation. Exposed the new vault TOTP, password-policy and machine agent HTTP routes. (`f03d0ed`)
- Core's voice route and session now carry the new speak parameters with bounded validation and stop silently substituting OuteTTS when a clone, named engine, or studio option is requested. (`78371b8`)
- Added vault::broker with service matching, placeholder substitution, a sealed P-256 CA and per-host leaf cache, rvb_ sessions, netguard, per-session rate limits, a value-free request log, agent proposals, a service catalog, unmatched-host policy and skills. (`9de5dfe`)
- Machine vault tokens gained max and explicit-max TTLs, renewal, periodic tokens, atomic num_uses, CIDR binding, child tokens with a revocation cascade over tokens, leases and cubbyholes, orphans, token roles and lookup routes. Also added single-use rvw_ response wrapping under sys/wrapping, per-token sealed cubbyholes, sys/leases lookup, count, revoke-prefix and tidy, and rate-limit plus lease-count quotas returning 429. (`ba84faa`)
- ryu-lsp.ts now also handles copy_paste in its tool_result hook, appending fresh language-server diagnostics for the paste destination (to_path, defaulting to path). Tests for the extension were extended alongside it. (`1594a93`)
- Core now enforces cloud_tasks.box_backend through a signed ryu_flags JWT claim evaluated server-side, refusing verified callers without it with 403 cloud_environment_feature_unavailable on save, prepare, bind, prompt, diff and push. Finish also gained the ability to open a GitHub pull request with title, body and draft using the credential Core already holds, where a PR failure does not fail the push or destroy the box. (`648392d`)
- Registered @ryu/pi-copy as a core-tier preinstalled plugin, embedded its extension in BUILTIN_PI_EXTENSIONS, seeded it, and updated ryu-plan.ts to withhold copy_paste in plan mode and confirm sensitive targets, with plan-mode test coverage. (`3024cc9`)
- Added the subscriptions module with provider kinds, per-account readings, and a credential-revision-keyed cache behind /api/usage/subscriptions, and routed the MCP usage tool through the shared reader. Added subscriptions.list and subscriptions.usage to the plugin bridge behind subscriptions:read with gateway allowlist and rate limits, extended routing policy rules with provider/account scope, and carried provider/account/pool strategy in hook turn context. (`266b704`)
- Cloud environment handling now follows the cloud_tasks.box_backend flag, which is off by default and fails closed, with platform admins first. Core enforcement stays with the Box service configuration because no authoritative per-user flag source exists there yet. (`14a41e2`)
- Added the cloud task box arm with lease-before-create recovery, a TTL backstop and metering, an environment runtime covering backend, executor and lifetime with policy checks, and /api/cloud-tasks status, prompt, diff and finish routes with clean-room branch push and compare link. A chat gate now covers managed-agent environments and the OpenAPI document was regenerated. (`93c2c49`)
- Added a provider_account scheduler target that sends one minimal turn with a specific saved account's sealed credential, bypassing pool selection, and validates the provider, saved account and pinned model at job creation; the Claude and ChatGPT server paths and the warmup UI manifest fixture were updated to match. (`93446cc`)
- Extended the plugin manifest and builtin plugin registry to recognise the Places plugin, and updated the core dev script. (`e8eebd8`)
- Added push delivery when a conversation run transitions to completed or failed, sending to opted-in owner devices with the agent display name as title and the agent avatar image, and added the run_finished push-token field plus notification API support. (`a3d000f`)
- Registered the App Studio manifest and compiled UI fixture as an opt-in companion, including plugin seeding and fixture wiring. (`6ef71fc`)
- Added the local_egress module with stream mux, desktop exit, node entry, and proxy handling, plus owner-only server routes, OpenAPI entries, cloud task proxy environment, and main wiring. (`bb8ca65`)
- Added `context.max-tokens.local` and `context.max-tokens.engine.{engine}` overrides to the app-level history trimmer, resolved engine → local → global → env. `auto` now sizes the budget from the merged engine and model launch config so an engine-wide `ctx_size` default no longer leaves the trimmer off. (`2dc681a`)
- Registered the family app in Core's plugin manifest with a compiled UI fixture, builtin plugin entry, seed row, and dev script. (`927772e`)
- Added a built-in consent server exposing consent.connect_app and consent.install_plugin, dispatched as client-rendered requests that validate input and tell the model to end its turn until the user replies. ACP tool names are normalized by title or input shape, and the MCP catalog supplies the server-derived fields used for trust tiers. (`8969044`)
- Added the code node kind to workflows and wired it through the executor and workflow builder to the new ryu-code-runner crate, adding that crate as a dependency. (`7c339d2`)
- Added validation for the new `contributes.agent_profile_tabs` manifest point, checking that each tab names a companion runnable in the same manifest, and served enabled entries from `/api/plugins/contributions`. Added a calendar UI fixture for the manifest tests. (`e6f8c75`)
- Added per-conversation, per-provider-family prompt-cache warmth tracking with TTL countdowns for Anthropic and OpenAI, fed by both the ACP and OpenAI-compat planes. Added the opt-in context.compact-on-cache-expire path that compacts the short-term replay and starts a fresh native session. (`8b910d8`)
- Updated Core's control-plane sidecar and PI configuration to use the live free-model list, with Core Free tags served from /api/own-supply/free-models and the updated seed behavior. (`2279585`)
- Updated core's pi-config module and Cargo manifest to support the unified Ryu Router provider and migrated saved model selections. (`4765fb9`)
- Added the continuity workspace routes, a blob store with TTL sweep, an idempotent resume record, a continued_on column and summary field, and corresponding OpenAPI entries. (`4503704`)
- Managed tier configuration now exposes ryu-&lt;tier>/{lite,standard,max} model ids that map to the upstream models. (`a7a4f50`)
- Patrol was added as a Core built-in bot seeded installed with the approval_required safety profile, bundled instructions and an ryu_api/memory/notify allowlist, with hourly and daily report jobs seeded on boot; a runs_on_ryu_engine hook covers bots borrowing Ryu's engine, and the marketplace Patrol package and its bundle entry were removed. (`cc2162f`)
- Added built-in challenges.list, challenges.get and challenges.submit MCP tools that call the control plane with the signed-in device-flow session, with submit gated behind user approval and refused when the approval engine is unavailable. (`c6ace03`)
- Added managed rows for the vertex, openai-credits and anthropic-credits pools with tier-namespaced model ids that the router maps to the matching gateway slot and strips before the upstream call. (`02dbb50`)
- Extended the marketplace store asset tests to cover the new Patrol agent package. (`53c5817`)
- Core gained script-node execution in the Deno sandbox with checkpointed agent() fan-out, automatic resume with a durable two-attempt budget, limit parking, delegation retry, a manual continue route, and OpenAPI entries. (`26d2ff6`)
- Added a chat_checkpoints table and a capture hook that snapshots the chat folder before each user turn, along with endpoints to list checkpoints, diff a checkpoint, and restore code, conversation or both. Conversation rewinds move the active leaf to the turn's parent and drop pooled ACP sessions and resume bindings, and node backups exclude chat checkpoints. (`4a32bd7`)
- Added endpoints for per-model sampling config, node-level inference presets with read-only built-ins, and a sampling-fields report. Overrides resolve in the order agent, engine, model, then request across local and cloud routes. (`227083d`)
- Registered the Polite Prompts plugin in Core's embed table, manifest catalog, and CORE_PLUGINS as install-on-demand, and updated the replacement note to Rewritten prompt sent. (`ab4ec80`)
- Added the Video Drama Studio production-crew workflow template to the Core catalog and marketplace store, covering brief, story bible, casting, script revisions, production plans, shot manifest, agent-led production and edit, and executive-producer sign-off. (`0aeb19b`)
- Added a `report_usage` action to the ACP tool broker and a ryu-mcp Pi extension that reports each assistant message's token and prompt-cache usage, which Core sums per turn and folds into the turn-end usage frame when the agent reported none. (`5a6c1e9`)
- Added the agent_inbox built-in tools (get, check_address, create, set_address) that call the hosted mail routes with the node's org gateway key and scope each call to the calling agent's own inbox. create and set_address are approval-gated through AGENT_INBOX_MUTATION_ACTIONS. (`d46596a`)
- The workflow executor now supports a per-node repeat policy with per-pass checkpointing, per-pass idempotency keys, agent conversations and child run ids, loop template tokens, graph validation rules and a 100-pass cap. (`115c158`)
- Added workspace trust and agent sandbox modules and wired them into startup, the server, and the ACP adapter. Untrusted workspaces reject permission-skipping session modes and unreadable shell requests, trust is stored in the trusted-workspaces preference, and worktree inheritance is checked against git's back-link. (`cb30d82`)
- ConversationStore now remembers conversations still running before boot reconciliation and, once sidecars and the Gateway are up, re-runs each last user turn through the shared rerun_request_from_history and spawn_detached_chat_turn path. A new run_auto_resume table caps automatic resumes at two per user turn, and turns older than 7 days, Safe Mode, the Kill Switch, or a lapsed entitlement are skipped. (`8b5be21`)
- Updated the sidecar adapter module so llama.cpp's cache_n cache count is read and reported in usage stats. (`fcc3c45`)
- Core's contributions endpoint now serves data-only contributes.interfaces entries from enabled plugins on the same path as backgrounds, while Bot and Console stay host-only. (`cda6d8c`)
- Catalog sources and the core server now project a single `deprecated: { message?, replacement? }` shape for cards, detail pages, the `/api/apps` list, the marketplace index and the hosted catalog. (`c1cc4cc`)
- The scheduler tracks app-owned jobs through JobTarget::AppJob with per-provider reconcile, hop timeouts and reply caps; legacy {type:"monitor"} targets load through a serde shim and are normalized in place at startup, and job and approval endpoints omit app_job rows unless include=app_jobs. (`4a34879`)
- Added the bridge-only safeActions.request, webhooks.secretGet and webhooks.secretSet methods gated by the app grant and the verified user's permission; self_api now denies /api/plugins/*/host, and server::kernel_op holds the shared error type and reply decoder. (`b76dc63`)
- Added a Core-side gate for requests marked x-ryu-web-delegation that runs before the permission check, registration/wake gate and body buffer, and requires a verified caller on an org-bound node, a permission-annotated route, a web-capable target app and a named calling app holding app:http or app:http:&lt;target>. (`88fc9cb`)
- Updated the mcp.callTool pin rationale in app_mcp_call.rs: the pin stands even with a consent label because the label does not describe a user-less credential read. (`93cca93`)
- Added POST /api/chat/prediction and the composer predictions server module, with model routing factored into shared side_generate and plugin_enabled helpers. The chat suggestions module, shipped portable loader runtime test, and OpenAPI spec were updated alongside it. (`cb42c9f`)
- Refreshed the workflows UI fixture and updated plugin seeding to match the new workflows manifest. (`fb35cd5`)
- Added `run_failures` to raise `core#run.failed` from the run-status bus, the scheduler's agent failure arm and `workflow::executor::fail_run`, and reworked `server::app_runs` to expose the approval, rerun-agent and workflow-rerun kernel capabilities. Removed `healing_client.rs` and `CoreHealingHost` plus the bootstrap manifest machinery. (`921428b`)
- Moved the warmup composites into `server::app_warmup`, exposing `warmup.detect`, `warmup.list`, `warmup.apply` and `warmup.runNow` as kernel capability rows for sidecars and as host-bridge methods for Companions under the existing `warmup:crud` grant, with app-scoped job access and plan validation before deletion. (`37e4e33`)
- Moved the inbound-webhook registry and ingress status into server::app_webhooks and exposed them as the webhooks.list and webhooks.ingressStatus kernel capabilities and host-bridge methods, gated by the existing webhooks:crud grant. The GET webhook and ingress status routes now answer from the same functions. (`652eab7`)
- Pi model suggestions now follow the openai-codex catalog in Pi 1.0, which dropped gpt-5.4 and gpt-5.4-mini and defaults to gpt-6.1-sol. The first suggestion is used only when a provider is set up without a model, so saved selections in models.json are unchanged. (`7315503`)
- ryu-mcp.ts now discovers Gateway image models from /v1/models with modality image at session start and registers them as Pi image models under ryu-gateway-images. Generation calls POST /v1/images/generations with the Gateway provider's resolved auth and routing headers. (`6dcc596`)
- Updated Core's quests, monitors and meetings clients to consume the capabilities those apps now provide instead of per-app loopback shims. (`d147e7b`)
- Added a linked_pull_requests column and a POST /api/conversations/:id/pull-requests endpoint so a chat can hold several pull requests. Registered the autoAddressPullRequestComments and autoArchiveClosedPullRequestChats governance settings and exposed them in the OpenAPI description. (`a951b97`)
- Registered the Steel, Kernel and Browser Use browser.control providers in the builtin plugin code and added shipped-grant runtime coverage for their adapter bodies. (`5d39212`)
- Added core support for serving plugin-contributed avatar accessories and styles, including manifest handling, catalog surfaces, agent records, and the enabled-gated server endpoint. (`2cd5518`)
- Added the jay-jr registry entry and seeded agent row with its instructions, avatar, and narrow tool allowlist, bundled the jiaweing.com knowledge snapshot with a KNOWLEDGE_VERSION refresh path, imported it once into a user-owned Space for background embedding without re-creating a deleted Space, and scoped the ACP tool broker grant to Jay Jr.'s agent id. (`c558d57`)
- Added POST /api/cloud/web-search, which forwards a web.search query to the gateway's /v1/web/search with the node's relay credential, and registered a compiled-in @ryu/cloud-search manifest as a selectable provider that is pre-installed but not default. Node relay credentials are now issued with gateway.inference and gateway.web.search. (`071f2e9`)
- Added a sidecar event fan-out that delivers events to enabled manifest subscribers through the external proxy, with bounded per-subscriber queues, a global concurrency cap of 4, and one retry on transient failure. Added the allowlisted kernel emit path for `core#` events, gated kernel subscriptions at delivery time, and replaced the Meetings and Quests subscribe loops with an optional `activity` hint on `events.emit`. (`bf0ab70`)
- Added `call_capability_raw` for non-JSON capability replies and `subscribe_capability`, which opens an SSE stream of `CapabilityEvent` frames over the existing binding resolution, registration gate, and provider token without reconnecting itself. Tests cover SSE framing across chunks, provider restart and resubscribe, disabled, missing, and unregistered providers, and a non-2xx refusal, with the fixture provider moved into a shared test_support module. (`7eae69f`)
- Core resolves a sandbox mode per sidecar, surfaces a status record as SidecarStatus.sandbox on /api/sidecar/status, and makes enforce-mode start failures and confined crashes report the sandbox and how to switch modes; the plugin manifest schema, capability consumer, external proxy, sidecar manager, process spawn paths and sidecar module were wired accordingly. (`6ef30b3`)
- Updated the plugin manifest test fixture to match the finetune Companion's app.request routing. (`7d43d90`)
- Added `ryu-core acp` dispatch ahead of every other mode switch so stdout only carries protocol frames, resolving the listener and token file through Core's own profile and path logic. (`8dd47bf`)
- Added version probing and enforcement for command tool binaries, run before argv, proxy, or spawn with a scrubbed environment and a path/size/mtime cache. Manifest validation now requires egress_url_arg tools to declare it, and Spider pins spider_cli to 2.53.9. (`301b4ab`)
- Added per-platform sidecar bundle installation with SHA-256 verification, safe tar.gz extraction, bin/&lt;command>.d/ staging, and entrypoint spawning in Core. (`cc93443`)
- The A2A module gained card signing and card asset routes, including /a2a-card/icon.svg and /a2a-card/jwks.json, with signing tied to the fleet identity key and peer card verification wired into fleet discovery. (`182dcb3`)
- Added `CapabilityConsumer::call_capability` in `sidecar::capability_consumer` plus `provider_target` and `post_to_provider` in `ext_proxy`, and a declared `/` provider route now maps to the bare mount. (`1f170b4`)
- Added egress broker and Spider runtime tests and wired the broker into the server. (`9cae048`)
- Removed the Deno sidecar runtime and Core's Deno installer, pointed the plugin host and tool-build paths at the new in-process JS backend, and updated the core environment example and offline test bootstrap. (`4251a61`)
- Added the live turn adapter with a compacted replay log and a durable turn driver so persisted turns stream on a detached task, the resume endpoint replays from the first chunk and then follows live, and cancel stops durable non-ACP/A2A turns. (`a633994`)
- Plugin updates snapshot the previous manifest, bundled UI code, channel pin and provenance, POST /api/plugins/:id/rollback restores it, and a new plugin_update hook phase runs after an update or rollback with from/to versions. (`869ce7c`)
- Added parsing and enforcement of the `engines.host_api` floor in the plugin manifest code, checked at both load and install time. (`9f2bc76`)
- The plugin host now surfaces `host.log` output from hooks and runs a per-hook circuit breaker, wired through the server module. (`b0b822d`)
- Plugin and portable-package enable now asks the control plane for the caller's license status and refuses refunded, disputed, or expired licenses with 402. A remembered active answer is honored for seven days while offline, and install seeds the cache. (`1d5bb46`)
- The A2A Agent Card now uses the control-plane org the node is registered to as provider, omitted when unregistered. Inbound URL parts are fetched through the SSRF-guarded HTTPS client with count, size, time, and textual media-type limits and framed inside the untrusted input block; anything else stays an unfetched reference. (`e5aa407`)
- Enforced plugin revocation and required trust levels at host-access seams in the LSP, app extension and server module paths. (`7219095`)
- Bound plugin trust to the loaded manifest and added a local revocation list across the plugin isolation, lifecycle and module code. (`0d12e8e`)
- A custom Agent catalog source with a base_url now resolves as an AgentRegistrySource, using SSRF-guarded and body-capped fetches without a buyer bearer. Installs from it are gated on fail-closed manifest signature verification like the first-party marketplace. (`b51d452`)
- Registered the `mxc` backend in the sandbox catalog registry behind a Windows-only gate and added it to the sandbox MCP tool description. (`99602b8`)
- The model optimizer now ignores non-chat catalog rows, keeping media-only catalog entries discovered for the Gateway out of the chat model list. (`25aa44b`)
- Added GET /api/memory/reflect for 7d, 30d and 90d windows plus GET and PATCH /api/memory/reflect/settings, backed by a shared usage_review::collect_review that carries the opt-in gate, caller visibility filter and exclusions. Reflect quiet hours now hold back the automatic Dream review, and break nudges are stored only. (`ca0353a`)
- ExpressiveSpec now stores avatar costume data opaquely alongside colors, so saved costumes persist through the agent store. A roundtrip test covers the new field. (`8878301`)
- Added the vault module covering environments, folders, versioning, policies, approvals, audit chaining, leases, transit, PKI, SSH, dynamic credentials, machine identities, import/export, scanning and snapshots, with new vault and vault-engine HTTP routes and OpenAPI. Also added control-plane shared-value proxying for managed nodes and a policy test fixture.
- Scope defaults at every level now persist coordinator overrides for main threads next to the thread values, with the node-wide global scope stored between the project and lane default; main threads read coordinator values when any level sets one and fall back to thread values otherwise. (`66f067d`)
- Extended PUT /api/hierarchy/threads/:id/project to accept spawned_by_conversation_id so callers can record the spawning conversation. (`8f51397`)
- Made threads.send_message_to_thread echo the session title and bot so session cards can label themselves. (`323ec35`)
- Added app-agnostic conversation hierarchy primitives for project IDs, main and session roles, project, agent, and group owners, group coordination, and spawn lineage, enforcing one main thread per project and owner. Added per-scope model defaults with a pair-wise cascade at turn time, project-keyed memory, REST endpoints under /api/hierarchy and /api/scope-defaults, and host capabilities for main threads, project placement, and scope defaults, plus seeding for the pre-installed Projects app. (`1b2df0f`)
- Core gained canonical routing strategy support across server configuration, OAuth pool policy and usage, and SDK and session account routing with quota handling, along with quota-specific test files. Native Qoder CLI and Qoder API transport and custody paths were added under the Pi config and server modules. (`70ffd50`)
- Added a native_accounts module under pi_config for Kiro account storage and exposed those accounts through server/native_accounts.rs and the OpenAPI schema. The ACP sidecar adapter now resolves the native account when resuming a session. (`c997f41`)
- Added voice WebSocket and protocol handling to save ended calls and support ringback while a call is connecting. (`01570f0`)
- Added server-side cloud environment settings with GitHub connection handling, a cloud GitHub transport, cloud task records, and an MCP cloud adapter. (`b3a0123`)
- Added the usage history subsystem, including provider API and export adapters, retained session scanning, a persistent store, durable import operations, and HTTP routes wired into the server and OpenAPI spec. (`f4f87d9`)
- Plugin host and plugin bridge API now dispatch view.action intents to a plugin's view_action hooks instead of returning 501. (`ac6601f`)
- Core now derives a model from Ollama launch settings and routes proxy and gateway requests to it with a degraded-status fallback, and evals, security sweeps and online scoring use the agent or node default model instead of gpt-4o-mini. (`c311f37`)
- Added the Jakub Krehel skill pack to the skills catalog and marked it as featured in onboarding state. (`3b026c2`)
- Catalog update checks now query Docker Hub and PyPI for versions when sources are Docker or Pip. Docker and PyPI lookup modules were added and wired into the catalog. (`92a66ec`)
- Added the agent optimizer API under /api/agents/:id/optimizations with get, analyze, apply, and dismiss endpoints, plus server module and OpenAPI wiring. (`f998442`)
- Registered the decision-model layer in the plugin manifest and builtin plugin list, and exposed decision-model capabilities through the plugin binding and MCP capability tools. (`2a729b1`)
- Added streaming availability state to the presence and notification modules, with get and put streaming settings routes exposed through the presence API and recorded in the OpenAPI spec. (`10e0422`)
- Added dev execution handling and main-core wiring so development executions remain alive across reloads. (`c18462d`)
- Added the Core server route and OpenAPI entry backing semantic page find. (`78e05ce`)
- Registered the Forms app in the core plugin manifest, built-in plugin list, and plugin seed data. (`a0e55bc`)
- Changed sidecar onboarding and the stable-diffusion-cpp provider downloader so AI Resize defaults to the local image model. (`2b617fd`)
- The image search proxy now accepts a page parameter and reports has_more for paginated results. (`9cc6739`)
- Added media server routes and module wiring in Core to support generative image resize. (`4db080a`)
- Added a monitors client and a usage MCP tool to the core sidecar, registering the tool in the MCP catalog. (`40c492a`)
- Added desktop presence tracking with a 150-second TTL through PUT and GET /api/presence, and made ACP elicitations and the new ask_user bridge tool return immediately while the user is unavailable. Added opt-in game detection and a model pause that stops local sidecars and an external Ollama until the game closes. (`448a4db`)

- Changed the local sidecar onboarding and SD.cpp provider paths to default to Qwen Image 2.1. (`c6faf41`)

The isolation module was split into digest.rs, policy.rs and tests.rs with public paths re-exported. (`1f9ce23`)

- Changed the server module to tear down the Tailscale Funnel as soon as another webhook ingress is selected while the mesh daemon runs, rather than waiting for the next daemon restart. (`446eeb0`)
- Changed the ext proxy WebSocket ticket test to derive its app id from the provider manifest instead of a literal constant. (`15ec98b`)
- Added a test asserting that every versioned tailscale/tailscaled name and the TAILSCALE_VERSION clone tag in release.yml match TAILSCALE_TARGET_VERSION in the sidecar downloader, so a version bump cannot drift between the two. (`0411363`)
- parse_status_json now reports nodeKey {expiry, expired} from Self.KeyExpiry and a tailnetLock value, and Core supplies the lock answer from 'tailscale lock status --json' cached for 60s because status --json omits it. (`7e56884`)
- ensure_funnel now mounts only the webhook public paths with 'funnel --bg --set-path' instead of publishing the whole Core port, clears any previous serve config and rolls back on partial failure, and turns Funnel off on stop or when the daemon starts with a non-Funnel ingress. funnel_url no longer appends Core's port since Funnel serves on 443. (`d9d237e`)
- Enrollment now passes --ssh=false and, once the daemon is reachable, reads RunSSH from 'tailscale debug prefs' and disables it with 'tailscale set --ssh=false' or refuses to continue. Core also logs an error when running as euid 0 with the mesh enabled and warns when an adopted client is below MIN_SAFE_TAILSCALE 1.98.9. (`260fde9`)
- Daemon spawn arguments were extracted into daemon_spawn_args so the argv can be tested. (`234278a`)
- A failure to chmod the mesh directory to 0700 now stops the mesh from starting with a clear error instead of logging a warning and continuing. (`f332aea`)
- Added tailscale::daemon_active(), true when the daemon runs or the mesh is enabled with a Tailscale or Headscale backend, and ORed it into forwarding_tunnel_active() so loopback peers are no longer treated as trusted while the mesh daemon runs. (`2587910`)
- Push token listing now decrypts at-rest token ciphertext before approval fan-out and skips tokens that cannot be opened. The contested-level ACL test was aligned with ownership rules, and owner-authorization lookups were boxed so the dispatch future stays within a 2 MiB worker stack. (`7d53e31`)
- Merged the ACL, vault, activity, approvals, plugin manifest and secrets, and sidecar changes, keeping both sides and taking the stricter rule where they overlapped, including the platform-admin gate, shared-budget reserve scope and server-transfer admin floor. (`8ec85c1`)
- Replaced the serde_yml shim with noyalib 0.0.58 used directly through its serde_yaml compatibility module, updating the import, plugin-eval, space-portable and skills-tool paths plus the manifest and lockfile. (`0c6c7a3`)
- Vault routes that Core proxies now accept the forwarded Better Auth JWT on vault management and the GitHub token route, and return a coded 403 org_access_not_in_session with remediation when the token carries no claim for the node's org. (`33f8c70`)
- Work-in-progress checkpoint touching approvals, identity verification, the vault API, shared vault code and the org GitHub cloud-environment route as part of Core-forwarded JWT resolution. (`d862598`)
- Regenerated all 40 embedded companion UI fixture bundles so the shipped single-file UIs carry the patched zod, dompurify, mermaid, katex and vite output. (`2787ac3`)
- Adopted zip 9.1.0 with SimpleFileOptions and the pure-Rust zlib-rs deflate backend across backups, portable packages, space imports and the download managers. Moved the MCP bridge to rmcp 2.2.0, changing Content to ContentBlock, and switched jsonwebtoken to 10.4.0 with the single aws_lc_rs backend. (`9ea0295`)
- Routed screening, typed rejections and safety refusals through the sidecar gateway and tool execution paths, added a node screener and a llama.cpp provider guard, and updated the fal, Replicate and OpenRouter credential modules along with the plugin manifest and registry. (`221e088`)
