- approvals.view and approvals.decide were added to the built-in owner and admin permission sets, approval-derived activity items are filtered on every activity read path, and approval titles in push notifications go only to tokens whose owner may view approvals. Core also forwards only real user JWTs through the vault API. (`16ad37e`)
- Annotation item assign and submit now apply the conversation ACL and answer not-found like get, list, next and export, instead of returning an item the caller cannot read through its conversation. (`f3dd1bf`)
- The embedded Pull Requests companion bundle was rebuilt against the current shared-package lock, leaving the other 39 companion bundles byte-identical. (`bfd37ea`)
- Hardened Core access control: the node key is attached to shared-vault requests only for local callers admitted with the node owner token, contested ACL permission levels keep deny-direction edges, parent org IP allowlists are still enforced for node-mediated vault resolution, and the approvals channel now distinguishes permission-check outages from refusals. (`6e72fae`)
- Annotation queue items are deleted with their conversation and queues with their agent, and list/get/next/export omit items whose source conversation the caller cannot read. The local prompt registry seals description, template, messages, model config and commit message in prompt-registry.db with a legacy seal-on-open pass, and a feed exceeding the page limit is mirrored without pruning rather than failing the snapshot. Captured span input/output is sealed through an injected ContentSealer, legacy plaintext is sealed at boot, and stored payloads are cleared when capture is off. (`80f7022`)
- Checkpoint changes to the server module, vault API and shared vault code as part of a work-in-progress third pass of authorization fixes; reviews are pending. (`d57a616`)
- Applied the second pass of RBAC/ABAC fixes in Core: ACL vocabulary and deny-side edit ceiling, vault change-request expiry and re-check, protected first-party plugin manifest namespaces, and approval and ext-proxy streams bound to authorization lifetime. (`4485da7`)
- Made fail-closed changes across server routes, webhook ingress, sidecar MCP and Composio clients, vault card items, the safe actions store, RAG host and path handling. The plan extension and autoresearch workflow template were updated with their tests. (`21f287f`)
- Core's dependencies were re-resolved for p256 and p384 0.14, and the fleet host status and vault transit modules were carried through the merge. (`3970ebe`)
- The vault transit engine moved p256/p384 to 0.14, dropping crypto-bigint 0.5. Stored keys remain PKCS#8 DER, exports remain SPKI and PKCS#8 PEM with LF endings, and DER signatures are unchanged, checked byte for byte against fixed openssl-generated keys. (`d5853cb`)
- Refreshed the ryu-core Cargo lockfile alongside the ctutils 0.4.5 dependency bump. (`b73b73e`)
- Organization policy handling now refuses member self-loosening of admin-set user policy, with the sidecar adapter layer and gateway tool member layer tests updated to cover the new authorization checks. (`abe439c`)
- Host status now derives the boot time from sysinfo(2) rather than reporting a 1970 boot time when ProcSubset=pid hides /proc/stat. (`cdbdbed`)
- Core now injects PIP_CONSTRAINT into every plugin sidecar environment so installs a sidecar runs itself honour the pip Brotli floor, and pip_security_constraints_path returns io::Result so create and write failures surface instead of running pip against a missing file. The vllm, sglang, mlx, mlx-vlm and omlx installers now remediate already-installed engines through a content stamp of the constraints file, and a guard test keeps pip install arguments inside external_runtime.rs. (`9ea6c54`)
- Pip installs for the mlx, mlx_vlm, omlx, sglang and vllm sidecar providers now route through pip_install_package_args, applying the new pip-security-constraints.txt with Brotli security constraints. The conflict in the mlx_vlm installer kept the mlx-vlm==0.7.8 pin while adding those constraints. (`6a5f54d`)
- Core now collects host patch state (reboot pending, kernel, pending security updates, last apt run, updater result) and reports it to the control plane on a six-hour cadence. (`087b149`)
- Regenerated all 40 embedded companion UI fixtures under plugin_manifest after the shared package hashes drifted. (`988dc32`)
- Re-derived the standalone Cargo.lock with sync-standalone-locks.sh so it resolves wasmtime 48.0.7. No Rust source changed in this commit. (`f0bd07b`)
- Added a shared pip constraints file pinning Brotli to 1.2.1 or newer and brotlicffi to 1.2.1.0 or newer, and passed it on every Core-managed pip install for manifest external runtime provisioning and the mlx, mlx_vlm, omlx, sglang and vllm engine installers. (`bc671c1`)
- Checkpointed in-progress authorization work across ACL, identity verification permissions, org policy, plugin secrets, approvals and vault APIs, websocket tickets, sidecar adapters and the vault policy modules, with vault policy test fixtures updated. Review and integration were still pending. (`94a7b68`)
- Updated the core Rust lockfile to wasmtime and cranelift 48.0.7 to address the October 2026 advisories. (`f4b5f95`)
- Regenerated the 40 embedded companion UI fixture bundles under the plugin manifest directory and cleared the stale release fixtures gate. (`6259a39`)
- Core's Treg tool caller id was changed from an @ryu/ app-id constant to ryu-core-agent. (`05058fc`)
- Core now sends a WebSocket Ping every 25 s on the shared voice connection so the automatic Pong resets the 60 s liveness timer, keeping a healthy muted call alive. A half-open peer is still torn down. (`32b5bdf`)
- Applied import-order fixes to the ryu-plan pi extension and rustfmt to server/mod.rs as part of the audit-validation cleanup. (`a95cb71`)
- The Pi auth slot test now writes the slot directly, the catalog card count includes deepseek and just-bash, Shadow fakes report sealing and answer the peer-proof health probe, and a mcp/mod.rs comment that split the passport source-scan test was reworded. (`014c0da`)
- Changed dev execution and the server core identity module as part of the in-progress security remediation snapshot. (`137f2db`)
- Core entry point and server core identity code were modified in the in-progress audit remediation snapshot; the changes are not finalized. (`900012b`)
- Members can no longer route STT or TTS through the node's Gateway engine, explicitly or via the node default. Voice sockets must send a start frame within 10 seconds, and the receive loop ends a call after 60 seconds without an inbound frame. (`74c40f6`)
- Touched the core sidecar's ext_proxy module during an in-progress audit remediation snapshot. (`22fc48b`)
- The fleet module, the spaces backlinks test and the sidecar external proxy were touched in an in-progress audit remediation snapshot. (`85b0971`)
- The ACP inference proxy now keeps an agent's signed provider_access list when it re-signs a bearer, folds that list into the cache key, spawn key and owner binding, and still fails closed when it cannot re-sign. Subscription cloud routing, cloud task API and provider routing were updated, subscription_not_configured notices are no longer deduped, and tool-not-servable responses were consolidated into a single 403. (`d5066b4`)
- Touched core safe-actions modules and routes, conversations and server wiring, sidecar capability consumption and the extension proxy, webhook ingress, and the ryu-plan Pi extension. The commit records an in-progress state pending verification. (`113293c`)
- Voice config now carries the member caller alongside the user JWT and agent authorization, and keeps the agent-run enforcement in place of the duplicate ACL block. The member call slot is taken before the conversation claim so a refused call claims nothing. (`deb3a68`)
- Applied the review fixes across the core runtime: dev scripts, the sealed activity store, approvals and the exfiltration guard, auth, plugin host bridges and manifests, sidecar MCP and provider adapters, workflow execution, history and notifications, session box, and subscription cloud APIs, each with matching tests. (`1cc077c`)
- Updated rustls-webpki to 0.103.16 and webpki-roots to 1.0.10 in the core lockfile. (`0c10d21`)
- Snapshot of in-progress remediation across the server routes for conversations, core identity, recommendations and space imports, the sidecar extension proxy and Composio MCP modules, webhook ingress, the ryu-plan extension and the autoresearch template. Not verified. (`f5cb5be`)
- Conflict resolutions from merging the security-audit checkpoint into main landed across core, including the data path, safe-actions store, conversation and recommendation routes, sidecar capability consumer and extension proxy, and webhook ingress. (`3a960fa`)
- Updated the core OpenAPI import module and Cargo dependencies during the merge. (`0588629`)
- Carried broad core changes spanning durable workflow execution, history, store, templates, auto-resume, notify_user and script nodes, the annotation queue API, space imports and connectors with HTML-to-Markdown conversion, harness and memory endpoints, trace and upload routes, MCP space and working-memory tools, telemetry, privacy and the RAG host. (`b1b04f3`)
- Scaled the ACP admission eviction grace to the admission slot count, letting a queued turn evict any idle instance after twice the grace. Scheduled agent runs in their own fresh conversation now close their ACP instances when the run ends. (`1d9cceb`)
- Work in progress touches the Core server voice and voice WebSocket handlers as part of the member voice call capping effort. (`7667232`)
- Work in progress hardens Core voice admission across the voice handlers, WebSocket ticket handling, sidecar handled-turn adapter and voice session module. (`4831c56`)
- Work-in-progress change admitting managed members to voice mode at chat-level privilege across the server, voice WebSocket and ticket modules; the commit message states it is not compiled or security-reviewed and should not be merged. (`0f7fff2`)
- Kept the per-Space write check and guarded upsert alongside #792's metadata validation, routed RAG and Spaces reads and writes through the sealed stores, and made working memory delete along with conversations. The server, workflow, scheduler, sidecar, and plugin manifest fixture files were reconciled through the merge. (`dac9704`)
- ACP admission now spares instances that have only just gone idle, admits queued turns first come first served, and ends an instance's eviction permit atomically with returning its slot. Spawns are logged with their reason, including evicted, exited, key changed, stale capability or grant, and unpooled. (`08c04af`)
- Merged changes to the ACP runtime and the MCP sidecar module from the cx23 benchmark rerun branch. (`f3c604a`)
- ACP auto-cap and the low-memory reaper now read the tightest cgroup memory limit and the least headroom on Core's cgroup path instead of host RAM. MCP discovery skips a server for 15 seconds, doubling to 60, after a list timeout, and any successful listing or server-map rebuild ends the backoff. (`4d68356`)
- The shipped portable loader runtime test was updated accordingly. (`ef73cc1`)
- Moved the "no automatic downloads" refusal into the shared Needle runtime used by Needle 2 and 3, so a skipped local stack falls back to BM25 before any library or router weight download. Onboarding sidecar and main entrypoint code were adjusted for the changed runtime. (`ca0dfd1`)
- Updated the gateway sidecar, MCP capability and Composio modules, catalog source and Tauri registry catalog, provider router and OpenAPI import to work with the revised tool catalog and Connect contracts. (`53d1e5f`)
- Reworked the ACP inference proxy and sidecar ACP adapter so bearer credentials are refreshed, with the Pi config, server module and sidecar gateway updated to match. (`fdef24e`)
- The engine start path now resolves launch arguments before any download, applies the engine launch config, and refuses models that do not fit the per-node image tiers or available RAM. The sdcpp downloader kept the Wan frame-model companions, the llama.cpp variant and mesh installer were updated, and catalog, registry, plugin bridge, media and memory-dream paths were adjusted to the hardware-aware defaults. (`9122048`)
- Cleaned up the ACP inference proxy and sidecar ACP adapter to satisfy clippy, using a smaller refusal type and character pushes. (`7512532`)
- Added a Treg tool route alongside the Composio equivalents map, with provider pins, the provider router, main entrypoint and Treg catalog updated to direct Treg requests. (`c93ea86`)
- Closed provider-pin bypasses by normalizing the tool id before the pin decision and forwarding that id. A Composio-pinned builtin call Composio cannot serve is now refused, and rerouted agent calls forward agent, user, and session with the same authentication as /v1/budget/charge so the Treg debit is attributed. (`032109a`)
- Plugin MCP servers now start in their package directory, with the MCP stdio spawn keeping Ghost's per-call seal environment while also setting that working directory. Framework import, the recipes host, and the MCP bridge and client were updated to support the just-bash plugin. (`1008b60`)
- Hardened local Codex plan sessions: limits hit in the first turn now fall back before start, retried stream errors no longer fail a run, and user config and rules are ignored with web search disabled so config.toml cannot widen the sandbox. Added tests for the local-run behavior. (`5268418`)
- Attribute background model spend, kept prompt prefixes cache-stable, and ran independent requests concurrently across routing, streaming, and workflow paths. The audit_log insert now names both new columns, cache_write_1h_tokens and purpose, with 42 placeholders and both values bound so audit writes keep working. (`f52b90f`)
- Hardened the ACP inference proxy: raw gws1 pass-through is refused while a tunnel forwards loopback traffic, reused instances are marked busy before their turn is queued, pooled instances are reused only with an hour of grant left, and the probe cache is invalidated on authenticate and logout. Unpooled chats no longer redeem or warn on their session-bound bearer, and the doubled-key fixture was corrected. (`df2f4d2`)
- Adjusted identity verification permissions in the core app to carry the Messaging branch merge. (`8918d18`)
- Added an exfiltration guard in the approvals module that places an agent-level hold on programmatic tool calls, wired through agent execution, tool execution and the MCP sidecar. A runtime test covers the guard. (`5678e6e`)
- Added a reviewed Composio-to-Treg equivalents table covering nine Composio Search actions, plus the routing that sends agents' public-data actions to the Treg equivalents behind a flag. Provider pins are honored on either brand. (`d9fec13`)
- Pooled Pi and OpenAI-compatible ACP agents now redeem their Core-signed Gateway bearer for a per-instance credential and carry a placeholder in the spawn command, so the pool key stays stable across bearer remints instead of respawning the agent. A new /api/acp/inference/v1 proxy resolves the credential to its scope and forwards to the local Gateway with the current cached bearer, accepting loopback only, a fixed endpoint allowlist, an allowlisted header set, and only while the instance is in a turn. (`48ce7a6`)
- Added a local Codex exec path plus routing, store and API changes for subscription cloud sessions in Core's cloud task and subscription cloud endpoints. The work is marked WIP and pending review. (`bec7fec`)
- Registered DeepSeek Search as a web.search and web.extract provider in the plugin manifest and builtin plugin list, with a local glyph fallback for icon coverage. Runtime tests cover the shipped grants and web capabilities. (`aa5521b`)
- Synced the app-local Cargo.lock with the root lockfile after the changes from #782. (`6764107`)
- Updated the core lockfile alongside the merge carrying the Tailscale installation security changes. (`d92c2d6`)
- Sealed-store support was threaded through Core, including a new activity sealed store, profile-field resealing with the bearer account-id scrub, sealing of refreshed app-agent system prompts, and sealed Codex auth.json custody. RAG keeps the caller-id ownership guard and places vectors only for rows the guarded write changed, conversation deletion clears sealed residue while still releasing cloud tasks, and the conversation, scheduler, approval, backup, usage-history and workflow stores were updated around sealed rows. (`07be026`)
- Core now forwards the user's per-brand provider pin and requireServable to /v1/providers/call. A new flagged Composio-to-Treg agent reroute module was scaffolded with an empty equivalents table. (`9f307f7`)
- Updated the core server's conversation and harness routes for the Mastra/LangChain parity work. (`d65aa91`)
- Added prompt registry server routes in prompt_registry.rs and mounted them in the server module. The OpenAPI output was updated to describe the new endpoints. (`450ad11`)
- Added an annotation queues module and its HTTP API, registered in main and the server router. The OpenAPI schema was extended for the new endpoints. (`43b878b`)
- Added trace API and optimizer API routes with matching OpenAPI entries, a privacy module, telemetry setup, and sidecar gateway and adapter changes used by trace handling. (`d84db68`)
- Added document parsing, space import connectors with tests, HTML-to-markdown conversion, upload route changes, and corresponding OpenAPI entries. (`ea8597e`)
- Added working memory endpoints, MCP tools for spaces and working memory, and updates to the agents module, sidecar adapters, and OpenAPI spec. (`84a2e5d`)
- Added a vector store module under the RAG host and wired the core app's dependencies to it. (`b0f885c`)
- Added a retrieval expansion module and exposed it through the server routes and OpenAPI document, with the plugin host bridge updated to match. (`3f09390`)
- Reworked the workflow runtime across durable execution, executor, history, store, templates, auto-resume, script and notify-user paths. Also updated webhook ingress, scheduler and server routing, and the exposed OpenAPI surface. (`3d3caeb`)
- Fixed the server harness so live dispatch tasks are tracked per run instead of per session, preventing a queued run from starting while a replacement run is still draining. Added a unit test for the tracker. (`50e73cd`)
- Annotation queue submit now refuses to overwrite an item claimed by another reviewer until that item is submitted by its claimant or released. (`b1392f0`)
- The organization prompt mirror now resets its version history when a prompt's createdAt changes, so a prompt deleted and recreated upstream no longer serves stale content for reused version numbers. The /api/prompts routes were annotated and merged into Core's OpenAPI document. (`7783c4b`)
- Redacted exported run-trace span inputs and outputs through Core export redaction with ryu.content.truncated, rejected unknown exporter presets and non-reference credentials in preferences, and blanked inherited credential-reference env for the Core-managed Gateway. (`7ab30ad`)
- Added tests covering run-trace scope handoff through the chat planes, touching privacy, trace API, sidecar adapters, and telemetry, with rustfmt applied. (`9a34153`)
- Updated the Core server module and vault broker catalog, along with vault policy test fixtures, as part of the Interface Protocol merge. (`decdea6`)
- Documented POST /api/documents/parse and GET /api/documents/parse/jobs/{job_id} with public descriptions, replacing rustdoc comments that named internal body-limit constants and an error code the handler never returns. (`232245e`)
- Notion databases now count toward max_items alongside pages and the skipped count is recorded in the import message; an unreadable Google Drive folder is treated as a per-item failure rather than failing the whole import; and when every fetched source fails, the import error retains the fetch-time failures. (`c6f2f0b`)
- The onboarding seed no longer marks Shadow and Ghost installed when the flag is set, while installs the user starts still download. (`26dcc55`)
- Core added session Box routes with caps, idle, inference, notice and relay modules, subscription cloud accounts and routing, cloud task backends, a Treg tool and catalog, and Box desktop MCP tools. The cached inference bearer now includes a limited agent's provider list in its cache key and signed scope, and the delegate path refuses limited provider access before per-subagent Box scoping. (`1a4ce6b`)
- Aligned working-memory injection with the update tool's owner partition: the per-turn block renders in the agent's configured mode, and injection is skipped on turns whose update tool would write a different owner or on temporary chats. Added an HTTP round-trip test for GET/PUT/DELETE /api/memory/working. (`186c17b`)
- Prefixed external vector-store hit ids with `vector-store:` so rank fusion cannot fold them into memory or Space chunks, skipped the collection for 30 seconds after a failed open or query, and rejected env: references to Core's own secrets as credentials. (`99a41a3`)
- Kept the per-agent provider-access check ahead of managed provider calls and routed own-supply through the gateway's agent provider authorization. Updated catalog source, OpenAPI import, MCP capability tools and Treg catalog code. (`cd32c28`)
- Updated the permission definitions to count 40 permissions after the messaging merge. (`a00d2f8`)
- Added a data-flow classifier in approvals/exfiltration_guard.rs and per-run state in agent execution so that, once a sandbox run reads a private-data source, later egress-capable calls require Layer A approval and fail closed without an approval engine. Also added a runtime regression test for the read-then-web.extract chain. (`3af1cbb`)
- The retrieval search route now surfaces source and space_id on Space chunks so one metadata filter behaves the same on retrieval.db and delegated Space hits, and the knowledge catalog install route accepts an optional chunking strategy. (`83b52b6`)
- Kept the Identity Vault profile check in may_delegate_to and added the rule that a remote A2A peer is never within a restricted caller, reflected across ACP agent settings, agent access, sandbox, server, plugin rollback and tool execution modules. (`ad3eb64`)
- Synced Cargo.lock so Core records its ryu-openapi-import dependency and ryu-hardware matches the root lock. (`47250d5`)
- Workflow branch merges are now relative to the branch's last merge, so state written at a mid-node checkpoint and then cleared no longer resurfaces in the canonical run. Forks now refuse caller-scoped script runs and treat notify_user ack state as engine-owned, and the concurrency test's expectation for an uppercased condition output was corrected. (`ac1a29f`)
- Resolved the core merge so the self-API allows POST /api/gateway/providers/apply, which only re-applies the saved revision and writes no credential bytes. Kept the MCP-layer refusal to switch a chat to a wider agent alongside the existing check in agent_control, and threaded new arguments such as AccountConfinement and the acting user through the affected call sites and tests. (`9caf05c`)
- Updated the vault broker catalog and vault policy test fixtures for the renamed labels. (`8dd69c1`)
- Added a Treg catalog module and wired Treg tool routing into the sidecar MCP layer, catalog sources and provider router. Agent execution and server wiring were updated to use the new routing path. (`dfa5f1a`)
- The cwd spawn fixture's list result in the MCP sidecar client now carries the ttlMs and cacheScope hints required by the modern stdio protocol, so the fixture passes validation after spawning from its declared working directory. (`6224cfb`)
- Ryu core saw broad changes across the vault (broker, dynamic secrets, PKI, tokens, TOTP, and password managers), sidecar providers and tools, plugin host and manifests, server routes, workflow execution, and the skills catalog, with tests updated throughout. (`ddf18f0`)
- Added a read_only flag to DescribedTool, set only for MCP tools annotated readOnlyHint=true and not destructive, and updated the MCP bridge and catalog to support it. (`8c6edb7`)
- Core's catalog sources, MCP catalog, Composio and TREG tool surfaces, gateway sidecar and provider router were merged to resolve both service bindings and the Connect key feed. (`6c55e19`)
- Merged main's content into the core crate's files and re-applied the rename that drops the Ryu prefix from Agent, Bot and OS. The change touches the server routes, sidecar providers and tools, plugin host and manifests, vault, workflow, telemetry and skills catalog sources, with the pi-extension tests and fixtures carried over as well. (`a01db11`)
- Plugin-supplied stdio MCP servers now spawn with the installed plugin directory as their working directory, so package-relative scripts such as `node server.mjs` resolve. `register_manifest_mcp_servers` records the directory as a runtime-only `cwd` that is carried to `McpStdioCommand` and marked `serde(skip)`, leaving user `mcp.json` entries and built-ins without an on-disk package on the inherited directory. (`bf5fd08`)
- Integration routing now works per action: Treg serves only what its catalog lists as callable on the fleet token, while account-scoped endpoints and unlisted actions go to Composio. The integrations brand carries `suggested_source` and the user's `preferred_source` pin stored in the existing preferences store, and a Composio pin makes `treg.call` refuse that app's endpoints. (`36ab833`)
- Updated the Integrations Store catalog ordering to list Treg and Ryu before Composio and mark primary/alternative options. Added flag-gated treg.describe and treg.call agent tools that call Treg through the Gateway managed layer. (`02ddcf8`)
- Fixed workflow run settlement so the first suspended gate's awaiting-child link is re-asserted when a sibling branch finishes, keeping resume routing correct. (`5052f91`)
- Model catalog installs now reject too-large and insufficient-disk requests with HTTP 422 before any download starts, sizing vision quants to include their projector. (`8d0e1df`)
- Gateway-routed side-model calls are now tagged with a bounded x-ryu-purpose header and have their parsed usage logged. Compaction and handoff summaries are appended after the static system prompt rather than prepended, and the direct OpenAI-compatible stream client gained connect and idle-read timeouts so stalled streams error into failover. (`f063822`)
- Merged origin/main into the working branch, resolving conflicts across the core Rust crate: snapshot and event handling now combine main's per-node scoping, past/upcoming split, hidden-session filter and spawn-chain running lift with the branch's live inputs and helpers, and approval actions are read through the typed actionField union. The merge also carries main's ES2022 and Zod fresh-fallback fixes, the covered-page key fixes, the inert page cover with retry and unavailable states, and the vault broker catalog and policy-case fixtures. (`cdb7957`)
- Added agent account-access handling, updated app updates to apply a narrowing identity mode automatically only when the user has not chosen another mode, and kept existing app agents through bundle and fleet updates. Limited agents' macOS sandbox now denies the Keychain except for an allowed Claude Code adapter. (`4bcc549`)
- Updated shipped-package coverage pins to count the new @ryu/deepseek package and its egress grant in the portable-loader and grant-lifecycle matrices. (`32188e2`)
- Merged the ACP pool reuse branch into the core runtime, the ACP sidecar adapter and the sidecar gateway. (`a42160c`)
- Added platform gates to supported_on_node and a platform_requirement surfaced as unsupported_reason on /api/catalog, refused unsupported engines in start_sidecar and dropped them from available_local_engines. Also stopped selecting the x64 sd.cpp build on Windows arm64 and the Apple Silicon brew formula on Intel Macs. (`07893c2`)
- Simplified the ACP sidecar adapter by passing retire_pooled_instance directly to is_some_and instead of through a closure. (`7d23b1d`)
- A retired ACP instance that was superseded or held stale authority now counts as an eviction, so its replacement waits for that slot instead of evicting another chat's warm agent. Cached scoped bearers are reminted at half their 60-minute lifetime so a reused agent starts each turn with at least 30 minutes of validity, and tests cover the slot handoff and that mark_idle wakes a queued turn. (`1c3c46a`)
- Cached the Core-signed scoped inference bearer per agent, user, session and signing key until under 15 minutes remained, so pooled ACP agents are reused across turns instead of respawning each call. Superseded pooled instances are retired when a new key is spawned, admission waiters wake when an instance goes idle and re-check every 5 s, and the auto agent cap is sized from host memory and logical cores. (`71dd809`)
- Regenerated the Core lockfile with the patched TLS and QUIC dependency versions. (`e98e55a`)
- Added dev-runtime, dev-restart and dev script support plus tests, and updated dev_execution.rs, the server module, and the live-turn sidecar adapter so the development execution host can be restarted. (`33f2601`)
- Added agent access handling in core and wired it through the agents module, server and tool execution so confined agents' plugin command tools refuse paths in the user's home credential stores. (`6289b51`)
- Core now re-exports the extracted ryu-openapi-import crate as crate::openapi_import, replacing its in-tree OpenAPI parse module. (`9b28010`)
- Fetches lanes concurrently with a five-minute failure cooldown, disables the default Ryu lane for a non-HTTPS origin, and keeps basis and metered_by on Ryu rows so the store can label base prices and compare only like-for-like. (`d706825`)
- Applied the security scan patches to Core authentication, the widgets server and the sidecar egress proxy, and updated the example environment file. (`8aa68aa`)
- Kept the Core OpenAPI summary in server/mod.rs unchanged so the generated API reference would not drift. (`10b17c6`)
- Updated capability_tools.rs so each Core facade verb corresponds to a promoted capability, with GitHub and generative-media jobs landing as proposed. (`f27424e`)
- Made Core read Connect's 403 precondition_required body into a typed error and map connection outcomes to NeedsConnection with a Core-written message and no URL. The MCP adapter now returns the same elicitation envelope as the embedded path. (`0b3d91f`)
- Closed account-access escapes in the agent sandbox so limited agents can no longer reach wider accounts through routines, workflow and dashboard builders, or conversation hand-off. MCP servers, saved-key app tools and desktop control now count as the user's accounts, deferred authorization and the extension proxy require the agent's grant, and a launch-check API reports whether an agent's engine can start. (`a976834`)
- Ran rustfmt over the merged Box and plan-account code in the server module, the subscription cloud API and the MCP sidecar sandbox. (`72981b0`)
- Changed providers.call so Gateway's typed 402, 403 and 503 response bodies are passed through to app sidecars instead of being replaced with 502. (`e19f85d`)
- Fixed compile errors in plan-account routing by having backend_view probe the built-in default account and by shortening a test's temporary conversation lifetime. (`f799c2c`)
- Merged the subscription-cloud-sessions branch into cloud_tasks API, box_arm and the subscription cloud module. (`cd60fdb`)
- Made Core refuse a Codex run in a Box with no OpenAI key bound unless the caller's signed flags carry cloud_tasks.subscription_backends_hosted_openai, while allowing Claude Code with the user's own in-Box sign-in. (`ff477b4`)
- Merged the subscription cloud sessions branch, bringing in the accounts, routing, CLI, local run and store modules under server/subscription_cloud plus related cloud task API changes. (`f63eeb0`)
- Changed data-path import so an archive without a key bundle or raw key no longer restores its key check value, and restores the retired index only into a folder that has none; copy-profile now copies the source profile's keychain-custody retired keys into the target's slots and aborts before writing any file if that fails. (`b3d566b`)
- Added multi-account support for plan-backed cloud tasks: each linked Claude or ChatGPT account gets its own owner-only CLI config folder under state/plan-accounts, runs record and stay on their account, cooldowns are per account, and the sessions endpoint lists sessions across accounts. (`4fc7e03`)
- Added the messaging read and manage permissions to the identity verification permission set. (`5884e54`)
- Seed rows for pre-installed apps and manifest sidecar permission grants now carry the seal grant, so sealing apps such as Projects, Sites and Forms receive crypto:seal at install. (`0c0c28b`)
- Limited custom agents on the acp:pi engine now run on Ryu's managed, Gateway-routed Pi under their own id, with a per-agent limited config folder rebuilt on each spawn; own-identity agents start on Ryu's local model and unrestricted acp:pi agents route as before. (`c02a364`)
- Startup now imports plaintext state/skill-versions snapshots from pre-Git builds into the sealed source history, verifying each imported entry and deleting the source folder afterward. The status endpoint reports version history as unencrypted until that import finishes. (`265e622`)
- Switched the activity, learning, approvals, safe-actions, plugin-secrets, prompt-eval and space-file-index stores opened at boot to the gated vacuum call, deferring large VACUUMs to the background compaction worker under the store's connection lock. Added a guard test keeping the ungated call off the boot path. (`a558edf`)
- Changed the key probe to read the newest sealed message bodies first (then the oldest) and pass when any opens, so folders whose oldest messages use a lost key are no longer locked out. Added `keys adopt --accept-unreadable` to record a key the probe rejects. (`908599f`)
- Moved the conversation store's pending vacuum back to the ungated call so stores without a background compaction job are compacted at their next start, leaving the deferred gated path to the six boot-path owners that register a deferred job. (`ffe18f3`)
- Account access was tightened for limited and own-identity agents: self-calling engines only start when their vendor is allowed, limited agents run in the OS sandbox with the user's provider sign-ins hidden, and the self-API refuses agent writes that connect, sign in to, re-key or remove the user's accounts. Trigger events for an agent's own Composio accounts no longer reach the user's trigger rows. (`7be0d6d`)
- Data backups made before key bundles (secrets/master.key and memory.key) are now read, validated and adopted through the bundle path before any file is replaced, so the target's own key is retired rather than overwritten. Node backups seal the full key bundle in the recovery file. (`0d0e496`)
- Server module was updated as part of the merged interface branch. (`5c4f413`)
- The conversations store no longer vacuums inline while opening when it is over the size gate, handing it to a background compaction worker instead, as part of a bounded free-page scrub that zero-fills freed pages in 64 MiB chunks with a WAL truncate after each. (`8862e2a`)
- Added approval policy and tool-intent handling plus MCP agent inbox and alias tools so agents can act on the organization mailbox. (`a9b90d7`)
- Cloud task handling for the session Box was updated, including the box arm and session notices, with corresponding test coverage. (`418a3a7`)
- Merged the subscription cloud sessions branch into ryu-core, adding session Box and subscription cloud server modules, cloud task routing and the Box arm, and updating sidecar adapters, vault APIs, plugin host code and workflow modules. The merge also carried in the bundled Windows Python 3.14 runtime and vendored pip payload under core. (`b4f7dfd`)
- Added the anthropic-subscription-sdk backend in a new subscription_cloud server module covering routing, CLI invocation, local runs, the store and tests, plus the cloud task API and server wiring that select it. Each conversation runs in its own git worktree on a ryu/task-&lt;hash> branch, and the rollout default for cloud_tasks.subscription_backends stays off. (`74b02e1`)
- Reformatted the Codex transcript and canvas migration modules. (`8afc56d`)
- The managed Codex config now disables prompt history and removes an existing history.jsonl, deleting a conversation removes its Codex rollouts through the native-session binding, and rollouts older than 30 days are pruned daily. The legacy canvas import deletes each board file once its Space document is written instead of keeping a .json.migrated copy, and a startup sweep removes copies left by older builds. (`cc6abf6`)
- Hardened plan-backed cloud tasks: the prompt route is serialized per conversation until the Box binding is recorded, task text is passed after `--` so it cannot be read as a CLI flag, failure classification uses word-bounded signals and strips echoed task text, an unreadable state file fails closed, Codex tasks are adopted only when a single new task appeared since submit, and strict plan pins that cannot be honoured are refused. (`4531fdb`)
- Added anthropic-subscription-cli and openai-subscription-cli cloud-task backends that drive the node owner's signed-in `claude --cloud` and `codex cloud exec` CLIs with an allowlisted environment, with routing (session pin, per-agent order, default order, Box as last fallback), one-hour cooldown fallback on usage or rate limits, no Ryu billing or Box for plan runs, owner-only access, and the cloud_tasks.subscription_backends flag defaulting off. (`c6a6e81`)
- Registered the cloud worker interface modules in mod.rs. (`42b820a`)
- Added BoxView::minimum_waiver, and run options, ticks and the final debit now forward the signed waiver token verbatim instead of a boolean flag. (`7a945e0`)
- Formatting was applied to the checkpoint and source history changes in the data admin server code. (`3c76a9f`)
- Settings > Data "Clear chats" now releases checkpoint pins and agent transcripts in a spawned task, so a dropped request cannot strand them, and each checkpoint store is collected once instead of once per conversation. (`3ee2688`)
- BoxView.billing now carries the Box service's minimum waiver, and a session Box resume passes that verdict into RunOptions.minimum_waived, sent on every tick and on the final debit of the run segment. The session Box notice and cloud task Box arming were updated alongside, with tests. (`bd81831`)
- Refused delegate.fanout for agents restricted to some or no model providers, and limited restricted agents to creating only private Spaces. Composio dashboard widgets and UGC metrics were left outside the grant check. (`1a944d7`)
- Corrected the audit comment on vault card approval. (`b85457a`)
- The cloud environments handler now sends elapsed_seconds_total along with Box ticks and the final debit. (`1e64376`)
- The one-time computer-use cost notice now names the 5-minute minimum per start or resume through minimumSecondsPerStart, and admission checks run before the notice so an owner is not refused after allowing. The first Box call of an owner is held for up to 90 seconds with a costNotice.waiting status until Allow wakes it, and GET/POST /api/session-boxes/cost-notice lets unattended runs be allowed ahead of any conversation. (`f283754`)
- Agent account access, the provider router and vault agent-account routes were updated, along with self API handling, sidecar adapters, external proxy, MCP and deferred authorization, and the server OpenAPI output was regenerated as part of merging #770. (`81c81de`)
- Core now runs the source-history import at startup and lists each store in the encryption status, showing a store that stays on its Git history as plaintext with the reason instead of only logging it. (`23db298`)
- Core now applies the signed-off running Boxes caps per plan tier, enforces a 300-second credit pre-flight, and reconciles against the shared rate table. (`d387d82`)
- Clearing all chats now releases each removed conversation's checkpoint pins and deletes its Pi and pi-acp transcripts, matching single-conversation delete. Residue is read under the same lock as the deletes so a conversation created during the clear is never removed without its residue being released. (`0505535`)
- conversations.db now records a scrub debt on the first sealing open and on every reseal, then runs finish_store or the pending vacuum on the single open connection to clear legacy plaintext run text left in free pages and WAL frames. The behaviour was tested against db and WAL bytes. (`935ed1b`)
- Core now refuses to create an owner's first session Box with 428 session_box_cost_notice_required, naming the size and the Gateway's live hourly rate, and records acknowledgement via POST /api/session-boxes/{id}/cost-notice with 409 session_box_rate_changed when the rate moved. The conversation status carries the same costNotice, and later or resumed Boxes start without asking. (`6627146`)
- The MCP stdio spawn now passes the Ghost component subkey, never the master key, when the program is the Ghost binary, so per-call Ghost keeps working snapshots instead of falling back to memory. ShadowProcess::stop now waits 25 seconds and on Windows asks over the bearer-gated /stop endpoint first, letting Shadow seal its open segments before exit. (`67f9581`)
- The scheduler start-up pass now removes a tombstoned job file left behind by a refused unlink or a crash, under the job lock, fsyncs the directory and counts it, with a regression test covering a plaintext job plus tombstone and a second idempotent pass. (`013e24e`)
- Messages Core writes to the space file index no longer name the file, and message and warnings are sealed per row with legacy rows sealed at open. (`8574c66`)
- Card grants now store only a requester or agent marker and resolve the subject from the sealed row, and new card audit and event details drop the requester and grant subject. The review-comment, operation-receipt and card walks now visit every value and reseal those that open only under a retired master key. (`946960f`)
- Deleting a conversation or an orphaned message now also removes its legacy plaintext vec0 vector, zeroing then deleting it while that table is still kept. The keyword index path in the search host follows the new secure-delete format. (`5460258`)
- Inlined the Ghost and Bytebot ids in the session Box display test so the app-id constant guard stays shrink-only. (`3c128a3`)
- Restoring a backup into a folder other than the active one adopts its key with the keychain disabled, so the active folder's keychain entry is neither retired nor overwritten. Checkpoints pin under the snapshot lock, and the plugin eval harness now deletes conversations together with their checkpoint and transcript residue. (`4b9c91f`)
- The boot pass now reads and reseals legacy run and script files under a per-record write lock, and seals plaintext job files and quick-routine pointers before the scheduler starts. It also reseals fan-out checkpoints, deletes checkpoints of completed runs, removes temporary files left by crashed writes, and sweeps orphaned voice samples; the sealed-credentials test scans the source-history store instead of the Git working tree. (`316f617`)
- The Box credit pre-flight now takes its rate from a live run's tick rate or the Gateway quote, refusing with 503 session_box_rate_unavailable when no rate is known, and the hardcoded per-size rates were removed. Conversations whose machine verbs run on a session Box are no longer offered bridge list or tool_search and may not call shadow.computer_use or local-machine computer.control and browser.control servers, and a machine verb with no remembered chat-route authority or derivable owner now fails closed on a node that puts computer use on Boxes. A regression test keeps a cert proof inside the expiry leeway single-use. (`25f83b6`)
- Decrypted parser inputs are now deleted from tmp/document-parse when Core opens Spaces, swept at each submission for files no live job holds regardless of age, and released when the import or file-index poller runs out of budget. Inputs are claimed before they are written so a concurrent sweep cannot remove one whose job id is not yet known. (`600f01c`)
- accounts.json is now resealed even when one account cannot be opened: unreadable accounts are kept as stored and carried through each rewrite with their plaintext profile fields sealed, so other accounts' legacy email, name and avatar are resealed on load. (`e6a96a0`)
- The card metadata scrub is now recorded before rows are rewritten, marking plugin-secrets.db vacuum_pending inside the seal savepoint and opening the first seal even without live legacy rows, so deleted card rows and a crash after the seal commit are still scrubbed; a recorded debt runs the pending vacuum and drops plaintext backups on open. (`0ae4b2e`)
- Clearing all chats now empties message-fts.db and message-embeddings.db and resets their backfill, and the owner-scoped clear removes each owned conversation from both indexes instead of leaving tokens and vectors behind. (`51f7e25`)
- Enforced account access in Core: ext-proxy calls are signed with the calling agent, the Treg switch is checked on providers.call, provider keys reach the ACP, Pi and Codex bearers, and agent-owned Composio routes were added. Self-API writes were reopened for restricted agents while credential, connection, sharing and model paths stay refused. (`88f1858`)
- The sandbox MCP final-debit path now takes the RunResidual returned by deregister_for_final_debit and builds the debit body with the same tick_body used for periodic ticks, so the request carries the registered run's size and box id. (`5066bb8`)
- Session Box and cloud-task handling were reworked: turn authority is remembered per conversation and owner, a Box-backed conversation errors instead of falling back to the node display, deletes tombstone the conversation, sub-agent numbers are released on finish, the idle sweep keeps parents with working children, computer.* and browser.* are exposed as box_* tools when the session Box serves them, and cloud task Boxes go through session Box admission. (`1603eff`)
- Applied the restricted-agent target check to routines and the chat active-target switch, refusing targets bound to Identity Vault profiles the caller does not have. Removed the delegate.fanout refusal for restricted agents because each fanout task runs as a read-only Gateway completion without the named agent's tools. (`19e3e93`)
- Registered Decks in Core's development script, plugin manifest and built-in plugin list. (`ca40fb5`)
- Moved Bot Flows into the Core-tier plugin list alongside Forms so it is no longer treated as Community tier and its managed sidecar is granted the process permission it needs to start. (`08009de`)
- Merged branch changes across agent access checks, the self API, onboarding profile, vault agent account routes, the agent builder and runnable modules, and sidecar MCP delegation. (`efa6c19`)
- Moved Bot Flows into the Core-tier plugin list beside Forms so the Gateway grants its managed sidecar process permission and the sidecar that serves its public chat pages and embed script can spawn. (`183d4a7`)
- Recorded each turn's authority for the session Box router in the server module and carried the sub-agent Box scope into delegate.fanout children in the workflow delegation code. (`bd58d3d`)
- The send approval card now shows up to 20,000 characters of an agent's message body instead of the first 200, and states how much of a longer body is not shown. (`f497b0d`)
- Seeded grants and host hierarchy checks now recognize chat:project-guidance as a reserved-namespace permission, and the extension proxy enforces it. (`6f7372e`)
- Core now adopts an externally started Shadow only when its /health reports sealing: ok; otherwise it stops that process and restarts Shadow with the key. (`198809d`)
- Added an agent inbox alias sidecar module and tool support, and extended approval policy and tool-intent handling for mailbox alias actions. (`53c73f4`)
- Updated the Core Shadow sidecar process to pass the component key that Shadow uses to seal its capture data. (`0cd6d6d`)
- Tightened agent-account host matching in Core's vault so credentials saved for a domain are not filled on its subdomains. (`0aacb1a`)
- Corrected the companion plugin seed table size to 45 rows so Core compiles after the merged Bot Flows row. (`b75c577`)
- computer.* and browser.* tool calls now route to the conversation's session Box, and sub-agents receive child Boxes. Node computer use is refused on a Box, with tests covering the desktop and capability tool paths. (`e58125c`)
- Core now delivers Ghost's component subkey at spawn, and the Ghost sidecar process deletes snapshot files left behind by earlier builds on first use. (`62195ea`)
- Agents gained identity_mode (managed, individual, mixed) and an optional account_access allowlist, with legacy rows migrated to managed and unrestricted. Core enforces both where accounts are resolved: Composio calls narrow to allowed accounts and individual agents run as owner-scoped Composio users, MCP OAuth drops the default-profile fallback and filters profiles, Identity Vault profiles are dropped for agents barred from the user's accounts, vault account create/fill/TOTP follow the mode, and trigger subscriptions, bindings, deliveries, delegation and thread messaging refuse accounts outside the allowlist; restricted agents cannot write through the self-API. (`669c596`)
- Deleting a conversation now releases its chat checkpoint snapshots and deletes the Pi transcripts of its native sessions, with a 30-day age cap applied to checkpoints and transcripts. Pi folders became owner-only, sync exports require a profile opt-in and write the bundle 0600, and owner-only loopback local-content seal/open routes were added for CLI history. (`80697c8`)
- Rotating log records now pass through redaction of token shapes, bearer values and JWTs, with log folders created 0700 and files 0600. ACP stderr is capped at 512 characters and redacted, JSON-RPC frames are logged only as kind, method, id and size, and the dev execution worker logs through the same writer. (`d8aacfb`)
- Data-folder exports now always include the sealed key bundle inside the passphrase-encrypted stream, and import adopts it before replacing any file. Import retires the target's own key, skips the archive's key file and key records, and scopes adoption to a child process when restoring into another folder. (`c5f49df`)
- Media files are now sealed as write-once RYU-SF01 through an owner-only .part file bound to the media id and renamed into place. Serving decrypts on the fly, Range requests decrypt only the chunks they touch, the quota counts plaintext bytes, and legacy plaintext files are sealed on first read and by a startup background pass. (`acc235b`)
- agent_inbox.send approval cards now show the Reply-To address so an approver can see a redirect before approving the send. (`b5f951a`)
- Added a test asserting the session Box protected and public routes merge without conflict, with the static inference segment winning over the conversation routes so Box inference calls reach the relay. (`ba9b1c9`)
- Conversation scope guidance, hierarchy API and host hierarchy handling were touched, the sidecar adapters and external proxy updated, and the embedded projects and bot-flows UI fixtures regenerated. (`6b75f6b`)
- Workflow tests that exercise the boot reseal pass now take a single lock rather than racing, since the pass walks every file in the shared test data folder and tests count what it rewrote. (`4e444ff`)
- Document parsing now reads Space blobs decrypted and digest-checked in memory, and hands document.parse providers an owner-only decrypted copy under tmp/document-parse that is deleted when the job ends, with stale copies swept on the next submission. The Spaces shim installs the crypto host before opening the store and exposes seal_diagnostics covering unreadable rows, migration and blob-sweep progress, and vector coverage. (`a3be7f2`)
- Introduced a per-session Box registry with its own screen, covering screen grants and relay, gwb1 keys, parking on kill, and caps. Session box code lives in a new server module with idle and inference handling, alongside cloud task box arming, cloud task records and route-gate tests, identity verification and ws ticket changes. (`2179b68`)
- Approval cards for agent_inbox alias claims now name the exact address and state that agent email addresses are permanent and never reissued, resolved through the read-only check_email_alias call with a 3s bound. Send and reply cards list recipients, subject and a bounded body preview. (`7c27aff`)
- Extended the plugin manifest and seed handling to recognize the bot-flows UI fixture, and updated the sidecar external proxy for the new app. (`abccfeb`)
- Routed every scheduled job file and quick-routine pointer write through one encb:v1 codec bound to the record kind and id, and opened every read through it, including normalization and delete. Legacy plaintext reads and is sealed on the next write. (`b512be9`)
- Workflow store now seals run records, live and script workflow definitions, legacy version snapshots, and fan-out delegate checkpoints as single encb:v1 values bound to record kind and id under the workflow-state content key. All readers open through the same codec and still accept legacy plaintext, and the boot reseal pass now also seals plaintext definitions and run records. (`bcaa314`)
- The core app's Cargo.lock was refreshed to pick up the sealed collab storage dependency. (`8eaacfa`)
- The agent inbox MCP tool now wraps verification-code fields as untrusted content and drops overlong links, and emits opaque tokens as agent thread ids. (`d96366b`)
- An inline voice sample for cloning is now staged under tmp/voice in a 0700 directory with a 0600 file for the length of one synthesis call instead of the persistent reference directory. The first staging after a start removes orphans left by a crash, including plaintext samples earlier builds staged in the reference directory, while user-placed files are left alone. (`d95b558`)
- The core app's Cargo.lock was refreshed to pick up the sealed plugin storage dependency. (`0af872f`)
- harness_runs.error and channel fallback warnings are now sealed with the conversation cipher, with legacy plaintext read and resealed at open and run lists skipping and counting rows that do not open. Deleting a conversation removes its keyword and vector rows, disabling Remember chats empties both indexes, the backfill sweeps orphans without indexing bodies that failed to open, and the Dream review reports vector coverage and unreadable-row counts. (`fd48bc3`)
- The bot-flows plugin manifest UI fixture was updated with the Bot Flows review changes. (`16cfecb`)
- Account email, name and avatar URL are now sealed as encb:v1 under the accounts.json content key, bound to the user id and field, with per-field failure dropping only that field and legacy plaintext resealed on next load. (`d5e8d9e`)
- Vault card metadata keeps only brand and last4 in plaintext, with merchant allowlist and expiry copy stored as a single sealed_meta value and plaintext columns dropped after commit; approval merchant host, requester, agent and note are sealed per value, new card audit and item-event rows carry the approval id instead of brand, last4 and merchant, and the vault scrubs freed pages and drops pre-upgrade .bak copies holding card rows. (`eb66289`)
- Registered the Bot Flows manifest and companion bundle in seed and manifest fixtures, and generalised the dot-segment guard in ext_proxy so it protects every plugin's public routes rather than only Forms. (`55a9929`)
- agents.db now seals each agent's description, system prompt and persona, legacy prompt versions and operation receipts as encb:v1 under the content key, bound to the agent id and, for receipts, the operation id. Row mappers open sealed values, list skips and counts rows that do not open, built-in seeds are sealed on insert and legacy rows are sealed on open. (`ccc605b`)
- prompt-evals.db seals suite and version configs, run requests and results, and review comments as encb:v1 under the content key at every writer, bound to the row id and, for comments, the run id and result key. A value that does not open is an error on a get and is skipped and counted in a list instead of decoding to null. (`d7c1f87`)
- safe_action_submissions.json is sealed as encb:v1 under the safe-actions.db content key, bound to the row id, and reviewed_at is now a plaintext column added in place and backfilled from existing plaintext rows with ids unchanged. Crash recovery of executing submissions opens, edits and re-seals inside a single transaction, while policies, contracts, receipts and steps stay plaintext. (`c24db8a`)
- The approvals.db json column holding tool arguments, prompts, message text, results and notes is sealed as encb:v1 under the content key, bound to the row id, on insert, update and try_transition, with legacy rows sealed on open and freed pages scrubbed. Getters error on values that do not open, list and pending_expired skip and count them, and a shared StoreSeal glue module is added for the Core record stores. (`76a0c51`)
- Added the media.audio host API at 1.20.0 and regenerated the server schema and OpenAPI output, with the plugin manifest UI fixtures re-synced. Gateway grant validation now treats Video Studio's media:record as an OwnerExclusiveGrant row, sd.cpp's Wan frame models resolve through video_models_dir(), and project import inflates zip entries in bounded chunks up to the declared size. (`cbd2f53`)
- Updated Cargo.lock to include the tracing dependency needed by ryu-search logging. (`8cc78c8`)
- Regenerated the embedded companion UI fixture bundles under the plugin manifest so they pick up the shared prompt-cache helper change. (`16a52d3`)
- The activity feed API now reports how many rows were skipped because they could not be opened during a list read. (`23b1b6f`)
- Scope guidance for conversations moved onto the stable prompt layer so project instructions reach every member thread's system prompt, and the Projects UI fixture was regenerated. (`05fc67d`)
- Refused assistant writes through the self-API that touch auth, audit, bind, channels, composio, control_plane, egress, the firewall sections or providers, leaving those to Settings. Gateway and routing changes now offer only Allow once and Deny, while other self-API changes keep the session grant. (`3281f0a`)
- Made ShadowProcess::cleanup_orphan delegate to tools::supervised_child while keeping the PID identity check, restoring the orphan cleanup used by the Shadow listener check. (`816ed9e`)
- Supervised child processes moved into a shared tools::supervised_child module that exposes the child PID, and ShadowProcess now delegates to it. Core also touched cloud task records, conversation history and sync, onboarding profile, the shadow proxy routes and its sidecar manifest handling. (`7494894`)
- The standalone core Cargo.lock was resynced with the root lock, picking up unicode-normalization and correcting a drifted ryu-hardware 0.4.0 pin. (`b617512`)
- Reworked privacy preference handling in the Core runtime, spanning the privacy module, plugin host, server routes, sidecar gateway and MCP tools, and workflow executor and delegation. Added a privacy preferences runtime test and an environment example entry. (`3db1f79`)
- Changed Core entitlement handling and the manifest sidecar. (`ac46c42`)
- Updated approvals and policy handling, the self API and governance endpoints, gateway speech settings, OpenAPI output and the MCP bridge adapters, with the exposed routes and modules adjusted together. (`bc0d00e`)
- CoreCryptoHost now records the data folder's key check value only after probing up to three sealed message bodies, reports already-sealed data instead of generating a key over it, and gains keys CLI functions and data-format marker helpers. (`7ba8ba7`)
- The dev execution host now removes the version directories of earlier hosts on start once the new host owns the receipt, so restarts no longer accumulate debug executable copies. (`02768a0`)
- Added rusqlite and zstd to the workspace crate and ctor to dev-dependencies, plus a refreshed Cargo.lock to carry the new crypto wiring. (`371898a`)
- Dev execution host now reports its live-turn count on an authenticated /internal/dev-execution/activity route, and a running listener adopts replacement hosts, respawns crashed ones with exponential backoff, and leaves explicitly stopped ones stopped. Added a detachable dev:core:restart script that rebuilds Core and swaps the execution host once no turn is running. (`89b69af`)
- Agent inbox alias tools now send the agent's name as displayName on the alias check and are exempt from the smart-mode name heuristic, while manual mode still gates them. The base64 dependency line formatting in Cargo.toml was fixed. (`378682f`)
- Formatted the Gateway self-operation changes across the self_api, server and MCP sidecar modules. (`b39c3c2`)
- Mutating ryu_api calls and interface switches now ask the person every time, via the in-chat card or the Approvals inbox, even when approval mode is off. On org-bound nodes gateway and routing routes are allowed when the person in a private chat holds the route permission, with an in-process proof so handlers run as that person, while provider keys, service accounts, hook overrides, audit pruning and the live traffic stream stay denied to agents; the OpenAPI spec now exposes gateway governance, org features and speech settings. (`dc4effd`)
- Merged PR #756, which builds per-session Boxes on top of the branch's cloud-task and desktop-stream fixes, touching core sources across server routes (cloud tasks, conversations, shadow proxy, vault APIs, voice websocket), sidecar providers and isolation, and workflow execution, delegation and triggers. The merge also added a bundled Windows Python 3.14 runtime under core, including its executables, DLLs, standard library and documentation. (`e3a5e18`)
- Added owner-only /api/scope-guidance routes and a scopeGuidance.set app capability backed by a scope_guidance table, and made the chat stream inject goals and the brief instruction as a stable system-prompt layer after agent instructions. (`2adc5ef`)
- Added partial agent_inbox alias and tool modules to the sidecar MCP layer and touched the approvals policy in a snapshot that had not been type-checked or tested. (`904dd5c`)
- Data-folder export and import now build and decrypt their plaintext scratch data through plaintext_scratch, an anonymous file in the data folder's owner-only tmp/exports or tmp/imports directory (0700), falling back to the OS temp dir only when that folder is not a real directory. Only the sealed ciphertext is created next to the export destination, so plaintext no longer lands on the backup medium. (`794be30`)
- Manifest-declared seal variables are still always dropped. (`2749cc3`)
- Data-folder export now always writes an encrypted RYU-DX01 archive keyed by an operator passphrase, with import decrypting to an anonymous temp file before validation while legacy plain zips still import. S3 backup and restore staging moved to an owner-only tmp/backups directory, workspace handoff patches are sealed with the master key, and chat checkpoints exclude credential files from their shadow index. (`b14be1a`)
- Kept managed Pi credentials alive across instance handover by reference-counting each per-conversation auth.json projection and deleting it only when the last instance using that directory exits. (`4568d82`)
- Kept the legacy source types in the dashboard builder's source.type enum after the authorable kinds, with a description limiting them to resending an existing widget's source unchanged, so a strict tool schema cannot block re-upserting a legacy widget. Updated the schema test to assert that contract. (`e2a111c`)
- Added an in-transaction union-find ancestry check in link_synced_messages so relayed parents that would close a loop are rejected and the row continues the receiver's thread, and cleared the first row's parent in linearize_locked so a stale parent cannot make the rebuilt chain a ring. select_version now stops at the first revisited row, and version_root is marked per row and back-filled without replacing a stored position. (`cafa3e4`)
- Secrets are sealed in the pi-accounts vault, injected into the ACP spawn environment only for Core's own Pi config dir, imported from legacy plaintext at boot and on spawn, and per-conversation projections are sanitized with auth.json deleted on Pi exit. (`3e7b5a5`)
- The isolated Codex auth.json copy is now written atomically at 0600 and never backed up, with the legacy auth.json.ryu-safety-backup deleted on gateway-home refresh and excluded from exports. Custody namespace homes are chmod 0700 and removing a native Kiro account now wipes its vendor token home after the vault row is deleted. (`88ca44f`)
- Cancelling an onboarding profile draft now re-signals cancel_conversation_turn to the detached ACP turn every 250 ms up to a 30 s grace, with a driver_active flag holding the job slot until the driver returns. Draft turns persist again, pending drafts are tracked in a preference and swept at startup, and ProfileJobView.materialized keeps its legacy wire meaning. (`4cd5dac`)
- Core now pins localhost to 127.0.0.1 in shadow::base_url(), limits the spawned-child loopback exemption to 127.0.0.1, drops the version record for a proof-less legacy Shadow child trusted by socket ownership, and injects SHADOW_API_TOKEN_FILE for the clips and meetings sidecars. (`e6f7429`)
- cloud-task-bindings.json went back to the shape the previous Core parses, with retention fields moved to state/cloud-task-binding-retention.json and retired markers kept in owners. Reads load only the bindings file, the retention pass writes only the retention file, and missing metadata is stamped on the next pass. (`d4952f5`)
- Workflow results returned to the chat builder now pass through secrets::redact_for_client before the trigger secret is dropped, and list, stored-version and restore dry-run responses use the new secrets::redact_for_listing that also masks the webhook trigger signing secret. persist_workflow restores an echoed placeholder from the stored node, and the Webhook step formats request and response-read errors with without_url() so run history and logs carry no token-bearing URL. (`0c76e06`)
- Workflow definitions now seal inline trigger signing secrets, ChannelSend bot tokens and channel URLs, and Webhook node target URLs with the master key before any bytes are written, with a boot pass resealing legacy plaintext definitions, version files and script workflows. notify.db seals alert_delivery JSON and push tokens with a new SHA-256 token_hash lookup column, GET /api/alerts/delivery redacts webhook URLs, bot tokens and Expo tokens behind an opaque secret_ref, and PUT keeps the stored credential for a matching placeholder. (`c7836fc`)
- Added committed_core_openapi_matches_generated_spec, which serializes api_doc() and fails on any path or top-level difference from the committed Core spec except the derived /api/apps aliases. The generate_image doc comment was reflowed to keep the internal ryu_image and CoreImageHost note out of the public spec. (`0a6c517`)
- The Agent Comms runtime test now asserts the exact shipped tool slugs (agents.directory, agents.send, agents.thread) and the permission grants without conversation:reactions, matching the manifest after agents.react moved to the Message Reactions plugin. (`85171df`)
- Added device usage snapshots, session dedupe, sub-turn attribution and a recompute guard across the plugin host, privacy, profile activity, server app-runs, sidecar adapters, gateway, MCP threads and workflow delegation modules. (`2afdc3d`)
- Restructured the media endpoint doc comments so image, video and audio generation handlers emit a summary paragraph followed by their description when the OpenAPI spec is generated. (`02a81e5`)
- Updated dashboard_builder's tool reference and source enum so agents no longer propose core_endpoint, monitor, workflow or agent sources. (`09ea10d`)
- The Core backup exclude list now covers relay.json, tailscaled.state and the OpenTunnel tunnel.json, since the relay token is re-minted and the two third-party tunnel identities cannot be sealed by Ryu and would clone the node's network identity on restore. (`38f19b6`)
- fleet-identity.json, fleet-enrollment-pending.json and fleet-enrolled-node.json are now sealed with the master key (enc:v1) before reaching the owner-only temp file, and load_json opens them. A plaintext body is sealed in place on its next load, a sealed body that does not open is an error, and enrollment fails rather than writing plaintext without a key. (`43c2f5c`)
- Custom catalog sources now seal every auth.bearer and auth.headers value with the master key except a value that is exactly one ${ENV_VAR} reference, and fail closed without a key. Legacy plaintext is sealed in place on load, and resolve_headers refuses to fetch with a value that cannot be opened. (`51edbf6`)
- Every literal header and env value in mcp.json is sealed as enc:v1 with the master key while vault references stay readable, seal_literals runs at boot, and writes without a key are refused. (`ec1bed9`)
- learning.prm-key joined the SECRET_PREFERENCE_KEYS allowlist, and opening preferences.db seals listed keys still stored as plaintext, checkpoints the WAL and vacuums. GET /api/preferences/:key answers credential keys with a redaction placeholder, and a PUT carrying that placeholder keeps the stored value without running the change hooks. (`6623eb9`)
- Onboarding profile jobs now start building as soon as they are created instead of waiting in a queued loop, driven through injected draft and materialize phases with cancellation and cleanup of the reserved conversation row. The queued state and PROFILE_JOB_QUEUE_TTL_MS were removed, and background is now reported as the user's progress-view choice rather than gating the build. (`5d88015`)
- gateway_bearer() and the control-plane sealer now install the crypto host before sealing the managed Gateway inference bearer and control-plane token files, and the Firewall dispatch test child installs it explicitly, removing the "crypto host not initialized" failures. (`2beb6e0`)
- Core now seals secrets/node-control.token, bootstrap-ack.token, the legacy gateway-durable.token and core.token with the master key, seals secrets/gateway-relay.key through the sealed load-or-create path, and compares opened values for idempotency while leaving the delegation public key plaintext. (`1f0b58b`)
- Changed the MLX-VLM installer so an already-recorded install is kept and runs on the Python it was installed with, instead of being reinstalled on every start; fresh installs still receive the pinned version. (`d96c092`)
- Moved vault:fill off the global grant allowlist and made it an owner-exclusive grant for @ryu/browser, so other installed apps can no longer request stored logins and TOTP codes. (`bc64b82`)
- Merged the #756 bug sweep into the shared core modules, so llama.cpp readiness now comes from a live child's /health inside llamacpp::satellite::Satellite::spawn for embed, rerank and classify, orphan PID reaping moved into tools::supervised_child via orphan::reap for Ghost and Shadow, and the compat stream finish and late-usage fixes landed in the shared translate_openai_stream path. The package also carries the vault login 403 login_token_response identity-name leak fix, the 1–30 s sandbox_exec timeout clamp alongside wasmtime environment support, the ACP cancel per-turn handle list, and refreshed bundled Python 3.14 runtime files under core. (`064e1f6`)
- Exposed engine launch options through the core server, updating the catalog registry, server routes, OpenAPI output, and preferences. Provider modules for llama.cpp, MLX, Ollama, oMLX, whisper.cpp, and the other sidecars were adjusted to the launch-option handling. (`56627c5`)
- Added vault agent-account storage in agent_accounts.rs with matching API routes in vault_agent_accounts_api.rs and vault_items_api.rs, wired through the server module, OpenAPI output, seed data, and the sidecar external proxy. (`a2c3488`)
- Added ConversationStore::link_synced_messages so synced and checkpoint-imported rows are placed under their parents and the leaf moves onto inserted rows in branched conversations, wired through the sync, continuity, conversation history, and conversations endpoints. (`4dd69e1`)
- Added shadow::verified_api_token() as the single gate for the /api/shadow proxy and computer-use settings calls, which now forward nothing when the peer is unverified. ShadowManager adopts only a proven listener, reaps its own PID-file orphan, rotates the token and fails start on a port conflict, and no longer counts a squatter as running. (`dd3137e`)
- start() now resolves model_args before fetching companions so a half A14B pair fails fast, POST /api/models/active refuses a diffusion model whose launch plan fails, and the umt5-xxl Q5_K_M and Wan2.1 VAE companions are pinned with LFS SHA-256 for the default video model and all four frame models. (`96f1488`)
- Frame model install and uninstall now take a Hub path validated segment by segment, so the LowNoise/ and HighNoise/ transformer halves of the Wan2.2 A14B GGUFs can be installed from the catalog while traversal, absolute paths and drive prefixes stay refused. (`7afc486`)
- Mesh LLM's missing test import that broke the ryu-core test build was fixed, and MLX-VLM installs were moved onto the pinned 0.7.8 with managed `--model/--host/--port/--api-key` flags stripped from raw args. (`c6f400b`)
- Profile activity now ignores and rejects bucket days past tomorrow (UTC), and an account is credited only for turns made while it was signed in, never for another verified user's turns or team-member fan-out. (`d6b095d`)
- Refusals map to HTTP 409 `gateway_seal_key_required`, while unchanged plaintext secrets and non-secret edits still write. (`eabfda4`)
- It also redacts sealed values and speech, channel and service secrets from /api/gateway/status and the effective_config echoed by PUT, keeping a stored client key when a redacted one is sent back. (`1a8e56d`)
- Cloud task binding markers now record updatedAt, and the 60-second recovery tick moves markers older than 30 days without a live slot or lease into a compact retired map that still answers lookups and blocks setup but no longer counts toward the 10,000 live cap. Cap refusals return cloud_task_binding_limit and leave the conversation unbound for retry, and DELETE /api/conversations/{id} marks markers deleted before tearing down workspace and leases so a recreated id starts unbound. (`c7a1324`)
- Added a profile_activity module that reports account activity at most once per UTC day after a qualifying turn, behind the new opt-out profile-activity-enabled preference, and tagged background turns with x-ryu-feature: agent. (`8508953`)
- Added native option catalogs and spawn wiring for MLX-VLM, oMLX, MLX Serve, apfel, Mesh LLM and audio.cpp, plus catalog fixes from an audit against upstream source. Marked work in progress with checks unconfirmed. (`1c8f91d`)
- Removed a stray Windows CPython 3.14 installation that had been committed under core, including its DLLs, tcl, tk, Lib and Doc trees, and added the path to the ignore rules so a local py-manager run cannot re-commit it. Core continues to provision Python through its runtime installer. (`c8406f8`)
- Formatted the agent-account modules and browser seed grants, kept the vault API module list sorted, and touched the vault agent-account and vault items API wiring. (`83d22dd`)
- Core now derives spawn-time arguments and environment from per-engine native option catalogs, emits those values after typed flags and before raw extra_args, and serves the catalogs at GET /api/engines/{engine}/launch-options while validating native value shapes on per-model saves. The llama.cpp reranker, classifier and Speech Processing providers, sd-server, OuteTTS, Ollama's server environment and whisper.cpp now read saved launch settings, with managed-flag filtering shared across providers. (`5bc6d14`)
- A grants-only seed row was added so pre-installed and existing browser sidecars are approved for the grants declared in their manifest. (`c201966`)
- Added vault-held agent accounts with create, list, origin-bound fill and TOTP enrollment, exposed through GET/POST /api/vault/agent-accounts and the vault.credentialFill and vault.totpEnroll kernel capability handlers. Fill and enrollment bind to the account's host or a subdomain over HTTPS and are scoped to the calling agent's folder in the agents environment. (`99f28f9`)
- Touched core server APIs for approvals, notifications, vault crypto and TOTP password policy, along with the sidecar provider modules for llama.cpp, vLLM and SGLang, the ghost and shadow tool supervision code, and telemetry content handling. (`e49d1db`)
- Agent sync reconciliation in the server module gained test coverage, with a new reconcile test file added alongside agent_sync.rs. (`b826e2a`)
- The plugin lifecycle test now reads Video Studio's grant lists from the shipped manifest instead of a hardcoded list, keeps usage:audit optional and asserts that sidecar:process is not requested. (`294fe5e`)
- Vault TOTP and password-policy routes reuse the crypto routes' Caller, authentication, caller!/require! macros, ok_or and test machine caller; notification inbox handlers share recipient-authorization, error and mutation reply builders; approval handlers share replies and a permission-checked decide helper. The Firewall dispatch runtime test reuses the policy runtime test's env override, isolated-child launcher and /v1/config fixture logic, with routes, OpenAPI annotations, status codes and response bodies unchanged. (`50458f4`)
- Changed core telemetry content helpers to re-export the shared gen_ai_content implementation from ryu-gw-contracts, preserving existing call paths and behavior. (`625e99e`)
- Moved the shared llama.cpp satellite lifecycle for embeddings, reranker, and classify sidecars into llamacpp/satellite.rs, leaving ports, launch flags, ownership rules, and health behavior the same aside from one classify stop-log wording change. (`d5b9e44`)
- Moved Ghost and Shadow tool-sidecar child supervision into a shared SupervisedChild, preserving orphan cleanup, logging, stop sequencing, and liveness checks. (`b8a1c10`)
- Replaced the separate vLLM and SGLang python -m server wrappers with a shared PythonServerProcess parameterized per engine, keeping spawn arguments, log targets, and shutdown behavior unchanged. (`5126a77`)
- Moved the shared Needle selector, C ABI loader, wheel download/extraction, schema, and alias machinery into needle.rs driven by per-release pins, keeping each release's store keys, URLs, digests, and messages unchanged. (`f3acfd9`)
- Corrected the broker minter-deny regression test to build the password-manager policy path with account_key so it exercises the intended role deny. (`2867b3d`)
