- run_fanout_with_policy now reserves every delegate in the run's lifecycle count before spawning any, and run_active_count counts queued delegates, so a fan-out wider than its concurrency limit reaches zero only when the last delegate finishes. An unadmitted reservation releases its slot on drop. (`d6dfdd2`)
- own_skill_skip_reason in agent_sync now skips only "projected" ledger rows, so an "external" row whose adopted hash is a user or agent edit can be imported again manually or automatically. A regression test covers a keep_external row. (`1803d8c`)
- link_resumed_messages now takes the bundle transcript and its context items separately and advances the leaf only when the import continues the active thread. Context-only imports join the active thread beneath the current leaf, bundles disjoint from a branched target are chained beneath the current leaf, and resume_conversation splits the payload into transcript and context ids, with regression tests for the context-only, divergent and disjoint cases. (`e06c883`)
- Raised the rule discovery directory-visit budget from 4,096 to 100,000 and skipped .venv, __pycache__, .next and .turbo in addition to existing cache and VCS directories. Added a truncated flag to RuleDiscoveryResponse and replaced the budget test with walk-based tests for truncation, later rules and cache skipping. (`63cd83b`)
- Named repository-root SKILL.md installs from raw.githubusercontent.com, GitHub blob/raw and GitLab raw/blob URLs after the repository, and host-root SKILL.md URLs after the host. Extended the URL-naming test with ref, refs/heads, GitHub, GitLab, nested skill-folder and host-root cases. (`24d9370`)
- Made untrusted sandbox masking accept the agent's launch HOME, so a native-account custody home under secrets/native-accounts/ stays reachable while other secrets entries remain masked. Passed the spawn HOME through acp confine_for_untrusted_workspace and added tests for custody, sibling and unrelated HOMEs. (`1d481ae`)
- Changed lease_expired to order never-attempted expirations first and due retries by when they became due, preventing a backlog of timed-out revocations from filling every page ahead of healthy leases. Added a test asserting one reap pass revokes a healthy lease behind a full page of due retries. (`0013773`)
- Changed enforce_control_plane_source_grants to check Composio actions by derived toolkit slug, matching how control-plane grants are keyed, with underivable actions still failing closed. Updated the dispatch-entry regression test to use a real composio action id and added a toolkit-slug resolution test. (`623fc62`)
- The export watcher now records the hash each pending item was compared under, so a newer export unzipped during an import is imported on the next tick instead of being marked already imported; the second hashing pass was removed. (`c779c43`)
- Extended the agent-comms delivery runtime test to cover hop context being cleared on turns that inject nothing. (`f79cba0`)
- Brought in the #745 changes to the codex config module and the ACP sidecar adapter. (`337a3c8`)
- Regenerated the blueprint UI plugin manifest fixture so it matches the updated companion behavior. (`9c6ec59`)
- Regenerated the 39 embedded app UI fixtures under the plugin manifest fixture directory with the sanctioned embedded-app-ui generator, and the strict check passes for all of them. (`2c75dab`)
- /api/auth/status reports the last settled device flow by its user code as lastFlow. remove_acp_account logs a settle failure and still materializes the active accounts instead of returning an error after removal. (`9fc4e54`)
- ACP turns now answer permission requests and elicitations as cancelled after a cancel, answer unserved methods with method-not-found in the turn loop and session/load replay, skip the exec scan for cancelled turns, and record explicit Codex sign-in and sign-out for the gateway home. (`0ab80a1`)
- The isolated Codex auth.json now follows the user's Codex CLI file through token refreshes until an explicit Ryu sign-in, account switch or sign-out takes ownership. An owned copy returns to following only when the CLI signs in to a different account, and existing markers migrate as not owned. (`e48cab7`)
- The Bun branch of the Claude route's OAuth fetch now refuses non-HTTPS targets the same way the Node tunnel does, so a plain HTTP request cannot cross the route unencrypted. Tests covering the proxy behavior were added. (`201aaa0`)
- The merge resolution retained the branch's cloud environments and cloud tasks server code along with the MCP delegate and sandbox sidecar modules. (`db838a4`)
- Rustdoc on the media module and the /api/images/generate route now describes provider_input as cloud only, unable to set reserved keys or override request fields, and refused with 400 otherwise, and documents the 400 and 413 (24 MiB) responses. (`5faf475`)
- Brought in branch #742's regenerated embedded app UI fixtures for the plugin manifest, covering the activity, app-studio, approvals, and remaining app HTML snapshots. (`3d9622e`)
- Fixed provider, multi-account and ACP account defects across the auth module, the Codex and Pi config modules, the ACP sidecar adapter and subscription reading. (`0057ed5`)
- Adjusted local egress provider resolution and the Pi OAuth login and proxy scripts, with tests added for the proxy. (`54a1907`)
- Updated chat export importing, agent sync with an added reconcile test, and the MCP bridge sidecar adapter. (`59f8c56`)
- Fixed skill install naming collisions: a source scoped to a skill subfolder now installs under that folder's name instead of the repo-root hint, and SKILL.md text installs under the caller's slug rather than the front-matter name. Added regression tests for both paths. (`84560d3`)
- The encoded side-model request is now checked against the Gateway's 2 MiB chat body limit before sending, so escaped or multi-byte text combined with the image budget returns a clear refusal from host.sideModel instead of an opaque 413. (`3b9e504`)
- resolve_references now refuses a canonical input referenced more than once, and OpenRouter is refused as a video cloud provider since the Gateway has no OpenRouter video job. image/jpg frames are normalized to image/jpeg, and local init_image and end_image are refused because no current ModelKind loads the encoders Wan I2V and FLF2V need. (`cb11caf`)
- copy_tree and copy_tree_filtered_at now recreate symlinks verbatim and error on non-unix instead of skipping them, so migrate --move and copy-profile keep llama.cpp dylib aliases and bundle links. A failed source removal is now logged instead of discarded. (`e1747ac`)
- Sidecar providers now return early from start() when their own child is running, so a repeat start no longer marks the provider as an adopted external server and the next stop actually kills the child. llamacpp embed, rerank, classify and speech replace the bare TCP-connect readiness loop with wait_for_ready on /health from a still-alive child, so an early exit fails fast and a foreign listener is not mistaken for the server; speech also stops a child that never became ready. (`9aca3ea`)
- An ad-hoc workflow script run with no calling agent can no longer use a mutating preset, closing the path where agent({preset:'code_write', agent_id}) could borrow another agent's tool loop. Schedule jobs are owned only when the id matches wf-sched-&lt;id>-&lt;digits> and targets that workflow, and limit reset parsing uses checked chrono arithmetic and clamps at MAX_WAIT instead of panicking. (`b44fc8d`)
- Untrusted sandbox workspaces now mask the secrets/, db/, state/, files/, logs/ and services/ data-dir subdirectories plus legacy root files. The A2A outbound cancel watch sender stays alive for the turn and stops polling a closed channel, so an unregistered or superseded turn no longer busy-spins; ACL app-level implies edges are honoured only from the plugin that declared the id and only toward that plugin's own levels, with others dropped and reported. (`e19e978`)
- Required hook:run-agent:write for mutating workflowScript presets, persisting the allowance on the script node and its content-addressed id. Passed the verified caller into manual hook context so registered-node ACLs and storage tenant apply, reported the top-level external runtime as an unenforceable isolation lane, and changed the hook breaker so dropping an unsettled Permit releases a cancelled half-open trial. (`20fd5e8`)
- Applied the minter's role and team policies to secret: and password-manager references in broker sessions, added exponential backoff and a 2-minute budget to failed lease reaper revocations, accepted casRequired and policy rule constraints in declarative reconcile, and wrapped Postgres creation statements in one transaction with best-effort role revocation. (`2f2e507`)
- Granted the app's own plugin-data directory read-write and the shared models directory read-only in the OS sandbox while refusing other apps' plugin-data directories, restricted orphan cleanup to recorded PIDs still matching the tool binary, and moved the capability shim token out of curl argv. Windows PATH updates now preserve the value's REG_EXPAND_SZ/REG_SZ type and broadcast WM_SETTINGCHANGE with a UTF-16 "Environment" string. (`bff9610`)
- Voice WebSocket connections now apply the chat-stream agent.run and exact-agent ACLs to member tickets before ready and carry the verified caller, author id and agent ACL into every voice turn. Rule discovery with no cwd returns an empty result instead of walking Core's process cwd, and canvas migration quarantines unparseable legacy boards as *.json.invalid and deletes the empty doc when the board write fails. (`8060be0`)
- Added three in-chat consent tests pinning the derived ryu_ext mutation prompt and the empty-summary Core route title branch; they pass at HEAD and kill three mutants. (`d8921f2`)
- The watched ChatGPT or Claude export fingerprint now covers only the files the importer reads, so exports holding more than 2,000 attachments import instead of being skipped on every 30 s tick. Ledger rows written before the fix cause each watched export to be imported once more after upgrading. (`bcac25a`)
- Stopped the agent sync from importing Ryu's own skill projections or skills already in its install directory, and made install-from-directory refuse to install a skill over its own source. Restricted git clone to https/ssh with no redirects and pinned HTTPS resolution to the SSRF-screened addresses, and gave the cloud sync SSE change-feed request a deadline beyond the sync interval instead of the 30 s client default. (`b0d428e`)
- Regenerated the embedded companion UI fixture HTML files after the shared theme, focus ring and i18n changes, so the bundled fixtures match the current app sources. (`ecc2690`)
- Made recent-message reads follow the active leaf so rewound or edited-away turns are no longer replayed, limited fork copies to the cut point's ancestry on branched sources, and extended conversation deletes to clear handoffs, model changes, title history, agent controls and run auto-resume rows. Newly imported rows on a branched target are now linked under the active thread via link_resumed_messages. (`e446bff`)
- Claude traffic on an enabled desktop route began refusing instead of falling back to the data centre when the route could not run; the proxy state became three-state, and Core's Claude client, Pi OAuth bridge, Claude Code spawn, and usage reading refuse on unavailable. Core began passing the provider state file and republishing it once the listener was up, with the file written under a lock and readable only by its owner. (`1fc2ab4`)
- Turns rejected after being marked running began writing failed using a compare-and-set on their own claim, ACP turns rejected before route_acp_stream returned their reused worktree guard to the diff store, the ACP cancel registry kept one handle per live turn with RAII registration, and browser client-tool waiters were removed when their stream stopped waiting or pruned on register. (`7108b3b`)
- All 39 embedded app UI fixtures were regenerated with the sanctioned generator so the strict fixture check and release fixtures job pass. (`62b9b4a`)
- Moved the OAuth bridge's provider-route fetch into pi_oauth_proxy.mjs, embedded it and wrote it beside the bridge as ryu-oauth-proxy.mjs before the bridge itself, and added tests covering the CONNECT tunnel with the proxy credential, proxy refusal, upstream certificate verification, plain HTTP refusal and Bun's native proxy option. (`23388d6`)
- Enforced control-plane MCP and Composio source grants in the no-gate dispatch core, charged Composio actions for every caller except the self-marking HTTP tool handler, and stopped replace_server from restoring typed fields an update cleared. discover_agents now excludes the calling agent, and sandbox_exec clamps timeout_secs to 1..=30s while refusing the unsupported env argument. (`f956f7a`)
- Tightened vault authorization: sourcing a folder in a protected environment now also needs admin on the folder, static role save and manual rotation refuse protected targets without admin and write-constrained targets, broker proposal approval checks write parameter constraints, and machine-token checks expand identity.machine.id templates. Native jwt, cert, aws and kubernetes logins now return a single generic 403. (`8b2b9a3`)
- Team chat stream turns now check fleet availability and the exact-agent agent.run ACL for every member and the lead before dispatch, and carry the caller's AgentResourceAuthorization into TeamRunDeps so each settled member agent is re-checked. Agent import now enforces agent.edit, imported and published schedules are stamped with the caller's owner and org, conversation bindings are kept only when the caller owns them, untrusted templates drop schedule conversation ids, and guarded retrieval index upserts return 409 instead of replacing memory, OKF, or another owner's chunk, with a Space space_id requiring write access. (`cdb8c59`)
- Added per-provider desktop routing for Claude subscriptions across local egress entries, provider routes, OAuth login, the Claude and local-egress APIs, OpenAPI output, sidecar adapter and gateway code, and the usage host. (`1987270`)
- Regenerated the plugin manifest UI fixture HTML files for the app catalog to match the updated markup with title attributes on truncated text. (`5b16765`)
- Merged the latest PR #650 commits into Core's vault API surface, touching the vault, vault-engines, and dynamic seal routes, their public-route auth test, the vault auth methods and machine state, and the ACP and MCP bridge sidecar adapters. (`a708868`)
- The ACP adapter now sends a coded error to queued turns when an instance fails before its session opens, resolves pending permission and question prompts on Stop, drains the cancelled turn's trailing updates, and clears the cancel registration on every turn exit. (`68f2bc9`)
- Fixed account handling in Core: account ids are no longer derived from the cloud bearer and existing bearer-derived ids are scrubbed on load, the active session survives a failed add-account flow, and gateway-routed Codex no longer re-copies the CLI login during in-Ryu sign-in, account changes or logout. Managed-Pi account removal now promotes or clears correctly, and saved vault accounts are refreshed before a usage read. (`bc60b16`)
- The native vault logins for jwt, cert, aws and kubernetes now answer through a shared login_refusal that maps every typed vault error except Sealed and AuditUnavailable to one fixed 403, "vault_denied: login rejected", with no identity name, method or verifier detail. The JWT login now runs through login_identity so unknown, disabled and other-method refusals are audited, and its source-address refusal records the shared reason text. (`85820b5`)
- The embedded companion UI fixtures under the plugin manifest were regenerated from the updated app sources. (`5a436d3`)

- Made KV v2 compat writes run as one store transaction covering the cas check, writes, removals and version bump, added a monotonic per-folder version that also advances on direct per-key writes, and authorized at folder level before lookup so denied callers get 403 regardless of whether the secret exists. - Closed the item PUT value oracle by comparing sensitive values only for read callers and non-sensitive values only for use/read, using constant-time SHA-256 digests and a 409 that never names the field, with confirmations audited as item.put_confirm. Item timelines now show only the current item to list callers, writes and deletes in protected environments require admin, environments holding items cannot be deleted, and normalize_totp_seed checks the otpauth prefix boundary-safely. (`4ba6b78`)
- Regenerated Cargo.lock from the root lock, bringing it in sync so the canary, nightly and release workflows and the root Dockerfile build again under --locked. (`3bf9b17`)
- Hardened external vault stores: source and destination creation now require folder-wide capabilities on the node folder, the Kubernetes JWT path became operator-only configuration with size and shape checks, and loopback store addresses require explicit opt-in. Also added exponential backoff for failing destinations, blocked pushes between live-sourced and store folders, prevented empty folders from wiping non-empty KV secrets, and aligned write guards and clash checks on scope_id. (`11e4a96`)
- Hardened vault audit devices and fail-closed gating: every secret handout is now gated, with only synchronous file and syslog writes satisfying fail-closed, audit rows fan out to devices and the event bus after commit, and file devices are confined to allowed audit directories. Event policy keys now mirror real route keys, SSE streams re-authenticate periodically and on policy, machine or credential changes, and declarative init rejects unknown nested fields. (`24f1502`)
- Fixed marketplace.describe to resolve listings from the public catalog card used by search and to describe only exact (kind, id) matches, so names, descriptions, pricing, keywords and ratings are populated. - Resolved merge conflicts so the catalog route keeps its cursor, category, query cap, rollout and collection filtering and nextCursor while gaining the kinds parameter, and catalog search filters on per-word clauses. - Refreshed the embedded Warmup UI fixture used by the plugin manifest tests to match the regenerated companion bundle. (`6ec246b`)
- Ported the provider-account work into Core: `warmup.detect` now reports `providers` and window `model`s, `warmup.apply` accepts `provider_account` targets, the scheduler's `AppJob` set accepts `ProviderAccount`, and scheduling one requires the node owner or an org owner/admin via `plugin_host::node_owner_or_admin`. `/heartbeat/jobs` omits provider-account rows unless the caller passes `include=provider_accounts`, and the subscriptions cache, projection, reading, and routing-policy signals were updated alongside. (`8b159fc`)
- PKI tidy now bounds `safetyBufferSecs`, uses checked cutoff math and never tidies unexpired certificates. Transit refuses to encrypt below `minDecryptionVersion`, rejects configurations where `minEncryption` is below `minDecryption`, honours `deletionAllowed` on forced restore, applies `import_version` only to imported keys, and makes DELETE permanent again by default with `?soft=true` opting into soft delete. Identity tokens refuse human callers without a user id, render templates in a single pass, and create the signing key with the issuer so the JWKS is never empty. (`7f1278f`)
- Hardened the vault policy-extension path: parameter constraints now gate dotenv, JSON, and snapshot imports per entry and the value rollback/restore restores; control-group redeem rechecks read before spending a token and returns it if the reveal fails, with the target version pinned at open; open requests are capped at 16 per requester with expired rows pruned on open and list and listing scanning every row. parsePolicyBody now fails closed by refusing controlGroup and parameter constraints, and handler-level tests cover the gated reveal/authorize/redeem flow, the request cap, and the import/rollback bypass. (`9a9e878`)
- Updated the shipped portable loader runtime test to count @ryu/pi-copy among the pinned authored packages. (`6f780aa`)

- Cloud task handling now cleans every lease during recovery even when one cleanup fails, clears the finishing flag through a drop guard when a finish request is dropped, waits at most 30 seconds for a slot before returning cloud_task_busy, refuses networked Box prompts and pushes with cloud_task_desktop_routing while traffic routing is on, and retries by name a setup-check Box whose destroy failed. (`429c380`)
- Cloud tasks and cloud environments were merged: mega's non-blocking observed_state and lock_slot_until ride #718's live runtime labels, the new GET status read answers a held slot from the persisted lifecycle, the JWT payload carries jwtIdentityClaims plus the ryu_flags claim, and the identity_verify test literal gained the new claim fields. (`f909fe8`)
- KV v2 handling was tightened: PATCH /data enforces casRequired when no expectedVersion is sent, GET /subkeys requires VaultWrite consent under route_policy, PATCH /metadata prunes versions through a shared helper and refuses soft-deleted values, and detailed listings require paging with a single batched version query. Handler tests cover capability denial, protected-environment admin gating and stale metadata versions, and the six KV v2 handlers are registered in the OpenAPI paths list. (`129e601`)

Launches through package runners in untrusted folders are refused on sandbox-capable hosts with a workspace_trust config warning and a workspace_untrusted_launch failed-turn frame, while the sandbox runner's order relative to privileged-process protection is documented at the call site. (`8f02a03`)
- Workflow script runs now record a caller_scope digest of the plugin, agent and conversation, and wait_for_script_run returns the same "run not found" for foreign, unscoped or mismatched runs on first load. Legacy runs without a scope stay unreadable until their owner re-issues the same call, and sr- lifecycle hooks no longer carry output or error. (`58fa638`)
- The agent inbox tool now refuses a node id that cannot be a single key prefix, mirroring the server rule that gateway-key callers must address &lt;nodeId>:&lt;agentId>. (`cb21bf1`)
- Vault broker hardening now requires use on every referenced secret for service create, replace and approve; ties machine-minted sessions to the minting token with per-reference policy checks; re-checks sessions on each intercepted request and closes tunnels on revocation or expiry; rate limits CONNECT and caps tunnels per session. Dot-segment and backslash paths are refused before matching, CA bundle variables point at OS roots plus the broker while NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS keeps the CA-only file, the leaf issuer cache drops on seal, ca.pem is read-only until a session mints the CA, substitutions default to headers, and pending proposals are capped at three per principal. (`b8b3d63`)

A router-level request_layer test covers 429s, the unknown-client bucket, encoded-role lease quotas, wrapping, and wrap TTL validation. (`0e1c6bd`)

- Introduced a notification module with push run handling and a store, plus a notifications API endpoint wired into the core entry point. (`e47245a`)
- Added the app-studio UI fixture, extended the plugin manifest module to embed it, and grew the seed plugin list to 42 entries to match the SeedSpec array. (`b9388a2`)

The update apply path keeps the staged swap with fsync and the set_permissions context, with approvals, catalog, plugin host, server routes and workflow modules merged as well. (`d8a51d1`)
- Rustfmt-formatted the consent ACP mapping tests in the sidecar adapters module. (`ca42fe9`)
- Registered the code node in the workflow builder's node list and the NodeKind documentation, and updated executor tests to supply the new repeat field. (`0d24888`)
- Updated the core server module as part of the plugin contribution merge. (`05426c7`)

- Brought core changes spanning access control and delegation, identity verification, the plugin host and plugin secrets, safe actions, sidecar adapters, control plane, deferred authorization, ext proxy, gateway and MCP/Composio paths, voice protocol and session handling, and webhook ingress. Server routes touched include conversations and history rendering, ACP tool brokering, agent sync, native accounts and thread import, notifications, onboarding profile and state, optimizer, realtime websocket, space imports, vault and voice websocket. (`9a8f19a`)

- Updated the plugin_contributions server response to keep avatar accessories and styles while adding the interfaces field. (`1758ebc`)
- Added the Patrol agent alongside Jay Jr., including its system prompt, seeding, managed-Pi routing, ACP adapter registry entry, and tool-broker grants. (`96b74b7`)
- Merged unified-node and worktree-handoff changes into the core server continuity, workspace, conversations, git, and OpenAPI code, preserving linked pull requests and continued-on fields in conversation summaries. (`203f796`)
- Conflicts across the core kernel were resolved: the base startup order, the on-path lookup helper in tool execution, and the research port handling were kept, while the research sidecar tool module and the removed ego-browser production rows were dropped and the legacy inline Deno backend constant absorbed the alias. Plugin manifest, sidecar, plugin host, scheduler, server routes and workflow executor sources were all reconciled. (`e2954c8`)
- Added chat checkpoint storage with its indexes and routes, and extended conversation clearing to delete checkpoint rows alongside message reactions and agent UI state. The sidecar ACP adapter and backup module were adjusted for the merged schema. (`609af8a`)
- Added a workflow.script tool backed by an inline JS sandbox bridge, with a script module, limits, and an auto-resume path that parks runs when a provider limit is hit. The executor keeps the repeat-wrapped retry loop while gaining the provider-limit arm, and the workflow store, delegation, and OpenAPI surface were updated to match. (`71ed77c`)
- Consent card handling was reworked so the merged `ryu-marketplace` and `ryu-catalog` source is canonicalized before the active-source check, restoring first-party installs from chat, while listings from other marketplaces stay Store-only with a recheck step. The sidecar adapter gained a strict filter for follow-up wording, bounded OAuth status requests, ACP consent mapping by qualified tool name only, and schema dispatch limits that require `pluginId` when the provider is `mcp`. (`12b507f`)
- Carried the merged org policy, plugin module, server hook, server and sidecar control-plane changes into core, resolving the merge against the family-plan surfaces work. (`77757e7`)
- Updated the core server's routes, OpenAPI output, and preferences handling, and extended the sidecar adapter module. (`7b6c894`)
- Merged the sidecar adapter and server changes: persist_assistant_reply now combines the reply checkpoint with sealed data parts and writes text, memory citations and stats after finishing the checkpointed row, while the adapter tests kept their credential-masking and proof-key fixtures. The bundled ryu-mcp extension asset and server module were also updated. (`b3c05df`)
- Replaced the $(...) scanner in codex_identity with a recursive POSIX lexer that tracks quotes, backslashes and comments, so only an unquoted ')' at depth 0 closes a substitution and unreadable constructs count as Codex. The classifier now reads PowerShell script blocks and subexpressions, Start-Process, cmd.exe start, and launchers such as exec, sudo, timeout, xargs and watch. (`f9449f0`)
- Merged polite-prompts into the shipped plugin manifest and builtins registration, updated the server module, and recomputed the shipped-portable-loader and grants runtime test counts to 96 packages and 61 granted packages with 120 covered grants. (`14bf78e`)
- Merged conflict resolutions across the agent sandbox, server preferences routes, sidecar ACP adapter, and workflow executor. The ACP adapter kept both the no-secret assertion and the per-secret and unscoped-credential checks, and the cloud-native ACP tests retained the gateway_token field used by their hop proof assertions. (`e0d1472`)
- main() now runs the agent sandbox check synchronously before building the tokio runtime and then calls core_main, with the default startup order and its test preserved. Workspace trust, the gateway, the ACP adapter and direct-spawn path, the server module, and the workflow executor were updated, and the timed MCP lifecycle round budget stayed at 2,000 ms. (`b0dee3d`)
- Added an agent_inbox MCP sidecar tool and registered it in the MCP module. The approvals policy was updated alongside the new tool. (`6832cd7`)
- Updated the plugin seed data so the pull-requests app is seeded with its current manifest. (`aab88d2`)
- Added a server-side auto-resume run module and wired it into server startup and conversation handling, with render-history tests covering resumed conversations. (`a4fd057`)
- Merge conflicts were resolved in the org policy module, the plugins module, and the server hooks, server root and sidecar control-plane files while merging #643. (`59131bc`)
- Composer prediction and chat suggestion server routes were added with their OpenAPI entries, and the shipped portable package count in the loader runtime test was recomputed to 97. (`e169d06`)
- Merged plugin host, plugin manifest, and sidecar adapter changes, and set the shipped-grants runtime test to the base package list (kernel, steel, browser-use, codex-computer-use) without the agents-md-tail row, asserting 59 packages and 117 covered grants. (`afd0c48`)
- Conflicts were resolved across the core sidecar providers, adapters, and downloaders, keeping the port-free checks while taking the installed-snapshot model argument and served-model-name handling, plus the Python engine model and env settings. The jay_jr marker was moved to paths::state_path so the layout guard test stays green. (`4a480b1`)
- Plan mode now refuses a broader set of tools through an isPlanDeniedTool check that blocks mcp__ryu__* tools except tool_search, describe, and ask_user, layered behind the existing per-agent toolScope refusal and applied in the ACP tool broker, MCP bridge, and pi config paths. (`2b742b4`)
- A local egress module was added with frame, mux, entry, exit, and proxy components, exposed through a local egress server API and OpenAPI definitions and hooked into the sidecar manifest and main entry point. (`838f409`)
- Changed the core server module and sidecar adapter module. (`1dfac6c`)
- Updated the sidecar adapter module and MCP catalog, consent tool, and module files. (`b237279`)
- Added a context handoff module and context window adapter to the core server and sidecar adapter set, wiring them through the server module and conversation handling. (`9e6789e`)
- Added a video-drama-studio workflow template and updated the workflow template loader. Added marketplace store workflow tests. (`b987971`)
- Changed the plugin secrets key-value store and its module wiring in the core app. (`c32caa3`)
- Workflow handling changed across the durable workflow, executor, template, notify_user, and workflow builder modules, along with the scheduler and Composio host. (`5dacf21`)
- Catalog source definitions and server module wiring were updated. (`8f6e1fc`)
- Reformatted the sidecar, space file index, and voice session Rust files so the branch adds no cargo fmt --check violations in these files. (`a7cb55f`)
- Changed the context budget trimming helper in the server module into a function to satisfy the borrow checker. (`f2c6411`)
- Added a draft local egress route tunnel module containing a frame codec, credit-limited stream mux, node-side credentialed SOCKS5 and HTTP proxy, node entry session, and desktop exit dialer. The module is not declared in main.rs, so it is not compiled. (`146e1da`)
- Narrowed tool-policy refusals to 400, 401 and 403 so a 404 or other status is treated as an outage that keeps the caller's last rules. Persisted connector grants now record a fingerprint of the gateway key and restore only under the same key, and fleet secret bindings are unique per organization, team and name with a migration for the existing index. (`70187ff`)
- Plugin installs from chat now resolve only against the node's active marketplace, and the host refuses an install the card marks as not installable. The install_plugin schema states its query-or-pluginIds requirement with anyOf so a schema-valid call is not rejected at dispatch. (`0e4d6e0`)
- Bound nodes now persist the enforced connector grant scope and restore it at boot, member feature checks include the member's team policy layers, disjoint allowlists resolve to an explicit deny-all marker, and a caller's cached policy is dropped on an authoritative 4xx while outages keep last-known-good. (`7dc57b1`)
- Core now decodes email_verified strictly from the session JWT and stamps x-ryu-caller-email only from verified_email(), while identity.current reports an empty email for unverified callers. Forged incoming caller email headers are still stripped, and tokens minted before the claim existed count as unverified until refreshed. (`c779f36`)
- The MCP consent tool now returns camelCase result fields, with awaitingUser matching the naming of the request fields. (`e55c61e`)
- Updated Core sidecar consent handling to use camelCase pluginId and pluginIds, removed model-supplied display_name labels, tightened ACP shape detection and title requirements, and aligned rejected client inputs with Core validation. (`b3f7ee4`)
- Core calls ryu_tool_exec::warm_up at startup, compiling the QuickJS guest on a background thread into `<data dir>/cache/js-sandbox` so later starts load the cached artifact instead of compiling on a tokio worker. (`e897511`)
- Updated the catalog package card count to include the new Round-Trip Translate plugin. (`df0752c`)
- Indexed approvals.updated_at so the 60-second history prune seeks old rows instead of scanning every row's JSON under the store lock, with a query-plan assertion. Catalog test managers no longer persist their stub versions into the real data dir's catalog-cache.json. (`7fefa50`)
- Ran the Composio webhook fan-out on a detached task so a sender timeout that drops the handler no longer cancels agent runs whose retries then became duplicates. The durable delivery-id claim is now covered against the real host. (`d01b39a`)
- Charged failed Composio executions that Composio still records: a verified billing receipt is kept on the FailedExecution error and taken from the call handler, the ACP bridge, and Space imports through the existing record_tool_charge path, keeping the composio:{transactionId} refId. Failures without a valid receipt or with an unsafe transaction ID charge nothing, and callers still see the failure. (`b7712e5`)
- Merged the team policies and primary owner work into family sharing, extending org policy plugins, server hooks, and control plane handling so the family owner is the primary owner, primary-owner transfer is refused for families, and both the role ladder and family role limits apply. (`50a28e7`)
- Updated the challenges sidecar tool to give pre-existing Desktop/CLI sessions a sign-in-again message for agent-only challenges and to avoid exposing credit pool ids in public prizes. (`0a8e5ba`)
- Merged slice C of the unified-nodes work, touching the continuity server module and its workspace routes, conversations, git helpers and OpenAPI entries. (`f12dac2`)
- The workspace-blobs HEAD endpoint now reports only blobs actually received rather than ones the node staged for its own export, and resume rejects existing-checkout destinations with a 422 existing-checkout-unavailable response. (`dd43352`)
- Updated the plugin manifest HTML fixtures for the calendar, skill-editor and workflows entries. The change was captured as an unreviewed checkpoint. (`8cdfdc3`)
- Composio deliveries claim their id in a durable SQLite ledger with 72 h retention on both HTTP and relay paths, approvals lists are capped and pruned after 90 days with store failures returning 500, run-now paths share the in-flight set and return 409 on overlap, catalog refresh is single-flight, and local provider children are kept alive instead of orphaned. (`d5d466e`)
- Model-switch handoffs are now keyed by the model change plus the last message before it on the active thread, so branching or editing from a message sent before the switch yields a summary of that branch. The ACP replay reads the active thread, and the model-selection endpoint returns the marker for the branch shown. (`66acd2c`)
- Checkpoint restore now changes a path only when its current bytes are saved in the pre-restore snapshot and reports everything else as skipped. Restore also refuses to run while any chat in the same folder may be writing to it, and the conversations route shares the per-path failure handling. (`fa202a8`)
- Core can summarize pre-switch history once when a conversation changes model and send that briefing plus later turns, governed by the context.handoff-on-model-change policy with smaller-context as default. The decision and summary are stored sealed at rest per model change and replayed on later turns across the OpenAI-compat and ACP planes. (`e951116`)
- The chat checkpoint handlers gained distinct operation ids for listing checkpoints, listing changes and restoring a checkpoint, and the routes were added to the generated Core spec. (`88ed9da`)
- Updated shipped plugin manifest and grants runtime tests so polite-prompts are counted in shipped package coverage. (`daf090c`)
- Carried the Marketplace's approvedVersions into the detail of Marketplace-installed plugins so the Versions tab hides install for unapproved releases, and relayed the control plane's refusal through the portable package install path. (`f20e04c`)
- Added a `historicalVersionGate` so `?version=` requests are served only for a listing's current stable build, a live channel build, or a version whose latest moderation decision is an approval; parked, rejected and never-submitted versions get a 404 with the reason. The detail response now exposes `approvedVersions` and the Versions tab marks rows outside it as `installable: false`. (`ea80b47`)
- Sent `x-ryu-untrusted-caller: 1` on the Gateway hop of untrusted-caller turns via `caller_trust_headers`, and made `/api/mcp/tools/call` accept a restrict-only `untrusted_caller` flag that narrows the agent's allowlist before dispatch. (`f578a79`)
- Stamped `x-ryu-event-delivery: <delivery_id>` on Core's own event fan-out deliveries and stripped that header from every proxied request so only real deliveries carry it. (`b6f0c58`)
- Made plugin revocation honour the disable tiers (403 for mandatory, 409 `load_bearing` without `force`), bounded the `quests.list` and `quests.judge` hops so a hung Quests sidecar cannot stall app jobs, accepted `inline_deno` again as a deprecated alias of `inline_js`, and resolved federated agent-registry install keys through `marketplace_trust_anchor`. (`d7bb51a`)
- Updated the blueprint and pull-request plugin manifest UI fixtures used by the manifest tests. (`f567360`)
- Codex classification now fails closed for script, package-script, env -S, encoded PowerShell and function/alias launches, with regressions added across the sandbox, sidecar adapters and core policy route auth tests. (`6e9e8ad`)
- Refreshed the pull-requests UI plugin manifest fixture to match the updated thread-id behavior. (`64136db`)
- Refreshed the pull-requests UI fixture used by the plugin manifest fixtures. (`220023e`)
- Two ACP tests in the sidecar adapter and gateway modules now take the managed-node env lock before the Gateway env lock, matching the other five tests, and the required order is documented on the lock. (`d78b19f`)
- Refreshed Core's compiled Pull Requests UI fixture so a fresh install seeds the global assistant with the assistant:context grant instead of the old in-app chat bundle. (`b28db1e`)
- PluginSecretStore::candidate_scopes now derives its order from SecretScope::precedence(), the shared credential ladder restricted to the levels the vault stores, via an exhaustive match. Tests pin the previous literal order of user, node, team, org and the team witness gating. (`f6f9d0f`)
- Changed While loop cleanup in the workflow executor to load the iteration's child run and discard the counter and carry only when that child run exists and has Failed. A suspension or a missing or damaged child checkpoint now keeps the loop state, replacing the previous error-message prefix check. (`c69f8ac`)
- The seeded grant for @ryu/pull-requests now approves assistant:context instead of hook:side-model, so the seed matches the plugin's manifest. (`c2cc4da`)
- While-loop counter and carry state is now kept when a pending child's checkpoint is missing or damaged, an integrity refusal, and cleared only when the child itself ran and failed, identified by a shared CHILD_FAILED_PREFIX. (`d1a3cc7`)
- The While loop's counter and carry keys are now dropped when an iteration fails, and kept only when the run suspends so a child can resume the same iteration. (`415e5f3`)
- Three Core files, document_parse.rs, plugins/builtins.rs and server/memory_reflect.rs, were reformatted with rustfmt. (`f78b749`)
- The embedded companion UI fixtures under plugin_manifest were regenerated after the gap fixes. (`9a4bd2a`)
- Closed verified gaps across the Core server, sidecar download manager, and skills catalog modules. (`e96dbe0`)
- Raised the timed round's budget in the MCP lifecycle cancellation test from 200ms to 1.5s so session setup can reach the fixture server under the parallel suite. (`f936f18`)
- HttpProxySpec gained a forward_caller_email flag, default false, so the ext-proxy stamps the verified caller email only for sidecars that opt in while still stripping caller-supplied copies for all sidecars. (`497f96c`)
- Reworked plugin binding and builtins, the server harness and routes, the ACP adapter, MCP and web-search access, delegation authorization, and the ryu-plan extension to close verified gaps. (`c80b5cb`)
- Previously the fixture set only the bearer and failed with "Gateway agent proof unavailable". (`245bb54`)
- set_active_local_engine now stops an engine already running outside the resident slot before starting it, and start_all takes the per-name start lock so a lazy start racing the boot pass cannot spawn a second child for the same name. Blank lines were added before the new rerank and embed tests. (`d552252`)
- An unverified caller's tool allowlist is now built by matching the static safe list against the agent's own allowlist entries instead of a full registry listing, so deriving it no longer starts external MCP servers on each phone turn. Dispatch still re-checks the other gates, and a test confirms a server-level grant still matches the safe tool. (`b9c994a`)
- The cloud-native SSE fixture now resolves its Gateway inference bearer through required_gateway_inference_token(), matching production callers. The fixture previously set the token in the environment but passed no key and stopped at "Gateway inference credential unavailable". (`dc479e7`)
- Voice sessions now accept caller_trusted in the start frame and enforce it: untrusted turns skip plugin turn hooks, narrow the tool allowlist to notify.desktop, set x-ryu-raw-tools when nothing remains, move ACP, A2A and SDK-app runtimes to the default model route, and keep memory, recall, provider sync, personalization, skills, Composio, identity profiles, referenced chats and client tools out of the turn. (`db0eddb`)
- ACP bridge environment scrubbing now records an explicit empty entry under the exact spelling of an unscoped credential, so a case variant such as ryu_gateway_core_token cannot be inherited by the spawned child. (`07ec587`)
- Codex deletion containment now classifies launches through npx without -y, bunx, pnpm dlx, npm exec and --package= forms, including cmd /c wrappers, while still ignoring the agent's own arguments. (`a297afd`)
- ACP adapters now read PromptResponse.usage as the current turn's counts, include cache reads and writes in prompt tokens, fall back to _meta.quota.token_count, forward claude-agent-acp's serving model, and apply OpenAI explicit prompt caching only on GPT-5.6+ without the Anthropic-style TTL. (`5f76e65`)
- Checkpoint work touched the catalog registry, plugin manifest handling, server module, sidecar download manager and install state, and the skills catalog. (`4ab91c2`)
- Re-registered with RyuRelay before resubscribing when a relay stream ended or subscribe returned 409 or 404, persisted changed registration data, and exposed a relay_public_url_changed hook so Core re-reconciles the legacy Composio webhook subscription. (`24d1729`)
- Core's ext-proxy now stamps x-ryu-caller-email from the verified caller email on the hop to sidecars and strips any caller-supplied copy of that header. Tests cover the strip, the stamp over a forged value, and the missing-email case. (`507f6ed`)
- Scheduler restarts are now handled, server sync retries with backoff, and sidecars are started only once through the manager. The llama.cpp classify, embed, and rerank providers plus plugin lifecycle and module wiring were adjusted alongside these changes. (`90fbdbd`)
- The plugin bridge now rejects host calls carrying the x-ryu-web-delegation marker unless web_delegated_candidate admits the caller, so a web-forwarded call no longer inherits unbound-node owner rights. Related server app actions, warmup, webhook, and ext proxy paths were updated. (`ed072ce`)
- Fixed gaps across plugin manifest parsing and plugin loading, catalog scanning, and the sidecar adapters for ACP, generative UI, and live turns. Updated the MCP artifact, spaces, and UI tools, the egress broker and web search access paths, and conversation and harness routes. (`6b92c05`)
- The scheduler tick no longer approval-gates app jobs that still carry a leftover require_approval flag, and DELETE /heartbeat/jobs/:id now answers 409 for a reconciled job whose app will re-list it rather than tombstoning it until it reappears under a fresh id. Uninstall cleanup through the store is unaffected, and a heartbeat app jobs test was added. (`000fbbd`)
- Merged branch 'claude/ultra-remaining' into the core app, touching approvals, safe actions, plugin binding and builtins, scheduler modules and store, sidecar control plane and proxy, server routes, self API, and update handling, plus Cargo.toml. (`0b8d6c1`)
- PUT /heartbeat/jobs now refuses to change an app or quest job's name, schedule or enabled state, and refuses retargeting away from app_job or quest. Run now and approved runs draw on the tick's app-job budget of one per job, two per app and four in total, with 409 while a job is busy and a five-minute wait for approved runs; approvals accept include=app_jobs. (`163869e`)
- GET /api/version now advertises a web_delegated_ext feature flag, and route resolution refuses ext path segments containing encoded question marks or hashes at any decode layer. Added multiplayer journey tests covering admitted and refused org members, route permissions, and unannotated routes. (`87bf827`)
- Added a companion test that reads safe_actions::routes() from source and asserts its method and route set matches the operator-role test table, and made the webhook secret-bridge tests delete their wf-secret-* workflows on drop. (`70272b4`)
- Dropped a llama.cpp cache-miss assertion from the sidecar adapter tests, since Core derives cacheMissTokens only when a cache-write count exists and llama.cpp reports none. (`f163cbf`)
- Added a test pinning that an app job falling due again while its first run is still in flight is deferred to a later tick without advancing last_fired or taking a second app permit, plus a fixture formatting fix. (`c5a3a1b`)
- Two runtime tests were repaired after the combined merges: the shipped portable loader now expects 95 packages and 14 MCP configs, and the reasoning verify test's code_file resolver includes the reasoning turn hook. (`1132d51`)
- Updated conversations handling and the sidecar MCP capability tools, including owner host env credential scrubbing, with runtime tests for shipped grants and reasoning verify capabilities. (`88d3533`)
- Core's sidecar ext proxy now stamps x-ryu-web-delegation: admitted on every web-delegated forward, overwriting any value supplied by the sidecar. (`48acb0c`)
- Updated the Core sidecar's gateway comment to state the 500 micro-USD cost_per_tool_call_micro_usd default rather than 300. (`27dc341`)
- notify.deliver and the events.emit notify hint now require the Gateway-approved notifications:send-to-user grant when targeting a recipient other than the node's active user; writing to the active user is unchanged. Doc comments in the notify rationale and kernel-handler pin guard were also corrected. (`60026dd`)
- Merged the ultra-remaining branch, bringing its changes across the app boundary guard, plugin host, builtin plugins, file notes, MCP call, notify and sidecar proxy files. (`7b737f8`)
- Reviewed the three pinned kernel-handler capabilities and kept every pin, correcting stale comments in the capability grant, notify rows, dispatch docs and Meetings plugin docs. Added the only-shrink guard no_new_kernel_handler_app_pins, which also inventories the ghost.* and email.* pins, and pinned the grants on the pinned rows with kernel_capability_grants_are_pinned. (`e522007`)
- Added coverage for agent sandbox identity handling and the sidecar ACP adapters, including the direct spawn path. (`ab61cd3`)
- Merged the healing and cross-app grants branch, adding an app boundary guard and healing client and touching run failures, the scheduler, plugin manifest and seeding, sidecar event subscribers, the ext proxy, workflow executor and server run routes. (`c29dabf`)
- Merge brought the warmup capability work in `server::app_warmup`, the server module wiring, the plugin bridge API and the ext proxy into Core. (`c592bd7`)
- Reformatted the Core data path module in data_path.rs. (`0609005`)
- Changed the optimizer fixture to open agents.db from db/, touching the agents module and optimizer API tests. (`2479fec`)
- Fixed the dev-execution fixture to create the runtimes/ parent directory. (`289e9f2`)
- Updated audio.cpp and ACP registry path assertions to the new data-folder layout. (`a48e6a8`)
- The refusal returned when a plain hook:run-agent app streams to an agent that runs its own tools (ACP/A2A/SDK) now names the grant needed to resolve it; the route itself stays refused. (`7b03e17`)
- Work-in-progress checkpoint of the data directory re-layout, touching the notify store and sidecar onboarding. (`ee2ff57`)
- Merged the rust-batch-decisions branch, touching plugin builtins, app webhooks, data admin, the plugin bridge and uninstall routes, sidecar adapters and the extension proxy. (`b177265`)
- Checkpointed in-progress work on the data directory re-layout in the catalog registry; this is a work-in-progress snapshot. (`71a7106`)
- Documented at the plugin install path why a URL install persists inline hook code and what protections still apply; no behaviour changed. (`30168f2`)
- Added builtins::is_system_labelled, defined as is_uninstall_protected, and projected it as the system flag on installed apps and catalog entries so uninstall-protected built-ins such as docs and composio-connect are labelled System. (`d3c2e2a`)
- Core now validates an uninstall, purges selected data:&lt;category> rows while the app is still enabled, then deactivates and removes it; failed purges complete the uninstall and are reported in cleanup_errors. Saved secrets are always deleted, while key-value storage is kept unless delete_storage is true. (`0ca1991`)
- Propagated the data directory re-layout across core path resolution, sidecar downloaders and providers, plugins and manifests, scheduler and workflow stores, backups, updates, and server routes. The changes are checkpoint 3 of an in-progress migration. (`d2e32fa`)
- Layers now only tighten. (`03aad6f`)
- The streaming host bridge at POST /api/plugins/:id/host/stream now derives tool scope from the same grants as the unary path: no hook:run-agent is refused, plain hook:run-agent runs read-only, and hook:run-agent:write keeps the full tool set. A read-only run sets ChatStreamRequest::read_only_tools, which restricts the turn to Core-governed routes, narrows the Gateway tool loop to readOnlyHint tools, and drops client and Composio actions. (`882da95`)
- Applied rustfmt to the Pi 1.x adoption changes in pi_config and the ACP sidecar adapter, with no behavior change. (`d10511b`)
- Added runtime project and user policy handling to the server and sidecar control plane wiring. (`9fba0b3`)
- Swept data_path.rs, paths.rs and a large set of core modules — servers, sidecar providers and downloaders, workflow, storage and catalog code — onto the new data directory layout. Also touched maintenance areas such as backups, usage history and update scheduling, with the change still in progress. (`4a19e1d`)
- Enforced that context hook rewrites leave messages before the newest user message byte-identical and that ACP replaces only append to the built prompt, ignoring directives that violate this and routing appended text through the pooled session's turn delta. - run_command_tool_with_agent_and_workspace now refuses egress_url_arg without bin_version before any I/O, so convenience wrappers cannot skip the version probe. PATH lookup now skips directories and files without an execute bit instead of selecting them and failing at spawn. (`dc9090c`)
- Restart-for-update now gets a 20s drain, then stops the Gateway and sidecars and exits 75 instead of waiting forever. A deferred update no longer restarts when the Gateway could not be updated alongside Core; a forced llama.cpp or embeddings update stops and restarts every server sharing the install directory; and each skill install stages in its own directory. (`8c80e84`)

- The bootstrap port test in the plugin manifest module no longer expects the removed teams row. (`254a96c`)

- Renamed ToolBackend::InlineDeno to ToolBackend::InlineJs with no alias across the plugin manifest, schema, builtins, isolation, approvals, sidecar bridges, env scrubbing and MCP catalog. - The `@team` chat paths and `agent_builder.create_agent_team` now reach teams through `crate::agent_teams` over `CapabilityConsumer`; `teams_client.rs`, `ServerState.teams` and `McpRegistry::with_teams_client` were deleted, and a disabled or missing provider surfaces as a typed refusal delivered as an error turn. (`f757053`)
- Mesh and app sidecar assets are now fetched from the running Core's own release first, with `latest` as the fallback for an unreleased local build, through a shared helper. (`f0e886c`)
- Engine catalog entries for ZeroClaw, Ghost and Shadow now check the repositories their downloaders install from, and version comparison ignores a leading `v` and uses semver where both sides parse. Forced sidecar updates now run one install per sidecar at a time and stop a running sidecar before replacing its files, and MCP update application walks every registry page, keeps the newest version per server, and applies against the source that was checked. (`149adfd`)

- Coalesced ACP Thinking snapshots to at most one per 50 ms, with close_thought and the persistence checkpoint flushing the latest text. Fixed the live_turn replay budget to track the size each entry actually holds, removed buffering copies from frame logging, broadcast and the durable driver's client forwarding, and added a ReplyCheckpoint for OpenAI-compatible, local engine and SDK app replies that saves partial text up to every 2 s so a mid-reply crash keeps it. (`6feaf6b`)
- Gated GET /api/gateway/traffic behind audit.view and GET /api/gateway/budget/spend behind gateway.configure, so neither streams other members' data to any caller with gateway:route. Unbound local nodes keep full access through enforce_permission, and a member's own spend remains available at /api/usage/me. (`2b6f0f8`)
- The ghost and shadow downloaders now reject unsupported platforms before downloading and hint at an unpublished release when a checksum is missing, with the builtin plugin and tool lists updated to match. (`624ceb3`)
- Read-aloud now returns 400 tts_engine_unknown for malformed engine ids or a RyuTTS 404 unknown engine while outages still fall back to OuteTTS, sharing the check and RyuTTS call with voice sessions. audio.cpp moved from MLX's 8086 to 8091 with a test asserting local engine and sidecar default ports are unique in every profile, sd.cpp refuses a busy port and is ready only when /v1/models reports sd-cpp-local, code_file paths reject `a..js`, and ACP keeps a blank entry for every configured credential spelling. (`12486db`)

It also prefers org GitHub App installation tokens for cloud environment checkouts, clears managed governance and its locks when a resolution omits them or the node's binding changes, and fails closed on unresolved tool rules and unreadable limits.

- Added marketplace asset and workflow runtime lifecycle tests, updated portable package runtime and workflow executor/templates, and extended Mem0 runtime coverage. (`cce239a`)
- Hardened the core server's trust and resource boundaries across the catalog source, plugin host and built-ins, sidecar gateway and MCP sandbox, and tool execution paths. (`8ad0bc7`)

- Repaired the committed Composio billing helper declarations in the Core sidecar gateway. (`470cd9a`)
- Bound direct Pi turns to a selected saved API-key or OAuth account using Manual, Round robin and Fill first policies, preserving existing bindings and rejecting disabled or removed credentials. Recorded the account and configured model before dispatch for usage history and subscription cost attribution, and normalized Windows Node/Pi launch paths. (`1eb8cd8`)
- Wired Composio usage metering and managed zero-data-retention gating through core's tool usage, Connect events, sidecar, and webhook ingress host paths. (`e55b1b8`)
- Bound managed Pi OAuth and API-key credentials, usage attribution, and conversation affinity to the captured conversation account across picker changes and restarts. Prevented provider, model, and cache authentication overrides from substituting another account and preserved account-qualified ACP pooling and resume. (`9b566e7`)
- Updated governance, server, and sidecar adapter code to honor managed worktree settings with recoverable cleanup. (`5d4ccff`)
- The built-in Ryu App Catalog plugin source and the server special-casing that hid it were removed, and the Ghost and Shadow downloaders now record the real installed version instead of "latest". (`20ec47c`)
- Aligned HTTP tenancy with the realtime rule so remote anonymous callers on an unbound node no longer see signed-in rows. Added the loopback user-JWT broker, a member my-usage route, a workflow edit permission check on save, 409 responses for stale saves, a two-person journey test, and OpenAPI entries, while removing stale dead-code allowances. (`22a64f4`)
- Agent and workflow saves now compare the incoming revision and refuse stale writes with a revision conflict instead of overwriting. (`6ce6790`)
- Space sync now keeps a device's concurrent edit as a sync-conflict version rather than discarding it. (`d3a59da`)
- Added connected-app trigger suggestions across the Composio host, notification module and agent runner. (`05d465e`)
- Updated pi configuration and ChatGPT API handling to keep native ChatGPT conversations tied to their OAuth account. (`a879ad0`)
- Expanded direct provider connections in pi configuration and the OAuth login flow, including the OAuth login script. (`214a1e6`)
- Updated core Rust plugin host, server continuity, conversations, sync, sidecar gateway and manifest, tool registry host, and workflow delegation and executor paths as part of bottleneck optimizations. (`b0202e4`)
- Updated the core dev runtime and dev script to support recovery of active chats through development reloads. (`ea658e1`)
- Set the space file index store to synchronous NORMAL in WAL mode, removing a full disk sync on every commit for this rebuildable store; a process crash still loses nothing, while a power cut or OS crash can drop the most recent writes without corrupting the file. (`e5abcbc`)
- Agent version probes now go through CatalogManager's shared HTTP client and in-memory cache with a single serialized save and per-key fetch times, and installed CLI version checks are cached by binary path, size and mtime with failed probes left uncached. Message appends now run upsert, title history, insert and leaf advance in one transaction. (`aa290f2`)
- Reused ACP sessions now send each turn's query context and the capability hint after the user text, so auto-recall, the memory prefetch, referenced chats and the capability hint reach the agent after the first turn. The recent-memory window is kept apart and not resent. (`adba895`)
- Skills distribution tests were made to pass on Windows by building expected paths with native separators, restricting the backup-rehash case to Unix, and adding a Windows counterpart that pins the held-open destination outcome. (`0a566fb`)
- Inline base64 image payloads in MCP tool results are replaced with a short type and size note before the head and tail cut, so the text-only model edge no longer receives undecodable base64 while UI tool rows keep the raw result. The engine health poll now backs off from 25 ms to 250 ms. (`338ebc0`)
- Auto-recall, the recent-memory window, the memory-provider prefetch and referenced chats moved out of the leading system message into a server-only turn context field, appended to the newest user message on the OpenAI-compatible plane and joined ahead of the capability hint on the ACP plane. The cached system block now stays stable across turns and the stored transcript is untouched. (`aeeec73`)
- Auto-routing now caches rule description vectors per model and dimensions so only the query is embedded each turn. The preferences open_default path returns one process-wide handle instead of reopening SQLite and rerunning WAL and schema setup on every call. (`ff8317e`)
- The context cut checkpoint step is now derived from settings only, at a quarter of the configured window. A per-conversation process memo holds the last cut so it never moves backwards, keyed by conversation id on ACP or the oldest turn on OpenAI-compatible paths and applied while the dropped-message fingerprint and step still match. (`0284ea0`)
- Added the phone assistant server surface, including gateway phone call routes, voice websocket and session handling, protocol definitions, and OpenAPI registration. (`ffaa1a1`)
- Added a gate for sidecar agent bridge runs in the plugin host bridge. (`f741194`)
- Enforced app agent run permissions in the plugin bridge, plugin bridge API, and sidecar adapters. (`5a5f2f0`)
- Added a reply_cadence hook match gate in Core, evaluated before any spawn, so hooks such as chat-title skip turns they would not act on; forced runs through run_hook are unaffected. (`524b76c`)
- Plugin hook execution now starts the same once-per-process Deno adopt-or-download as the MCP bridge tool listing, so hooks no longer silently degrade to no-ops on nodes that never listed bridge tools. (`3c62d48`)
- threads.read and threads.send_message now read a single thread's run status, agent and folder through ConversationStore::get_summary_visible with a bound id, instead of loading and decrypting the caller's whole visible conversation list. The bridge dispatch test's handled-method list was also updated to include the execution pause, resume and status methods. (`9d8a92f`)
- Context window trimming now snaps the cut to checkpoints every half-budget of history counted from the oldest message, keeping the replayed prefix stable while the kept tail still fits the budget. External tool results on the shared model edge, covering both the ACP bridge and the chat tool loop, are capped at 100k characters with head and tail kept around an omitted-count marker; meta-tool JSON envelopes are exempt. (`d044d30`)
- Capped the observed ACP tool title map at 128 titles per agent instead of retaining every distinct tool-call title for the life of Core. (`b602647`)
- Delegated subagent instances are now closed when the call returns and cancelled when a wall-time limit drops the call, and workflow runs close their wfrun agent instances once the run stops. Directive hooks within one phase now run concurrently with an order-preserving join, so a turn waits for the slowest hook rather than the sum of all hooks. (`18f0425`)
- Extended the plugin manifest and server module so extension-contributed backgrounds are carried through to clients. (`a21348b`)
- The ACP sidecar adapter now reopens a stopped pooled chat via session/load for agents that take no Ryu bridge and advertise loadSession, draining replayed history before the first turn and falling back to a fresh session on failure. (`5c90630`)
- GET /api/media/:file now streams from disk instead of buffering the whole object, honours a single Range: bytes= request including suffix and open ranges, and serves mp4/webm/mov with their real content types. (`e2d0ea3`)
- The idle ACP session timeout default in the ACP runtime moved from 10 minutes to 5. (`6081a3c`)
- Added resuming of stopped Claude Code chats through session/new resume metadata and added a background check that stops the least-recently-used idle ACP agent every 30 seconds while available memory is under a tenth of RAM. (`46077d7`)
- The ACP adapter now sets strictMcpConfig and consistent setting sources through one helper for chat sessions, config probes, and session resume/load, so Claude Code chats start only the MCP servers passed through Ryu's bridge rather than every user-level server. On one idle chat with 11 user servers this measured 1,631 MB to 503 MB resident and 32.7 s to 20.8 s session start. (`70d10ba`)
- Measured on one idle Claude thread, this freed roughly 80 MB resident and moved initialize from 1.4 s to 0.5 s. (`dbd36fe`)
- ACP admission now tracks evictions in flight so a waiter can evict again when the slot it freed was taken by another waiter, instead of waiting for an idle TTL. (`748d63c`)
- ACP process trees are stamped with an env marker and killed on instance exit, with orphaned trees from a crashed Core swept at startup. When the admission gate is full, the least-recently-used idle instance is evicted per waiter instead of holding its permit through the TTL. (`3dd846e`)
- Bounded sync and relay responses in the MCP bridge sidecar adapter. (`551520b`)
- Updated authorization, server setup, and sidecar adapters so agent credentials are isolated and relays are scoped, with the environment example adjusted for the new configuration. (`f68feff`)
- Webhook ingress now requires a signed timestamp and uses a durable delivery replay guard, with the ingress host wiring updated to support it. (`17eed8c`)
- Authorization delegation logic now issues node-bound delegations in place of shared user JWTs. (`ec262ab`)
- Enforced signed agent binding on REST tool routes in the core server. (`3f61177`)
- Required vault-write consent for secret mutation in the authorization and server modules. (`aec79ac`)
- Updated the MCP sandbox sidecar logic to retain Daytona metering until the remote sandbox is stopped. (`ed87488`)
- Added core fleet and server wiring for the managed node command center. (`81bc940`)
- Merged per-window presence reports so an idle second window no longer marks the user away, and refused presence and gaming writes on organization-bound nodes while skipping game detection there. Added a seeded Not games ignore list and matched the ask_user bridge tool by its title to prevent duplicate Question cards. (`d3a58b4`)
- Integrated a node-wide kill switch plugin across execution control, the scheduler, the plugin host bridge, A2A outbound calls, and sidecar adapters. (`bf68cf6`)
- Updated the Self-API router so path arguments remain within their route. (`4ab2dd3`)
- Bounded ZIP extraction by actual decoded bytes in data path and portable package handling. (`bcea9d9`)
- Changed the MCP client sidecar so transport URLs are stripped from errors surfaced to agents. (`7235a5c`)
- Enforced agent tool capabilities in the shared dispatch path, including approval and MCP bridge/sidecar dispatch code. (`3a89554`)
- Bounded delimited Space import parsing in the server import handler. (`80d9732`)
- Bound authenticated fetch in identity consult to the canonical URL host. (`9618e81`)
- Reduced repeated history work in the conversations server route. (`a063969`)
- Updated core entry points, plugin manifest and builtin loading, sidecar adapters and runtime paths, and MCP catalog and suggestion tooling. (`1359a5a`)
- Hardened the catalog source and server module for agent-facing package execution paths. (`fa91ef7`)
- Updated the plugin manifest, binding, and builtins to align the web search toolkit with Parallel. (`439673f`)
- Updated core plugin module wiring, conversation and auto-title server handlers, the OpenAPI definitions, and the crate manifest. (`cf8c1e8`)

### `ryu-crypto`@0.5.0

[Published package](https://crates.io/crates/ryu-crypto/0.5.0)

#### Patch changes

- The crate manifest was updated as part of merging origin/main into the release branch. (`1903ef3`)
- Merged origin/main into the crate's Cargo manifest, taking the dependency security bumps. (`1438289`)
- Received main's update to the crate manifest during the merge. (`974ca98`)
- Split the plugin key store into separate file, SQL, SQLite and seal modules with their own tests, and updated the crate manifest. (`5c03086`)
- Gained a plugin_keys module with file, SQL, SQLite, and store-seal helpers plus tests, exposing the sealing primitives that satellite backends now call directly. (`d7b9cf5`)
- Documented the headless `plugin_keys` test command and its log target, with the crate manifest touched alongside the docs. (`5a274f5`)
- Added the plugin_keys module holding the shared key-state logic, file and store sealing helpers, and the SQLite ryu_seal/ryu_open functions behind a new sqlite-functions feature. Test coverage for the module was added alongside it. (`79ab882`)
- Updated cryptographic app-key, blind-index, content, custody, sealed-file, secret-file and vector-index code, plus test vectors and README. (`0af1456`)
- A mismatched legacy crypto key is now preserved with a warning instead of being treated as fatal. (`21f287f`)
- Edited the crypto crate's library source during the in-progress remediation snapshot. The commit marks it as unverified. (`113293c`)
- Adjusted content encryption, the SQLite content store, custody handling, and the crate's public exports. (`1cc077c`)
- Updated the crypto crate library code as part of the audit remediation checkpoint. (`3a960fa`)
- Reworked the crypto crate around sealed storage: added app-key handling, blind indexing, content and SQLite content sealing, custody, process keys, sealed files and logs, secret files and a vector index, and documented the crate in a new README with content-v1 and biome test vectors. (`07be026`)
- Updated the crypto crate's implementation in lib.rs, its Cargo manifest, and its lockfile. (`ddf18f0`)
- Merged main's crypto crate manifest, lockfile and library source, re-applying the unprefixed Agent, Bot and OS naming in the source. (`a01db11`)
- Merged origin/main into ryu-crypto, updating the crate manifest, lockfile, and library source. (`cdb7957`)
- Reformatted the desktop app key module without changing its behaviour. (`49d43cb`)
- Added app_webview_keys, which derives a store's webview key under the current desktop key and under each key the slot used earlier. (`47375c5`)
- Adjusted the custody module to support access to the per-profile retired key slots used when copying a profile. (`b3d566b`)
- App key resolution now fails when a slot has been used, detected through a recorded key check value or a sealed desktop file, rather than minting a file key while the keychain is unreachable. The recorded key check value pins the current key when keychain and file disagree, and the other key stays a retired root that still opens. (`6dd0fb2`)
- Updated ContentSqlite store opening to call the gated vacuum variant, deferring large compactions to the background worker. (`a558edf`)
- Reworked the content and custody probe logic to try the newest sealed bodies before the oldest and succeed if any opens, and supported adopting a key the probe rejects. (`908599f`)
- The content SQLite store now runs pending vacuum work at startup instead of skipping large stores, with deferral left to owners that register a background job. (`ffe18f3`)
- The background compaction test in the content SQLite store was made independent of available free disk space. (`6b50546`)
- Node restore now writes every retired key into file custody with a rewritten retired-key index, while recovery files carrying only the master key still restore. (`0d0e496`)
- The content SQLite store now zero-fills freed pages one 64 MiB chunk per transaction with a WAL truncate after each, only while a chunk plus headroom is free. (`8862e2a`)
- Merged changes to the crypto crate's library entry point. (`b4f7dfd`)
- Added VectorIndex::search_filtered so callers can rank only a scoped set of ids instead of sorting every vector. (`477ada9`)
- A resealed Retired store recorded the current root's KCV in the transaction that finished its last item when no value stayed unreadable. RecoveredLog printed a record count and byte total instead of decrypted records. (`d1678d0`)
- Content ciphers reported stores sealed under retired keys as Retired. (`67fdccd`)
- Marked a store vacuum_pending in the transaction that starts an unfinished item so a kill before finish_store leaves the scrub owed, made migrate_columns reject stores recorded under a key the cipher does not hold, and gave the desktop webview key its own salt and crate-owned info (app_webview_key_bytes) pinned in the shared vectors. (`019a6a5`)
- Crypto now reports file custody while a key file adopted into the keychain still exists as a recovery copy in the data folder, so status surfaces and the recorded key check value reflect it. A host-parameterised custody report was added. (`53dd45c`)
- Hardened the content-store SQLite migration: the write lock is taken before each batch read so a concurrent writer waits instead of failing the batch, migration and completion are refused without secure_delete, and a blocked WAL truncation is now an error that leaves the store vacuum_pending instead of reporting it clean. (`5e6b081`)
- Added content sealing formats: an encb:v1 content cipher bound to store, purpose and record ids, blind indexes with a shared term tokenizer, write-once RYU-SF01 files with Range reads and seal-in-place, append-only RYU-SL01 logs, an f16 vector index under one process-wide budget, and a sqlite migration helper. Custody now records a key check value, never generates a key over sealed data, recovers from a matching candidate, keeps up to four retired keys, and checks a data-format marker. (`13cdc50`)
- Gained sqlite and test-ephemeral-host features along with tokenizer, f16, free-space and optional rusqlite dependencies. (`371898a`)
- Updated the crypto library implementation. (`e3a5e18`)
- Changed write_key_file to publish a master key file without replacing an existing one, so a process that loses the race adopts the key on disk, and the keychain-unwritable fallback also adopts an existing file key. (`21ed6bc`)
- Added the ryu_crypto::secret_file primitive with read, write and reseal, sealing before an atomic owner-only temp-file swap with fsync and rename, refusing symlinks and oversized bodies, and resealing legacy plaintext once while treating an unopenable sealed body as an error. (`1f0b58b`)
- Carried the merged bug-sweep changes into the crypto crate's library module. (`064e1f6`)
