### `ryu-gateway`@0.5.0

#### Minor changes

- Registered the Vercel lane only when providers.vercel.resale_permission reads approved with a written reference, recording the reason as the activation error otherwise. Vault keys now only fill an authored lane, and custody gate tests cover upstream identity for the new lane. (`bc1cd18`)
- Ryu-operated Gateways now fold model-call audit rows for a hosted credential into per-minute windows and post closed minutes to the abuse ingest endpoint on a dedicated reporter task, limited to 2000 windows and 3 MB per request with the cursor advancing only on 2xx. Charged cost is shared between stored rows and live records. (`2240b62`)
- A provider safety refusal held on ProviderRejected now settles into UpstreamSafetyRefused on fleet or managed-node custody, returning a 403 with layer upstream and recording one abuse.upstream_* violation and a live-feed verdict. Self-hosted custody keeps an ordinary rejection and records nothing, non-streamed content_filter completions record a RefusedUpstream event, and no fallback, circuit penalty, quarantine or account cooldown is applied. (`046899f`)
- Enforced abuse ladder L2 throttle and L3 restrict levels from the resolve standing, and held keys younger than 24 hours to 30 rpm and 4 in flight. org_limits::check_request now returns a Result so chat, compat, media, embeddings, video, web, provider calls and tool loops apply the ladder rates with their own refusal codes. (`e4ac882`)
- Added screener.Dockerfile, docker-compose.fleet.yml and fleet/screening.toml to run a digest-pinned CPU decision screener on an internal network beside the unchanged gateway, with tests pinning the private-network backend table and that compose sets every variable it names without depends_on. (`802d268`)
- Screener admission, buffered output blocks, stream cuts and the inbound firewall and residual screen now build ViolationEvents through a new record_violation path on AppState, and a reporter task drains the outbox to /api/abuse/ingest. (`9c6a12b`)
- The hazard screener is wired into the gateway: [screening] config with backends by id plus the node_classifiers opt-in and degraded_rpm, the platform floor's screener field with its replica checks, screening of admission in pre_process and on every dispatch attempt, tool rounds, embeddings, rerank, media, transcription, auxiliary calls and /v1/providers/call, output screening for buffered and streamed responses, per-backend breakers, new safety GatewayError variants, and GET /v1/screening/status. Backends are probed at boot and every 10 s, and on Fleet a remote processor key equal to a held provider credential refuses startup. (`80c1b07`)
- gateway now depends on the new screening crate, with test-backends enabled only for dev dependencies, and its firewall module was rewired to the new taxonomy support. The standalone lockfile was resynced. (`52e6542`)
- GET /v1/traffic events now carry a per-process sequence number, a kind, routing and custody details, stage latencies, and a structured verdict naming the deciding layer, action and catalogue code. The SSE handler deduplicates by sequence, firewall sanitize and warn decisions ride on the completion, guardrail and failure rows publish without the audit store, and ?org filtering pins non-master callers to their own org. (`6126465`)
- The platform floor is now applied first in FirewallResolver on the node base and tightened only by later overlays, with the floor kept until a newer valid one arrives and lockable fields locked. Resolves advertise the platform_floor capability, and a fleet gateway with no floor returns a retryable 503 screening_unavailable with the master key exempt. (`c486f64`)
- Enforced platform standing from /gateway/resolve and enforcement invalidations, fail-closed on missing or malformed standing and mapping org, user and key suspensions to 00.7 policy_violation refusals. (`45af0a2`)

A Block that ends a stream on either path now writes a firewall audit row, with scope tests covering a tenant Block, a tenant custom pattern and a tenant Sanitize policy over a warn-only node. (`4b55f7f`)
- On a floor-bound gateway only a transport error, a 5xx, a 408 or a 429 may fall back, so a 402 now ends the attempt chain like any other upstream 4xx and is no longer re-run on the Ryu Router route from an own-supply slot. A managed node now ends the chain on an upstream refusal and returns the refusal itself instead of wrapping it as all_providers_unavailable. (`06e995a`)
- Provider and gateway errors now carry their HTTP status, with every 4xx other than 402, 408 and 429 becoming a rejected variant, and penalizes_provider_circuit narrowed to an allowlist of 5xx, 408, unreadable replies and 401 refused credentials. Every fallback loop returns a safety outcome at once, Fleet custody returns an upstream refusal unwrapped instead of as all_providers_unavailable, may_fall_back drops PolicyViolation, and is_row_unavailable quarantines only on a structured 404 or 401. (`92921ae`)
- Widened the fleet query-credential gate to refuse rgw_ tokens that start at any word boundary in decoded query strings, including inside JSON values and after separators. Added the custody gate probe suite. (`f824606`)
- Changed query-token refusal audit rows, warnings, and traffic events to record the matched route template instead of the raw request path, keeping agent proof segments out of audit data. Added a test that the proof never reaches the audit row. (`4a03697`)
- Closed tool-loop screen gaps by screening object keys at every depth and URLs under media keys, and by screening injected tool definitions before they join the tool set. Object-shaped function arguments are normalized to JSON text and new probe tests cover the screen. (`cff643c`)
- Merged gateway changes in organization limits, inference governance, web pipeline handling, and policy alerts. (`0588629`)
- Added a probe suite proving the strict provider-call screen still dispatches benign object keys, URLs, image.src values, PNG data URIs, base64 runs under file, allowed methods and plain slugs. Method matching became case-insensitive, and Treg dispatch now sends the canonical uppercase token so an app forwarding a lowercase catalog method is served instead of refused. (`8950ae4`)
- Moved managed provider-call bodies onto a strict argument walk that screens object keys like values, including inside stringified JSON, and checks every string percent-decoded and base64-decoded when it decodes to text, closing the data:;base64, prefix, media-key URL, padded base64 and object-key bypasses. The screened wire now carries the method, Composio account id and body orgId, methods are allowlisted and the action slug charset is restricted in both validation and treg segmentation, and cross-org billing by a trusted forwarder requires a Core proof for the billed org while credit_gate reads that org's wallet. Refusals after authentication now write one ExecCall audit row naming the verified org. (`57c6023`)
- Extended the gateway with online evals, the evaluators registry and execution path, evaluator and config routes, metrics, state and telemetry wiring, and pipeline auxiliary updates. (`b1b04f3`)
- Added a probe in the tool-loop screen tests that runs both tool loops with the local firewall off and a control-plane locked prompt_injection guardrail, asserting the request ends with 403 after one provider call and no fallback call. (`b568102`)
- Both the unified tool loop and the Composio loop now screen appended model-turn content and raw tool results before re-dispatch, ending the request with 403 policy_violation and a failure audit row instead of replaying on the fallback provider. The screen is detection-only so request bytes and prompt caching are unchanged, and regression probes cover injection, secret and newline-split payloads in both loops. (`1c54391`)
- Added a provider_call_guard pipeline that runs before upstream I/O on POST /v1/providers/call: it screens provider-bound strings with locked guardrails, applies per-key request and burst limits, runs the managed pre-flight credit gate, and writes an ExecCall audit row for every refusal and executed call. A caller-supplied fallbackCostMicroUsd above $1 is clamped and the clamp is audited. (`d9e41ab`)
- The outbound text residual walk now screens non-media URL keys such as webhook_url and callback_url instead of skipping every *_url key; media keys are limited to explicit names plus modality keys. Added a probe that a secret in a nested Replicate webhook_url is refused before dispatch. (`798a110`)
- Replaced the outbound text extractor's key-name skip list with a zone-based walk that screens arrays and objects under control keys, tools that are not tools[].function, prose under media keys, and secrets padded into long base64 runs. Screening stays detection-only, with phase-0 probes and benign controls added. (`5b0c9d4`)
- Added `pipeline/outbound_text`, an extractor that walks every string leaf of the dispatched body and returns the text the named fields do not cover, including parsed or unescaped forms of stringified JSON. Chat, compat, Responses, embeddings, rerank, images, video, TTS and STT now screen that residual with the regex firewall and locked guardrails; the body is never rewritten, and uncovered matches are refused under Block and Sanitize. (`6284e45`)
- Introduced a single admit_request helper so chat, embeddings/rerank, images/audio, video, web and auxiliary routes all emit Retry-After, RateLimit and RateLimit-Policy headers plus error.retry_after on per-key refusals, while bare inbound 429s again send no Retry-After. The server-wide timeout now returns a gateway_timeout JSON envelope instead of an empty 504, the CORS layer exposes the rate-limit and routing headers, and the firewall audit row uses the request's x-request-id. (`ddc1805`)
- Reworked the evals, evaluators, and metrics endpoints plus online eval execution and registry handling, with corresponding config and state changes in the gateway service. (`dac9704`)
- Added gateway API modules for audit, firewall, and providers alongside config, connection, credit-pool, and org-limit handling. Extended the inference pipeline with gen-AI telemetry, inference governance, own-supply, provider-usage, tool-round, and web stages, plus policy alerting, traffic, reporter, and treg updates. (`53d1e5f`)
- Adjusted the gateway pipeline to carry ACP traffic through the refreshed bearer handling. (`fdef24e`)
- Provider API, connections and error handling were updated for the Treg routing follow-ups, with the GenAI telemetry pipeline step adjusted. (`c93ea86`)
- Updated the gateway providers and connections APIs so an endpoint the catalog cannot tie to a brand stays on Composio when a pin is set, while the gateway can still serve operator-priced ids. (`032109a`)
- Changed the pipeline to compute the gws1 owner binding before the scope is moved, so the binding uses the original scope. (`b9780b1`)
- Reworked the inference pipeline so independent requests run concurrently and prompt prefixes stay cache-stable, and attributed background model spend in governance and traffic accounting. The audit insert now names both new audit_log columns with 42 placeholders and binds both values, and the chat, config, firewall, passthrough, node-routing, web and tool catalog paths were updated to match. (`f52b90f`)
- Updated the gateway's provider and connection APIs so a Composio provider pin is honored on either brand. (`d9fec13`)
- Bound gws1 response ownership to the credential scope rather than the token string, so responses stay reachable after a bearer remint. (`48ce7a6`)
- The gateway governance module was updated as part of landing the DeepSeek plugin merge. (`aa5521b`)
- Updated the gateway lockfile as part of the merge carrying the Tailscale installation security changes. (`d92c2d6`)
- Gateway configuration, governance and the request pipeline were updated for sealed user content, with the channel host, provider runtime and state handling adjusted alongside. The Dockerfile and environment example were updated to match the new configuration. (`07be026`)
- Gateway routing now honors provider pins: Composio-pinned calls stay on Composio, the Treg pin still falls back to Composio, and a literal "builtin" is accepted. Provider-call handling, connection errors and gen-AI telemetry were updated. (`9f307f7`)
- Added online eval support with evaluator registry and execution modules, plus eval API routes and supporting config and state wiring. (`43b878b`)
- Added a telemetry module to the gateway and its Cargo.toml dependency entry. (`d84db68`)
- Wired cache and storage configuration and metrics into the gateway, including new metrics endpoints and auxiliary pipeline handling. (`ea002bd`)
- PUT /v1/config now validates evaluator bindings against the live custom evaluator set rather than the startup snapshot, and refuses changes that would orphan an [evals.online] reference. Config responses report the judge model each online record actually resolved. (`4877f58`)
- Added evals API test coverage for the online judge budget using an uncached production call. (`670e6f6`)
- Telemetry test coverage and formatting were updated alongside the run-trace scope handoff work. (`9a34153`)
- The Gateway added provider-list and sandbox minimum-waiver API routes with matching config and pipeline changes, and updated its Treg integration. (`1a4ce6b`)
- Carried per-call timeouts and caller id on connection calls and combined spend tags with modality-generic media labels. Updated own-supply, provider usage, firewall, credits and Treg modules. (`cd32c28`)
- Adjusted gateway configuration and egress handling as part of the security fixes, including the proxy credential prefix. (`784fd89`)
- Restricted tag spend counters in org limits and the pipeline to budgeted tags only. (`22b79ea`)
- Merged the gateway credit pool and inference governance pipeline changes against the updated core interfaces. (`9caf05c`)
- Added a Treg module and updated firewall, providers, connections and credit pool handling. Pipeline governance, tool rounds, provider usage, own-supply, passthrough, telemetry and traffic code were adjusted to match. (`dfa5f1a`)
- Updated the Rust gateway across its API handlers for chat, responses, audio, batches, audit, config, evals, firewall, governance, models, and providers. The change also touched pipeline, routing, policy, rate limiting, telemetry, tool execution, provider vault, and the standalone build test. (`ddf18f0`)
- Implemented bounded concurrency for contiguous read-only tool calls, configurable through tools.parallel_reads with a default of 4 and 1 disabling it, while appending results in tool_calls order. Other tool categories remain sequential barriers. (`8c6edb7`)
- Gateway config, providers, connections, credit pools, pipeline stages including tool rounds and own supply, and the TREG module were merged to handle both service bindings and self-serve Connect. (`6c55e19`)
- Conflicts in the gateway were resolved by taking main's content across the source tree, including the API handlers, routing pipeline, policy and governance modules, provider runtime, telemetry, firewall, and compat layers. Two JSON files were reformatted with no content change so the pre-commit check passes. (`a01db11`)
- Gateway connection and Treg handlers now route integration actions per the catalog, treating account-scoped endpoints and actions Treg does not list as not servable and sending them to Composio. (`36ab833`)
- Changed builtin connections routing to prefer Treg and fall back to Composio per call, with named providers and explicit selections not falling back. The call response now names provider and fellBackFrom, and GET /v1/providers exposes order and fallback. (`02ddcf8`)
- Audit rows record purpose, and the usage rollup adds purpose plus cache read and write token sums with a purpose filter on audits that Core's proxy forwards. The unified tool loop bounds tool results to head and tail within 100k characters. (`f063822`)
- Merged main's gateway work into the branch across the HTTP API surface, including chat, responses, batches, audio, voice calls, models and firewall routes. It also brought over pipeline, routing, policy, governance, telemetry, rate-limit and provider modules along with the standalone build test. (`cdb7957`)
- Added tag budget limits from /gateway/resolve and enforced them as a tag budget scope in the gateway pipeline. (`0be3017`)
- Regenerated the Gateway lockfile with the patched TLS and QUIC dependency versions. (`e98e55a`)
- Updated the Anthropic compatibility layer, the request pipeline and the skills module in the gateway. (`cba19df`)
- Applied the security scan patches to gateway configuration access and the egress module. (`8aa68aa`)
- Adjusted credit pool and inference governance logic so limited agents on managed Pi can be served a model the gateway serves them. (`a976834`)
- Charged retries and provider-side replays under one ledger refId at the first attempt's amount via ChargeMemo, treated x-ryu-max-cost-micro-usd as an admission check only while charging reported cost in full and flagging exceededMaxCost, debited oversized Treg responses at the reported or estimated cost, mapped catalog 404 and invalid-id errors to 403 tool_unpriced and 400, and scoped idempotency keys by org, Core-authenticated app and endpoint. (`e19f85d`)
- Merged the Phase A unit covering tool-call quoting, a capped response reader, org-scoped idempotency keys and headroom reservation across the providers API, config, connections, error types, pipeline telemetry and the Treg client. (`dfadadc`)
- Managed tool calls at /v1/providers/call are now quoted before they run, with unpriced calls refused as 403 tool_unpriced and an unreadable Treg catalog returning a retryable 503. Treg bodies are read through a 2 MiB capped reader that fails with 502 provider_response_too_large uncharged, the vendor Idempotency-Key is sha256(org, caller key), and responses carry callId, providerCallId, chargedMicroUsd, estimated, priceSource and ledgerRefId. The charged estimate is reserved against org headroom until the debit resolves, and x-ryu-max-cost-micro-usd refuses or caps dear estimates. (`882e196`)
- Updating a pool ceiling now drops cached own-supply allowances so the new ceiling reaches the resolve handshake immediately rather than waiting out the 60 s cache. (`d7c977c`)
- A paid request is now admitted only when the resolve handshake reported its pool with no ceiling and an unexpired allowance; a capped, lapsed or unreported pool keeps paid traffic on OpenRouter. The shared capped-allowance machinery, snapshot ordering and hold window, paid-spend tally and per-org free-credit drawdown tally were removed. (`bd42373`)
- Fixed the end-to-end paid-dial test to read the paid allowance view (`get_for_paid`) rather than the free-credit handshake view, and documented the dial-off invariant. (`e8bd328`)
- Split PoolAllowances into a free-credit view (last handshake, nothing netted) and a paid view (`get_for_paid`, ordered and netted), and had the planner read the appropriate basis. Own-supply headroom now applies only once a paid dial is set or the audit log records one ever set. (`c5f7e38`)
- Snapshots in the credit pool code are now ordered and identified by the control plane's asOf, so re-observing a held snapshot is a no-op and the gateway-clock clamp is applied once on arrival. A snapshot that arrived in the future outranks nothing, and the free-credit tally is pruned at most once a minute instead of being rescanned on every charge. (`ea63598`)
- Inference governance on a billing gateway no longer blocks hosted organisations' managed inference on the basis of an agent's provider list. (`7be0d6d`)
- Session debits can no longer attribute spend to an own-supply pool and are refused with 403, allowance snapshot asOf is clamped to the gateway clock with a three-minute precedence window, and locally counted paid spend draws down the caller's resolved free credit across requests on the same resolve. (`ff1c766`)
- The sandbox API gained a minimum waiver endpoint module, and gateway configuration was extended to support it. (`418a3a7`)
- Merged gateway changes covering the Anthropic and Gemini compatibility layers, the sandbox and traffic API handlers, configuration, and the request pipeline. (`b4f7dfd`)
- Billing now charges one-hour prompt-cache writes at twice the prompt price, sums cache reads and writes across every tool-loop round through ToolRoundTotals, and records the cache legs a Drop-settled stream was charged for. Reserve accounting was reworked so grants are held against combined own-supply allowance, paid consumption reduces later grant issuance, allowance snapshots are ordered by asOf, and paid traffic fails closed when a pool's allowance or reserve is unreported. (`5ed7ca2`)
- Priced own-supply cache legs separately in non-streaming, streaming and usage reporting, limited paid traffic to allowance above outstanding free credit, skipped tool-loop callers, and required a chargeable price for paid dials. (`237ebfe`)
- Changed Gateway to keep metering when spend.db was never sealed and no sealing key is configured, while an already-sealed store still refuses without its key, and added budget_store_sealing to /health. (`a25372a`)
- Routed paid traffic through the own-supply dial: each own-supply row carries a paidRolloutBps value, and a paid caller's org bucket above it is served from Ryu's own provider account, keeping free-credit priority and falling back to OpenRouter on failures before output. (`8669361`)
- The /v1/messages translation no longer flattens system and message text blocks that carry cache_control: they map to OpenAI text parts with the breakpoint, tools keep theirs, and the top-level marker is copied through. Content without breakpoints keeps the string shape. (`1f13130`)
- When a Sanitize posture is configured through the firewall, inspector or an inline input evaluator, the pure idempotent redaction now runs on every request so each string's egress form depends on config alone rather than on per-turn verdicts. Skills injection now prepends a text part to array-shaped system prompts instead of flattening them to an empty string, preserving the client's system text and its cache_control markers. (`773d1d2`)
- Tick bodies now accept an optional minimum_waived field, defaulting to false, honoured on both the stateless and in-process pricing paths. A Core that does not send the field is still charged the minimum. (`bd81831`)
- Sized Box ticks in the sandbox API are now priced from the request body alone, so replicas and restarts charge the same minimum, and stale accrual entries are pruned. (`1e64376`)
- The gateway's chat, config, embeddings, multimodal and web API handlers were updated together with the inference governance, node routing and channels host code as part of merging #770. (`81c81de`)
- An unreadable phone-call journal is now set aside sealed at 0600 and synced when it was plaintext and a key is available, otherwise renamed and narrowed to 0600. Readable legacy journals are resealed instead of quarantined, stale journals and temps are swept at startup, and the copy fallback seals before writing its temp. (`a104612`)
- Updated Gateway routing to skip providers an agent may not use and to carry the agent's provider keys across chat, config, embeddings, multimodal and web request paths. (`88f1858`)
- Gateway governance now approves chat:project-guidance only for @ryu/projects, so other apps holding chat.sendFollowUp can no longer write standing project instructions. (`6f7372e`)
- Gateway health, error, pipeline and state wiring now reflect a spend store that can be unhealthy: metered requests return 503 budget_store_unavailable when the store is sealed under another key or no key. state.rs also wires the sealed phone-call journal. (`81c565c`)
- The phone-call journal body (call goals, hand-off numbers, idempotency keys) is now a single encb:v1 envelope under the Gateway content key and moved once from beside gateway.toml to state/phone-call-state.json. An unreadable journal is moved aside and the hub starts empty instead of refusing startup. (`571e82b`)
- The gateway channel host now loads the pairing store through a seal, reseals legacy plaintext, moves an unreadable body aside before starting empty, and keeps the store in memory without writing when no key is available. (`4493b54`)
- The gateway.toml walker now treats channels.phone_calls.lines[].allowed_callers and transfer_to as encc:v1 leaves under the Gateway component key, opening them at load before validation and caller matching while the line's own numbers and firewall patterns stay readable. (`611e5a3`)
- The secret is never printed in the source's debug output. (`bdfcae5`)
- The hosted gwb1 arm now parses the org hint using BoxInferenceScope's own camelCase serde shape, so hosted Box keys are accepted instead of refused. Caller-policy narrowing now treats a Core-signed gwb1 user id like gws1, and the gateway changes were rustfmt'd. (`464c0de`)
- Work in progress on gwb1 Box inference keys and a per-size sandbox tick, touching sandbox, config and pipeline modules. (`c4222f8`)
- Extended the multimodal API with audio generation request, poll and provider routes alongside the existing video ones, and updated the jobs, providers, connections and governance modules to carry them. (`cbd2f53`)
- The gateway's Cargo.lock was refreshed; no gateway source files changed. (`7494894`)
- Changed the Gateway reporter module. (`3db1f79`)
- Regenerated the lockfile to pick up the new crypto and sealing dependencies. (`371898a`)
- Updated gateway traffic handling and the shared compatibility layer, including the Anthropic and Gemini compatibility adapters. (`e3a5e18`)
- Updated the reporter module as part of the device usage and attribution work. (`2afdc3d`)
- Formatted the vault:fill governance test in the gateway governance module. (`74fada6`)
- The Gateway README and Dockerfile now direct operators to `ryu-gateway print-key` instead of reading the key file off the volume. (`57b608f`)
- Standalone gateway-admin.key and gateway-relay.key are now sealed with the Gateway key and resealed from plaintext on bootstrap, staying owner-only plaintext with a warning when no key source exists; a new `ryu-gateway print-key admin|relay` command prints a key for the operator, and the diagnostics reader opens the sealed relay token and skips the relay without a key. (`1f0b58b`)
- Updated gateway governance to match the owner-exclusive approval of the vault:fill grant for @ryu/browser. (`bc64b82`)
- Applied the shared compat stream finish and late-usage fixes across the compat path, including the Anthropic and Gemini translators and the compat and traffic API handlers. (`064e1f6`)
- Updated the gateway governance module as part of the agent credential vault merge. (`a2c3488`)
- Refreshed the gateway lockfile to pick up the updated sidecar-runtime dependency. (`dd3137e`)
- The Gateway config API and startup path now surface the sealing refusal for external-mode writes, mapping it to gateway_seal_key_required and naming the key-handoff remedy. (`eabfda4`)
- GatewayConfig load and provider hot reload now open sealed leaves first, and a sealed leaf without a key is an error. (`1a8e56d`)
- Changed agentSeconds in the reporter to round rather than truncate per report slice. (`8508953`)
- Changed the governance test to assert the Gateway's denied vault grants in request order. (`83d22dd`)
- Reserved the vault namespace and allowlisted the vault:fill capability in governance. (`99f28f9`)
- Changed the audio wire, compatibility and multimodal API modules along with gateway telemetry content handling. (`e49d1db`)
- Consolidated duplicated gateway handler code for Anthropic/Gemini compat streams, multimodal authentication and output headers, and audio-wire cue rendering and test setup, with wire formats and headers unchanged. (`74043f1`)
- Changed gateway telemetry content helpers to re-export the shared gen_ai_content implementation from ryu-gw-contracts, leaving wire and span behavior unchanged. (`625e99e`)
- Gemini compat now falls back to name pairing when a functionResponse id matches no pending call, since the gateway emits functionCall parts without ids and the Gemini CLI answers with its own generated id. Added a regression test where the calls carry no id and the responses carry unrelated client ids in reversed order. (`7769c04`)
- Fixed provider and multi-account defects in the Gateway config, egress, pipeline pool signals, provider vault and provider runtime. (`0057ed5`)
- Anthropic passthrough now reads the provider route state file on every request instead of trusting a read for two seconds; the route takes the proxy from the state file, falls back to the spawn proxy, and refuses Anthropic while the route is active with neither. (`54a1907`)
- Fixed Anthropic compatibility so tool_use and tool_result blocks survive messages that also contain text or thinking blocks, and mapped Gemini functionCall and functionResponse history parts to tool calls and tool messages. Streaming now keeps usage sent after finish_reason, and live traffic SSE dedupes only against seed ids so the seen set no longer grows per request. (`b3b3f34`)
- DLP now skips only well-formed base64 image, video and audio data: URIs, scanning all other data: strings as text. For https URLs whose query is a presigned signature, scanning and rewriting apply to host and path only so a signing key id neither blocks the request nor breaks the provider fetch. (`57afc12`)
- The Gateway began reading the provider proxy from Core's state file rather than only its spawn environment, so it follows a new listener after a Core restart. It refuses Anthropic while the Claude route is active and no proxy is available. (`1fc2ab4`)
- Anthropic passthrough now re-reads the provider route state file on every request instead of trusting a cached read for two seconds, so a route the owner just enabled applies to the next request. (`23388d6`)
- The gateway passthrough was updated to handle per-provider desktop routing for Claude subscriptions. (`1987270`)
- A provider is now rebuilt when only its account strategy or drain threshold changes so the PATCH reaches the running pool, circuit-penalising main-path failures are recorded in the pool feedback ring, and a pool member with a zero quota reading is hidden only until its reported reset and never for providers with rotating accounts. The anthropic-credits pool keeps anthropic-beta opt-ins and top_k, and stale raw extra keys for Fal, Replicate and Modal are dropped when the fleet vault supplies the key. (`950e40d`)
- Changed the Anthropic passthrough so the provider proxy is used only while the Claude route is active rather than on every request, re-reading the active-routes state file at most every two seconds and keeping the proxy if the file cannot be read. (`dce1af2`)
- Lifted the 300 s total timeout on SDK egress clients so long streams are not cut at five minutes. (`871af6b`)

- Resolved the governance module conflict, keeping both sides of the merge in the gateway's governance checks. (`8b159fc`)
- Changed the connection registry's unsupported-provider error to echo the requested id and list the provider ids it can resolve, omitting builtin, and updated the test to assert the exact message. (`348c69c`)
- Added tests covering the live backends.router swap so router selection survives provider reload on both paths: a reused router with unchanged routing, and a rebuilt registry with changed routing. (`485f491`)
- Merged #717's changes to the Gateway config module and its config API surface. (`e25326b`)
- Updated the gateway crate's Cargo manifest and lockfile. (`7cd2103`)
- Restored line-slot reservations after a Gateway restart for journaled outbound intents younger than OUTBOUND_RESERVATION_TTL, keyed by Call SID or intent id, so answered calls are admitted rather than dropped by the cap check. (`112b605`)
- Moved caller-ID verification ahead of the outbound reservation so an unverified caller ID records nothing and takes no line slot, and every retry with the same Idempotency-Key gets the same 400; tests check that only the lookup reaches Twilio. (`8a07e8a`)
- Changed the outbound call refusal for a phone line at its simultaneous-call limit from GatewayError::BadRequest to GatewayError::Overloaded, rendering 503 engine_overloaded with the same message; security tests match the new variant. (`9237da3`)
- Added a media:record grant to the first-party grant table so companion apps such as Teleprompter can capture audio. (`9d78c41`)

- Regenerated the standalone gateway lock through sync-standalone-lock.sh so it also resolves rustls 0.23.46. (`efe7348`)
- Merged the changes touching the phone and voice call routes, their security tests, gateway configuration, and the phone-call module. (`13adf61`)
- Merged a branch updating gateway config and API config, Composio and governance modules, policy, the auxiliary and main pipeline, and the router. (`8afdc0f`)
- Merge touched the Gateway config API and config, Composio, governance, policy, router, and pipeline modules including auxiliary requests. (`a9d8955`)
- Applied rustfmt to branch-added Rust in the gateway config, Composio, governance, pipeline, policy, and router modules, limited to whitespace, wrapping, and use/mod ordering. (`42f99c0`)
- Updated the gateway Cargo.lock as part of the merged Rust test fixes. (`34b0475`)
- The standalone Gateway lockfile was regenerated with sync-standalone-lock.sh to record the crates' dependency on ryu-sidecar-runtime. (`e033830`)
- Updated gateway state wiring so the passthrough scanner carries the team firewall overlay from the policy, matching the request path. (`05795ef`)
- Updated the gateway governance module. (`3b0e412`)
- Marketplace manifest signing now always requires the master key and fails closed, with the key authorizing from any peer and mode while the Sec-Fetch-Site CSRF check is retained. Also carried the standalone build, policy, rate-limit, pipeline and tool execution updates. (`2a72a08`)
- Updated the gateway governance module as part of the merge. (`ad9974c`)
- Updated gateway governance API and module code, error handling, and the WASM policy module. (`fade797`)
- Kept the stream observer's usage() call, which was already saturating, while the budget holds auto-merged. Conflicts were also resolved in the audit and sandbox API handlers, circuit breaker, egress, auxiliary and main pipeline, provider registry, and state. (`71765ad`)
- Kept each pipeline attempt on the detached buffered/attached dispatch with the hang-up cancellation token, so attempts settle after a client disconnect, and billing now resolves through settle_billing with the serving provider passed to response_cost_micro_usd for own-supply pricing. Credit headroom is computed from the request state and spent_since_resolve via grant_money_reachable_from, and allow_hosted_web is computed before AppState::new consumes the config. (`8009a0a`)
- Updated the gateway policy module and user policy handling. (`e6c40cd`)
- Adjusted gateway error handling in the error module. (`196568f`)
- Updated the governance API handler, the governance module, and the WASM policy module in the gateway. (`a87e9e3`)
- Integrated gateway changes across audit, config, doctor, and models APIs, plus egress, credit pools, own-supply discovery, routing, policy cache, provider vault, and reporter code. (`55b56f7`)
- Updated firewall resolution, pipeline, policy, user policy, and gateway state handling. (`a44b668`)
- Merged the gateway's audit and sandbox API modules, circuit breaker, egress, pipeline, providers and state modules into the mega branch. (`4c7c6d4`)
- Reworked gateway own-supply discovery and table handling, credit pools, egress, provider vault, policy cache, model aliasing and node routing, and inference governance. Updated the audit, config, doctor, and models APIs, plus channel hosting and reporter state. (`f68e3aa`)
- Updated gateway error handling as part of the merge resolution. (`254a2e7`)
- Propagated organization policy through the gateway's firewall resolution, request pipeline, user policy and state modules so the family-sharing policy changes apply at the gateway layer. (`1f2b399`)
- Updated the gateway governance API and governance module along with the WASM policy host. (`84e9a3b`)
- Integrated #643 into the gateway by resolving conflicts across the firewall resolve, pipeline, policy, user policy, and state modules. The resolution keeps the hook trust logic where the user layer may only withdraw trust. (`c41ab31`)
- Updated the gateway request pipeline to carry the new inference sampling and preset handling. (`b8a2e94`)
- Extended gateway configuration and the auxiliary pipeline so the smart router can honor route overrides. (`8a96d90`)
- Updated the gateway's channel host, governance module, and profile handling, along with its Cargo manifest. (`2116eb2`)
- Conflicts in the gateway's audit and sandbox APIs, circuit breaker, egress, auxiliary and main pipeline, provider registry and state modules were resolved by combining both branches' edits. (`d8a51d1`)
- Resolved conflicts across the gateway pipeline, policy, rate limiting, governance, tools and API modules while keeping both credit_accounting_unavailable and budget_resolved_at. Cache scope uses the user tenant plus a caller-credential partition, and the capability-gated web search debit is expressed as a new CreditDebitReason::WebSearch. (`9a8f19a`)
- Updated gateway policy modules, including the user policy implementation, as part of the family-sharing merge. (`2f749d2`)
- Added credit pool and own-supply handling to the gateway, including own-supply discovery and routing, provider vault and egress changes, policy caching, and model alias and node routing updates in the pipeline. (`11a6be0`)
- The governance API route, the governance module and the WASM policy module were reconciled during the merge. (`e2954c8`)
- Outbound calls now reserve a slot on the phone line under the hub lock before any Twilio request, returning LineBusy and a 400 error when the line is at its limit. The slot is keyed by intent id until a Call SID is bound, then taken over by the media stream's registration, and is released on 4xx refusal, terminal status callbacks, or the outbound reservation TTL. A configurable Twilio REST base URL was added so tests can point at a local fake. (`579741a`)
- Updated the gateway's error type as part of merging the workflow provider-limit handling. (`71ed77c`)
- Updated firewall resolution, pipeline, policy state and user policy modules to consume the merged organization policy surfaces. (`77757e7`)
- Updated the gateway pipeline module as part of the inference settings merge. (`7b6c894`)
- Extended gateway config and the smart router to handle routing pools, with corresponding changes in the pipeline module and the auxiliary pipeline stage. (`4a0d834`)
- Merge conflicts were resolved across the firewall resolve module, the pipeline, the policy modules and user policy handling, plus gateway state. (`59131bc`)
- The gateway crate manifest, channels host, governance module, and profile module were updated with the merged code. (`4a480b1`)
- Reworked gateway configuration, provider environment handling, provider runtime, routing, egress and connections modules, along with the config, doctor and providers API surfaces. (`c32caa3`)
- Narrowed cached per-caller allowlists in user_policy.rs against the current base policy using the same rules as the control plane, so a refreshed, tighter org or team policy applies at once. (`4cdc1a7`)
- Reformatted the audio wire, multimodal, and web pipeline Rust files to satisfy rustfmt. (`a7cb55f`)
- Only 400, 401 and 403 responses from the tool-policy route are now treated as an authoritative refusal. A 404 or any other status is handled as an outage that keeps the caller's last known rules. (`70187ff`)
- Regions now narrow by the gateway's area rules, disjoint allowlists resolve to an explicit deny-all marker rather than the inherited list, and a caller's cached policy is dropped and the request denied on an authoritative 4xx while outages keep last-known-good. (`7dc57b1`)
- The inbound answer webhook now reserves a call slot under the hub lock keyed by CallSid before responding, and answers busy when no slot is free. The media stream takes the reservation over without a second cap check, retried webhooks for the same call keep their one slot, and a reservation whose stream never starts is released after the 30-second TTL; outbound streams and lapsed reservations still go through the atomic cap check. (`27c9ca9`)
- The pool final-execution timeout path now calls settle_timed_out_tool_rounds so a metered tool round still running at the deadline is billed from its real usage instead of being left uncharged. Its settlement is combined with the answered rounds under the same attempt ref, with the credit claim held until the debit resolves; unmetered loops are unchanged. (`1d17d77`)
- run() now hands run_attached a cancellation token that a drop guard cancels when the handler future is dropped, and metered buffered tool loops race that token so no further tool runs or new rounds start after a client hang-up. Rounds already in flight finish on their own tasks and every answered round settles as one gateway_usage debit under the request id, with the failed-attempt settlement generalised into settle_unanswered_tool_rounds. (`5296c34`)
- Policy resolution, the firewall, and pipeline state now apply team policies and primary owner rules together, with team firewall, connector catalog, team secrets, and team feature controls refusing family workspaces. (`50a28e7`)
- Pipeline modules were updated for the revised audit, in-flight budget and channel handling introduced in this release. (`2272b4a`)
- Read a restrict-only `x-ryu-untrusted-caller` header and, on that signal, withheld `tool_search` and the operator's always-on tools, narrowed the effective allowlist, skipped the managed loop when no tool list is supplied, and forwarded `untrusted_caller` on each Core hop. Tests cover the header parse, allowlist and loop selection, and a refused denied tool in an end-to-end loop run. (`3eb79bc`)
- A failed tool-loop attempt now swaps its full-size credit claim for one sized to what its charged rounds actually cost, taking the new claim before releasing the old one and never growing it, on both the streaming and non-streaming paths. ABANDONED_PROVIDER_WAIT was raised from 600 seconds to 30 minutes so a buffered round answering late is still billed. (`e87c927`)
- RequestContext now carries budget_resolved_at, the fetch time of the cached resolution that supplied its figures, set on the dynamic rgw_ path, so the freshness check dates each request's budget by its own resolve rather than by the org's newest resolve. The per-org newest-resolve map was removed and figures not sourced from a resolve are never adjusted. (`f7e2a6d`)
- Adjusted the gateway's audio wire handling in the audio API. (`c80b5cb`)
- A metered stream now opens on its own detached task, so a client that hangs up before the first byte is billed only if the provider accepts the request; a refusal charges nothing and releases the credit claim. The detached open is bounded by ABANDONED_PROVIDER_WAIT, and unmetered streams still cancel on drop. (`e90a801`)
- The per-minute token limit is judged on a tool loop's answering round again, with earlier rounds admitted as admitted_tokens and recorded through window-bounded verbs that charge each bucket at most one window. The wallet and budgets still bill the summed totals, and streams settle the same split so a request cannot leave a bucket minutes in debt or return 429 after its tools already ran. (`6c19507`)
- The phone bridge now opens Core voice sessions with an explicit caller_trusted: false for inbound callers the line does not list, while listed inbound callers and owner-placed outbound calls send the same start frame as other voice clients. Added a unit test for the start frame and an end-to-end bridge test, and rustfmt-formatted the voice bridge. (`2082266`)
- The output clamp and credit claim now size requests from a debit-reported balance when that report is newer than the resolve-cache entry that supplied the org budget. Only balance drops are subtracted, higher reports wait for the next resolve, and the gate is unchanged when no debit or no resolve timestamp exists. (`820b31f`)
- Stored per-agent smart-routing overrides in gateway config under smart_routing.agent_routes and applied them by ctx.agent_id in the pipeline, while still letting Core's request field win. (`61c3055`)
- Billed every answered tool-loop round through MeteredRounds and a ToolRoundLedger, and settled metered streams abandoned during stream opening, including the in-flight round. Added attempt-scoped billing for rounds answered before a later failure and kept unmetered nodes on cancel-on-drop. (`4dc753e`)
- Provider calls and disconnects now accept a member's personal Composio entity only from that authenticated member, while org-shared and app-account entities remain organization-scoped. (`664fbd6`)
- Changed gateway policy and cache handling, node routing, inference governance stages, budget and organization limit enforcement, audio and config APIs, the channel host, and the web pipeline. (`6b92c05`)
- Backends patches now merge onto the persisted selection instead of resetting other routing stages, and GET /v1/config returns backends. Model-map entries outrank the upstream router, unregistered vendor prefixes fall through to the selected upstream, router/ ids stay out of eval A/B routing, and caller-supplied LiteLLM routing overrides are stripped so they cannot bypass the model allowlist; LITELLM_* was added to the public environment variables. (`755493c`)
- Applied partial gap fixes to organization limit handling, the request pipeline module, and rate limiting as an interrupted-work checkpoint. (`33db4fa`)
- Budget spend is now persisted durably, the response cache is bounded, and replayed requests are no longer billed. Pipeline, provider, egress, and state modules were updated together. (`9e10501`)
- Manifest signing in the governance API is now an administrator operation: the master key authorizes it from any peer and mode, a keyless Gateway keeps the loopback-only path, and cross-site browser requests are always refused. (`99ec0d0`)
- The pipeline now screens tool definitions for secrets only under the default firewall, so example contact data in third-party schemas no longer triggers Block refusals. Locked pii/secrets guardrails still read the definitions and Sanitize still redacts them when it runs. (`d7171c8`)
- Non-release Core-managed Gateways now adopt the shared pre-profile marketplace signing key on first start instead of generating a fresh one under the profile-scoped path, so earlier signatures keep verifying. Fresh installs stay isolated. (`39fa26e`)
- Locked guardrails on the chat path now read tool definitions only for PII and secret categories, and on the passthrough non-DLP locked categories read the conversation while secrets and PII still read the system prompt and definitions. The inbound definition screen reports secrets before PII. (`ecaf5f9`)
- Manifest signing in the governance API now attaches the master-key bearer only when the Gateway base URL is loopback, and the 502 response names the loopback requirement. A stale comment claiming signing has no master-key concept was corrected. (`f679d5c`)
- Tool and function definitions are now screened only for secrets and PII, while conversation content, tool calls and tool results keep every category. On the passthrough, a locked prompt_injection guardrail reads the conversation rather than the agent's own system prompt or tool definitions. (`5ac0ee0`)
- Declared AGPL-3.0-or-later in Cargo.toml to match the Gateway license file instead of Apache-2.0. (`f267b5e`)
- Removed the composio_wildcard_allowlist drift rule and its doctor mapping, since an empty Composio allowlist fails closed rather than permitting every action; a test pins that no warning is raised. (`b67a227`)
- Made standalone Gateway defaults self-hostable: GET / returns a neutral JSON description unless a dashboard URL is configured, CORS admits the hosted web origin only for paired or opted-in Gateways, OpenRouter attribution is sent only with non-blank site fields, and profile-suffixed data paths isolate dev audit, spend and signing key state. Startup now logs the gateway.toml it loaded and warns when none exists. (`c2ddf00`)
- The standalone lock is regenerated by sync-standalone-lock.sh, and new tests fail on lock drift, libdbus linkage, or a build context that stops copying the repo root. (`ac0bf05`)
- Run, media/speech, and embedding pipelines now detach only when the node debits an org's wallet for the call; unmetered calls keep cancel-on-drop so a client hang-up frees the local engine slot, and the detached task retains the caller's tracing span. A test pins that an unmetered abandoned call is cancelled. (`74c837a`)
- Moved parse_bool_env's doc comment back onto its function in the gateway config module. (`25fe046`)
- A metering node now logs at startup when control_plane.model_pricing has no per-model price table, since only OpenRouter reports usage.cost and other routes fall back to the flat cost_per_1k_micro_usd estimate. Also corrected stale Composio rate text and a comment claiming a catalog lookup the Gateway does not perform. (`e278caf`)
- Made text completions net their prompt estimate at the routed model's input rate out of the balance before clamping output, and made the credit claim cover prompt plus output at the model's rates. A balance that cannot cover the prompt is now refused with the pre-flight 402 instead of proceeding with a zero or missing ceiling. (`a1e1f7f`)
- Moved the buffered chat, media and embedding pipelines onto their own task so a client hang-up or timeout only detaches the handler instead of cancelling a provider call that had already been accepted. Accepted work now finishes and settles with its audit row, budget charge and debit. (`5a6be92`)
- Managed stream settlement now runs once on whichever exit comes first, EOF or client drop: budget counters advance synchronously and the wallet debit runs on a spawned task idempotent on the request ID while holding the credit claim. Metered streams now force stream_options.include_usage on and estimate any unreported usage from the generated text, marking the ledger row as estimated. (`66ddd2c`)
- Settlement for embedding, rerank and auxiliary inference now sends a typed debit reason and carries the call purpose in taskLabel, instead of passing purposes such as semantic-cache or provider-pool-leg as the reason. (`37f55bb`)
- Reformatted the phone caller-control test. (`2a29f08`)
- Merged changes to the gateway governance module as part of the healing and cross-app grants branch. (`c29dabf`)
- The passthrough test helper now builds its config with struct update syntax, clearing the clippy::field_reassign_with_default lint. (`10056fb`)
- Inbound phone lines accept an optional allowed_callers list and a max_concurrent_calls cap defaulting to 2, enforced atomically before a Core voice session opens. Unlisted callers are rejected before answering, and callers described to the agent are marked as unverified outside parties. (`9c3c673`)
- The gateway's unified and legacy Composio tool loops now scan model-chosen tool arguments and external results, denying flagged calls and withholding, redacting, or logging results according to the configured action. Untrusted-content wrapping was extended to Composio action output and hosted web search results. (`591c85e`)
- Adjusted channel host, governance, and profile code plus the crate manifest for the in-progress data directory re-layout (checkpoint 3). (`d2e32fa`)
- Changed the gateway pipeline so that an exact or semantic cache hit is run through the requester's outbound firewall before the output evaluators see it. (`643f223`)
- POST /v1/manifests/sign now requires the Gateway master key whenever one is configured, so signatures can no longer be minted on loopback posture alone; the bare-loopback path remains only on a gateway with no master key. The existing fleet, mesh, Host and Sec-Fetch-Site refusals are unchanged. (`63ebad0`)
- Authenticated /v1/models and /v1/modalities so anonymous callers can no longer enumerate providers, model ids, or modality routing, or make the Gateway probe upstream /models with operator keys. No-auth local mode still accepts anonymous callers. (`9d11292`)
- Changed /v1/firewall/check to scan with state.resolved_scanner(ctx) for the authenticated caller instead of the node-base scanner. (`207da46`)
- Added runtime project and user policy resolution and team policy layers across the firewall resolver, pipeline, and gateway state. (`9fba0b3`)
- Passthrough redaction now rewrites every prompt-bearing string in Claude Code and Codex wire formats, leaving signed, encrypted, and id fields untouched, and uses the resolved node-to-org-to-trusted-agent scanner so overlays apply. The route refuses fleet mode, only records x-ryu-user-id, x-ryu-agent-id, and x-ryu-feature alongside a master or trusted_forwarder key, and never forwards x-ryu-* headers upstream. (`19fc44f`)
- Inbound detection and Sanitize now draw provider-bound prompt strings from one visitor pair, so array content parts, tool-call arguments, tool definitions and predicted output are both scanned and rewritten. After redaction the body is re-scanned and a surviving match returns 403, and sanitize logging only fires when the body changed. (`495f2c9`)
- Circuit breaker half-open probes that never report back now expire after max(reset_timeout, 60s) rather than blocking the provider until restart. Sandbox tick accrual is now check-and-accrue under one entry lock so concurrent replays count once, elapsed widget rate-limit buckets are swept past 4096 entries, and stream token totals saturate from upstream usage frames. The audit API was touched as part of the same change. (`8bd0ad5`)
- Changed the web pipeline and the gateway policy module. (`28c00ca`)
- Added organization limit handling to the gateway pipeline and updated policy caching, policy evaluation, and policy alerting. (`b8a1c88`)
- The merge resolution updated the gateway audio wire and multimodal API modules together with the router. Those three files were the gateway's portion of the merge. (`80a9107`)
- Updated evaluator, governance and tool execution modules. (`f0accf9`)
- Extended the gateway across its budget and provider APIs, concurrency handling, configuration and error types, main entrypoint, auxiliary and web pipelines, inference governance, policy module, and responses store. (`121f95c`)
- Updated gateway eval and Responses API handlers, including hosted and streaming paths, compatibility code, and the request pipeline. (`00aa7d6`)
- Updated gateway governance module wiring to account for the new builtin plugin. (`059ec30`)
- Added a ServiceAccount budget scope keyed by org and account so every key held by a service account shares one enforced limit, including fleet-wide limitsSpend snapshots. The scope is now carried through org limits, policy caching and spend alerts. (`670e6b0`)
- Gateway evaluators, governance, and tool execution modules were updated to account for the merged host API changes. (`98e6646`)
- Updated the audio wire and multimodal API handlers and the gateway router module. (`a9f93af`)
- Renamed the inline_deno backend to inline_js in the gateway's evaluator, governance and tool execution paths. (`ddb3ae9`)
- Merged the fix/boundary branch into the gateway, resolving the conflict in the governance module. (`ff8a693`)
- Gated unfunded rgw_ tenants on billing gateways as managed with a zero balance (402) and added a per-org cap on in-flight plus queued local-engine requests through local_max_pending_per_org, defaulting to in_flight + queued/4. Continuation-store eviction became tenant-scoped, and upstream 400/404/413/422 responses no longer count toward the shared provider circuit breaker. (`7779978`)
- Changed /v1/evals/score so deterministic score requests without a model fall back to the configured default or record the model as unspecified. Requests that need a judge with no model and no default still return 400. (`65ecd29`)
- Updated gateway API modules for audit, budget, chat, config, embeddings, evals, providers and web, and adjusted the pipeline, policy cache, rate limiting, traffic and jobs code. Added a Composio billing HTTP proof test in the gateway test suite. (`465ed08`)
- Updated the gateway governance API route. (`14e26bd`)
- Owner-exclusive grant rows are now unioned per owner in the gateway governance module, so multiple exclusive grants for the same owner are combined into a single row. (`4b6da0a`)
- Merged changes to the gateway governance module and the wasm policy module. (`3f02230`)
- Adjusted the router for the updated sidecar wake and readiness handling. (`8a00261`)
- Transcription requests now accept timestamp_granularities[] and render srt/vtt from real verbose_json segments, while stream and include[] return specific errors. (`f21b145`)
- Removed the dead wasm_policy module left over from the M6 wasmtime sandbox spike. (`f6e8341`)
- Governance checks in the gateway now distinguish the read-only `hook:run-agent` grant from `hook:run-agent:write`. (`ae801ca`)
- Removed the mcp:claude_cu entry from the Gateway governance allowlist. (`834bd47`)
- Replaced three hardcoded per-app branches in validate_grants_for with a single OWNER_EXCLUSIVE_GRANTS table and an app-agnostic policy path, plus a test that owner-exclusive grants do not leak to another owner or the allowlist. (`bc2f7ea`)
- The /v1/manifests/sign endpoint now requires the master key in addition to a loopback peer. (`7d312d6`)
- Updated the governance allowlist so the new computer-use plugins receive their mcp:&lt;server> grants. (`28b9db3`)
- Gateway changes covered the audit, budget, chat, config, embeddings, firewall, health, multimodal, providers, and web endpoints, plus pipeline stages for auxiliary handling, inference governance, node routing, and web. Policy caching, user JWT handling, rate limiting, org limits, policy alerting, reporting, and traffic modules were also touched. (`25192e8`)
- Added org, member, team and key budget and rate-limit enforcement with durable windowed spend persisted in SQLite beside the audit store, verified x-ryu-user-jwt attribution on the rgw_ credential path, and per-caller tool policy resolution that fails closed. The reporter now sends keyDaily and teamDaily rollups with stable rollupIds, prompt-cache token counts and multi-team attribution, splits configured rate ceilings across active gateway instances, and treats a failed resolve as unresolved rather than running uncapped.
- Added max_tool_calls to cap hosted web-search calls, with the tool withdrawn at the cap and excess calls reported as failed max_tool_calls_exceeded. ### `ryu-gw-providers`@0.5.0

[Published package](https://crates.io/crates/ryu-gw-providers/0.5.0)

#### Minor changes

- Added a Vercel provider adapter that enforces Ryu-origin dispatch by requiring a ryu. subject in safety_identifier and writing only providerOptions.gateway.zeroDataRetention, and added an AnthropicProvider extra-body hook so anthropic/* models send metadata.user_id on the Messages leg. (`bc1cd18`)
- Added a static safety-signal table keyed by provider, status and error code, type, provider_code or moderation shape rather than message text, backed by fixtures under tests/fixtures/safety/. check_response_status, check_stream_status and the Anthropic adapter now build ProviderError::SafetyRefused from it. (`046899f`)
- The Anthropic provider writes the stamped Ryu-derived subject into metadata.user_id. (`7ae6961`)
- Added submit_media_job_bound with video defaulting to submit_video_bound, and overrode it in Fal and Replicate to reuse their generic queues for audio. Runway, Topaz and BFL continue to refuse audio jobs. (`45af0a2`)
- The genai provider passes top_k through to the Gemini, Cohere, Anthropic and Vertex SDK adapters. (`c7c55a0`)
- Added translation of the private `ryu_sampling` fields for gateway provider attempts, including forwarding top_k to Anthropic. (`227083d`)
- The GenAI adapter now streams a usage chunk with cache and reasoning details, Anthropic Auto mode places request-level cache_control on the last cacheable block, an OpenAI prompt_cache_key no longer suppresses Claude cache breakpoints, and per-provider cache TTLs are authored in prompt_cache.rs. (`fcc3c45`)
- Added Parallel as a direct web-search provider kind with fast mode, 10 results, x-api-key auth and wire tests, and wired it into the web provider module. (`0cdd1f6`)
- The OpenRouter provider now backs Gateway TTS via /audio/speech, STT via /audio/transcriptions, video jobs via /videos with captured-account polling, and images via /images with chat image-output fallback. Discovery queries output_modalities=all, OpenRouter-hosted content is inlined, and credentialed downloads are limited to the job's own content endpoint. (`25aa44b`)
- Added native Qoder transport and custody, quota-aware provider handling, and governed Fusion and Pipeline execution paths in the Gateway providers package. (`70ffd50`)
- Added an account pool and reworked the provider clients, including Anthropic, OpenAI, OpenRouter, GenAI, the audio and image providers, and the web search providers, to draw from direct provider accounts. A shared runtime module carries the routing state the clients read. (`487d252`)
- The local provider implementation now handles requests for the derived Ollama model. (`c311f37`)
- Extended the Anthropic, GenAI, local and Modal provider implementations, along with the shared provider library, to serve requests originating from the Responses API path. (`e9358bd`)

#### Patch changes

- Its Cargo manifest was carried through the merge of origin/main into the i18n and file-split branch, resolving the manifest against main's version while preserving the branch's splits. (`1903ef3`)
- Merged main's changes into the provider integrations for BFL, Inworld, Minimax, Modal, Recraft, Runway, Stability and Topaz, including the shared error type and the per-provider test modules. The crate manifest picked up main's dependency updates. (`1438289`)
- Main's provider modules were merged in, including the bfl, inworld, minimax, modal, recraft, runway, stability, and topaz adapters together with their tests and the provider error type. The crate manifest was updated alongside those files. (`974ca98`)

- Merged upstream changes into the gateway provider implementations for BFL, Inworld, MiniMax, Modal, Recraft, Runway, Stability, and Topaz, along with shared error handling and provider tests. (`73d58d0`)
- Eight adapters (BFL, Runway, Stability, Topaz, Inworld, MiniMax, Modal, Recraft) now call AccountPool::record_account_rejection with a shared error::PAYMENT_REQUIRED_COOLDOWN instead of record_rate_limit(index, Some(300)), so a key refused with 402 leaves rotation without cooling the whole quota domain or the last usable key. Inline test modules for five adapters moved unchanged into sibling *_test.rs files, and each fixed adapter gained a test that a single 402-refused key reaches upstream again on the next request. (`03e4a05`)

- The Anthropic, Cohere, GenAI and OpenAI adapters classify upstream 4xx responses as ProviderError::Rejected carrying the HTTP status and message, so callers classify by code instead of matching message text. The error module gains that rejected variant. (`92921ae`)

- Adjusted the OpenRouter provider's batch error handling so a truncated 2xx answer to a poll or list keeps the 502 read error rather than the 504 resubmit warning used for submit and delete, with a regression test covering a cut-off response. (`0d23210`)

Gateway transcription accepts `timestamp_granularities[]`, renders srt/vtt from real verbose_json segments, returns specific errors for `stream` and `include[]`, rejects unknown STT engine names, reports `tts_engine_unknown` for unknown voice-session TTS engines, and transcribes utterances that hit the 60s capture cap instead of discarding them. ### `ryu-gw-screening`@0.5.0

#### Minor changes

- Added the screening crate with the ScreenerBackend trait and verdict types, ScreenerChain, the isolated SafetyClient and a keyed segment cache. It also carries the systemone decision-model primary, the remote Jev processor behind RemotePermit, Llama Guard and Qwen3Guard-Gen parsers, the inspector prompt and parser, and sentinel test backends behind the test-backends feature. (`52e6542`)

#### Patch changes

- Its Cargo manifest was carried through the merge of origin/main into the i18n and file-split branch, resolving the manifest against main's version while preserving the branch's splits. (`1903ef3`)
- The crate manifest was updated while merging main into the branch, carrying over the dependency security bumps from main. (`1438289`)
- The crate manifest was updated as part of merging main into the primary-bot-port branch; no source files in this package changed. (`974ca98`)
- Reworked screening backends (decision, guard model, inspector, test), the backend chain and cache, the safety client, coverage probes and sentinel test data, and refreshed the README. (`0af1456`)
- Raised lru from 0.12 to 0.18 in the gateway screening crate. (`9ea0295`)
- Changed the screening crate so output screening reads reasoning, reasoning_content, reasoning_details, refusal and legacy function_call arguments in both buffered and streamed responses, with supporting backend and chain updates. (`435052c`)
- Introduced the screening crate with pluggable decision, guard-model, inspector and test backends, a chain and cache layer, a safety client, and sentinel test data plus coverage probe tests. (`221e088`)
- Aligned the screening cache code wording with context-bound cache keys for Definitions. (`a57b402`)
- Added SegmentKey::for_text_in_context so cached segments are bound to the context they were classified with, making a new combination a miss while append-only turns still reuse earlier segments. (`cf35e8e`)
- A Llama Guard first generated token on the opposite branch from the reply now returns Malformed in both directions rather than falling back to Fixed confidence, so contradictory logprobs no longer score codes as a confident allow or block. (`1e9c6ce`)
- Closed coverage-probe gaps in the screening crate: generated images ride in the assistant turn for the guard, the chain checks a defaulted permits(tier) before the segment cache, and qualification gates hard codes on floor-tier traffic only. The local decision backend now requires a pinned weights_sha256, contradictory Llama Guard logprobs are ignored, multi-line or hazard-tagged Qwen3Guard output is Malformed, and a coverage probe module was added. (`39505b7`)

OKF ingest accepts a strategy and stores filterable chunk metadata, and export restores the verbatim body. (`badd9ef`)

- Split the RAG store into separate index, open, reindex, remove, retrieve, scorer, state, okf, okf_rows, and legacy modules, and updated embedding, reranking, memory graph, and test code to the new layout. (`cd7a09b`)
- Split the 7k-line lib.rs into dedicated embed, rerank, and store/* modules, with store logic divided by concern (open, legacy, state, index, okf, remove, reindex, retrieve, scorer, okf_rows) and tests moved to tests.rs and at_rest_tests.rs. Public paths are unchanged through crate-root re-exports, and memory_graph.rs now reuses the fnv1a helper from embed.rs. (`2e6a97c`)
- Refreshed dependencies and revised the RAG pipeline's query expansion, filtering, hybrid retrieval and text splitting modules. (`0af1456`)
- Reworked the RAG crate across new expansion, filter, hybrid and splitter modules, with the crate root re-exporting them. (`b1b04f3`)
- Moved metadata filters and hybrid search onto the sealed stores, dropped the plaintext FTS table in favour of the blind term index for keyword search, applied the allowlist filter to the keyword fallback, and made filters fail closed when metadata cannot be opened. (`dac9704`)
- Kept the caller-id ownership guard in the RAG crate and constrained vector placement to rows the guarded write actually changed, so sealed segments retain their capture time and history windows still apply. (`07be026`)
- Added expansion, filter, hybrid, and splitter modules to the RAG crate and exported them from its root. (`3f09390`)

- The RAG store's start path was updated so a pending vacuum runs at the next start regardless of how large the store has grown, unless the owner defers it. (`ffe18f3`)
- Retrieval stores above the inline size gate defer vacuuming to the background compaction worker instead of compacting during open. (`8862e2a`)
- Merged changes to the RAG crate's library entry point. (`b4f7dfd`)
- Retrieval scoring now runs on a blocking thread with an owned connection guard, ranking only chunks that pass the scope filter through VectorIndex::search_filtered and hydrating straight from the row stream. Partitions larger than the whole cache are scored from the stream while keeping only candidate scores. (`7f1314f`)
- Sealed retrieval.db chunk content and OKF metadata as encb:v1 and vectors as RYU-CB01 bound to chunk id and model, scoring through a shared in-memory vector index with one partition per collection and a streamed fallback past the cache budget. OKF chunk ids carry a blind token of the concept path with a concept_path_bi index for per-concept deletes, and a background cursor migration seals legacy rows before the freed-page scrub. (`3842e2d`)

### `ryu-search`@0.5.0

[Published package](https://crates.io/crates/ryu-search/0.5.0)

#### Patch changes

- The crate manifest was reconciled when origin/main was merged into the feature branch, keeping main's behaviour alongside the branch's file layout. (`1903ef3`)
- Updated the crate manifest as part of merging origin/main into the branch, carrying over the dependency security bumps. (`1438289`)
- Updated the crate manifest while merging main into the primary bot port branch. (`974ca98`)
- Updated the message full-text search and message index modules, refreshed dependencies and revised the README. (`0af1456`)
- Adjusted the message full-text search implementation in message_fts.rs to address review findings. (`1cc077c`)
- Changed message full-text search and the message index to open sealed rows, with the crate README and manifest updated for the new sealing dependencies. (`07be026`)
- The message index now vacuums pending work at startup even for large stores, deferring only when the owner registers a background compaction job. (`ffe18f3`)
- The message index moved large-store compaction off the boot path to the shared background compaction worker. (`8862e2a`)
- Message search now runs after the embedding on a blocking thread, hydrates partitions straight from the row stream on a cache miss, and scores partitions larger than the cache row by row into a bounded top-k. Scoped searches resolve message ids in one query, rank only those through search_filtered, and fetch hit metadata in one batched query. (`477ada9`)
- The keyword index moved to an external-content FTS5 table with secure-delete, so a delete removes the row's postings instead of leaving a contentless tombstone, and clear plus key change use delete-all. The contentless format is rebuilt on open, and tests assert the deleted bytes are gone from the file and the WAL. (`5460258`)
- Reformatted the keyword index tests in the message full-text search module. (`cb27a82`)
- message_terms became contentless and each row's blind tokens are sorted by token value so the row no longer reveals word order. An index in the older row format is dropped, scrubbed and rebuilt lazily, and sealing legacy vec0 vectors is refused when the store record names another key. (`aa94444`)
- Message FTS and message index paths were adjusted to work against the sealed retrieval store, where the stale-reindex compare-and-set now compares stored ciphertext and rows that fail to open are skipped and counted. (`3842e2d`)
- Reworked ryu-search message indexes to use blind term tokens in message-fts.db and sealed RYU-CB01 vectors in message-embeddings.db, with lazy rebuilds and a background migration from vec0. Message search is now whole-word only. (`9b5b82c`)
- Added tracing to the ryu-search crate manifest so the sealed message indexes can warn on unreadable rows and report migration progress. (`8cc78c8`)
- Added the ryu-crypto dependency so the crate is ready to seal content in phase 2. (`371898a`)
- Conflicts in message_fts.rs and message_index.rs were resolved while preserving local history and independent coverage work. (`1b8bdef`)
- The message embedding and FTS index stores now use `synchronous = NORMAL`, removing the per-commit disk sync from index writes. (`e5abcbc`)
- Reduced repeated work in the message index implementation. (`a063969`)

### `ryu-spaces`@0.5.0

[Published package](https://crates.io/crates/ryu-spaces/0.5.0)

#### Minor changes

- Made the chat-recall Spaces delegate forward hybrid and filter options into each Space it queries. (`970cfcc`)
- Spaces now store an optional ChunkingStrategy and per-chunk splitter metadata, with an FTS5 external-content index kept in sync by triggers behind BM25 ranking fused with vector or graph ranking by weighted RRF. Metadata filters are evaluated before ranking, hits can widen to neighbouring chunks or the whole document, and search_ext became search_with with default options. (`89d1da8`)
- Added index_unindexed_documents_in_space, which embeds one Space's pending imports without touching other Spaces. (`c558d57`)
- Added embed_texts support in the spaces crate for semantic page find. (`78e05ce`)

#### Patch changes

- The crate manifest was reconciled when origin/main was merged into the feature branch, keeping main's behaviour alongside the branch's file layout. (`1903ef3`)
- Updated the crate manifest as part of merging origin/main into the branch, carrying over the dependency security bumps. (`1438289`)
- Updated the crate manifest while merging main into the primary bot port branch. (`974ca98`)
- Refreshed dependencies and revised space backup, database query, history, retrieval and sealing code, including the seal tests. (`0af1456`)
- Upgraded the backup path to zip 9.1.0 with SimpleFileOptions and fallible entry names, using the pure-Rust zlib-rs deflate backend. (`9ea0295`)
- Sealing logic in the spaces crate was reconciled with the stricter variant kept, and the seal test suite was updated to match. (`21f287f`)
- Applied rustfmt to lib.rs. (`a95cb71`)
- Fixed backup and library code in the spaces crate and updated the sealing tests. (`1cc077c`)
- Updated the spaces crate library code as part of the audit remediation checkpoint. (`3a960fa`)
- Changed the spaces crate root and added a retrieval module for space-scoped retrieval. (`b1b04f3`)
- Changed Space retrieval and sealing so chunk metadata and OKF concept bodies are sealed and reads and writes go through the sealed stores. (`dac9704`)
- Sealed space data across backups, database queries and history, and added seal tests alongside the new seal module and manifest changes. (`07be026`)
- Reworked the spaces retrieval module and its public exports to support the new retrieval flow. (`3f09390`)
- Space retrieval chunk metadata now carries source and space_id, so filters such as {"source":"space"} match Space hits instead of dropping them all. (`83b52b6`)
- The spaces crate was updated in its database formula and library modules, along with its manifest. (`ddf18f0`)
- Spaces manifest, lib and database-formula module were resolved in favor of main's text with the rename reapplied. (`a01db11`)
- The merge updated the spaces manifest, the database formula module, and the crate root, reconciling the branch with main's review fixes. (`cdb7957`)
- The in-memory Space vector journal is now bounded: a write that takes a Space past the journal apply limit drops its state and journal rows, and a search drops the journals of evicted partitions. Writes to Spaces nobody searches no longer cost memory, and the next search reloads the Space once. (`354a79f`)
- Writes to a Space's vectors no longer discard the whole decrypted partition; TEMP triggers journal the chunk ids written while a partition is hydrated, and the next search opens only those vectors when the journal accounts for every generation bump, reloading otherwise. Full reloads now open vectors on a blocking thread, and a partition larger than the whole budget is not reopened until it shrinks. (`ecfdccc`)
- Moved spaces.db to the gated vacuum call, running compaction only after migration finishes and restoring MEMORY temp storage and the TEMP term-index triggers afterwards; added seal tests covering the behavior. (`a558edf`)
- Moved graph retrieval-mode rebuild staging into main-schema tables so it spills to disk, with leftovers dropped at open. The deferred startup VACUUM now runs only once every column is sealed, the legacy vec0 tables are gone, and both derived indexes are sorted. (`1781bac`)
- Spaces derived indexes now sort term-index and per-chunk graph rows by token value, rebuild rows written in plaintext order once using format markers, and drop the plaintext vec0 reindex staging table older builds could leave behind while marking the scrub owed. (`ac33adf`)
- History snapshots are now addressed by a blind-index HMAC rather than a plain SHA-256 of the page content. The migration moves rows stored under the legacy digest, repoints versions and flags the pending scrub. (`1df6544`)
- Deferred and post-migration VACUUM now run with temp_store=FILE so a large spaces.db is not copied into RAM, switching back to MEMORY for sealed reads. Graph-mode Spaces rebuild after a key adoption in bounded batches with a per-Space cursor, and plaintext .tmp restore staging files from older builds are deleted. (`6a29c46`)
- Spaces now records the root the blind tokens were computed under and, when it differs from the current root, recomputes equality tokens at open and rebuilds the term index and graph in a background migration. Term-index triggers that call ryu_terms were moved to per-connection TEMP triggers, and temp_store=MEMORY was set on every spaces.db and database-query connection. (`c4746cf`)
- Added tests covering sealed columns absent from the db and WAL, AAD row binding, legacy plaintext vectors and graph text migrating once, blind-token backlink resolution, sealed vector search, RYU-SF01 blob reads with truncation detection, the in-place blob sweep and sealed backup restore. (`ceb8385`)
- Sealed spaces.db free text per value under the content key through SQL functions on every connection, adding blind equality columns for titles, link titles and Space names, blind-token graph entities, a trigger-maintained term index, sealed embedding rows scored in the in-memory vector index, and write-once RYU-SF01 blobs. A background migration converts legacy vectors, graph rows, terms and columns, scrubs freed pages and seals blob files in place. (`2e5c6ac`)
- Added the ryu-crypto dependency so the crate is ready to seal content in phase 2. (`371898a`)
- SpaceStore backup and restore now operate on File handles so archives are streamed from owner-only staging rather than a temporary path. (`b14be1a`)
