- MCP OAuth consent now requests the challenge's scopes, then the resource's scopes, falling back to the authorization server's list only when the resource publishes none. (`db6dd78`)

- Made handoff git fixtures portable to Windows by dropping the verbatim path prefix for drive paths, building file:/// URLs and pinning core.autocrlf=false. Split the module into git_io, export, materialize and tests while re-exporting public items at the same paths. (`3377850`)
- Adjusted the source-history metacharacter test to avoid a pipe character in checkpoint filenames on Windows while retaining the remaining metacharacter coverage. Split source_history into sealed, git_history, storage and git_history_tests. (`aa2f019`)

- Source history now reports LegacyGit while a .git directory or working-tree copies remain beside a migrated store. Checkpoints can release several owners with a single collection per store, with tests covering both paths. (`f34953e`)
- The Git source-history import now treats only a path missing from the commit's tree as deleted; any other unreadable version stops the import and keeps .git, and migrate_and_report returns the state so Core can report a store left on Git. (`17b2d18`)
- A source-history .git that reappears after the migration is now imported before it is removed, with working-tree copies deleted first and .git last, and leftovers alone trigger the cleanup again. Tests were added in source_history/tests.rs. (`35780c7`)
- Stale checkpoint snapshots now get a fresh commit instead of reusing an unchanged HEAD, which had let the age cap drop a pin just recorded. Snapshot and restore can pin under the same lock, and a release drops the shadow index so gc can prune the released capture. (`dd5b18a`)
- Chat checkpoint snapshots became parentless commits kept alive by owner refs, so released conversations and snapshots past the age cap can be garbage-collected, a store with nothing left is deleted, and older chains remain under refs/ryu/legacy until they age out. (`f2287f6`)
- Source history moved from Git into files/source-history/history.db, storing the label as encb:v1 and the content as RYU-CB01 of zstd plaintext bound to (id, path), retaining 200 versions per path, importing and verifying a legacy Git repository on first use before deleting it, and continuing to serve from Git when free space is short. (`85bf73b`)

- Workspace checkpoints append credential-file patterns (.env*, *.pem, *.key, *.p12, *.pfx, SSH private keys, .npmrc, .netrc, .pgpass, credentials.json) to each store's info/exclude and drop those files from the shadow index even when the user's repository tracks them. (`b14be1a`)
- Source-history working-tree files are now written with 0600 permissions so sealed workflow definitions are not world-readable on disk. (`c7836fc`)
- The merge of #756 carried its fixes into the shared workspace code, touching the git helper in git.rs. (`064e1f6`)
- clone_public_repository now fails closed when an HTTPS clone by host name would be pinned with http.curloptResolve but the node's Git is older than 2.37 or its version is unknown, since older Git ignores the key and re-resolves the host. The pin is applied only to HTTPS URLs, the SSH residual is documented as accepted, and a parse_git_version test was added. (`1803d8c`)
- Remote git stdout and stderr are drained on reader threads and pulls run with --no-stat, so a large diffstat can no longer block git into a false timeout. (`d9eef76`)

#### Minor changes

- Updated the shadow server in the same change that introduced the Clips quick attach shortcut. (`7c04bdf`)

#### Patch changes

- Merged origin/main into the shadow crate, updating Cargo.lock, Cargo.toml, and the package manifest. (`1903ef3`)

The .env.example, README, package manifest, frame capture, passive capture modules for calendar, filesystem, git and settings, and the config tests were carried through the merge. (`1438289`)

- Merged origin/main into the shadow app, bringing changes to frame capture, the passive calendar, filesystem, git and settings capture modules, plus configuration and its tests. (`1b4b24f`)
- Keyframe extraction limits are now constants in capture/frames.rs with unchanged values. (`e76c49f`)
- Reworked capture paths for audio, input, screen and passive terminal monitoring, along with the capture engine and sealed database. Updated agent runtime and tools, memory, directive and semantic modules, intelligence context and meeting handling, OCR, mimicry procedures and the local server. (`0af1456`)
- Re-derived the standalone Cargo lock so the shadow build picks up the updated YAML and search dependencies. (`0c6c7a3`)
- Re-derived the shadow lockfile with the patched crate versions. (`9ea0295`)
- The shadow app's standalone Cargo.lock was re-derived to match the re-resolved dependency set. (`3970ebe`)
- Re-derived the standalone Cargo.lock through sync-standalone-locks.sh for wasmtime 48.0.7. (`f0bd07b`)
- Adjusted the agent prompt builder, runtime, the AX and memory tools, passive terminal capture, and the main entry point. (`1cc077c`)
- Updated rustls-webpki to 0.103.16 and webpki-roots to 1.0.10 in the shadow lockfile. (`0c10d21`)
- Updated the shadow app's Cargo.lock as part of merging the bot UI setup change from #782. (`d92c2d6`)
- Shadow gained a sealed database module and moved its capture, memory, OCR, pattern and video data onto it, with the paths module and server updated. Closed segments keep their capture time when sealed so the history window still applies. (`07be026`)
- Dropped key codes from input records on every platform via the shared ingest path and applied the Shadow challenge check in the agent runtime and prompt builder. (`784fd89`)
- Updated the shadow crate's capture engine and audio/clip capture, agent pattern handling, LoRA and model manager intelligence modules, configuration, paths, server, and entry point, with Cargo dependencies adjusted. (`ddf18f0`)
- Shadow's Rust capture, config, intelligence and server modules were updated for the Agent, Bot and OS rename and the Console naming. (`a01db11`)
- Touched the capture engine's audio and clip capture, the agent pattern and LoRA/model manager modules, and the config, path, and server wiring. (`cdb7957`)
- Regenerated the Shadow lockfile with the patched TLS and QUIC dependency versions. (`e98e55a`)
- Changed the passive terminal capture module and its build configuration, wiring the updated module into Shadow's entry point. (`b1093ab`)
- Hardened the Shadow terminal spool: history-excluded commands are no longer recorded in bash or zsh, hook steps fail quietly, and appends stop once the drainer PID is gone. Drains retire files before emitting, bound per-line and per-file reads, avoid losing appends that race the rename, and the Windows spool directory gets an owner-only ACL or capture stays off. (`cc492ed`)
- Terminal-capture hooks now append each command as a JSON line to a 0700 spool file under the data directory instead of POSTing to loopback /ingest with the shared API token; a Shadow thread drains the spool every two seconds and emits on track 9 at the command's own time. Also fixed the zsh hook to record the last command and dropped the per-prompt Start-Job from the PowerShell hook. (`b8a0dab`)
- Applied the security scan patches to the agent prompt builder and runtime, input capture and the Shadow server, including an exclusive owner-only token-file create and removal of the input-producing AX tools from the activity chat. (`8aa68aa`)
- A Shadow started by Core without a key on a store that was never sealed now keeps the pre-sealing plaintext formats, reports that it is waiting for a Ryu update, and is sealed by the existing migrations at the first start with a key. A sealed store, or a Shadow started by hand, still refuses writes without a key. (`6f02da2`)
- Merged the proactive and context intelligence modules and updated the crate's main and server entry points. (`b4f7dfd`)
- The shadow app now uses ghost_eyes::capture_scratch for raw capture frames, cleans crash orphans at startup and deletes frames left behind by earlier builds. (`8192eb1`)
- The capture engine now closes and seals an open screen-video segment on the wall clock rather than waiting for the next encoded frame. A segment is sealed once it is an hour old, has been idle for five minutes, or is open while recording is not allowed, and segment names now include seconds so multiple segments in one hour do not collide. (`4feed5f`)
- A stop request now closes capture before axum drains open connections, so a long SSE stream no longer delays sealing past Core's kill deadline, and a failed ffmpeg trailer still drops handles and seals the segment. Encoders register their open path so the media sweep skips only those and seals a dead process's recent leftovers at once. (`1345e30`)
- The microphone recorder now refuses to start unless Shadow can seal, buffers PCM in memory and writes each two-minute segment sealed and indexed instead of plaintext WAVs. Video segments only open when Shadow can seal, and stopping capture via /stop or SIGTERM closes and seals the open segment. (`7707012`)
- Agent pattern files are now written whole-body as encb:v1 through an owner-only temp file, and plaintext files from earlier builds are resealed when the store opens. On macOS, OCR frames now go to Shadow's 0700 scratch directory as 0600 files instead of system temp. (`7d575da`)
- Episodes, meeting summaries, semantic memory, directives, proactive suggestions and procedures now keep their text as encb:v1 under per-database stores of Shadow's key, with legacy rows sealed on open and text matching moved into Rust. Shadow captures its key before runtime start and reports sealing in /health. (`198809d`)
- Changed Shadow's path handling, server startup and video module to seal event logs, keyframes and closed media segments, and to sweep legacy or orphaned files at startup. (`0cd6d6d`)
- Shadow's main binary and server took the listener-ownership and port-check changes, and the intelligence context and proactive modules were updated alongside the crate manifest and lockfile. (`7494894`)
- Carried core into the standalone tree and added the dependency, refreshing the lockfile. (`371898a`)
- Updated Shadow's intelligence context and proactive modules along with its server and main entrypoint. (`e3a5e18`)
- Brought activity episodes and proactive suggestions into the retention sweep through new delete_before methods on EpisodeStore and ProactiveStore, pruned with the same cutoff hourly and after a retention change. The sweep now also finalizes abandoned open recording segments and rotates the writer's current hour when it was last written before the cutoff. (`a6a8b48`)
- The service now runs the history retention sweep at startup and then hourly, replacing the daily keyframe-only loop, and spawns a sweep right after /capture/control saves a retention change. (`e06b0af`)
- Shadow now creates its api-token exclusively at 0600 instead of writing and then changing permissions; the token stays plaintext because shell hooks read it. (`1f0b58b`)
- Shadow's /health endpoint now answers a challenge query with hex(HMAC-SHA256(token, ...)) over the supplied nonce, letting clients prove the listener before sending the bearer. (`dd3137e`)

### `Website (ryuhq.com)`@0.5.0

#### Minor changes

- Help articles, guides, blog posts, and legal and content pages exposed Copy Markdown and Open controls through a content page actions menu, pointing at each page's .md twin. The slug, blog, guide and help routes used the shared content page actions. (`1b53e69`)
- Replaced the desktop-style sidebar shell in personal settings with Link pill tabs in the portal header's context row and a large page heading in the content column. Added active-key mapping for `?tab=` and sub-routes, moved ProfileStatsTab into its own file, and updated the settings e2e harness to render the real header. (`a2d774a`)
- The home page latest updates section renders the shared featured layout with nine items, six as cards and three in a row, reading banners from records it already loads. The blog index uses the same layout and features six posts, with tests covering the latest-updates model. (`e5c2769`)
- Added background preset selection and an off state to the landing announcement bar. The admin page shows Live, Scheduled, Ended, Off or Not saved status with a visitor-facing note; off, scheduled and ended settings render no bar, failed reads fail closed, and the seasonal Halloween bar appears only when no settings were saved. (`2c6d1b5`)
- The email sign-in code page now auto-submits once all digits are entered, with a guard that prevents double sends while a request is in flight and holds back a rejected code until it changes. The password reset code step advances to the new password field at six digits, and the mailed-link reset form moved into legacy-reset-password.tsx. (`15ba298`)
- Swapped the redrawn ghost and house in the Witching Hour Open Graph art for the hero's artwork, adding a captured PNG of the costume ghost and porting the house, window and moon shapes. The URL line was removed from the card. (`6f4d97d`)
- Rebuilt the Witching Hour social card on the hero's layout and copy, with the stacked title, Update 0.5 seal, Halloween tagline and Summon a Ghost button on the left and the moon, ghost, bats and haunted house on the right. The scenery was split out into witching-hour-og-art.tsx to keep both files under the size limits. (`ab94dbc`)
- The NLWeb test was updated to follow the unversioned documentation paths. (`42f5593`)
- The landing announcement bar now renders one outlined, blinking Ryu ghost in the pumpkin tone instead of the moon and lucide ghost, drops the shining bottom border, and adds Anthropic (Claude for Startups) to the partner programs strip. The bar's tests and seasonal module CSS were updated to match. (`ecce4e4`)
- Guides, help and [slug] pages now share components/content/article-toc-layout.tsx: a sticky contents column beside the article on xl and an inline Contents disclosure below it, replacing the right-edge contents list and floating mobile sheet. (`35be110`)
- Added the /admin/landing-announcement editor, a shared contracts module with the icon set and link safety checks, a singleton model and /api/landing-announcement router with an anonymous live-only read, and a cached server-side read in the root layout that falls back to the seasonal Halloween bar. (`dc9972d`)
- Moved the unlisted marketing pages onto the landing hero and section pattern, led the Resources menu with a Plans group, replaced the hero gradient with a WebGL cloud sky with morning and night palettes, added sectioned explainers to /subscriptions and product pages, rebuilt /gifts and /gifts/redeem around a share card, and made stage heroes follow the light theme.
- The /platform "Also" line now reads the same hidden list as the header, dropping Agents as a Service and Red Teaming until their catalog.* launch flags open and disappearing entirely while both are hidden. (`70fde3b`)
- Homepage product cards now list the same products as the header's Products menu, adding Desktop, Skills, Marketplace, SDK, Core and Cloud first and flag-gated products later, each with a minimal catalogue-derived scene, and wide rows are balanced across rows of up to four. (`2c0ea40`)
- Blog, changelog, guide and help routes plus standalone pages such as /terms and /privacy gained colocated opengraph-image files that draw the page title and meta description in the shared card. Pages pass their config images through withFileOgImage so the file image wins, and leftover component tags and trailing section numbers were stripped from card copy. (`db5e7e1`)
- The site's default Open Graph card moved to the Spell Prism frame and now carries the site description. (`a6cc431`)
- The header Products menu, mobile nav, footer and /products index read one hidden-product list that includes the three default-off launch flags, and nav filtering also matches an item's /products/&lt;slug>. Product pages stay reachable by URL and in the sitemap. (`ca7bb4f`)
- The home page now server-renders a "Latest updates" strip that merges the newest blog posts and changelog releases, labelled by type with date and title and linking to /blog and /changelog. The page revalidates hourly so scheduled posts appear without a deploy. (`98da43e`)
- The web language picker sets the locale cookie and, when signed in, saves the locale to the account through Better Auth update-user, with server and client account-locale helpers and tests. (`73158e8`)
- Moved Pricing and Gift Ryu into a Plans group in the Resources menu, rebuilt /gifts on the marketing design system with a post-checkout share card and a ticket-style redeem page, split /subscriptions into scannable sections, and added product explainer blocks. Pricing header copy changed and the gift page was split into components under components/gifts/.
- Adopted effect 4.0.5 and added a server-only runOrNull helper with an import-boundary test. The core proxy was split into admission, caller, deadline and shared modules, pitch-stats and github-stargazers moved to Effect, the mail OpenAPI service was split into response and test-source modules, and the test script now runs isolated.
- The floating landing header now offsets itself by the announcement bar's published height and returns to the top once the bar scrolls away, the mobile bottom bar relies on the progressive blur instead of a solid surface, and product, plan and marketing pages pass the new card visuals through to the shared blocks.
- Wrapped the website layout and chrome in WebsiteI18nProvider. Added the provider component and a layout test covering the i18n setup. (`1087afc`)
- Split the pricing interactions end-to-end spec into shared helpers plus standalone, plans and surfaces specs, with a dedicated Playwright config for the suite. (`27c0cfc`)
- Updated the website i18n provider to use the official literal catalog loader after app overlays. (`de356ad`)
- Added a Witching Hour announcement bar above the header that links to /witching-hour and shows only from Oct 20 to Nov 1 on the visitor's clock, resolved after mount. The hero headline max width widened from 48rem to 88rem. (`da832ed`)
- Added the Datadog for Startups logo asset under the web app's public logos directory. (`ac0648c`)
- Removed the homepage desktop demo images and set the site theme to default to dark while keeping system and light selectable. (`3544013`)
- Wired the organization Safety map page and the admin traffic map to the summary route with a ten-second poll and a toolbar window selector, drawing per-layer and per-link counts, verdict category codes, and infrastructure health on the fleet map while showing no numbers for loading, missing, failed or denied states. (`4fe98a8`)
- Added a public appeal client and an appeals API client so an org can view and file an appeal from an emailed link, and updated the admin abuse actions and formatting to show appeal state. (`37b94dd`)
- The organization audit page now gives mail.inbox.create a human-readable label. (`29f73e3`)

- The abuse case page lists each detector signal with what it did and offers End action while one is in force, and the dismiss dialog says it ends the case's automatic actions. Formatting helpers and the abuse admin API client were updated alongside component and API tests. (`66ee21e`)
- The org Safety map wires the same drag-to-assign palette, and a new read-only /admin/traffic page renders the hosted fleet's layers and supporting services on the shared canvas with links to the owning consoles and no traffic totals, because the spec 07.3 cross-org summary endpoint does not exist yet. - Added admin-side formatting helpers and API bindings for the new abuse signals and cases. (`d4230ac`)
- Added the /organizations/[orgId]/guardrails page under Governance with a workspace client that names the step-up 403 as STEP_UP_REQUIRED, and linked it from the policies page. (`3e95dac`)
- Added admin abuse UI pieces for the approvals queue, shared formatting helpers and the admin abuse API client. (`980bed2`)
